I think this is actually my first yelp review but I was inspired to comment on my experiences here! 

A few months ago I dropped my new iPhone 4 and of course the screen cracked. I called around to find the best repair deal and settled on this place. Overall it was a pleasant experience and the one thing that particularly stood out to me was that they didn't try to sell me any products or services I didn't need (I'm very wary of that). 

Recently I cracked my phone again so I decided to bring it back since they did a good job there. In the past few months my proximity sensor had started to fail and eventually got to the point that it was barely working at all. I told them that and not only did they repair my screen, they took the time to realign and clean my proximity sensor cable for no charge! That fixed the problem and I couldn't be happier! They are really knowledgable there and do great work. 

Bottom line: the customer service is excellent and the work is great! If you need phone repairs this is definitely the place to go.

I first contacted Tammy in May of 2017 via email to ask a few questions when we were deciding to list our house. She was very approachable and helpful even before I was a client. She answered all of the questions and connected me with the right people. Once we decided to list the house Tammy guided us swiftly through the whole process. As a first time seller, I cannot thank her enough for her patience and flexibility. I am extremely satisfied with her outstanding service. If I ever decide to move back to TX, Tammy will be the first to know.

The last few times I've been to Portland I go to Blue Star Donuts instead of Voodoo Doughnuts! Blue Star Donuts are donuts for foodies and people who like more sophisticated flavors. My favorite is still the creme brulee with cointreau. They were out the last time I was there, so I tried some other flavors. They make an excellent buttermilk old fashioned. So when I saw they had a raspberry rosemary buttermilk old fashioned, I had to try it! OMG the raspberry rosemary was the winner that day. The raspberry rosemary flavor was nice and bright, just liked I thought it would be. The flavor starts with raspberry and ends with a light rosemary flavor on your tastebuds. I hope they have it next time! The 2nd favorite that day was the olive oil orange cake donut. It was really moist and had a delicate orange flavor. The 3rd one I tried was the blueberry bourbon basil. I gotta say, that was the least favorite of all their donuts I've tried. The glaze tasted like sugar more than anything and the flavors were really muted. Overall, that donut was just too sugary for me. Can't wait to go there again, (I'll be crossing my fingers that the creme brulee with cointreau  and raspberry rosemary buttermilk are available!)

If you're in Portland, Oregon, and you love buffalo wings, you need to go to "Fire on the Mountain"!! There are two locations in Portland, and both of them are a little away from the downtown area, but well worth the trip.

My favorite wings there, by far, are the Spicy Peanut wings. It's very similar to the Thai peanut sauce, and the wings are drenched in it!! If you really like hot spicy food, and daring enough, try the "El Jefe" wings... But fair warning, it's not for the faint of heart!! I love spicy food, but found these wings a little too spicy for my tastes!! I couldn't even finish a single one!! They have other food there (burgers, sandwiches, salads, etc.), but they are really known for their buffalo wings... Possibly the best in Portland!!

Amazing artists and AWESOME customer service! 
My friend and I were walk-ins and we were greeted immediately (unlike their competition around the corner)! The staff were all friendly and sociable and made us feel comfortable and safe. The first woman we talked to had a deathly hollows tattoo (so you know it's legit)! Jason gave me my tattoo and did a wonderful job. My friend get her first tattoo from somebody Garcia and she was thrilled with his art and service. 
Thank you to everyone there! I will be back!

This was a great breakfast option! You go through a line to put your order in to a computer. There are healthy options, such as an egg white scramble with chicken sausage and fruit (I ordered this for myself and my child). We were also able to order "the gray stuff" which is their hallmark cupcake. It's $4.99, but I think it's worth it! 
When you sit down there is a beverage spot where you can refill your fountain pop, hot cocoa, or coffee. They will bring you your kid beverages (juice boxes and chocolate milk), the service will bring your order to your seat with a pastry tray. We received a small blueberry muffin, chocolate muffin, cinnamon roll, and crescent roll with chocolate chips. You have to make a reservation but if you are on the dining plan at Disney, it's a quick service! Don't forget to go in the dark room, it's "the west wing" where the rose and beasts picture are! Very cool place with decent food!

Overall I had an excellent time at Tsujiri! The service was very friendly, and because we made a reservation we did not have to queue. 

We ordered several desserts: O-matcha Cake, Sakura parfait, Matcha and Kinako Daifuku and O-matcha Shaved Ice. Everything was beautifully constructed and executed. My favourite would definitely have to be the Shaved Ice. It was extremely refreshing without being too sweet and you have the option to have a twist (matcha and hojicha) ice cream to top it! 

We throughly enjoyed our desserts and we cannot wait to be back!

One of my top five favorite restaurants in Austin!

FOOD: For two people, we had five dishes and left feeling totally satisfied. Plates are shared and come out a few at a time. I'd say each dish is good to share among two to three people. If you have more, I would order multiples of the same dish. Each dish was impressive, beautifully presented and lick-the-plate tasty!

Grilled potato salad $6
Pretzels $6
Zucchini cake $6
Quail fried quail $12
Taco of the day (fried chicken skin) $7

DRINKS: Holy moly melon margarita! 

AMBIANCE: Modern, cool, casual. Great patio, even in the Texas summer.

SERVICE: Table service was spot on. I will note the hostess told us a 30-40 min. wait and it ended up only being like 10 minutes. There is only a smallish standing area in the front, but they do serve you drinks there. Otherwise you can go next door to Gibson and they'll text you when your table is ready.

PARKING: Free valet.

They just opened next to my work.  I had the lolipop burger which had mushrioms, grilled onion, arugala, cheese and aoili on it. This is a huge burger. Very flavorful and messy. The burgers come with a salad and potstickers.  My only complaint, when I got my burger back to the lunchroom the bottom bun was soggy from it sitting in all the juices. The gentleman working the counter was very friendly over the phone and when I picked up. I hope they do well in this location.

In my opinion, one of the best dining experiences in Boston. The décor is funky yet simple, and the setting is impossibly sexy. Excellent for a night out with the girls or a date. 

Two of us enjoyed a class of wine while one ordered a cocktail, the Caipi Porto, which was excellent. Reminiscent of a margarita but much more smooth.

We started with the charcuterie: Two cheeses, and two meats: Drunken Goat/6-Month Manchego and Jamón Serrano/Chicken Liver Mousse
My only complaint was that there was not nearly enough bread for the charcuterie... we actually had to forfeit most of the chicken liver. 

I'm obsessed with tapas-style restaurants... such a great way to try lots of new things! I cannot remember what the names of all the dishes were, but we had about 6 or so, including the Patatas Bravas (total crowd pleaser), the Roasted Bone Marrow (again, we needed something to spread it on), the shishito peppers (delish), Scallops served with blood orange and mustard greens, Shrimp, and some kind of Farm egg dish (it was sort of like a tangy egg salad with peas on a top-  This was my fave!). 

We didn't have room for desert, but I will certainly be back!

I've found "my bar". You know- the one with the best service, the best environment, and most importantly-the best IPA. Gigantic has quickly (and without shame) become a weekly spot for my boyfriend and I. We've gotten to know the staff quite well and enjoy trying their new releases; though the original IPA will always have my heart. This is a great spot for bringing friends together, which in my opinion, is the best part of drinking a cold one after a days work.

When I lived in BC as a teenager I tried bubble tea with friends and hated it. I couldn't understand why my Asian friends liked the awful stuff. I didn't try it again until a decade later. I'm not sure if my 10 year run ended with this place, but Green Leaf Natural Food definitely turned my distaste to near addiction. I don't get too experimental, I only drink the fresh fruit with coconut jelly (like mango-blueberry best). Compared to other places I've been, the bubble tea here is reasonably priced (I paid something like $7 at Moii Cafe for bubble tea!). The man that used be the one always there was nice, the younger women who are there aren't nearly as personable. If you haven't been here in awhile, they've renovated the place - clean and modern-looking, less of a hole-in-the-wall like before.

Lisza did an outstanding job hanging art, heavy mirrors and shelving at my new apartment.  She also quickly assembled a chair id been unable to figure out myself for months!  Lisza has an eye for detail and design - she was a great help with wear certain items should be hung.   Very efficient and neat too! I've added California Handy Girl to my contact list as Lisza is now my go to for such help!  She's a pleasure and I highly recommend!!

Yard house rules! Beer - yes, and plenty of choices. Large interior with seating options for all, outdoor seating in a front corner, and a large double sided bar for the real beer drinkers. We had such a friendly beer tender, Allison greeted us when we sat down and was fully engaged throughout. Her knowledge of the 120+ beers was very good, and she gave great suggestions to fit our desires and preferences. Samples were offered without question, and she also talked about local breweries that I would want to visit in the future. While there is a full food menu, we just snacked on the large onion ring tower with 2 different sauces. They went well with our beer choices. 
The beer options are what you want, from light to dark, there is nothing missed here. I was after red ale beers, loved a brown nut ale, and Alan enjoyed the IPA flight Allison set up for him. The beer menu can be overwhelming, so talk with the beer tenders, and they are sure to be helpful and friendly. We visit Orlando yearly, and found a regular place to enjoy.

So let me start this by saying I never complain . But I went for a visit today and was completely unhappy with my nails . Kristine took care of me and did such an amazing job . She did the nails I had done earlier by someone else and took the time and effort to make sure I was completely happy . My nails came out beautiful and the amazing customer  service she showed shoes how awesome they are . I will be back again! Thank you Kristine you're amazing

This is probably my most favorite place for tacos! They are so delicious and the atmosphere is amazing!  I work close by to Abuelos but live pretty far from them but when we crave for yummy tacos the drive is so worth it! We were there on a Saturday night and they had a mariachi band come out to entertain you just can't beat that! It can get crowded and the place is limited to space but those tacos are so worth it! We will definitely be coming back!

LOVE the Roseland Theater! Four of us went to our first concert there this past weekend and we all left feeling we had one of our best concert experiences ever. The acoustics were excellent and the atmosphere gives you the feeling of being in this cool, intimate club setting - a rarity in our decades of attending concerts between the four of us. 
 
I'm not one to write reviews but after reading all the negative reviews before attending the concert, I want to set the record straight. All the people I encountered working at the Roseland were professional and friendly. Yes, the building is definitely old but that's what gives it character - you can't help but imagine all the history and the great music that has gone on there over the years. And the biggest misconception is the facility is not clean. I'm easily grossed out by public restrooms but can attest that everything from the restrooms to the concert area was clean. I'm convinced that the negative reviewers' experiences are due far more to the crowds they're attending concerts with rather than a reflection of the Roseland Theater and its staff.

I just got this pizza yesterday based on the reviews and pictures I could just tell this pizza would be awesome! Honestly since moving to Portland I have been somewhat disappointed with the pizza I have had here and have yet to find my pizza place. My fiancé and I always go simple when first trying a pizza place, you don't want a bunch of toppings if you are really trying to taste the sauce and crust which let's face it is the most important part of a good pizza. So we got a pepperoni whole pie and with the first bite we both looked at each other and knew we found our pizza place. The sauce is so tangy and good! The crust from first bite to finish is delicious! I cannot wait until the next time we order from here again, it's truly so good and one of the best pizzas I have ever had.

Food/Value: 5 Stars
Service: 4 Stars

This is my go-to sushi spot in Boston/Cambridge. They have three locations in the area which makes it super convenient and I've actually been to all three. Believe it or not, the quality of each of the locations is about the same.

What I like most about Genki Ya are their rolls. They are absolutely delicious, well made with a decent ratio of filling to rice. Seaweed is fresh. Everything just gives a very clean feeling when I look at the plating to the construction of rolls that are really geometrically prepared unlike places which just put together the rolls as fast as they can.

Value is also key. As Damien has mentioned, this place is great for the quality and amount of sushi they give you! If you want someplace you can go to for all your sushi needs on a regular basis, Genki Ya won't break the bank.

Some of my favorite rolls in no particular order: Volcano roll, Doomsday Roll!!!, Hawaiian Roll. 

They also do the traditional appetizers and udon pretty well.

I'm going to give Papa's 5 stars, even though the entire experience didn't quite warrant it. My booking was last minute and secured via a cancellation as I was in a pinch with possession dates being pushed back multiple times. The whole process started off a bit rocky but was instantly turned around by the friendly and efficient crew that showed up on my door step. Papa's guys were awesome! They were experienced, careful, and put 110% into the move.  As mentioned earlier, the entire experience would have been perfect, minus some poor customer service from the head office. However I won't hold it against the guys doing the real work here. I would definitely hire these guys again, but think it might be time for someone to consider retirement.

We had the jumbo pie with meat only. The chunks of chicken were huge. We had peas and carrots on the side, which we just added in, as not everyone cares for veggies. Also served it with our own butternut squash and cran. sauce.  It was the tastiest store bought pot pie we have ever had.  I just got another one with veggies and will have it tomorrow, if I can wait that long. The crust was flaky and delicious.  As far as these reviews, I don't understand.  It was an incredible comfort food for a nice cold night.  Harrow's keep up the good work. I can understand why your business has been around for so many years.

I highly recommend TFC if you're going through fertility issues. I saw Dr. Silverberg and I love him! He is genuinely there to help you achieve your dream of having a baby. I originally saw my OB gyn and had a myomectomy surgery with him to remove uterine fibroids. My scar turned out awful! Dr. Silverberg ended up having to do a 2nd surgery, but this time more minor through laparoscopy and hysterscopy to remove access scar tissues, polyps, and somehow small endometriosis. I really wish I should have went straight to TFC and maybe only had to go through 1 surgery instead of 2. After I healed, I ended up getting a cyst. I was very heartbroken and discouraged, but Dr. Silverberg helped me through it and remained positive for me. He discouraged me having to go though IVF even after all of that, and told me I was healthy enough to try the least invasive procedure, which was 2 rounds of IUI 2 days in a row and injectable medication to produce at least 2 eggs. I got pregnant on the first try with 1 baby, and I couldn't be any happier. It had been a 2-3 year process of trying, and now I'm so excited for my new arrival coming in a month that I don't even think about the surgery or the hardship that I went through anymore. Everyone at TFC was so helpful and nice! They really know what they are doing. I realized they have steps for all the procedures for a specific reason, and they're goal is to get you pregnant with a healthy baby. I also meet Dr. Vaughn and Dr. Probes (not sure if I spelled that correctly) when my doctor was out, and they were both very nice and awesome as well!!!! Do yourself a favor and see them if you are having trouble getting pregnant. I'm 36 right now, and who would have known how many more years I would have waited to get pregnant if I didn't see them. I just wish I could have seen them sooner!

One of the best dinner experiences I've had in Austin. This place is not undeservingly overhyped. Not only was the food delicious, the service was amazing. Everyone was friendly and accommodating. Our waiter, John, was well knowledgeable in all the dishes and gave us great recommendations. We tried everything he suggested and was not disappointed. He suggested we end with the Foie Gras and even gave us complimentary wine to pair it with because he said it was the best to end the meal and he wasn't wrong. The waiters worked together and made sure our tables were cleared as soon as we were done eating and ready for the next one. Unlike other places I've been to, Uchi times their dishes perfectly. We hardly had to wait too long for our next course. My favorite was the Hotate which is spicy scallop and avocado. I highly recommend it to anyone who goes there. It had a powerful and delicious taste and had such an impression on us that we had to order more! I also really enjoyed the Lemon Gelato with pistachios and white balsamic.
It was definitely expensive but it was worth it and you can tell with the quality of the food. The rolls were good but if you're going to eat here I would focus on the other items on the menu.

Since my condo complex was clearing the parking garage for it's annual cleaning, I felt it was a good time to drop off my Jeep for a complete detail.  I was originally scheduled for an exterior package but after looking it over I decided the interior needed some TLC too.  

Ryan was able to accommodate the change.  After the detail was complete, Ryan walked the vehicle with me to make sure I was completely satisfied with the job.  

I am very pleased with the detail.  My 2014 Jeep looks factory fresh once again.  I can tell it wasn't just my impression as everyone I drove by on the way home stopped and stared!

Great job to Ryan and his team!  I will be back.

This Papa Gino's features a large and comfortable dinning atmosphere, the most inviting space I have yet to see out of a Papa Gino's. The facility is clean, quiet and well air conditioned, perfect for dinning in with a large gathering or a date night. Additionally this is one of the best staffed locations I've been to, someone was always there to take my order without hesitation. The line never even had a chance to form before someone chimed in to ask for an order. The food line was clean and organized much like the soda station was also. The food was delicious and expedient, much faster and fresher than many locations I've been to. The managers working the line are hard workers that maintain order and efficiency very well. The dedication and pride this staff has is remarkable. I promise I will be returning shortly.

We first tried Vintage a few months ago on the advice of a neighbor and almost immediately fell in love with this place. This restaurant is almost always packed after 6:30 and it gives off an incredibly positive vibe: people laughing, servers whirling about, gas lamps flickering and music churning out in the background. 
    The food is every bit the complement, and the reason, for the positive environment. Pizzas are Neapolitan with generous amounts of fresh toppings. We've also been digging the Caesar salads and pasta dishes lately, particularly the lasagna, which has just the right amount of kick from the spicy sausage.
    Some yelpers have complained about the service but in the 20+ times we've eaten here I really haven't had a problem. It does get very, very busy, so take that into account if it takes more than 5 minutes to get your drinks. Overall, we consider this to be one the brightest stones in a part of town that has many culinary gems. 

Note to Kara and Mario: please, please, please consider offering delivery service.

I love me some Home Slice Pizza!  After checking out a few places on SoCo, I had to get me a slice of pizza to go!  One slice of pepperoni with tax came out to $3.45.  I walked to my car and ate it before I even got home. 

Great tasting pizza, always hot and fresh, and great people working!

If you go to the take out spot or even at the restaurant you can see the cooks making the pizzas. They do not hide what they put on the pizza, or how they make it.  It's great! 

Try it out! Now go! Like right now, well not right now its 9:35 am go for lunch it will be awesome! I promise! 

Families - if you want to take your kids the restaurant has a play area in the back, it has a few games and a garden area where you can sit and enjoy a slice if the kiddos don't want to eat.  There isn't a full playscape or anything like that but it will keep them entertained for a few minutes while you eat your pizza and have a beer.

Very impressed with this salon!  I called yesterday afternoon, looking for a last minute appointment same day.  Since I'd never been there before, the receptionist took the time to ask several questions about my hair (length, texture, etc).  They were able to take me right away, I'm assuming because it was a random, rainy Tuesday afternoon!  

I LOVED my experience here.  Desiree took the time to ask lots of questions about my hair and lifestyle.  She did an amazing job with my hair and was so pleasant to work with.  I will definitely be back!

Went there two years ago and ended up getting a better deal somewhere else.  That first Charles Maund experience was pretty awful also.

But today was the opposite.  Charles Maund had the best deal for the new Rav4.  My sales rep Sony was amazing.  I told him what payments Im willing to make and how much I'm willing to pay for the RAV4.    Same thing with the finance manager Dave.   They tried their  best and were both very courteous and respectful.  They didn't try to bully or pressure me into taking their first or second or third offer which I respectfully declined.  End of the day, I am very happy I went to Charles Maund today.  I can tell you that I probably got the best deal for a RAV4 in the city today.   Thanks guys!!!

Outstanding Filipino food and modern cocktails in a comfortable, lively environment. Our server, Joe, was really informative and friendly, and all of his recommendations were spot-on. We went on Valentine's Day and they were utterly slammed, but all of the staff handled the crowds professionally and kindly, and everything arrived reasonably timely given how busy it was. They even put roses on all the tables. Everything was very good, but the pyanggang and mussels were excellent, as was the lychee martini. Try the balut! It's actually quite lovely... it's like a hard boiled egg, with the flavor of a rich chicken broth. And the halo halo is a perfect refreshing dessert for a hot summer day.

Ranju is AMAZING. She is fast, precise, kind, funny, and great at what she does. I go to her faithfully every 2 weeks to get my eyebrows done. She is gentle-- I've heard that sometimes people get cuts from aggressive threading-- never with her! She keeps my eyebrows looking natural yet tamed. The other staff members are great too, but I generally wait for my time with Ranju. Prices are reasonable, and the location in downtown is easy to find. Thank you Ranju for opening my eyes to threading! Go to Boston Threading!!!!

I really enjoyed my visit to this place. I had a European facial with microdermabrasion. The facial was nice and the space was very relaxing. Tallie was super nice and when informing me of deals she offered, she was not pushy at all, and made me feel very comfortable and welcome. 
I would return here absolutely. 
One suggestion I might make is that I would have appreciated a short discussion about my skin and my concerns. She just dove right in. Despite the lack of a pre-facial conversation, my skin looks and feels fabulous. 
Can't wait to return!

Came here today for brunch and it was so DELICIOUS! We basically got everything on the menu which featured local fresh berries today! We loved the burger with fresh strawberries and the blue berry pancakes!  We also tries the Brie and strawberry empanadas that both savory and sweet!  we sat at the bar and received great service from the bar tender, Toni, who made great recommendations on the menu and was helpful to explain all the fresh ingredients used in the drinks and the food.   Such a great experience, we will be back soon!!!

I love the Enzian!  It's a fun treat to go see an indie movie and have dinner or snacks. 
I recently went to see "can you ever forgive me?" With Melissa McCarthy. It was great. I don't get out to movies much but Enzian makes it worth putting my phone down for 90 minutes to 2 hours. 

I have tried a few different menu items recently grilled chicken melt and the chicken tenders! The tenders were absurdly good for a movie theater! 

It can be slightly annoying to see servers delivering food and dropping checks but overall the system works pretty smoothly with limited disruption. 

I love that they do weird cult classics occasionally too.

As a first time home buyer, my boyfriend and I definitely thought finding and purchasing a home would be a stressful and time consuming process. Not the case when you have an AMAZING team and realtor working with you. Jenn Swaney exceeded beyond expectations. She answered questions we wouldn't have even known to ask and kept us informed through the entire process. I couldn't have imagined it going any smoother. I will refer everyone I know and will continue to work with this team in the future!!!

We recently moved in this area and have been to S & S for Sunday brunch 4 weeks in a roll! This place is amazing and really love the dinning atmosphere. The first time we passed by was a late night. We just wanted to check it out and we told them we just moved. They were super friendly and recommended several restaurants nearby for us to try. We felt very welcomed!

Their "Brunch from the Grill" selection is delicious as well as almost all the omelettes. Roasted Salmon Hash and Eggs Oscar are also good options. I enjoyed their freshly pressed orange juice with my brunch too.

The dining experience is really pleasant and all the staff there is very friendly. Highly recommend!

I recently was charged with planning a work dinner for 20 people for a Team Celebration...fun right?  Well, kinda stressful when the group includes some executives who are picky on their food and wine because they can afford to be!  
What better way to say "I'm totally on your taste level guys, that's why I picked this GREAT restaurant"... and so I decided to give Bambara a shot in hopes of hosting the BEST DAMN TEAM DINNER ever.

Bambara has a limited menu for groups which only makes life easier!  Less time deciding, more time eating and drinking!  There was not a bad option either.  Just to make your mouth water a little, I'll let you know that I had the pea soup to start, then the steak frites, and it was fucking amazing and cooked perfectly.  
The wine list was impressive which really made everyone happy and of course we ordered the high-roller status bottles...no expense spared, keep em coming Bambara!!! (which the very attentive waiter did...I could just SEE the dollar signs in his eyes imaging the gratuity)
And who could forgot dessert??  The group menu comes with a few dessert trays for the table.  I wasn't expecting much from this... and then my world changed.  Have you EVER seen a whole Creme Brulee on a dessert tray? I haven't...and yet...there it was!!! Along with many other delectable goodies from their dessert menu.

Overall, a huge success with the crowd.  Thank you Bambara, for giving me that extra edge on my way up the ladder with your nice wines and classy food!  I will definitely keep this place in mind in the future for special occasions, dates, and the like.

The Folk Festival is held each year in June, and it is a truly magical event.  The festival itself is set up at Jericho Beach, and the entire area gets taken over by tents for the music, tents selling festival ware (souvenirs, food, music), but one of the most fantastic things about the Folk Festival is that much of the best action is free and takes place outside the fence of the festival grounds.  If you don't want to spend the money on the ticket, you can still hear the mainstage shows pretty clearly just by coming down to the beach and setting up.  You can relax, have a little beach barbeque, and listen to some great music all while watching the sun set over one of the very beautiful spots in Vancouver, and you can do this all for free!  Also available to both festival goers and non festival goers alike are the many, many stalls selling all kinds of wares that set up by the beach, just outside the festival grounds.  You'll find plenty of beaded jewelry, t-shirts, hemp ware, and many more hippie-ish items here.  This is a great weekend to get in touch with your inner hippie self, or you can just be yourself and enjoy the scene.

what a great place

for this type of bar, everything was (almost) perfect 

the place looks classy with a modern look without losing the bar feeling

service was fast and friendly (even if i had a Montreal Canadiens Tshirt...)

the food is incredible: the Philly Cheesesteak eggrolls... A-M-A-Z-I-N-G
potato skins, burgers, everything was good (ok i would like my burger bun toasted...)

we were there to watch my Habs lose against the Bruins... ambiance was nice, no heckling... (lots of tv too) nice older crowd (30+) the place becomes a live venue after

i loved the place so much that i came back the night after for late drinks!!

nice choice of beers at a very low price (avg 5.50 a pint)

u can bet i will be back when i come back to see the BoSox

continue the great work

fashion advice... i don't mind preppy looks, but beige pants, with a white shirt and a pink tie is NOT trendy!

I used to go to one of the top cosmetic dermatologists in Wellesley until a friend convinced me to try Dr. Mary and I have never looked back. She made me feel comfortable, just like two friends catching up. I never felt rushed or forced into something I really wasn't looking for. The first time I got Botox was with her (I've previously had fillers) and she made sure that I was comfortable and always telling me what she was doing. Eventually I went back for more fillers and she was always upfront with me on what I would need and what was really unnecessary. She always set my expectations to help men make the right choice. She is a perfectionist in that she enhances your natural beauty - I don't look "done" just well rested, fresh and youthful. The comments I receive are wow you look great not wow what work have you gotten done. My husband thinks I continue to look young all on my own! Also, her new space is great, very cozy feel, like you are going to a friends house for some tea (they offer CBD tea!). You will not be disappointed with Dr. Mary is is amazing!

My friend and I tried to get a table at Pok Pok on a Friday night and found the wait time was longer than an hour.  We didn't have the time to wait so she suggested we go to Thai Peacock.  I am so grateful for her suggestion for here we found thai food of the same caliber as Pok Pok but without the wait.  The ambiance is a little more of the "mom and pop" variety, but what matters to me most is the quality of the food a restaurant serves.

Thai Peacock's green papaya salad was absolutely delicious!  It had a great zip to it that was countered by the perfect amount of heat.  We also tried the deep fried Tilapia and the Pineapple Curry.  Both were done very well.  Portion size was large and we went home with plenty of leftovers to enjoy the next day.  Overall, the food was fresh and fantastic, and the prices were more than fair.  What's not to love?

Now that I've tried Thai Peacock it's going to be hard to get me to go back to Pok Pok...especially on a weekend!

I could have sworn I had written a review for this place?? Apparently not. 

So, the Whole Bowl is a vegan or vegetarian (your choice) meal of healthy but delicious beans, rice, sauce, cilantro, salsa, avocado, olives, and, if you want, cheese and sour cream. 

They keep it simple with a small menu and just two sizes. If you are really hungry you can add chips and a cookie. And they have a few drinks too. 

Service is fast and friendly. The owner works the cart himself and is very nice. I wish I lived/worked closer so I could go more often. 

Highly recommended.

We took advantage of the Magical Dining menu, however the main menu was quite tempting. the restaurant is simple and cute, The French Onion soup is to die for as was the zucchini and tomato tart. our beef was cooked perfectly, and our dessert, while delicious, left us wishing we had pAid the up charge to indulge in a Grand Mariner soufflé (when in France...).  Service was provided by Dino, who was attentive and charming.  All in all a perfect date night and a great deal.

Stopped by truck at JP farmers' market to get my daughter an apple vegan cupcake this week.  I noticed they had pies (6") for Thanksgiving and decided to get one of each (pecan, pumpkin and apple).  All I can say is WOW, WOW and WOW!  I am not one to typically gush over pie but these little treasures were absolutely perfect in every way.  I could have eaten the pecan pie all by myself.  The crusts on each pie were heavenly...flakey, buttery, melt in your mouth; the pecans were toasted to perfection and the filling...just the right amount of everything.  The pumpkin pie filling was so silky, my husband said it was hands-down the best pumpkin pie he ever tasted; and I have to say that the apple pie apples were cooked to perfection.

They are expert at matching colors.  Today, they matched a creamy yellow, almost white, and I know how difficult that was, since I'd had some fails at the big box stores trying to match it.   I do a lot of painting, and I love their customer service, and Ben Moore paint.  Sure, it's pricier than the big boxers, but it's totally worth it.  And,  it's a local business, which I prefer to support anyway.  They really go the extra mile to be helpful and their expertise is the real deal.

This is a great lounge with the trifecta- good good, good drinks and good entertainment! We prefer to eat here over the quick service or Boatwrights. Their wings are among my favorite at Disney. My favorite were the Himalayan Zing flavor at the Hangar Bar (Disney Springs), but they got rid of them! The burger is super tasty as is the charcuterie board. We also love the Loaded Potato Puffs! The highlight of this location is YeeHaw Bob who plays from around 8:45pm-midnight on select nights (he has a website- check to see if he is playing before you commit). Get there early to snag a table. Families start getting here around 7-7:30pm! Stake your claim- order some food and drinks and make a night of it! Speaking of drinks- everything we have had has been great. They have the standard fare offered at every resort plus some specialties- Hurricane, Sazerac, and Rum-a-Rita. Beer and wine is also available! Love this place and come here every time we stay, and sometimes when we don't!

Hop over here if you want to grab and go or sit diner style instead of at the regular restaurant next door. They have slices ready to go but you can also order full pizzas and other items here as well. 

Their slices here =  LARGE thin crust deliciousness. I went with their classic cheese which had just enough sauce to have flavor but not too much to make it floppy. Perfect for folding in half New York style. Dip all of this is their delicious home made ranch.

Boyfriend went for a sausage and garlic slice. I love that they had interesting combinations available for the daily slice option. He loved his choice!

You can smell this pizza the second you step a toe on south congress. I would definitely come here again when visiting Austin

I'm not a big meat eater but their seasoned mushroom sandwich with house-made vegan Russian dressing was stellar. Layers of "pastrami"-seasoned flavorful mushrooms piled onto perfectly toasted fresh rye bread and a creamy House-made Russian dressing with just the right amount of flavor and kick.

My friend ordered the beer cheese with toast which was to die for as well. I did manage to sneak a taste of my friends pastrami and I must say it was superb and a must-try for serious meat eaters who appreciate good food.

I'll be coming back here when I'm in Austin next time without a doubt!

I just moved to the neighborhood a week ago and luckily found these guys.  I have been there twice and am delighted with the menu and the service.  One of the owners, Sam, took us under his wing and talked us thru the menu, gave us samples of a few things and made sure we were happy.  There was enough food each time to take home enough for another meal!  I am not very adventurous, but I loved everything I tasted! And as a side note - they even met us at the door each time and held the door for us.  I will be a regular.

Fanny Bay is BOMB.COM.  On a recent trip to Vancouver, my friends and I made the 2 mile round trip trek (on foot!) from our place to eat here TWICE, and it was so worth it! The first day we ordered the oyster trio, which showcased three different types of oysters around the Vancouver area, squid ink pasta, kale ceasar salad, pork belly and scallops, and finally, clams and mussels with fries! Everything was so good, but my favorite was the kale ceasar salad and the clams/mussels.  The salad comes with pork belly bits instead of bread croutons and made the dish unforgettable!  Surprisingly, their fries were pretty good too, and was much better when you dipped them in the clam/mussel sauce.  Day 2, Mymy N. and I split the clams and mussels and kale salad, but we also ordered the clam chowder and the seafood chowder. The clam chowder was outstanding! Everything from the food, the staff and the ambiance of Fanny Bay is awesome! I want to make a return trip to Vancouver eventually and will likely be back in. Love this place!

PS. You can order a loaf of bread for $2. Definitely tasty as a starter, or to dip in your chowder and clam/mussel sauce. =]

I love this bakery! They have tons of different baked goods and even delicious Vietnamese sandwiches. 

Their coconut bread is delicious and well-worth the price. They had some fresh malasadas (though I'm not sure how authentic they are) so I tried one. 

As for their sandwiches, I tried the BBQ pork and really loved it! It also didn't hurt the wallet one bit so I was able to purchase a few more baked goods without feeling like I splurged too much. 

Note: They have a minimum of $5 for card chargers (I think, I can't quite remember now)

I'll definitely be back!

Gone are the days where you need to commute to NYC for the cutting edge in high quality artisan home goods--nestled in a converted industrial brick building, Artefact is a destination in and of itself. 

Artefact is also proof that doing what you love shows in the quality of your work: co-owners Sue and Maureen are as pleasant as they are knowledgable about everything home-related, from container gardens to metal work to sofa fabrics, these ladies are like the nicest walking encyclopedias you have ever met! (with a standout aesthetic eye that makes the store feel more like a slice of heaven than a shop). Each product is thoughtfully hand selected and the attention to detail is apparent from the moment you enter. The only complaint I have is that I struggle to stay away--visit once and you're almost guaranteed to be a devoted customer.

I don't even know where to begin. That's how happy I am with my hair . My hair stylist was Angelina & not enough words describe how much of a fantastic job she did with my hair . I walked in with an idea of what I wanted and she gave me something even better . The atmosphere is very modern and their employees are very nice and welcoming . There are not enough stars to rate my experience here and I can't wait to come back. Thank you guys for a great experience and thank you Angelina for doing such a wonderful job! Your creativity and professionalism does not go unnoticed !!

This is Disney's first time share resort. You can book this on a pay per night basis as well. The resort is beautiful, it is laid out with a golf course running through it. There are four different sizes of apartments available, studio, 1 bedroom, 2 bedroom and grand villa. The prices start at $295 a night, for cash payers. We own at this site and can stay here when we come over to Orlando for free. There are 3 small pools and 1 large pool with a feature slide. There is a great resturant, shop, gym, snack bars and much more. They have daily entertainment for the kids in the common room. There is also DVD, bike, skurry and boat rental. In the main house there is a relaxing library called Papa's Den where you can unwind. We have visited at all different times of the year and even though it is the busiest Christmas is one of the nicest times. This resort has the largest accommadation in Disney and spread out on the largest plot. All the buildings are 2 or 3 floors high and you can park outside your own building. The staff are great and really enjoy their jobs. You can catch a Disney bus to the parks, a boat to Downtown Disney or drive your self around. Staying in a Disney property means that you won't be paying parking fees. This has to be the best resort in Disney.

Paragon Tea Room is tucked on Cambie Street, sharing a spacious area with Porto Cafe. Michelle Cheung, the owner of Paragon Tea Room, wants to provide a different experience for all tea drinkers. She believes Tea'spresso can also make a cup of tea as strong as a cup of espresso that can generate enough energy to go through your day. Using the Tea'spresso machines and premium tea leaves, they can craft a cup of tea, with enriched aroma, flavor, and aftertaste, in no time. 

I ordered a cup of Oolong Tea Misto, recommended by Michelle. And I love it. It is my first tea trying tea'spresso, and I am shocked by how flavourful the tea, even with a splash of hot milk. The layers between the tea and milk are beautiful as if you are trying a cappuccino but in tea form. 

Michelle also recommends trying the Oolong Tea Misto with Oat Milk, which becomes a new trend in the milk family because it is more nutritious, with less fat. Compared to real milk, the flavor is a bit reminiscent of how milk tastes after cereal sit in it for a while. It is a popular dairy-free, vegan-friendly milk substitute. I tried the drink cold instead, and I love it. It doesn't have a strong milk flavor, but its creamy texture lends itself well in the drink. I can also taste a touch of sweetness, which is perfect in an oolong tea misto. As a person who loves her skimmed milk, I think I might start trying oat milk from now on!

Overall Impression

When you pass by this area, make sure to also go and try a cup of tea'spresso from Paragon Tea Room. Many tried and they did not disappoint. It is such an innovative concept, which allows customers to get a better alternative to have their caffeine intake.

Taste : 5/5 * Service: 5/5 * Ambiance: 4.5/5 * Quality-Price: 5/5

Their name says it all. It's so much more. 
After a miserable experience at Garden of Eden (avoid)
we walked down to Picco
To my dismay (not enough research)-the epiphany: we could have had lunch here instead!

A haven of deliciousness. Crispy crusts that snap with just the right amount of smoky nutty chewy flavor. End the meal with decadent heapings of creamy ice cream and homemade candies and toppings. stand out flavors are coffee-toffee ice cream which kept me up all night and a classic vanilla, raspberry gelatos homemade fudge and nuts on the side for the sundaes. WOW! Friendly and accommodating staff, seated us quickly and adjusted for an extra 2 people including a 3 year old.
Space was modern, w/ long red curtains (perhaps for draft control?)
they make all their own candy that's added to the ice cream. Parking
was easy on sunday@lunch

Is it wrong to love a chicken?      
Not when it's coated in some awesome breading that keeps the chicken nice and juicy and served with a side of fried green tomatoes. This is some of the best fried chicken I've had in a long time. The service there is super nice and friendly. I sat by the counter and had a good meal with pleasant conversations with the staff. Finished it off and finished it off with a chocolate pie with vanilla ice cream with was like silk.

Atmosphere:  large and it gets busy during the brunch period so expect a wait and be patient. We waited 40 minutes but we went in reading the other reviews beforehand, therefore, we were prepared for that. 

price: market value. 

customer service: friendly enough. they did seem a bit under staffed as another yelper pointed out as they're still trying to work out their expansion which is a good problem as we want businesses in the city to succeed. this is more of an observation not a points deduction. 

food: I had the short stack and poached eggs. the eggs were made to order short stack is what you would expect.

In love with their empanadas. I've tried every hole in the wall Cuban place in Orlando and cannot get enough of Black Bean Deli. If you're impatient, I wouldn't recommend going during lunch hours. The line tends to be long. I say this as a warning but more because I love Black Bean Deli so much that I wouldn't want them to get a poor rating due to standing in line for too long. The lunch platters are great, my favorite are both pork dishes that they serve (only on certain days of the week)

Rudolfo brought my hair back to life! I've been receiving compliments on my hair since I have been seeing him.


I've been choosy about hair stylist (I've only had 4 faithful stylists from the age of 5 until adulthood).  My previous stylist, before Rudolfo, moved and I was left to do my hair myself for about 6 months.  I was use to getting my hair done atleast every 5 weeks.  I found Rudolfo on YELP last year and I have been coming to him ever since!

Rudolfo suggested I use a different relaxer which made a world of difference.  He also uses shampoos and conditioners where you can feel the magic working.  Rudolfo provides quality, affordable hair maintenance and style...that's why I've changed my salon visits from 5 weeks to every 2 weeks!  He is ssooo worth coming to faithfully. 

When I'm under the hair dryer watching Rudolfo do his other client's hair, they all come out looking amazing!  Rudolfo is very talented and I feel he can do anyone's hair: long or short, thick or thin, curly or straight.

Dr. Howard and his staff are amazing and so super sweet! We had gone to him before we moved away and recently moved back and he was so warm to welcome us back. Our children LOVE everyone in the office, too! It is exactly the kind of place you want to have your children go for dental treatments. The attitude of the doctor and staff is top notch, and they really take a lot of time to talk to you and your children. A+++++ for Dr. Howard and team!

I've been going to this DQ since I was a little kid, used to walk over there after school in HS and now I'm taking my summer camp kids there for treats! I've never been disappointed by any of the food there, and my stomach is a little picky about "fast food" quality, and as a family owned and operated restaurant, the service is great and always has been. 

Now that I work for a summer camp and we take the kids there, I've been even more impressed with their efficiency and customer service. The smallest group we've taken was 30 including counselors and it's never taken more than 15 minutes to get everyone's ice cream, pay, and be seated! They also will make up a tray full of waters for the kids to drink since they know we won't buy them soda. 

Whether you're going there just you, you and a friend, or with a large group I highly recommend it-- besides, how can you go wrong with DQ ice cream?!

I might be in the minority, but I preferred Wiz Bang Bar over the original Salt and Straw.  I like soft serve ice creams that are lighter, more refreshing than rich, heavy ice cream, so maybe that has to do with my preference.

I got the salted caramel with chocolate dipping on a waffle cone, and it was delicious!  Right amount of sweetness, richness, and I loved the crunchy chocolate shell.  The wait wasn't long at all when we went around 3pm on a weekday.

I know Salt and Straw made its way to LA, so maybe Wiz Bang Bar will be opening one in LA soon as well?  One can hope!

This is only the 2nd Indian restaurant that I have been to and it is definitely my favorite! 

They have a great happy hour from 5 - 7 PM with 1/2 off appetizers and 
$1.00 off all beers, $3.00 well drinks. Best of all they have a gluten free beer! 

The food is fantastic, I especially love the saag mushroom! I think I might be a wuss when it comes to Indian spices because I can't handle even one star! I always ask for no stars when I order and they look at me funny, but anything one star or higher gives me crazy hiccups! My husband on the other hand always gets his food with 5 stars and even then it's not spicy enough for him so he has to ask for extra spice. 
For an appetizer we usually get the assorted vegetable platter and everything on it is so delicious! Since going gluten free I've had to give up nan, but when I did eat it we would always go for the garlic nan, it's fantastic! As for drinks, I LOVE mango so I always get the mango splash. 

I'm sure the desserts are great too, but we're always so full that we can't even think of dessert.

We stumbled on this place when looking for   good place to eat in the north end without a crazy wait and not overcrowded. We also were looking for a vegetarian friendly place as one person in our party was vegetarian. This place was perfect! So many delicious pastas. They also have a prix fixe menu for $35 for three courses which seems like an amazing deal, but we ended up not doing that since we were all sharing appetizers and entrees. We got 2 appetizers : the ricotta fritters and the asparagus one. Both excellent. Our entrees were the lobster ravioli, pumpkin ravioli, chicken masala- all delicious. Perfect portion sizes. Save room for dessert! The flourless chocolate torte is to die for!! Bread pudding, creme brulee and tiramisu were great too. We shared a bottled of the sanghiovese which was perfect with our food. We will definitely be back! They have a brunch menu that I can't wait to try.

We have Scott-Willams as our oil company for the past 10 or so years.  It was the same company the previous owners of the home used.  They have been excellent.  We enrolled in the auto-delivery and we used the payment option of paying what you use.  The owner was very nice and always responds to any question by email or when we call them.  We saw that our oil was low one time and called them to fill and they were at our property the next day.  I don't know how they get negative reviews we didn't have any of the same issues.

We recently had a tech tell us that our furnace was get close to needing to be replaced.  I asked Scott Williams to give us an estimate and it was very reasonible compared to all other company I researched before I agreed to give them the job.  When they came out to perform the install everyone showed up in masked and safety is number one right now.  They showed up a bit early but on time and finished the job in one day.  When they left everything was clean and professionally done.  Scott Williams also helped up apply for an additional rebate for the furnace and indirect heating tank replacement to be applied to our account for us through there company.  We do get a discount through our town for the replacement and every discount is a plus.

As a young homeowner, the thought of refinancing was unfamiliar and daunting, but I kept hearing about how rates were at historical lows and decided to find out more. I'm so happy I came great reviews for RMS & Elisa Balboni.

From the first call, Elisa & the folks at RMS managed the entire process. Not only was I able to get a great deal, but Elisa was great at answering my many questions. Refinancing is a rather lengthy process, but she helped me stay on top of the countless documents and steps along the way. Choosing RMS to do my refinance has been one of the best decisions of my adult life.

Thanks Elisa & RMS - keep up the great work!

Estragon is a bit off the beaten path, and thus not so busy as Toro, Kava, Copa, etc. That said, it rocks. The team at Estragon is fantastic, and the toasts, oh my. So after you bail on the 2hr wait at Toro or the 40 min wait at Kava, head down East Brookline St to Harrison and fall in love with the wonderful people and great food at this classic tapas place. You'll end up hugging your waitstaff and hoping to do the same to the chef! P.S. If you are gluten free or paleo, as for the toasts w/o the toast. My fav!

My favorite ride of all at Epcot. I have done both green and orange. Here are the differences:

Green:  much less intense and you do not feel G forces.  You still feel it and it's definitely worth a try. If you weather the green OK, you can easily try the orange which is more intense and I would imagine it feels like being on a real rocket.

Orange:  sickness bags are provided.  You will absolutely be pinned to your seat feeling as if you've just taken off on the space shuttle or some crazy rocket for the next minute or so. It is absolutely amazing.

My best advice to you when you take this is do not eat lunch or breakfast right before. Just have a nice stable empty stomach. Many people feel off-balance for sometime after they get off this ride. I was one of those people. I will only do the green from now on however, if you have not tried it, you should. I am a huge wuss when it comes to riding anything like a roller coaster or anything like that but this was fantastic! Highly recommend!

My favorite Mexican food in town. Eat here about once a week. Great Margaritas (which are a requirement). Try the combo plate with margarita sauce for enchiladas and a steak taco. The wait staff is great, same people for years. Dark red salsa and escabeche (SP?) on salsa bar is amazing, Don't miss it. 

If you need something fancy - don't come to Polvos (please) and certainly don't complain about it. 

It is so annoying when people move to Austin from other places and complaining about the style and character than makes Austin Austin, If LA or Chicago or New York are so great.. don't move here.

Polvos is what it is - South Austin. 
:-)

Dr. Craft is a fantastic dentist.  I highly recommend her for her friendly competence, professionalism, and chair-side manner.  I have visited her twice: once for a cleaning and tooth chip repair, and once for the removal of a tooth per my orthodontist.  She does a terrific job on everything.

This office on Airport and 38th 1/2 Street is centrally located and easy to find.  Don't be put off that it's surrounded by payday loan shops -- it's right by Mueller and they're getting a head start on improving the area.  The staff is excellent and friendly.  Rose processed my insurance with no problems whatsoever, and she even was very helpful getting my dental records transferred.

**UPDATE JULY 2014**
Dr. Craft has moved on to a different office in Cedar Park, but I had to update my review because I still love Airport Dental.  Dr. Walton is friendly and a wonderful dentist, and the rest of the staff is just amazing.  Now that I've dropped my dental insurance (my chompers are fine, so I decided to try a year of paying for cleanings out of pocket), there's nobody I'd rather give my hard-earned dollars to go see. Trading a few greenbacks for pearly whites is a great investment!

Had the lobster roll and clam chowder yesterday at around 11 30 am, then at 4 was craving them again! So we found another place and got those two things. That second place was ok, but Luke's ruined my ability to enjoy 'ok' lobster rolls. So came back today after a wedding ceremony and got myself yet another amazing lobster roll. 
Why I liked Luke's so much was because of the bun! It is buttery and crispy on the outside. Not to mention the lobster chunks. So good!
Staff is friendly and place is nice. I would definitely recommend to everyone.

I am so happy to have found Lamberts...and it is right in my hood! After recently moving to Boston, a friend recommended I go to Lamberts for my fruit and veg. What a tip! I went yesterday (Memorial Day) to find a gorgeous outside nursery greeted me and once I walked inside a lush fruit garden that almost sent me into cardiac arrest when I saw how low the prices were. Goodbye Stop and Shop, hello Lamberts! The place is small in size, however big on variety. They have unique cheeses, import foods, a wonderful butcher shop, and much more. Very friendly staff! I am a customer for life.

This is what a neighborhood cafe in Portland is all about! They serve standard cafe fare (sandwiches, salad, etc.), but the quality is what puts this place above the rest. When possible, they use local ingredients and herbs from their own herb garden. I know this because the owner is very hands on and will sit and talk with patrons as they come in. He also makes every effort to remember the names of those who come in. I have been there three times and he was calling me by name on my second visit, as well as my wife and son. 

They have a good selection of local microbrews and wines availabe as well as local coffee. There is an outdoor seating area that has a "kid's size" table and chairs, which makes this a good destination for parents. As a parent, a major selling point was a kid's menu WITHOUT fried chicken strips. In fact, all the kid's sandwiches are served on nutrient-packed Dave's Killer Bread. For the picky eaters, the staff will put together a "grazing plate" that can include a variety of whatever the kiddo may want to eat. 

For the quality of food, the price is right as well. To say I am a fan of this place would be an understatement. Again, this is what a cafe should be! If you're in the neighborhood, I would suggest walking or riding a bike as the parking lot is small.

Not only is the food FANTASTIC, the service here is so great and friendly! These guys are never intimidated by big groups, and no matter how busy it is I've always found a place to sit (unless rain closes the patio, but that's nobody's fault). The line can get long on the weekends as some big groups meet there in the mornings, but it's worth it. Always take the cashier's suggestions, they know what's up. I usually get the garden taco (black beans, sauteed mushrooms and spinach) and have started adding potatoes to it at a server's suggestion to soak up some of the extra juice. Genius! They'll also go out of the way to get you everything you need, even though it's set up as an order-at-the-counter restaurant. Salsa? Napkins? Utensils? They're on it! Thanks for always being so helpful and cheery Tamale House!

Jeff and I met when we got thrown together on a co-ed softball team. He ended up being our team manager. He cares about our team and makes sure every thing is taken care of. I quickly noticed this about him. He's the type of guy who can't ignore loose ends. He's the type of guy you would want managing the biggest financial decision you'll ever make! And the icing on the cake is: He'll give you a REBATE!!!

After handing over the largest amount of money I may ever have to hand over, Jeff handing a significant portion of it back felt Awesome! Just when I found the perfect couch and love seat!

Jeff was accessible, helpful, and most of all, honest. He told me what to be worried about and what probably wouldn't be an issue-- which for a new homebuyer, was a relief to put my trust in someone with so much experience. He had an excellent pool of resources and referrals, but wasn't at all pushy about it. It was nice to grab a bite and a beer with Jeff and casually talk about what I wanted in a house. He let me know that I was a priority and clearly set deadlines for himself and myself, and made sure that we made our goals. In fact, I know that he worked well into a Saturday night in order to get our proposal into the Sellers. 

Did I mention REBATE? When's the last time someone paid you to use their services? Um, I can't think of any...

Spectacular!!

Been waiting forever to stop by at L'Abattoir and finally squeezed in a reservation Friday night. I was a huge PITA and shuffled around my reservation and they amazingly juggled reservations around to accommodate.

Clean decor, great cocktail list and a decent selection of wines. Did I mention great cocktail list??!?!!

Bacon brioche - reminiscent of the ones from Joel Robuchon's over the top bread cart

Poached egg and brocoli, pasta, pecorino sabayon - simple enough ingredients, execution speaks huge about the reserves of talent the chef possess.

Steelhead and crunchy potato salad - Damn right the potato is perfectly crunchy, steelhead perfectly cooked, moist, velvety, almost a smoked salmon texture, the night is definitely heading in the right direction.

Loin of rabbit - Poor rabbit had its loins cut out and stuffed with its leg meat, wrapped in bacon and served on its favorite diet of silky smooth carrot puree. Pickled radishes  and baby brussel sprouts (I detest brussel sprouts, these had no bitterness to them and were delightful little gems) complimented the dish amazingly. 

Roast scallops and potato gnocchi with chestnuts, mushrooms, celeriac - Light sear on scallops, delicately cooked, perfect sweetness.

Trifle with berries - I loved the bitter chocolate used in this, how it refreshed the palette with the citrus curd and slight bitterness from the chocolate and rum to finish the meal off.

In all, it was an amazing meal, a great testament to the chef's attention in placing wonderful ingredients that brings together great dishes and still execute each and every component to perfection.

The most compliments from our wedding was in regards to the food! People were raving over Courtney's catering and I couldn't agree more. The food is 5 stars yet affordable. I was beyond impressed (so were my guests) with the quality of food for 260 guests. Their customer service was great and very responsive. Everyone was full and satisfied. We had the salmon with lobster sauce and chicken with garlic cream sauce and it was out of this world. No complaints here. Highly recommend Courtney's Catering to everyone.

Wow.  My girlfriend and I booked more or less back-to-back appointments with Laura -- we'd never been before but heard good reviews.  This place has a great down to earth community feel, and Laura has a no-nonsense friendly and also down to earth attitude.  The first thing she said when I showed her a picture of the haircut I wanted was "You're ok with short, right? You won't cry or anything?" 

My gf and I left a few hours later feeling like superstars.  She has long hair, mine was a short cut, and Laura did a super job on both.  Also, as for the short cut, I have a hard time getting stylists to understand the "I'm not super butch but please don't compensate by trying to make me ultra femme." Laura understood instantly. 

Also, the price was wayyyyy affordable.  Laura could probably charge double with her care and precision -- (but don't get any ideas, Laura.... then you'd miss out on all the hip young poor folks like me)

I'll be schlepping down from Somverville every few months from now on.

I came into Wig Villa Orlando on 2/26/19, on suggestion from my Hairdresser who did some research before finding this place for me to check out wigs. The lady working there was wonderful. I have never worn a wig. I had many questions and she was extremely helpful with info and the answers she gave me. This store has a great variety of wigs that look natural, some made of human hair, even the synthetic ones look great. Based on my positive experience, I plan to buy my wig from Wig Villa Orlando.

We had a group of 5 people in town for a business retreat and Joy designed some excellent workouts for us each morning.  Joy has a warm demeanor and she was very accommodating for the different levels of fitness that we had in our crew.  She made the workouts fun and sought input for how she could further tailor them to our needs.  She brings great energy and is motivational without coming off like a drill sergeant.  I would highly recommend Joy for a group or individual workouts.

One of the best brunches I had in along time. Try anyone of their margaritas! We had the big french toast and the tres quesos omelette. Portions are big and every did had an interesting kick to it. Definitely not boring flavors. The mango quacamole comes with warm chips. 

I love the design of the place and can't wait to try their sister restaurant down the street Posto. Prices are reasonable. This is my new favorite brunch spot! 

Service was mediocre. Our waitress came only once, about 40min after our food was dropped on our table to ask if we needed anything else or wanted another drink. She was polite, but neglectful. The restaurant was only half full. 

Get a seat by the open window. 

So happy with the new design/layout of the place. Definitely flows much better now.

Jennifer is so great! She is super friendly and sweet. She's so great with dresses. She fixed so many pieces of my prom dress and made it look so beautiful and excellent. i can even explain how much i'm happy that she did in such short notice too. I went to her Sunday and got it done by today (Wednesday). I am definitely going to recommend Jennifer to everyone who needs a prom dress or wedding dress alteration. Thank you again Jennifer!!!

I've loved Sushiko from day one. The first time I went to it, I researched "the best sushi in Columbus" and found that their prices for the portions couldn't be beaten. I traveled 30 minutes just to take a chance on getting some amazing sushi and they did not disappoint.

They had sushi Tuesday's and Thursday's for a while, but they eventually cut out the Thursday's. Still, I choose to go on the days that are NOT half priced.

I have found, consistently, that the fish is fresher, the avocado isn't browning, the entire sushi dish is much more presentable and tasty. I feel like the chefs rush because of how busy those days are. Possibly they are trying to move older product?

Whatever the case may be, I still hands down vote this as my favorite sushi restaurant and will continue to devour until I burst.

I have been skiing for about 15 years and have never had such a knowledgeable staff help me find my gear. This is not a store where you walk in and feel like you have to buy everything they suggest or where they throw worthless additional gear at you just to increase the sale. I walked in and told them what I was looking for and they followed up by asking tons of questions in order to help me buy the perfect pair of boots for my level and my skis. I will definitely buy all my future ski hardware here.

I was introduced to Boston's Fish House by some friends who know my standards. It's true, first timers will feel out of place. You'll wait in a line that doesn't feel like it's moving. It's worth it. The menu isn't pretty, and the food presentation is just okay, but the taste and quality is there. The service makes you feel like you're in a small town -- it's exceptional. The staff are on-top of every need you have -- as my friends reminded me of my high standards.

They seem to have things down to a science. Typically with fast-casual restaurants, I avoid appetizers because they usually come out with the food. They actually pace your experience. Drinks, appetizers, then entrees.

Try the food without sauces first. The fried shrimp and fish breading is very light and airy. Then add on their signature tarter and/or cocktail sauces, and enjoy.

We ordered the fried pickles to share, my friends thought they were really good, though I felt the batter wasn't adhering to the pickles well enough and they were a tad too salty. Neither which stopped me from eating them though.

BIG Portions -- Lunch is enough for a hungry man's dinner, and 2 people could easily share a dinner portion with some to spare.

Every time I've been, I've noticed the crowd is typically older (55+), with a few younger folks here and there. Sometimes I find it refreshing as fewer younger folks typically means cleaner language and behaved children (if any). I'm 31.

Some minor decor changes might make things pop better -- flooring (peal and stick laminate perhaps) and seat/booth cushions. While most of the staff don't wear matching attire, or aprons, they're easily spotted -- if they don't spot your need before you.

We chose Your Personal Ceremony based on Yelp reviews and their website. My husband and I wanted a ceremony that represented what we believe love it and honored our cultural traditions. Joanie was fantastic. She suggested a general outline for our ceremony and helped us choose cultural wedding traditions that fit well together. She suggested readings and helped gather the needed supplies for the ceremony (cord for handfasting, cup for Anam Cara, etc). She was extremely organized and punctual. We had our wedding ceremony finalized 3 months before the date itself, which reduced stress significantly. She helped lead our bridal party through the readings and various traditions. In the end, we had a very unique and very memorable ceremony involving the people we love most with little to no stress. I would certainly choose Your Personal Ceremony again.

Although we live less than a mile away, some how we had never heard of this little joint. We went as a group of 4 around 10:30 today (Sunday) and we just beat the rush even though it was raining. The inside is decked out in all old school tables and chairs and decor and they had a little waiting area with a bunch of old ovens where you could hang and get a coffee while you waited. As for food - super good! We all got something different. I went halfsies with my roommate on the Mexicali Omelet with
home fries and a biscuit, and he got the PB&J goes to France (basically flat top fried PB&J. Our table also got the Gingerbread Waffles with lemon curd and the Mediterranean scramble. Everything was very good. The biscuits were large and super fluffy. My Mexicali was like a breakfast burrito but inside eggs and the cilantro on it was a fresh touch. I'm not a huge home fries fan so I won't comment on those. The PB&J had the perfect balance of PB and Jelly - neither too overpowering. The Gingerbread waffles made us feel like to was Christmas in August but without the lemon curd to accompany it, the texture would have been a bit dry - what do you expect? - it's gingerbread! The other two scrambles also seemed appetizing as all of our plates were empty by the end of the meal. Cash only so just remember that before you come but they do have an ATM if you forget. Parking out back which could tight if it's busy. The entire staff was very nice and well organized and always on point to offer us more coffee and water. I didn't see any breakfast drinks but it's not really the atmosphere if you are looking for never ending mimosas. Most people are dressed in workout attire or just casual in general. Overall, a fun hidden little gem in the heart of midtown!

Kathy is a very friendly and knowledgable trainer. My puppy and I had a really fun experience coming in every week and going through puppy kindergarten. I will definitely recommend her classes to those looking for a trusting and skilled trainer who makes dog training an engaging experience. 
My puppy is a Rottweiler-Great dane mix, so I wanted him to learn manners because of his big size. I had no previous experience with dogs so I also learned a lot of valuable information from behavioural training to grooming to general care.

Not sure how to review a boutique but I will try to share with you my personal experience shopping there. I first shopped at this Cartier around the early summer of 2011, when I was looking for an engagement ring for my GF. The sales associate, Jeannette Wong, greeted us, and took the time to introduce a variety of different options. She was extremely knowledgeable and helpful, and eventually we decided to get the classic cut of the Cartier's diamond ring. The whole process was pleasant, and we didn't feel being pushed into more expensive options at all.

What really impressed me was what happened post my first purchase. Jeannette followed up with me on whether my GF liked the ring and told me that whenever we were in this area, we should stop by and get the ring cleaned and polished for sure. We also received some informative Cartier magazines outlining their new and classic products. When we got married, we went to this store again to get two wedding bands and Jeannette had them engraved with the dates of our marriage.

Given that our home state is about 2 hours away by flight, we didn't really have easy access to this store (there are NO Cartier in our home state). However, I have been able to call up Jeannette to order some gifts for my wife, such as earrings and pendants. This Cartier store always uses Fedex next day to ship the stuff to me, so it is both efficient and secure.

Fast forward to the summer of 2017, we got a warm greeting card from Jeannette to celebrate our five year anniversary. Now that we are in a area with a Cartier store nearby, we don't have to fly to Boston any more. She introduced the local store manager to help us, which we really appreciate.

Cartier is definitely one of the more expensive brands out there. But the service of the store, the care and friendship from the associate Jeannette, as well as the styles of their offerings, all deserve thumps-up. I highly recommend this store and thanks their wonderful staff for making our experience unique and memorable!

I'm absolutely happy I came here and I'm very satisfied with the cookies! The cashier working at the register was so friendly, I asked for recommendations and she told me the popular cookies, as well as her favorite one, which I got. The cookies were very soft on the inside and almost like a mix between a cookie and a cake. It definitely tastes better when you eat it warm. My favorite would have to be the samoa cookie! It had a layer of chocolate on the bottom and was overall just a really tasty treat. The cookies did taste really sweet, but my family cut each cookie in fourths so it was enough to share and not too overwhelming to eat one cookie by ourselves. I was told that the rotation is every Sunday at 5 PM. I love how the flavors rotate every week, so I'll come back again and try more flavors!

I recently bought an e cig from the RR store and didnt have the best experience at all!! However, I decided to give it a try and happened to be nearby this location. My experience this time was GREAT!!! The guy who helped us, I like to call him Charlie, but his name was Harvey. He was so nice, professional, and more than willing to help us find the juice best for our taste. He helped us and we all talked for easily an hour. Not once did I feel rushed or pressured. I wil definitely come back to this location. I rarely hand out 5 stars but this was top notch in terms of customer service. Thanks ABV!!!

Drove down from Watertown Ma to have what might be one of Bostons best BBQ places. Virtually everything on the menu is good old comfort food and will warm your belly on a crappy New England day.

 I always like to judge places on how they do simple dishes, because most of the time they are not that simple. The BBQ Mac and cheese is amazing and holds ground against its southern state brethren. Virtually all the food has a some kind of twist that is not commonly found in your typical places around here giving Da Bomb its own culinary identity .

I stopped by The Spotted Trotter today because I saw so many good reviews.  It definitely lived up to everything that everyone said.  They have a great selection of cured meats as well as fresh steaks and sausages.  They also told me that I can always look on their website and if I need anything, give them a call and they can get it in.  
The person that worked there was very knowledgable and was able to recommend a good cheese since I didnt really know what I wanted.  
Prices are also very reasonable. 
This will be a regular for sure.

Holy Mole! I wish we had started coming here earlier because every Mexican place we've had in PDX pales in comparison to Autentica. The mole is to die for and every other sauce they make is just as amazing. I know its total bad manners to lick your plate but try and stop yourself when you get near the end of your meal, especially when they have the most amazing little tortillas to soak it up with! 
Lets talk about margaritas for a second...I usually hate the sugary sweet concoctions that we try at other so called authentic Mexican restaurants, if you are in the same boat then you MUST try the Spicy margarita they serve here, its cool, sweet, spicy, and perfect! Little slices of jalapeno and various chiles swirl around this amazing drink and give it a floral liveliness that I will come back for again and again.  
We closed down the place last night and the servers were super fun, gracious and knowledgeable, five stars all the way!!

Paul from Alamo is the absolute best person in the business for this type of work. I don't know what me and my family would have done if it wasn't for Alamo. During the pandemic when most people are skeptical to come out to work, Paul was at my house daily checking out problems we were having and going beyond to help rid us of our situation. After Alamo finished with their work (Paul)  came help us again, when no one would and It was absolutely out of his way and also after work hours.
