I have had all types of work done (color, black and white, realistic, etc) at Memorial and receive a lot of compliments on each and every piece. There isnt another shop in Atlanta I will even think about going to. 

If you want a great tattoo given by great and friendly artists in a clean and sterile environment, then go to Memorial.

Ryan is the best.  He is extremely knowledgeable and really knows his stuff about bikes.  I truly appreciated him educating me about my bike & giving me enough information for me to feel confident that he was doing an awesome job.  My bike has ridden seamlessly ever since going to see him 6 months ago.  I had been to 3 other bike shops in the Boulder area and none of them impressed me like Ryan did.  His prices are also very reasonable, which is great for a privately owned bike shop with such amazing customer service.  I would highly recommend Standard Bike Repair!

Honest location for repairing your Honda. We took an old Honda Accord to various shops.

1. Herb Chambers Allston - tried to charge $129 diagnostic fee, even if nothing is broken.
2. Honda - Dedham - charged us for finding nothing. What a scam.
3. Honda Village Newton - charged $0 for diagnostic fee and found that the seat belt was damaged under warranty. Replaced it free within an hour. 

Hard to find honest dealerships these deals since everybody is trying to squeeze every dollar out of you. Honda Village in Newton did not. 

I will only return here.

This place is a gem. I've drove by this place every week for the last 4 months and thought nothing of it... that was until we were going to try the place across the street for an omlette, unbeknownst to my gilfriend and I they had no beer to serve. Big Mistake.

So, having advertised on their street-side banner to serve beer, there was little debate where to move the party. This place had a nice modern interior design. I enjoyed a bleu & bacon burger with season fries and I wouldn't have changed anything about that day for the world.

Ok, start with Daija the FOH Manager, Amazing, Fabulous, Great at what she does.  Makes you feel welcome from the minute you walk in the door My server Ashley, knowledgeable, friendly, happy,  made me feel comfortable, made food suggestions and OMG!! The Baked Oysters!! Off the chain! Flavors burst in your mouth & makes love to your soul all the way down!! The fajitas are tender and flavorful, highly recommended!  Thank you for giving me a great experience! I appreciate both of you The City Tap is beautiful inside, warm, welcoming & lively! Try it if you haven't!! I give it 5 stars and I will be back!!

This is such a novel idea! I'm very excited to hear that the owners are scouting out locations in Seattle to open up shop closer to me as well. My friend who lives in Oregon booked our spots for an 11am session - the instructions say to arrive on time or late, but not early! This was great news for us as we found parking easily nearby and got started just before noon. 

We both chose projects that projected 3 hours of focus. We were assigned seats across from one another and by the time we got there little satchels with instructions and all pieces of our projects were there waiting for us. We donned aprons and set to work - me on a bottle carrier with bottle opener on the side, and my friend on a string art wall hanging piece.

Time absolutely flew by and we finished right around 2:45 as projected! The time really does pass quickly when you are focusing on your craft. We were both very pleased with the finished products and went next door to fill our tummies - crafting really builds up an appetite!

Marianne is fantastic! I was seeing her at Urban Waxx, but when she started Bare Beauty Waxing Studio, I followed, as she always did such a great job :) She makes you feel so comfortable and at ease, no matter the kind of day you're having. But she is genuine. I feel often that you get the sound of a bubbly voice, but you can sense an annoyed/unhappy employee behind the act. Marianne is always genuine and kind. 

Her studio is so clean, bright, relaxing, cute, and it's a room you could just hang out in. The was she uses is great, I used to always get terrible ingrown hairs afterward, but with her and this wax, Im so much better. It also hurts much less. She is very thorough, asks the right questions, pays attention to detail, and you can tell she really cares about what she is doing. She is so sweet, always a joy to see, when you have to go do the thing you don't particularly enjoy doing. She makes it so much better!

I'll definitely keep going back for as long as I need waxing! And refer all my friends and family. Thanks for doing such great work Marianne!

I have been to a lot of airports in the world. This is one of the top I would say myself. One thing I realize is that it has spent a lot of money on the decorations in the place.

I really take this place for granted. When I compare it to so many airports, this is one of the most cultured one I have ever seen. Comparing to size, you can't because the place looks so new, and the airport looks so lovely. The carpet flooring, while LAX has tiles.

I really appreciate the layout of the airport too as well. The people returning are at the bottom which is so close to the parking, like literally 6-7 steps away. Then the people leaving has an amazing drop off, which makes it so convenient and the bag picking up is before we see all of our friends and family at the end. I love the layout of this place.

I need to appreciate what I have more in the city that I live in. I never realized that there are so many amazing potentials in the places that are so near to me. Love ya YVR.

We left a great hamburger place in Minneapolis called the Red Cow and are so happy that we have found Hopdoddy here in Austin. Every hamburger is delicious including the impossible burger. The french fries are amazing and the shakes are crazy good. The only thing I wish is that they didn't have the calorie count next to every item. The service is terrific and it's entertaining to watch the servers carry 7 trays at a time. I think they do a really good job of seating people even when it's crowded.

I really enjoyed my interaction with Dr Wyatt even though I did not use her.  My neighbor had to put her cat down and recommended Dr Wyatt.  I was facing having to put my dog down and called on a Saturday.  Dr Wyatt's message said she'd call back within a couple of hours even on Saturday and she did just that.  Then even though it would have been very easy to set an appointment and come out to put the dog down and collect a fee, she took time to talk through the issue and I never once felt rushed.  In the end she recommended holding off and letting our dog pass naturally.  We decided that if it passed a certain point she would come out which in the end was not necessary.  I though this was extremely professional and this one phone call is more than enough for me to recommend Dr Wyatt.

This place is a not-so-hidden gem for cured meats and one of the best highlights of my trip to Atlanta. When I came by the shop, the gentleman at the counter came by and pulled out one of the butchers from the back to help me select the multitude of cuts they offer. 

They take the time to really know the local cheeses and meats they work with to offer wonderful cured and fermented products. I cant wait to see what the offer up in their next larger location.

Stopped in at Novara during a recent trip to Massachusetts.  Absolutely wonderful experience. The food was absolutely delicious. One of the best calamari I've ever had, and I've had plenty. Perfectly crisp with the perfect little kick of heat. The Bucatini Bolognese was equally delicious and I left an empty plate. Brought home cannoli for dessert. Our waitresses was super friendly and answered all questions we had regarding the menu. Will definitely be returning whenever I make it back to the area.

You know, as a business, I think running a restaurant is something I would NEVER do. You have to deal with people, work nights and weekends, deal with perishable food, picky eaters, and worst of all, you have to deal with people (yes, I said this twice). 

But from a customer's perspective there are just some basic things you have to have to run a good restaurant:  a clean and pleasant establishment, good food reasonably priced, attention to detail, friendly and efficient staff. All this is lots of work to accomplish, but it is transparent to the customer, for all they get is a good, affordable dining experience. 

This restaurant, in my opinion (and I have lots of them), gets the basics right. It is well-run, with pleasant and efficient staff, and good food that's reasonably-priced. End of review.

So lovely and under new management since I first discovered the best massage chairs in town on Easter Sunday (see my review for Pro 2 Nail for that day!)

Once again treated to the Queen treatment with the fabulous massage chair and more foot and calf massage than anywhere else I have been! The attention to detail shows in everything they do :) Christy was super welcoming. The new manager was friendly but not overly so. Make sure you upgrade the pedicure to include the gel massage! The invigorating leg gel is wonderfully tingly and fabulous! They were just installing 2 new huge TVs and everyone was just as sweet as can be!  5 stars for price, experience, and service.

My bill was high, because I kept ordering more. This place is incredible with great staff.

The tortilla soup is easily the best I've ever had. Pair that with a great bloody Mary and steak tacos, and there is ultimate satisfaction.

Bonnie is the best waitress I've ever had - if you're lucky to be seated in her area. She kept making sure I had what I needed and was very personable - even offered to go above and beyond with giving me a coffee to go. 

I can't rave enough about this place...maybe there will be more raving after additional visit - definitely coming back!!

Kudos Bonnie!!!

I'm surprised this place doesn't have more good reviews. I've been here a few times and always try to come when i'm in town for conventions. We sat at the bar, and the bartender was extremely nice and helpful. I have absolutely no complaints with him. I was in the mood for a burger, and i'm glad, because it was very good (refer to photo). I ate the entire thing along with the fries! The bistro burger was just how I like burgers, not burned with just a little pink. Simple toppings and bun. All tasting perfect. What surprised me was those fries were so freaking delicious! They were just soft enough and had plenty of flavor. I could eat a whole plate of just those fries. Yesssss! Anyway, i'll be back for sure.

I generally dont finish my whole plate at breakfast or brunch . At Gigi's cafe I wanted to order another dish. Between Gigi's and Tasty and Alder they are my favorite brunch spots. The waffles at Gigi's are so tasty, we didnt even order the chicken and waffles (what they are known for). I had a hash and she had a scramble. I also got the waffle of the day. I dont know how they do it or what they do but the quality of the food was great. You do not need syrup for your waffle and everything is just perfect. I can only say this place was AMAZING!

I went back here (as I said I would for the wings).  This time I ordered Honey Garlic & Salt/Pepper wings and the order was perfect and it was done in 15 minutes.  

The girl that took my order was great, and explained how you are able to get two flavors.  The wings are not just good, they are excellent and I am not even sure I want to know how many calories are in them.  Each bite a nice taste of heaven.  

As much as my butt does not need the deep fried eats, I will likely be here at least 2 times a month. I definitely recommend getting the 3lb wing deal, if you are sharing they will be gone fast.  Next time I go in I will try some new flavors as they have tons to pick from. 

Overall my experience was WOOHOO as yelp says.  Recommend going!

This is one of Atlanta's hidden gem restaurants. The ambience is absolutely wonder, inviting, and cozy, which mimics both owners personalities. They are beautiful women who are cultivating their brand of urban soul food. The 'Southern Fried' stuffed green tomatoes and their creative twist on spinach dip as a 'Collard Dip' literally were some of the BEST appetizers I have ever enjoyed! We each ordered different meals for dinner and we were collectively thrilled with our choices. The chicken was fried to perfection; each bit of the chicken breast oozed with flavor, moistness, and steam. I  mused whether the chef cooked it in a cast iron skillet; it was uber delicious ! The dessert was such a mouthwatering surprise, again the chef out did herself with her take on an urban soul cinnamon bun. It was the perfect balance of light and fluffy filled with (I believe) a mixture of cinnamon, nutmeg, and sweet potato...SURPRISE! You WILL enjoy your dining experience at the restaurant, from the moment you enter until you leave...ENJOY!

"Praise the Lard" as my new Tee shirt says. 

Hip, young and modern like Portland itself. Friendly staff that connects with you and delivers a contagious smile. We had Sunday lunch/brunch; the menu seemed limited at first but in reality the quality of the food more than made up for the number of selections.

Locally sourced ingredients that are wonderfully fresh.

We started with the Vegetable Tempura which was perfectly cooked and not greasy. Okra and mini eggplant really stood out. The Mushroom Congee was simple in construction but complex in delivery with layered flavors, the mushroom varietals all so different in taste and texture. The Spicy Pork Ramen was rich, flavorful and had the perfect heat.

Portland is such a foodie location and Pono Farm Soul Kitchen fits right in and doesn't disappoint. 

Cheers!

Beautiful space. 

The veggie dishes at American Local are to die for and are worth every cent of melt-in-your-mouth goodness. Probably the best vegetable dishes in all of Portland. 

The other items on the menu look delicious. I tried the rice ball last time and it filled me right up and was a good snack. I'm excited to go back and try some more of the comfort food options. 

I will probably pass on the kebabs next time as they are pretty small and not worth the 7-10 dollars to me. The few that we had were delicious, though.

The floral arrangements Mercedes designed for our son's memorial made a beautiful statement. We contacted Mercedes after the florist referred by the venue we used did not respond. We checked reviews for florists in the area and Mercedes Flowers had, by far, the best reviews. 

Mercedes responded to our initial request immediately, even given it was their busiest time of the year. The first thing she did was to provide her direct mobile phone number so we would be able to contact her anytime. She then provided photos and descriptions of ideas/options/pricing via text and email based on the information and budget we provided. She was patient and understanding. In addition to her condolences, she took the time to discover what our son liked and further customized the arrangements accordingly, all while staying within budget. 

Though we didn't expect her to, Mercedes waited for us to arrive after she delivered and set up the arrangements at the venue. She wanted to meet and hug us and make sure everything was to our expectation. It was definitely that and more! We had endless compliments on her work.

Love love love them.  They are all super nice and friendly and they really love their coffee.  Personally, I am not a big coffee drinker, but that doesn't mean that there isn't anything for me there!  They have some really great tea choices and the chai was pretty good.

The only thing I could want more is a better selection of food (primarily since I like to go there for hours upon end to study for exams and never want to leave and lose whatever prime seat I have managed to acquire).  However, the choices of treats they DO have are pretty damn good, so I can't complain too much!

What do I love even more then a huge juicy cut of steak. A huge juicy FREE steak.

I was one of the super super lucky folk to be invited to the preview night at Jaspers. What does this mean, you ask. Everything. Free. I didn't believe it when I was told so I asked again. Free they said. This when on a couple of times until I finally got the picture.

I show up with my mom and sister in tow for the most expensive meal my family may ever eat. On the house.

Jaspers is an old fashioned "backyard grill steakhouse" except if the steakhouse was super posh and the food served faster then anyones uncle on a grill could cook it up. 

We began with appetizers, crab cakes, calamari and Bruschetta. Both the crab cakes and calamari were excellent, the calamari very tender, which I love and in a tereyaki sauce, but the bruschetta was to die for. Covered in goat cheese on other fabulous sorts of things, it made me slip on south beach, and thats saying a lot.

We all had salads too. Mine was a baby green salad with shallot vinaigrette dressing, nuts and blue cheese. Yum.

But the time I got to the main course I was almost stuffed but hey, I had to make some sort of dent right.

Prime Rib. OH MY GOD. Now, Ive only had amazing steak once or twice in my life ( many other times it has been more the  sirloin variety) and this was th best steak Ive ever tasted. Juicy and cut well, presented beautifully and they had these portabello mushroom "whippers." Good god in heaven.

Our waiters name was Robert and he was fabulous. And we had enough left over to eat lunch the next day.

A really amazing dining experience. Quick service, delicious food, friendly people.

Now Ill just save up enough to go back, as things are a little pricey. Tip. My sister, the picky vegetarian, had a pizza that she said was the best pizza she had ever eaten and was 9 bucks. Cheapskates...this might be your dish.

This is one of the first restaurants to open in the domain, and , trust me, should be on every yelper's to do list in the near future.

brb location looks shady af but they take credit card
brb delicious chicken at half the price of fresas.
brb plenty of tortillas when every other restaurant tryin to short you on the cheapest thing on the menu.
brb google maps takes you on weird detour for some reason, just turn on ohlen instead of fairfield.
brb food came out faster than steph curry's shot
brb green sauce is straight fire but it's delicous

what to order guide:
under 150lbs: a taco
under 230lbs: half chicken
over 230lbs: whole chicken, trust me mane 

10/10 wood come again

I will never move to another apartment without a concierge. This place sets the bar in my 10 years of renting apartments. The building itself is right on Rainey St. but at the end so you are not in the middle of the madness. The building is secure for the most part, about as secure as you can ask for. The pool and terrace are unreal, along with the rest of the amenities. The floor to ceiling windows (in unit) are awesome, and the units are made from concrete and have hardwood floors. I never hear my neighbors and the place carries a condo feel verse an apartment. I've never had maintenance requests taken care of so quickly, and whenever I had an issue- the management team is responsive and gets a resolution... Chassity/Amy/Chris shout out to you guys. The garage is really my only negative thing to say. It is not attached to the main building, and the turns get tight with all the special drivers in Austin coming around them. The parking space kind of sucks, but if you care about that then pay for a reserved spot...they have them. I used to live at Lamar Union, and this place is a night and day difference. I am relocating to Dallas, otherwise I would stay here till i bought a place. Also, I wanted to point out... they have 3-br's (normally college or young 20's) on the 2/3 floors. The higher you go, the older/more professional feel you get... it's worth the money to live 10 and up (views & quieter).

My husband and I came to Beaverton Oregon 2 years ago on vaction and on our vacation we ate at Ruby Tuesday and let me tell our food was GREAT!!!!!!  Steak and Lobster tails ( Red Lobster what's  Red Lobster) and our waitress Jessica I love the women she is a ROCKSTAR!!!!!!! Ok any who my husband and November 1,2014 we moved up over the hill from Ruby Tuesday we still go to Ruby Tuesday I still get the steak and Lobster (AWESOME STILL when the cooks don't eat it before i get it LOL LOL) and yes our ROCKSTAR Jessica still is our LOVELY waitress!!!!! So just a friendly heads up go to Ruby Tuesday SW Murray Blvd & Scholls Ferry...... Jessica i had to put the cook comment in lol lol......  I SO LOVE THIS PLACE!!!!!!!!!!

We had a great time last night!  Our event (business team building) was a success!
Kerry Mulloy (Head Event Coordinator) was amazing! Such a hard worker!!
I have to commend the chef on providing food for my guests with food restrictions, they were so very pleased with all of their food selections and greatly appreciate that lengths that they went to accommodate them! 
Our two servers were absolutely fantastic! Super friendly and accommodating to all in attendance!
A special thank you to the girls behind the front desk for helping set-up the bowling tournament, they were a pleasure to work with and very accommodating!

I loved this place so much I came back 5 times within 2 weeks. What I love the most about Bambu is that they don't load their desserts with crazy amounts of unnecessary sugars; the flavors are more on the natural, lighter side and that's perfect for me. I am seriously addicted to the Fruit Addict! If you're someone who likes to chew on boba and want more than just a drink, the Fruit Addict is the way to go because there are so many different fruits inside, giving you a variety of different textures and flavors. The great thing about the che is that real ingredients are used, so don't hold back from trying Taro Lover because they use real taro, a nice break from the powdery stuff you get everywhere else. It may not be the cheapest dessert option($6) but its the perfect fix for when you want something sweet but do not want to indulge in a triple layer double chocolate cake.

Samantha takes it to the next level when it comes to costumer service. She offered to run to the store and pick up the exact gel nail color that I wanted which is generosity that I have never experienced at a nail salon. She also worked 2 hours after her normal closing hours to make sure she got the job done clean and correctly. She does have a slightly limited color selection when it comes to gel nail polish (her normal polish selection is great) but regardless, I will definitely be coming back for a manicure and pedicure- especially with her awesome deals going on right now!

This pizza is very good. If you've been to Italy and hope to someday find a pizza place here in the States that will remind you of your trip, this place will probably do it for you.

Pizzas are wood-fired with both very creative as well as classic combinations of toppings and very reasonably priced for the high-quality ingredients you are getting. The crust is excellent with just the right combination of crispiness and char. One pizza is actually big enough for two people to share in most cases, esp. on some of the more filling topping varieties. Early happy hour until 6pm features very reasonable beer prices.

There's also a good jukebox to choose from while you dine, although it could use a little more blues and classic R&B.

A second meal at Belly Timber has added a star for me. Mmmmmmm. The subtlety in flavors and the delicate new pairings made me realize that high levels of thought and care went into making these entrees. Last night I ordered an appetizer of salmon chickpea crepes with celery and cumin. Wow! 

Since my belly didn't have the space for an enormous entree, I was thankful that dinner plates were offered in two sizes. I got the roasted pork loin with prunes and trotters, which was delectably tender and quietly amazing. As for "trotters", I didn't know what they were until after I ate the meal, and I'll leave you to discover it yourself. I might not have ordered it if I'd known, but I definitely would've missed out. My only complaint is that the brussel sprouts seemed undercooked.

My boyfriend got sweet potato gnocci, which was very smooth and satisfying, and a butter lettuce, goat cheese pomegranate salad. Yum. Before dinner, bread is served with butter and unusually flavored salts for more taste adventures.

Our service was again excellent, and one drink we ordered was very unusual: it was a Tom Collins with a Clear Creek Vodka that had a smoky flavor. The drink tasted slightly salty and had a pleasant similarity to smoked meat. Along these lines, there is a bacon bourbon Manhattan on the menu which we didn't try, but I really liked the Tom Collins. 

Again, the architecture--embossed silvery wallpaper, lovely dark wood, beautiful bar--was a wonderful backdrop to an evening of culinary discovery. I was left feeling satisfied and at the same time wanting more!

This place definitely deserves a full five stars.  Not only was the supply of tea great but staff was very helpful.

They must carry just about every tea that Stash makes from loose leaf to tea bags.  Some of the teas are available to sample.  In addition there are tea pots, tea cups, strainers, storage bins for teas and great gift ideas.

We loved spending time smelling the tea leaves and picking out teas to take home with us.  There were even some sample sets we could take with us.

If you like tea, this place is definitely worth the visit.

As a female college student who knows nothing about the inner workings of cars, I'm the classic candidate to get banged over the head by the auto guys but this was not the case here. They waived the the cost of the estimate because I'm a AAA member (but after sitting in the office for an hour listening to them interact with other customers, they seemed to be really generous when working with the pricing). They were also extremely honest with me, and didn't attempt to lie or cheat me out of any money. They did a great job identifying the issues and fixing up the car in an efficient and quality manner. Overall, I think they deserve all the positive reviews they've gotten on this site.

I am so upset with myself that I do not remember what I had from the lunch buffet!

All I remember is that it was good :)  ... I had a simple side salad, some rice and tofu burrito. It was all delicious! I looked online and here is what they had for Wednesday:

Mains: Potato Patties, Enchiladas Rojas, Tofu and Peas, Veggie Stir Fry   
Sides: Squash and Corn, Brown Rice, Pinto Beans, Black Beans, Gorditas

I had an all-natural Blueberry soda. My friend had a Hibiscus punch which was SO good!

Mr. Natural's is the perfect name for this place - All of the food was vegan and all-natural - I felt really good after I ate.

They had a lot of spices and sooo many desserts that I would like to try another day...A great place!

Let me start off by saying this is one of my favorite places  to eat and it is a metric I use to compare all other restaurants to. We have eaten here for years and the food here has almost always been very good.The tacos are all good while my favorites are the memphis, brisket, and fried chicken. They also have really good margarita. There are no reservations and all people are treated fairly and asked to wait in line for a table. Which at peak time can be 30 min to an hour.

We came here for date night seeking some good wine and perhaps a few bites. While my proverbial 'last meal' would be glasses of a big, spicy red and chunks of creamy pungent blue cheese, we decided to bypass the extensive cheese and charcuterie board options in favor of their full menu. 

I spent the next three days obsessively recalling the flavors of the evening. The lamb meatballs had a unique middle eastern take. If you enjoy recipes out of Ottolenghi's cookbooks, you'd love these. They were delicately moist but with a perfectly browned thin crust.

And I'm considering a policy of gifting myself with an evening of wine and their macaroni and cheese on a weekly basis. This is no typical sloppy pasta-with-cheese sauce rendition. Apparently the cheesemonger chooses a different combination of cheeses weekly. It had the richness and edge of a sophisticated cheese plate, again with what in my view is the critical broiled top-crust. I have had so much bad mac n cheese in this city. My search is over.

The greens on grilled bread appetizer were the only disappointment. On the bland side and way overpriced for what it was. But that was the anomoly in an otherwise delicious evening. Cyril's is being added to our regular restaurant rotation. I haven't described the great gougeres and local wine flight, but I should leave some of the pleasure of discovery to you.

Went in today without an appointment, terrible thing to do on a Saturday. Very quickly, Jamee worked me in her schedule and told me to come back a couple hours later. Once I got there, while waiting, I watched Netflix and was offered a beer or a water. After 2-3 minutes, Jamee came and got me for my haircut. She took her time and it was soon clear to me that I now know who I will use as my barber. Very knowledgeable and takes her time with you. Makes you feel how important you are to her as a customer. After the haircut, Jamee put a hot towel on my face and used a massager on my shoulders/neck. The owner was extremely nice and very welcoming, though I didn't catch her name. This is the kinda barber that College Park needs and will have my business along with my referrals.

Gresham does not (yet?) have a Franz store, but I can usually find our favorite Franz goodies at my regular grocery stops. Lately, I can't find my husbands lemon cookies anywhere, so while I was out running errands with my mom on Saturday, we stopped in here. 

Their selection is huge! And they have more than just Franz and bakery type items, they have Milk, Little Debbie, Svens??? danishes. All at fantastic prices. Parking is ample and service was splendid. I'm so glad they are here. I already want to come back for more.

When you've been in Boston for more than a few days you start to branch out and look for different places to eat that aren't swamped with people like you. Tourists! We finished our morning walk, about 4 miles, and we were ready for a snack. We walked toward the water from downtown and entered the Tap. A small historic pub style eatery. The place was empty, it wasn't even 12 yet, but when you are on vacation lunch can come at any time. We were greeted, seated, and served by Raven. Raven is the kind of serve you want working for you. She was friendly, kind, knowledgeable, not only about the restaurant menu but about Boston in general. She helped us order some local brews and a nice appetizer that was enough for everyone in our party. Timing is everything. I recommend this place for lunch or dinner for any occasion! The restrooms were clean. They use cloth napkins. They even have an open dinning concept with a wall of windows that opens up to the sidewalk. Just off the Quincy Market.

super trendy cute place! right when you walk in the artwork and look of the place immediately catches your eye! the service here is outstanding, super helpful and patient. so many things to choose from on the menu, the boba teas here are amazing! super good and i've tried the taro and nutella. their popcorn chicken here has a major asian style taste to it but it's so good!! when you go, YOU HAVE to get the popcorn chicken and some boba tea. the other side dishes they have are so good too! had the siracha honey fries and the crab rangoon chips and dip and omg i was impressed! you get a lot for the price. i got a small boba tea, the rangoon's, popcorn chicken and the siracha fries for 17$. i also had some macarons for 2$ a piece, those are so sweet and amazing! please try this place out, it's 10/10!

What a shop!:) They do clean your hat for your and some repair work.

But anyway they give ya fantastic service and a have large selection of hats varying in design, style , colors, etc etc. There is even a large accessories area...more than just feathers :).   I could go on and on about the shop but its all about preference. This shop seems to have it all. It's not I go into a shop for a hat and come out with 2 but this shop made it quite difficult to leave without at least 1!  

They sell good to great quality hats at great prices!!

If you are looking for unique and funky gifts this is your place.  This store is like a modern art museum gift shop on steroids.  The owner was working behind the counter when I went in and he was friendly and helpful.  I wanted to ship an item out of state and he charged a very reasonable shipping fee.  This place has items from cool kitchen/wine goods to funky yard items to vegetarian cookbooks.  This is the kind of place that is just a pleasure to browse, you'll want to see everything in the store to make sure you don't miss any great finds!

I finally know "A GUY" 

You know, as in "hey, I know a guy" who...

I hired PC to come out and totally rework my
downstair's bathroom toilet. Jorge, was on time 
and ready to get right to work. He had to put
in a new flange, new anchors, wax ring,
flood master,  fill valve and so much more. He
leveled it perfectly. It's "built to last" 

Jorge, is super professional and transparent as
far as his work, he liked it when I was kinda looking
over his shoulder. He actually, I think, encourages
it, he is very comfortable explaining everything he
does and why he does it. He also tries to teach you
how to troubleshoot minor problems too. I really
like Jorge's style and work ethic. 

I would highly recommend him, he will do a great job 
at a fair price and on time. Also, he cleans up the area
very well. Most plummers leave your house a total mess. 

Thank you Jorge !

This is our favorite place to eat and it's where we go the most. It's the kind of place where you can eat a ton and still feel really good because you had so many vegetables and fresh food. They treat us like family here.

Pro tips:
 - instead of two sides, ask for four half sides for the same price so you can try more things
 - if they aren't busy, you can ask them to warm up the pita bread (located to the left of where the line starts)
 - don't skip on coriander potatoes and blended baba ganoush
 - get the spicy stuff on your hummus
 - falafel might take a few minutes, so be ready to wait if you order it
 - great place to bring your kids - the staff/owners are super friendly with little ones

This is literally the only place I've wanted to take time to review. Just go here and thank me later.

I visited Kerlin because I saw it reviewed on Thrillist as the best BBQ in the nation. I was skeptical, as I love franklin and have never heard of this place. First, a word of caution: be careful where you park, the owner of the piñata palace next door will tow you in a second if you park in the wrong place. However, the BBQ was superb---definitely on par with Franklin without the line. It is only a husband and wife, so service is a little slow, but we ordered and had our food in less than 15 mins. The pinto beans are amazing and the brisket is so tender, it falls apart. If you want delicious BBQ with no wait, visit Kerlins.

(Note: This is a review of the Doggy Day Camp service ONLY.) 

First of all, the staff members here are INCREDIBLE! My dog gets excited when we pull into the parking lot of the Beaverton Petsmart because he knows he is going to play with his furry and human friends there! He comes home happy and tired after a full day of exercise and socializing. I especially love reading the adorable "Pawgress Report" that details who Zeke played with that day. So cute!  Also, I recently injured myself and am on crutches -- the staff members are so accommodating that they actually meet me out at my car and bring my dog inside for me. I could not believe their kindness! 

The hours/pricing are pretty awesome. They are typically open 7am-7pm, which is great for those of us with typical 8-5 office jobs who have to fight rush hour traffic. The rates are competitive with those of other daycare centers. The only thing I wish they did was package pricing (ex: 20 days for $X) or a flat monthly membership fee. I feel like that would make it a little cheaper for those of us who are regulars, but I am also a Pet Perks member so each month I get one free day after 10 visits that month ($23 value) and there are surveys that will sometimes print with my receipt that give you $3 off if you complete them online. Sometimes additional coupons are given via email or in the Pawgress Reports. I am pretty saving-savvy so I make sure to read all of them! :)

The store itself is clean and well-stocked and organized. I always get greeted by a friendly cashier or manager when I enter and leave. They offer training classes in the evenings and also have a Banfield pet hospital and grooming salon on site, making this the perfect place to bring your pup for any and all needs.

I haven't been to the brown bag for a long long time and I'm just now giving it a review because it was there that I first learned of soft whole wheat bread. Yes this was way back in the seventies I think or maybe it was the eighties I don't remember. Anyway since having one of their wonderful sandwiches I have continued to use soft, delicious whole wheat bread. If it weren't for their wonderful sandwiches I would probably still be eating cotton. I no longer work in the downtown or German Village area hence the reason I don't visit the Brown Bag very often. When I get a chance so you can be sure that I will be back there to get another of her wonderful sandwiches.

This is hands down my favorite location. The staff is amazing and the manager always comes and checks on the tables. He is super hands on which is great. The food is always fresh and great and the servers are always good at guiding you in the right path to the best foods! Their beer prices aren't that bad for it being a high end restaurant and their wines aren't to bad either. If you have not been, I recommend coming! Be prepared to spend money and be way to full to move! 

This round our server Kelly is sweet and quick! She knows her food and offered to get us more broccoli for out cheese fondu!

I love this campus! My 16 month old is so happy to get to school and I get photos every day of all the fun activities they do. Teachers are caring and sweet with all kids and there's been relatively low turnover. I admit that I wasn't a huge fan of Stepping Stone after a not so great experience with my daughter at another campus several years ago. BUT this time it's different. The director, Ms. Misti is great- she's a positive, friendly, and supportive presence. She's in touch with parents, kids, and teachers and she's on top of everything. I feel super confident that my child is in good hands.

Service Now Inc., Heating and Cooling, did a WONDERFUL job replacing our old worn electric heat pump and furnace!!  We are a 19 unit condominium and 4 of the residents decided it was time to change old electric heat pump and furnaces.  Bids were solicited from 3 companies and we chose Service Now.  Jason Johnston, the owner, was very easy to work with.  He provided a complete description of the work to be done, which included a crane to get the old compressors off the roof of the condominium building and to lift the hew ones into place.  New furnaces were also replacing the old furnaces.   Correspondence always took place in a timely manner.  A team of 4 technicians and an electrician completed the job in 3 days.  The team captain was Kelly, his team: Frank, Wesley and Alec.  Everyone showed up when expected, explained what they were doing, worked hard, were friendly, and cleaned up after themselves.  The old units came out and the new units were installed without incident.  All units are working GREAT.  We would highly recommend this company to anyone looking to replace their HVAC equipment!!

This is one of my favorite places to eat. I like to sit in a booth by the window and people watch. Delicious food. Nice staff. Validated parking. My only wish is that they kept later hours on Sundays. 

They serve a wide variety of food and it has all been good.  I would recommend the tuna burger, cream cheese scramble (scrambled eggs and cream cheese), and meatloaf with mashed potatoes.  As for appetizers, the artichoke dip is truly amazing. It is not that gross, processed crap they serve at the chain restaurants. It has huge pieces or artichoke heart and real cheese and it's served with pieces of toasted, buttery bagel. In regards to sides, the grilled tofu, asparagus, fruit salad, mac and cheese (so good!), grilled tomatoes, and sweet potato fries are delicious. Finally, the milkshakes and fruit cobbler are wonderful. The only thing I haven't enjoyed as much is their specials. Those have tended to be overpriced and underseasoned.

Weekend mornings are super busy and you must wait for a seat, so I try to avoid going then, but for lunch or dinner, I've never had to wait. Basically, this place gives me the warm fuzzies and I leave feeling relaxed and well-fed.

By far, one of my favorite eateries in Austin!

Cons: 
They do not serve alcohol - but this is not really a con, for they will allow BYOB and there is a fabulous beer/liquor/wine store within a 100 feet walking distance - that has an outstanding selection!

Pros: 
They provide cold beer mugs and wine glasses for your BYOB! 

Their staff goes above and beyond - super friendly!

Their food is phenomenal!

Cauliflower?!?! The Gobi Manchurian is OUTSTANDING!

I love their Saffron Nan, something about the sweetness and dipping it into the Aloo Achari Lamb... to die for!

Love the people, their food, and their atmosphere!

This is the second time I've gone to this salon and I absolutely love it! The service is great and the staff is very nice. I originally had gone there with the buywithme coupon for a hair cut with Michael Labreque the owner/head stylist. I didn't really know exactly what I wanted but I knew that I wanted it at my shoulder and with layers. I loved the style and the way he cut it, it grew into a really good shape. He is awesome and I would highly recommend getting your hair cut with him. I went a second time and I love the cut even better than the first. He really knows what works and what doesn't. 

The great thing about this salon is that they do a 20% student discount. Even though I only paid $35 the first time with the buywithme coupon, what I paid the second time was totally worth it. 

They have these really cool massage chairs for when you're getting your hair washed. The salon itself, even though its on the ground floor, it has alot of natural light and seems alot more open and spacious than some of the other salons that I've been in.

All I can say is that after living four years in Boston, I've finally found a salon that I'm willing to stick with :) 
Overall 
*very talented/friendly staff*
*awesome atmosphere*
*worth the money/good value with 20% student discount*

Huge Portion | Scrumptious Food

I was visiting Colorado from California and wanted to check out Boulder. We wanted breakfast food that was filling and had decent portions. Thankfully, this place popped up on Yelp and were not disappointed! I ordered the Denver Omelette (a boulder omelette doesn't sound as appetizing, am I right? haha). I got it with avocado, which really wasn't necessary but I guess the Californian in me really couldn't resist! It tasted great! They were really generous with the cheese. The toast was already buttered, which I highly appreciated because it was already melted into the bread by the time it was served. Overall, I highly recommend this place! There's tons of other popular chain restaurants around this town, but this one felt more wholesome and local-owned. Enjoy~

Elizabeth is awesome! After having a bad experience elsewhere she gave me hope again. She is incredibly warm, easy to talk to and checked up on me several times during the treatment. I am very happy to have found her. I also love that she uses a canula for her lip treatment. I prefer it to having my lips jabbed like a pincushion. 2 points of injection sites makes one happy customer. (: 

Her receptionist is very sweet as well and made me tea to help warm up me up on a cool day.

The food is always fresh and there are lots of healthy options available. Great value as well - where else can you feed a well balanced and nutritious dinner for a family of 4 for less than $30? The staff here are always very friendly - a shoutout to Tyrone who is always super nice to our kids. The quinoa addition to the salad bar is a great one and their chocolate mousse is always super chocolatey. I've tried other locations and this is by far the best one in terms of service and quality .

I was delighted to get a Nift card for this spot, and was not disappointed whatsoever in my experience!

From the incredibly friendly and interesting bartenders (I've never seen a crew have so much fun together while also providing fast but thoughtful service) to the delicious food (I found the pizza here to be far fresher than the Kendall Square branch) to the oddball atmosphere (several smaller vintage black-and-white TVs and several inflatable mini-flamingos lining the bar), this is was a delight. Think Delux Cafe but with more breathing room, pizza, and takes cards!

Based on the recommendations on this site, I made an appointment with Stephanie 6 months ago.  While I have pretty nice hair, I am generally pretty grumpy about my cuts and especially about how they grow out.  I am IN LOVE with what she did to my hair - all sorts of layers.  She got me to blow out my hair every other day, which is a miracle, but who wouldn't when it looks so fabulous.  Am flying back in October for another cut (and to do some work) because I am pushing my luck to get 6 months out of the last one.  Recommend this place without reservations.

I really enjoy Hong Kong House. Everything I have had so far as beenexcellent. Everything is really flavorful and not overly spicy. Don't be scared of the two peppers on the menu. Here is what we've tried so far:

Spicy Fish Filets - awesome 
Spicy Diced Chicken - awesome
Salt and Pepper Squid - awesome
Boiled beef in hot chili oil - awesome
Dumplings in Hot Chili oil - awesome
Griddle Beef - awesome

I wasn't aware they converted from buffet. I used to go to a former Szechuan restaurant in town (RIP) and everything here is just as good!!!

I drove by this place after my lunch meeting and noticed that it was finally open so I decided to make a quick stop and check them out. I was fortunate enough to park right in front and also did not have to wait in line (the drive thru line was pretty long). I ordered the single deluxe combo, which came with fries and a drink. I opted for their "real fruit fizzy water" (I chose strawberry puree with the soda water). The drink was pretty good and refreshing, just make sure to mix it well before drinking.  The fries were cooked perfectly and had the right crisp to it. The burger had this taste that once you take a bite, it was just hard to stop. Ther burger kind of reminded me of an In n Out burger. It was packed with lots of flavor, but yet was simple. I would definitely eat here again.

Maudie's is my FAVORITE Austin Tex-Mex!  By far, my favorite.  This location in particular, no reason really other than maybe because it was my first one to experience so it has sentimental value, who knows.  I typically get the same thing every time and you have to get the queso, it's the best part.  Chips and salsa are great as well, but queso is the star of the meal.  This is how much I love this place:  my friend and I were on the cleanse diet where you drink nothing but a cayenne lemonade concoction, and we fell off the wagon like 3 days in and had to have delicious food and we both instantly suggested Maudie's.  Needless to say we hogged out and blew any part of the so called cleanse, but that's a different story.  Yum!!

I am very happy with the staff here and their results. I have utilized their service to  hem and repair two pairs of pants for me and they did a fine job. They also clean my dress slacks for work and I have no complaints. They are very friendly and their business feels clean and organized. We recently moved to North Portland and I decided to try to find a dry cleaner closer to our new home. Sadly, I had a horrible experience ( I tried Walnut Cleaners--horrid) , and now I will just continue to come back to Fashion Cleaners. It's worth the drive for friendly service and reliable results.

I first came here through a recommendation on Styleforum.net -- and have not been disappointed. 

The head tailor knows his stuff. (I can only speak to his knowledge of men's clothing). He'll listen to your wants, but also make suggestions of his own which you should probably listen to. Quite realistic about what can and should be done. Neither him or his son have ever tried to oversell me -- knowing that it is sometimes better to start over with a new garment than completely deconstruct an existing one at tremendous cost. I've seen the results of major suit alterations done by him (narrowing shoulders and adjusting collars) and have been impressed.

He's taken in numerous sport coats for me with attention to how different cuts should fit, whether I'll possible want a sweater or not, etc. Straight, well finished seems. Same on the tailored shirts, and hemmed pants. They've taken the extra minutes to fix a loose button and steam out any jacket oddities for no charge.

Prices are reasonable and have always been done on the stated date for me: $39 for taking a waist of a jacket in, $22 for sides+sleeves+darts of on a shirt, $12 for just darts, ~10-15 for a hem.

My girlfriend took me here for Valentine's Day brunch, and every little nuance about this place was incredible.
First, our waitress, Brooke, was the best waitress we've ever had- since it was our first time, she brought us their signature creme brûlée French toast with the Meyers rum sauce... To die for!!!!
They bring out fresh out of the oven croissants with amazing strawberry topping. 
The breakfast quiche was great but the crab cake Benedict easily because my favorite breakfast dish in Austin. 
If I could give more than 5 stars, I would.

I'm honestly surprised there are such low ratings for this hospital (not to doubt patients negative experience here were real) but we had a 5 star visit when my husband had to take me late at night last week when my wrist started to hurt so bad I was crying hysterically in pain. EVERY SINGLE time we had gone to health alliance Leominster hospital, either for one of us or one of our 4 kids, it was more traumatic than the trauma itself! I mean AWFUL from the 4-5 HR wait time to the flat out RUDE staff & my husband was not about to put me through more agonizing pain than I was already in so he brought me to Emerson.. The intake person (I think her name was Christine) was absolutely wonderful & the entire visit including X-rays lasted less than an hour & 1/2!!! Everyone was kind, caring & professional & they answered all our questions in a genuinely caring manner. They even called a few days later to "follow up" & see how I was doing!! This is DEFINITELY our new  emergency care facility in any time of need & we thank them from the bottom of our hearts for the care I was given!

My bf and I went to Another Broken Egg on Dec 5th 2020 while visiting from out of state. We were seated quickly and pleasantly greeted by our server (Keischa). The food here is immaculate.. made to perfection. I ordered the Floridian omelette and added bacon (chefs kiss) and my man got the Cinnamon Roll French Toast. The foster sauce is to DIE FOR  The staff is super friendly and helpful with menu questions however we haven't had service at a restaurant as good as Keischa provided since before the pandemic!! She is very kind quick on her feet and attentive! Would love to come back and have her serve our table again. All around great experience here

Got my septum pierced by Danny of Friday and I am LOVING it. He was so kind and informative and personable.. it really made the pre-piercing jitters a little calmer lol. I liked that he really breaks it down so you can make an informed decision instead of just piercing for the piercing and booting you out the door. So glad I went to IRIS - the jewelry selection is awesome (some things are pretty pricy but there are plenty of budget friendly options too) and the piercing room was clean and comfortable. I even got to learn all about their jewelry sterilizing equipment (seriously don't remember the piercings I got 20 years ago bring so stringent) it was awesome. Looking forward to having Danny do more work in the future!!

Truly some of the best gelato I've ever had! 

The owner was so nice and let me try as many flavors as I wanted. He even shoved four flavors (max was supposed to be three) in a waffle bowl for me because I loved all the flavors. I would recommend the Wild Berry and Black Cherry as those were my absolute favorite. The mango, pistachio and strawberry were a close second. 

My husband loves gelato so we always get some in each place we've visited and this is some of the best. Worth the stop in! 10/10 would recommend.

I think Salt Lick may have been the reason I went to Texas. 

A fairly short ride through the beautiful and scenic Hill Country outside of Austin leads you to the epic destination that is Salt Lick BBQ restaurant, winery and associated ranch. You park in a huge dirt parking lot right off the side of the road in Driftwood, TX.  When we pulled up, I was shocked by the number of cars in the lot.  

The restaurant is made up of two buildings and an outside area.  The outside area has popcorn, drinks and live music most of the time.  It has plenty of shade so it isn't too sweltering for those who have to wait to be seated. Everything about the setting feels authentic.  I came with two friends on a Sunday night and we were seated immediately in the building with the BBQ smoker.  The pit is a spectacle for sure and you should check it out even if you are sitting in the other building.  

For our meal, we were focused on the meats.  I ordered the half ribs, half brisket plate which comes with potato salad, beans and slaw.  They bring bread, pickles and onions for the table.  I will say the sides are nothing to write home about (between the three of us, we didn't finish one order of sides).  The greatness of the meat makes up for the lackluster nature of the sides.  As someone who doesn't eat a ton of red meat, I was pretty blown away.  The brisket is served in long, large strips and the pork ribs have plenty of meat on them.  

If you come with a larger group, I would recommend the Family Style meal so you can sample everything Salt Lick has to offer. It is about $20 and comes with brisket, sausage, and ribs in addition to the sides.  Or you might just want to order the meats...the sides just really aren't worth it. They also have a little gift shop where you can purchase commemorative T-shirts as well as Salt Lick sauces. Salt Lick is a Texas experience that you shouldn't miss out on.

This place opened up close to my house, and it has become a regular spot for my husband and me. We usually sit either at the bar, or on the patio with our pup. 

First, order the salmon tartare. Do it. Don't ask questions. I am obsessed. 

Second, their cocktails are always amazing and affordable priced, as are their excellent beer and wine selections. 

Third, when the weather is nice, the patio is the best place to be in our neighborhood. I hesitate to add that because it fills up so quickly! But it's true, and you should know. 

Fourth, every person on the staff, from the wonderfully warm owners, to the hilarious front of house servers, are fantastic at their jobs. They're friendly and knowledgeable and awesome. 

Basically I love this place. Especially the salmon tartare.

I truly enjoyed my shrimp  french fries and salad with my Sangria  I really recommend if you live in south or west austin a hidden delight location is lake hills plaza. Strange we found it driving by. I will come again because they great  Asian and american food .My cup of tea so if you are around the area stopped in and get the fried shrimp is very good. Waitstaff is very attentive  collen is excellent. Enjoy good food and good drinks

I highly recommend this place after my second visit. I believe there are two locations, but this is the newer and cleaner one. Unless they moved from the old one to this one. 

First visit- 30 minute foot massage ($30)
Second visit- 1 hour deep tissue body massage ($60)

Massage Therapist: I believe it all depends on how you want to be massaged. The two times I've been, no complaints. You could always speak up and let them know to apply lighter pressure during your massage. They usually ask if you're okay (body massage). 

Decor: Very clean and soothing. Typical spa music, but with Chinese instrumental music added. 

Service: friendly and swift! I called to make a reservations for my second visit and the person over the phone was very nice and booked it right away. 

Parking: private lot. Plenty of parking.

This is THE BEST Thai place in Columbus. Their food is incredible and they have so many vegan options: sushi, apps and multiple entrees! My most favorite is this incredibly dish called Monsoon Tofu: it's perfectly steamed veggies and seared tofu smothered in a sauce that's coconutty, spicy, savory and a bit sweet all in one. I get it at least weekly, and I'm not kidding. I heard they may be changing the menu and removing it soon, which would be SUCH a loss!

I went to Dr. Lauri with neck pain so bad, I wanted to rip my own head off! Dr. Lauri was professional, thorough and took the time to get to know my physical history and symptoms so that she could analyze the reasons for my pain. She is definitely very knowledgeable about chiropractic and ART and you'll learn more about your condition and its treatment when you visit her. She administers treatment that is tailored to YOUR needs and cares enough about her patients to follow up via text after each session to check on how you're responding to treatment and then makes recommendations based on that.  Doesn't rush through sessions and does what is needed. 

I have been seeing Dr. Lauri for 6 months now and my neck feels a lot better, something I definitely attribute to her treatments. She is also a great maternity chiropractor and I still visit her to get my back adjusted from time to time now that I'm pregnant. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a good chiropractor!

So here I am writing another review.......mostly because i found Lucky Shaw and Water Damage Restoration and Roofing of Austin here and based on the other excellant reviews decided to check them out.  We needed a whole new roof and I actually got about 8 or 9 estimates from different contractors.  What I liked about Lucky was his low-key approach to sales, no high pressure or anything like that just solid info.
I could not be happier with the excellant quality of the work and crew, just first class all the way!  Highly recommend!

I love P. Terry's and I'm SO EXCITED that one opening up around 30th and Lamar very soon!  

The fries are delicious and the burgers are just right, some think they're too small, but I think they're perfect!  I love grabbing P.Terry's during the summer on my way to Zilker or Barton Springs and making a picnic out of it, the food paired with a milkshake makes the perfect summer lunch.  I need to get down there and take advantage of this gorgeous February that we've been having!

I stopped by this shop after brunch at The Steeping Room. I am visiting from out of town and wanted to make sure that I made a stop at Houndstooth, as it was on my list of "must visits". I was delighted to walk in and see that the staff was all female, which isn't always the case in the specialty coffee world. The cashier was pleasant and efficient, and the friendly barista made me a delicious almond cortado. Tasty espresso & smooth milk. The shop itself is nice, clean and has outdoor seating as well. I would certainly recommend this spot for a tasty drink.

We had a wonderful experience at the Gunshow. Kevin Gillespie was there this night cooking along with the other wonderful chefs. This was an additional awesome surprise as we had heard he is not there all the time. What a treat!
We have actively been trying to get a reservation for a while now. Finally snagged a 9pm reservation on Friday night. It's was packed when we arrived but they seated us immediately.
We were not familiar with the concept but were pleasantly surprised, just think like a dim sum restaurant where the dishes that you share are coming around. The chefs prepare what you see on the menu but you don't order it. You wait for them to come around with the dishes and you either accept the dish or deny it. Pretty much like dim sum. Except not on a cart. The chef that prepared it brings it out themselves and describes it to you before you decide to keep or not.
We decided to accept the whole menu. We only denied one that thought might make us too full to accomplish this feat!
I can tell you that my husband and I are in agreement that every dish was spot on spectacular. They were very unique and even if it was a familiar taste to you, it had a twist to it. For example the Chicken Liver Mousse Split had sweet plantains and candied nuts? It was an unexpected combination but it worked very nicely together.
Our hands down favorites for the night were the Grilled Pork Belly (which Chef Kevin Gillespie) brought out himself, Burnt raw Kobe beef and the Bone Marrow. At last call we ordered a second Bone Marrow as the pre-dessert (I'll take another dish to dessert any day) to our Banana Pudding dessert. 
I won't go into describing the dishes because they change them every 3 weeks and that might crush you to go in to eat  something I describe and then it not be on the menu. But I can vouch for the fact that every single one was delicious and beautifully presented. We loved that we could ask the chef anything about the dish since they deliver the dish themselves. 
The place is very loud and it feels like you're at a party in someone's home even if you don't talk to the person sitting next to you. You will be seated at long tables and have perfect strangers next to you. But it works!
Enjoy the unique experience!

Side note:
Chef Gillespie graciously spoke with us before we left and being the To Chef fans we are, indulged us with a foto.

My boyfriend was kind enough to treat me to dinner here for my 30th birthday.  

We couldn't decide what to order so we got ourselves some sushi which was absolutely delicious.  

The kitchen is open and clean and just so efficiently run.  You can just tell by watching the staff.

We had a window table and were able to view the "Mickey's Not So Scary Halloween Party Fireworks Show" and the lights went out in the restaurant, and the audio available to the people in the Magic Kingdom was playing in the restaurant and it's seriously the best seat in the whole park!  We had an amazing panoramic view of the whole show.  I was so happy!!! 

Our waitress was really attentive and helpful when we were picking out our food.  We had the ravioli which was absolutely delicious.  

Tip:  Order a bunch of stuff with your party and split it so you can sample a lot more.  That's what we did and we left trying a bunch of stuff and we weren't stuffed!  

Def. take the time to make a reservation ahead of time (cause you won't get in otherwise) or you can sample a thing or two at the bar!!

I visited eight bridal shops on my wedding dress hunt in Austin, and Blush was by far my favorite and best experience. (I did find my dress here, after all!) 

First, the boutique itself is exactly what you picture a bridal boutique to be: quaint, vintage, luxe, well-lit, and full of beautiful dresses and accessories. Trust me, the same cannot be said for all bridal shops. I've been in some that are dank and run-down looking, and Blush blows them all out of the water. 

The associates were helpful and friendly. I felt comfortable the whole time--never had that "Pretty Woman" moment, if you know what I mean. They also have a great "same-day" policy (or, at least, they did the day I was shopping!) where you receive a discount if you buy a dress the day of your appointment. We actually ended up returning to Blush at the end of the day after two more appointments to purchase the lace, fit-and-flare Tara Keely dress I had fallen in love with. Between the fabulous dress itself, the great experience at Blush and the fantastic deal we were going to get on top of that, it was as if the stars had aligned that day. I highly recommend Blush for Texas brides!

I am so thankful that I found Deka Lash!! I've had extensions before from other salons in the area, but this is by far the best experience I've ever had! (Not to mention, this is the cleanest salon I've visited) 
My lashes always come out perfectly and I've never had any issues with them staying put. Anytime I've ever had questions or concerns, the staff is so helpful and knowledgeable about caring for my lashes properly! 

They so kindly fit me in last minute this weekend. For such a booked studio, the environment is so serene and relaxing - I'm always able to enjoy my appointment without distraction! I've seen several of the girls there, and they are all very talented - my technician was timely, skillful, and professional. She gave me exactly what I was looking for! They always customize my lashes just for me - sometimes I want something more dramatic, or even a little more subtle. I just love it here!! Can't recommend enough

When I moved to Wakefield 18 months ago I tried Nails Plus based on yelp reviews.  Best decision, Stephanie and Julie take their time and you never feel rushed.  I always feel so relaxed after leaving, they give you a good massage and really clean up your nails.  They listen to your request, I always ask for super short and round and that is exactly what they do.  
The salon is small so I recommend making an apt because if they don't have time they will turn away walk in's which I think is a plus because you know they aren't going to do a bad job and rush you to fit everyone in.  
I always have them pick out colors for me, Stephanie is honest and will give you her opinion, today she told me the color I picked was too old lady!  Glad I took her advice and went with her recommendation.

After 3 plumbers tried to clear a clogged shower drain
And after the last plumber put 3 huge holes in my nicely painted dining room to gain access to pipes only to tell me I had to redo entire bathroom for $10K and replace old pipes
Finally, David comes to the rescue
He figured out the problem and fixed it and I don't have to redo entire bathroom! He saved the day
He is also on time
He calls first and he was a pleasure to work with and saved me a lot of  money!
Highly recommended

This place has limited seating and if you have to sit on the bench along the wall, there's a good chance your butt will be in someone's face. It's very tight seating ! With that being said, the breakfast was delicious. We started with the banana bread bites they provide for free. Those were good. Then the Nutella banana croissants; also good. Our egg breakfast came out also and this was good too. The service was friendly but the day we went they were so busy, we didn't get as many coffee refills or water refills as we would have liked. The food made up for it though. Go here if you're in the north end.

We were immediately greeted and seated. drink service was also immediate and friendly. bathrooms and dining room were clean.  prices (for the area) were reasonable.  My wife had an egg sandwich and decaf (late dinner) and I had a gyro.  both were excellent, served hot with fresh ingredients. the server was constant in his care and attention to detail.  we enjoyed our late dinner so much we came back the next morning for breakfast.  I had a the early bird special and my wife had 2 scrambled eggs and a slice of apple pie.  the service was consistent and the food delicious.  (i'm fairly certain i was given 4 eggs! - all portions were generous).  this cafe is a hidden treasure but worth the hunt.

If you have fine, thin, or thinning hair, I highly recommend Sidney. 
Sidney is truly a fine hair expert. My hair is very fine and I recently experienced a great deal of hair loss. Sidney understood exactly the problems I encounter trying to style my fine hair. She explained her recommendations and what I could expect to achieve. Sidney listened carefully to what I hoped my fine hair could look like and discussed cut and treatment options with me. 
I've never written a review for a haircut before, but I hope all the frustrated fine or thin haired people in Austin will consider Sidney for their next haircut!

OMG if I could rate Sweet Tooth with 10 stars I would!!!  By far Sweet Tooth has the  BEST cupcakes I've ever had in all my years on this planet.  Someone at work who is getting married and is ordering her cake from ST suggested we order their cupcakes for an office birthday party.  They are absolutely too pretty too eat, but after an intense decision making moment, I chose their Chocolate Truffle-chocolate cupcake filled with chocolate butter cream, dipped in ganache, topped with one of our signature truffles (which I might add was a mint chocolate truffle- Yummo).  To start with the cupcake is HUGE (but I managed) and savored every morsel, groaning in pleasure  (to the point of almost needing a cigarette when I was finished LOL!!!).  Anyone, and I repeat anyone, who doesn't enjoy Sweet Tooth, there is something seriously wrong with them.   Can't wait to reorder!!

Santa Catarina has become a great little spot for a quick dinner, relaxing happy hour, or meet up with friends.  The chips and salsa are awesome (which is foundational), the food is tasty and fresh.  We also enjoy the drinks.  My most recent visit was on a Friday afternoon for happy hour.  It was a working meeting but my brain was fried from a week of stress.  After a margarita and a beer I jumped up and headed home.  Once home I realized I had left my briefcase.  I freaked!  My files, my computer...my life!  I called Miguel at S.C. and he assured me he would keep it safe until the following day when I could pick it up.  I walked in at 9am the next morning and my briefcase was brought out of the office in the back.  Thanks for being an honest place of business with great service and fresh food.

My bf and I have decided this is our favorite restaurant in town, and here's why: Holiday in Cambodia cocktail. Bacon-wrapped dates with chèvre. Flawless local microgreen salad. Duck confit. (No, seriously, guys, DUCK CONFIT. HOLY CRAP.) Fallen chocolate soufflé. House-made ice creams and truffles. Oh, yeah, did I mention that all of that is gluten-free? Each server we've had has been very helpful with my gluten issues. And I will tell you a secret about the soufflé...

Well, first, order it (and it takes a while, so ask for it when your entrées come). And second, either save the butter that domes with the bread, or ask for some, and then scoop a little butter onto your spoon before each bite of soufflé. (Yeah. You're welcome.)

If you are looking for the Holy Grail of Doctors.. 
CONGRATULATIONS! YOU'VE FOUND IT!

I am hesitant to leave this review, because I want to keep Dr. Hill all to myself, but I will try to make it as short and informative as possible instead. However, I cannot help but rave about the overall, outstanding quality of this facility, and the people who work inside of it. 



Dr. Hill, and her husband (also Dr. Hill), are two of the most genuine, kind-hearted people I have ever met in my life. They TRULY care about their patients and NOT about their revenue. 

I don't know why it is hard to find a good doctor, but I did a lot of research, this place had no reviews: I decided to give it a try.. What luck I was in! 

- The reception is: awesome, clean, modern, comfortable, & aesthetically pleasing, but that's not of much relevance, you won't be there for long! 
- The receptionists are awesome, friendly, professional, organized, &  empathetic. 
- The wait time is basically NON-EXISTENT.
 
and finally.. We get to Dr. Hill. She is:
- AMAZING. AAAAA MMMMM AAAA ZZZZ IIIIII NNNN GGGGG 
- Empathetic
- Accomodating
- GENUINE
- Sweet
- Professional
- Intelligent
- Doesn't rush, takes her time with you
- Explains thoroughly: the why; actions for the present; plan for the future
- INEXPENSIVE
- Doesn't shove products for you to buy for her profit, only if you need it
- Very accommodating with insurance needs, problems, concerns.
- Is always on your side, wants you to be at your best in all aspects of health.
- Available 24/7 

Seriously, do your self a favor, try her out. Depending where you are in Austin, it may be a bit of a drive, but it is 110% worth it.

I had not eaten at the South Congress Cafe in years, but remembered enjoying it. 

Stopped in for breakfast around 10:45 on Labor Day with my GF. The place was packed, but we were able to get on the list, were told it would be a 15-20 minute wait, and they took our phone #, sent a a text immediately confirming the 15-20 minute wait, and then texted us when our table was ready. Nice and efficient. 

We didn't have to wait long for our waiter Gabe, and we weren't ready (because there are a lot of seemingly delicious items to choose from on the menu), so he said he'd come right back, we figured out our order, and he was back in 2-3 minutes. 

We ordered the Migas, add avocado, with corn tortillas, and the Crab Cake Benedict: "spinach bacon quiche, crispy prosciutto, and potato pancake" with the chipotle hollondaise (you get a choice). 

Our plates were out shortly, and the meal was delicious. I was worried the crab cake benedict was going to be salty and too rich with the spinach bacon quiche, but it was delicious. I'm not usually a fan of crispy crab cakes, but in this case it was a perfect bite with the soft light quiche and the crispy crab cake giving a nice crunch.

The Migas too was delicious, and came with delicious home cooked tortillas. 

Service was fantastic, especially considering how busy the place was. We had one guy who was just going around ensuring people had coffee (great idea!), and a manager named Otis came by to ensure our experience was satisfactory. We told him it was a Yelp 5 star experience, and he came by again - spoke to me by name, thanked us for coming, and invited us back again. 

The South Congress Cafe is a class act. Fantastic food, reasonable prices, and runs like a well oiled machine. We will definitely be going back to sample more of their culinary delights.

I have been on 3 tours with Texas Wino's and had a blast on all of them.  First was a winery tour from Austin to Fredericksburg, second was brewery tour that started south and went north, and third was a brewery tour that started north and went south.  Tour guides are friendly, on time, and do a great job of keeping everyone on schedule.  I recommend this group highly to anyone looking to take a group out and not worry about who will be the designated driver.

I came here for dinner tonight with my friend.  We ordered the Caesar's salad and an 18 inch half n' half pizza.  We has the margarita and the Bacon Bianca.  Both pizzas were outstanding as always.  We made reservation tonight and were promptly seated.  As busy ad the restaurant was we never felt that our waiter forgot about us.  Everyone was friendly and all diners appeared to be having a great time.  I highly recommend their home made Caesar's salad which is put together with whole romaine leaves with parmesan cheese and home made dressing.  Yummmm!!  This place is extremely busy every day but especially on weekends.  If you don't have reservations on a weekend expect at least an hour or longer wait.  Reservations are a must on weekends and that goes especially with groups of 4 or larger. With exceptional pizzas that are rated top 10 in the nation you can expect long waits and big crowds.   Oh by the way, they don't seat your party unless every person in your party is present.  Just a heads up!  I will always recommend this place to any pizza fan, and with prices comparable to some of the chain pizzerias, why go anywhere else but Apizza Scholls! Starve yourself and come with a big appetite because the portion sizes are HUGE! You won't regret that you did.

Great North End location.

Best Cafe Mocha in North End.  Owner is nice and interesting to chat with.  Don't expect brewed coffee here-this is European as in-espresso drinks only.

The first time we walk into Cafe Graffiti:

We all walk in, me, my wife, two girls.  I'm looking up at the menu, kids are checking the place out.  I walk up to the counter.  Behind the counter is the owner.  Probably 6'6", big guy, tatts all over, could be intimidating to some.  My daughter walks up to the counter and looks up at him.  At the time she was 9.  

Huge dude with tatts looks down at her, holds out fist, tosses head back slightly:  "Sup?"

Little girl makes fist, raps it on huge dude's fist, tosses head back slightly:  "Sup."

We've been going here ever since.

Great location to relax and people watch.

Very warm and welcoming atmosphere, I go here every time I'm in the North End (which is pretty regularly)

Loved my stay at this hotel! I was here for the Fourth of July weekend and it was great! As soon as we got to this hotel we were greeted by the concierge. The checking in process was quick and we even got complimentary champagne. That being said, the staff was super friendly and helpful. As for the room, I stayed in the standard room where the balcony overlooked the garden entrance. Haha one thing I found to be pretty cool was the greeting message on the tv which said "welcome mr/mrs/miss YOUR NAME". Also, the hotel provides shuttles to a list of numerous theme parks. I took the shuttle to Magic Kingdom and it was incredibly easy and fast. Okay so here comes the best part of the hotel!! THE POOL AND THE LAKE are AMAZING! You have huge pools that have cave like features!! You have a rope bridge, water slide, hammocks, rock climbing, a full bar that also serves food, hot tubs, and even movie nights by the pool on Saturdays. The lake has paddle boats and sail boats available for you to use and it's included in your stay (the mandatory resort fee includes all the amenities, this being one!).

I've been coming forever and every year the show somehow gets better! Still find it hard to believe that such a high-quality production is put on entirely by students. The performances, costumes, and script are all impeccable. Theatre is clean and conveniently located.

I paid $40 and it was totally worth it, but definitely keep your eyes peeled for deals. I recommend following their Facebook, since they post about theme nights and deals on there a lot.

Cannot wait for HPT 169: Casino Evil!!!
