Not my first time at Yard House but this past Sunday was my first visit for the Austin Domain location. Staff was super polite and courtesy - quickly greeted and escorted us to our table. Every staff member wore masks and patrons were spaced apart for social distancing.

I ordered the Lobster Bisque Agnolotti which did not disappoint; paired with the mango mojito - delicious. Hubby went for the bacon cheeseburger and the crown apple mule which really surprised him - super tasty. 

Very pleased with quality of food, service and price - all three remain consistent. We'll definitely be back soon.

I recently had my son's birthday at Milwaukie Bowl. The staff were laid back yet very attentive and helpful. The prices were super reasonable. Everyone had a fantastic time and several parents in attendance commented on being impressed with the set-up and accommodations. I would not only recommend having a child's birthday party here, but I will continue to visit as a customer with my family. Thank you, THANK YOU Milwaukie Bowl for the use of your facility and for your excellent service!

I can't think of one reason to take any stars off...after reading my fellow Yelpers reviews yesterday I decided it was time to bite the bullet and finally get another bikani wax. With memories of painful past experiences, I called and lucky enough to get a same day appointment (someone cancelled- Priscilla later told me they are usually booked up weeks in advance). 
   It was as pleasurable as a wax can be. Priscilla was really quick and efficient. Tears didn't have time to form before the whole thing was over. She did a great job, was great to talk too, the environment was great..and best of all, it only cost me $20 . That has to be the best deal in the Boston area. Yeah Skin and Body works! This one goes on my good finds list .

I went to to Jose Luis Salon on a recommendation from my daughter. The Salon was very relaxing and they have a great boutique right when you walk in. Lots of really beautiful things, Jewelry, candles, beauty products, etc. The girls working in the front were very friendly and welcoming. Ryan was my stylist. I went in for a health cut and some texturing. Ryan did an awesome job, he asked me all the right questions about how I like my hair and the things I don't like about it. Then after our Q&A he restated my likes and dislikes, to make sure that he understood what I was wanting and then made his suggestions.  He gave me an great scalp massage while shampooing my hair, (I would go in just for that !!! It was awesome:) Then he cut and styled my hair. I have to say that most times when I leave a salon, I want to go home immediately and restyle it before I go anywhere. This was not the case with Ryan, I left there and was ready to go, my hair looked awesome. Needless to say I would highly recommend this salon and Ryan. I will definitely be going back. Hope this was helpful:)

I was visiting Orlando for a wedding and searched for a nail place to get mine done before the wedding. I am so extremely glad I stumbled upon this place. What a beautiful relaxing atmosphere. They were quick to get me in and quick to get me finished since my husband was waiting on me. My nail tech did such an amazing job on my nails, they were beaten up pretty thoroughly. If I'm ever in Orlando again, I will be visiting more often!

Studio 52 is a beautiful studio in the heart of downtown Boston featuring gorgeous vintage windows that let natural sunlight in during the day. At night, the studio has candles lit making the studio feel like a zen spa. The wood floors and exposed brick walls make the studio feel incredibly clean and spacious. Absolutely NO yoga studio in downtown Boston can even compare to Studio 52! I have visited studios in downtown Boston, Brookline, Newton, and other towns that serve wealthy clients, and by far Studio 52 exceeds in aesthetics and serenity!!

Now on to the yoga: The owner and lead instructor, Alena, strives to make every class unique, comfortable, fun, and relaxing! 
- For an energizing and physical yoga experience, I highly recommend the HIP HOP YOGA class. Alena chooses new and interesting music playlists for the class that makes you want to come back every week for a new spin on the fun techniques and new songs to add to your spotify playlist!
- If you work downtown, then you may want to try the LUNCH BREAK 45-MINUTE FLOW class to help get yourself energized and ready to tackle the stress that comes with the workweek. The lunch break class is not so physically demanding that you'll be going back to work all sweaty either!
- For those who have done yoga in the past, you know the feeling of refreshment and have seen the glow in your skin afterwards. One of my favorite classes that Alena offers at Studio 52 is the Friday WEEKEND GLOW class. You can go right after work and then go out (to a date, bar, club, or hang out with friends) with a refreshing glow!
- Along with the yoga to start the weekend, Alena offers a SUNDAY FUNDAY class to end the weekend on Sunday. This class is the best when you've either partied hard or (if you're like me) studied too hard all weekend long and need a light workout with an emphasis on detoxing and starting the week with a fresh mind!
- My absolute FAVORITE class is the VINYASA CANDLELIGHT FLOW class. Alena creates the most amazing atmosphere I have ever had in any yoga class or studio by lighting candles near the large windows (which are not facing any major building that has people who can look in, by the way). She also burns incense (not too much) that give the room a calming effect. Lastly, if you're lucky, Alena will give you a cooling neck massage during shavasana! I've only experienced that in one class at one other studio ever! It is definitely the best way to end a yoga session!
- Lastly, although I have not tried this class yet, I can infer that the PILATES YOGA FUSION class would be amazing! After attending all the other classes that Alena has instructed, I can only imagine how great of a workout and strengthening session this class will be! Now that winter is coming, I'm definitely going to try it out to work on my core and get those abs ready for next summer!

Moving away from the yoga to one of the best new features that Studio 52 has to offer is the website!! I was pleasantly surprised how easy it is to navigate and reserve spots on my iPhone! The website is designed to have everything easy to access right when you visit! NEVER have I seen a website for a yoga studio that is easily accessed on a phone (which is absolutely crazy since almost everyone has access to a phone at all times rather than a computer)!!! Now I can reserve a spot for any class within a minute!

Truly this is one amazing place with an innovative and inspiring owner/instructor to get your yoga on =)

Went here on a whim to get my awkward growing hair out cut and reshaped. No appointment on a Friday afternoon and only had to wait ten minutes (actually put my name down and ran to the Safeway next door). Katy did a great job cutting my hair and did exactly what I wanted including a lot of needed thinning which some stylists are hesitant to do but I have too thick hair and need it.  Shop was very clean and friendly. Will definitely go again.

I was at the end of my rope. My very large and strong dog Winston had become aggressive and hostile towards every living non-human creature. I couldn't take him anywhere without running the risk of him attacking something or even leave him unattended around my other dog. 

Then Doggy Business came to the rescue...! (Queue epic theme music). After attending a few of their behavior classes and being very diligent in following their recommendations, Winston's back to being the lovable fur bag I knew and loved before his psychotic break. Their reward-based, non-punishment classes not only help your dog, but most of what I learned was how to be a better dog handler. Who knew? Now, Winston's happier and so am I.

I just brought my mom in to get a covid test and we had a great experience from start to finish. The staff at the front desk was very polite and professional and understood that I was there interpreting for her as my mom only speaks Spanish. We had made an appointment for 4:55 and were called in at, like 4:58, which is amazing all things considered with this pandemic. Once we were called in, the screening for the test was quick & effective, the girl that took the swab for my mom was very nice & understanding at the discomfort of it, and the results came back in about 15-20 mins. The best part, however, was hands down the doctor that checked on my mom and asked about her symptoms (after getting the results back as negative for covid) and showed concern for her breathing condition and examined her. Though my mom has asthma, she has been breathing terribly at night the past few nights and this doctor took the time to write her some prescriptions to treat her bronchitis symptoms. I feel like the doctor could have easily not cared and sent us home after the negative covid results, but she took the time to attend to my mom's health (she was even perceptive of the language barrier and printed out her discharge forms in Spanish!). Amazing experience and highly recommend!

Delicious! We had the Banjan, Mourgh Kabob, Tikka Kabob and Aush soup. The bread and spreads they bring out are also amazing. Every single thing on our plates was delicious and tasty. My 11 year old couldn't stop eating the spinach that came with my dish and loved everything we ordered. For desert we had the pineapple cake - which was moist and not overly sweet- just amazing, like everything else we had there. The portions are perfectly sized and the prices make sense for the quality of food and the amazing flavors. We will definitely come back again soon!

Dr. Amanda Massey is a miracle worker. Prior to Dr. Massey's care, I had always been reluctant to seek out chiropractic treatment. However, my attitude toward the profession has been forever changed for the better! 

Following an acute neck injury, my pain and limited range of motion led me to accept a recommendation to visit Dr. Massey at Infinity Wellness Center. The waiting room is somewhat spa-like in its decor and ambiance, creating a feeling of relaxation. Dr. Massey is not only pleasant in her demeanor, but also refreshing in her tendency to take appointments slowly, analyze problem areas thoroughly, and develop an individualized treatment plan for each patient. She doesn't just "get cracking" on your back right away. She gives great eye contact and asks plenty of questions. Adjustments are made deliberately, with care, and only as needed. You are in GOOD HANDS with this doctor! 

While I understand that healing takes time and repeated treatments, I do not like being "sold" a number of treatments from the get go. Thank goodness, Infinity Wellness Center DOES NOT do that! Patients collaborate with Dr. Massey to determine how often, and for what duration, treatments should occur. No up-front commitments or payments are taken. 

Thank you, Dr. Massey and Infinity Wellness Center, for awesome care. I will absolutely return in the future if needed.

This place has it all: great food, service, ambiance, and location.  The sushi is impressive; tip: make sure you always ask for the specials like live amaebi and uni.  The hosts and servers are attentive and knowledgeable; for big groups make reservations for the private rooms on the second floor.  The decor is an immersion into another place; tip: watch the serene videos on the second floor.  The location is right in Coolidge Corner; tip: ...nope. I am not telling you my secret parking spots.

This is the best place to go for auto glass in Quincy. They take care of your car, and they finish the job quickly. They also stand by their work. I have had the windshield replaced on my 22-yr. old Buick here twice, and was very satisfied! They have even replaced my windshield once for free because the molding around the top of the window was screwed up (after the car was painted), and could only be repaired by doing the job over again... I was very happy they fixed it! I would definitely do business with them again on any type of car...

Thank You, STK-Orlando, for a very special evening. It was our 17th Wedding Anniversary and we wanted something special, so we made an Open Table reservation. We started off in the downstairs bar/lounge area, where Damien took very good care of us. He was polite and engaged us to where we really felt like the only people there. We were then treated to a very special, intimate upstairs balcony seating area. Wow! And the view...Mr. David Provencio, the GM, took over from there. I can safely say, we have never been treated so well. STK-Orlando went the extra mile by having a dedicated staff wait on us. The chef came out to greet us and David recommended one of the nicest wines we have ever had. We started off with appetizers; the shaved brussels sprouts salad-OMG, it was wonderful. Now, the steaks. We dined on the cowgirl ribeye and 10oz. filet, with crab oscar-style and imperial (crab cake), respectively. This truly was perfection on a plate! David ensured everything was perfect, and boy was it ever. A perfect medium-rare and very flavorful. We enjoyed sides of jalapeno grits and bacon mac & cheese. For dessert, David surprised us with a combination of sorbet, bag of donuts with dipping sauces, and a large slice of chocolate cake. I mentioned the wine. As a gift, we were provided the wine case for the wine, signed by STK. The team really went out of their way to make sure we had a wonderful evening, and I would like to call out David for his outstanding customer service skills and really knowing how to make people happy...and wanting to return to STK-Orlando. Well done, David. We will be back!

Moving sucks! To me, the worst part of moving is the last of it. Getting the last little crap out of the house, and then, at least for me, the dreaded weekend of cleaning. Move out cleaning is hard! All I wanna do is go unpack and enjoy my new place but we still gotta clean the old place, the oven, the windows, the fridge, the fans and the carpets! I will just come out and say it. I was waaaay lazy and took the easy way out this time around.  I paid someone to clean my house and paid The Steam Team to clean the carpets.
The Steam Team rocked!!
I filled out some info on their website for an estimate and received an email that afternoon with the price. After I mentioned that all the furniture would be out of the house at the time of cleaning, I was offered 15% off due to vacant house! Awesome!
I was given an arrival time of 9-930, no 3-4 hour window requiring me to hang around an empty house waiting.
They showed up about 905, walked through explained how they would work and what we should expect, wrote us out a receipt and said hed be done in about 2 hours. 
A few hrs later we stopped by to lock up the house, they were gone and the carpets were clean! 
I mean really clean.  We had 3 dogs, 1 cat, and 5 roommates abusing the carpets for the past year and they had them looking almost new! I am so beyond happy with their services and the price was perfect, $200 = 3 bedrooms, 1 hall, 1 living room, 1 dining room. Worth it!

when you walk in, you might feel like youre walking into a four star restaurant because it seems rather pretentious, but the food is actually not that expensive...their food is so good here, the salads are satisfying just by itself!  maybe not filling since its not a  large portion, but it will quench your taste buds!  this was the place that converted to beets and fried goat cheese salad! the entrees are scrumptious as well!  the cuisine was basic, but the flavors of every dish were beyond spectacular!

My boyfriend and I celebrated our 2 year anniversary here. We were seated in the dining area (opposed to bar seating area) and were waited on promptly. They like it if you order your appetizer and entree all at once so we ordered the escargot (best I've ever had), and the chicken entree for 2 and it was ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS. It comes with the creamiest mashed potatoes ever and was the perfect amount for the two of us. For dessert we had the bleu cheese icecream with a port wine reduction sauce (sounds crazy... Because it is!!! But so good!). They gave us two mini eclairs on the house for our anniversary. 
Other notes:
Valet is complimentary 
The peach purée Bellini was delish
Service was phenomenal 
We would definitely dine here again!

Beyond Fit is amazing! Seriously. I have been training with Chad since they opened and I couldn't be more thrilled with my results. Every day, I look forward to heading to the training center in Austin to attend class and work out. The workouts are always varied and challenging. Everyone that trains there is really supportive; whether you are going for a new PR or a celebrating a weight loss. It is a welcoming, vibrant, positive and fun community.

Chad is an extremely knowledgeable and passionate trainer who urges each of his clients to make their minds a weapon (for good!) rather than their weakness. He works really hard to meet the needs of each of his clients and goes above and beyond to support everyone on their own level. Each workout is scalable; moves can be modified or amplified. At Beyond Fit, there is a great emphasis placed on nutrition and Chad works with clients to figure out how they can best achieve optimal results. He worked with me to develop a nutrition plan that was personalized to my vegan lifestyle and high level of activity.

Classes at Beyond Fit are great. Every day there is something new happening; the variety helps keep me on my toes and trying new things each time.  Chad pushes me and I leave my workouts feeling strong and motivated! The value of the service you receive is so much more than the monthly rate. You WILL NOT get the same quality of knowledge, service and support from other trainers or gyms in Austin. Invest in your health and wellness, for now and the future and and check out Beyond Fit - you will be sorry if you don't!

I went to Hubbard recently with a friend and Wow! We were really impressed from start to finish. The minute we walked in, we received a very warm greeting and welcoming smiles all around from the staff. It was a gorgeous day so, we decided to sit outside on their awesome patio! The atmosphere was clean and hip yet, had an elegant ambiance.

My friend and I are both gluten - free so, we checked out the menu to see what we could have and the menu was labeled with icons next to the dishes that were or could be made gluten - free, which makes ordering a breeze! Our server Nick greeted us immediately and offered us drink options. He was extremely friendly, knowledgeable and accommodating. We wanted hot tea and he recommended this delicious berry tea. When he brought it out, he served it with fruit wedges because he said it paired well and it really did! That presentation even with a cup of tea was just the start of our awesome meal. All of the staff was really informed about accommodating specific food allergies and providing recommendations. Our whole meal was based pretty much on what was recommended to us and we were NOT let down. So here's our meal breakdown..

First up was the roasted beet salad: Fresh, flavorful. Then the Tuna Tartare: SO GOOD! The combination of the crisp cucumber paired with the tuna was mouthwatering. Then we had the Lemon Artichoke Dip: Again Fresh, light, left us wanting more. Short Ribs + Shrimp: YUMMM! With cheddar grits I might add. The presentation was artistically beautiful. Next up was the Seared Salmon and Scallops: Listen..anyone reading this review. ORDER THESE TWO DISHES. Treat yourself. Seriously otherworldly exquisite. We were able to have all of these dishes gluten - free by the way!!

I'm going to wrap this up now and say that from beginning to end, we felt spoiled with our experience at Hubbard Grille. We left feeling like we had a big hug for a few hours. We thought..now how do we top that? We probably can't so, we will be back!

We used Cuisine Chez Vous for my daughter's wedding, which took place on Sept. 4th. Based on the reviews, and our experience throughout the wedding planning process, we expected great things from them, and they totally exceeded our expectations! We interviewed seven highly recommended caterers and did tastings with three, prior to choosing Cuisine Chez Vous, and they stood out, head and shoulders, above the rest. When we tasted their food, we were completely sold. They served us the best sea bass we had eaten in our lives, as well as to-die-for appetizers! In addition, they were competitively priced, but just seemed to put out that extra effort and enthusiasm that convinced us that they were just what we wanted!
Over the many months of planning the wedding, Walter was an absolute doll to work with. He was totally responsive to our frequent emails, and nothing seemed to faze him. He also seemed to to really "get" the look and feel that my daughter wanted at her wedding, which had a number of non-traditional and personal touches. What I loved about him, and about Michelle, is that they set their default to "yes", rather than "no". Whatever we asked for (and we did have a few non-standard requests), they always found a way to make it work, with good humor and caring.
On the day of our wedding, CCV took charge completely and made the whole affair seem seamless. As the mother of the bride, I didn't want to have to worry about or be responsible for anything during the actual wedding and reception. Michelle ran everything so smoothly, I felt like I was a guest rather than a host, and I was able to mingle and have fun with our friends and family, rather than worrying about the details or what would come next. Michelle is unflappable - that's all I can say!
I also wondered, in advance, if the food would be as delicious and as beautifully presented as it had been during our tasting. And it was - people are still telling me it was the best food they'd ever had at a wedding! There were plenty of servers too, so nobody had to wait very long for food or drinks. I loved how they used a number of servers to deliver plates to everyone at a table at the same time . That way, nobody had to wait, while their food got cold, for the other guests at the table to be served.
I could go on and on, but will only advise people not to consider anyone other than Cuisine Chez Vous! Thank you Walter, Michelle and everyone else at CCV!

I love love love you Red Shed.  You used to be Beverly's, a biker bar that I patronized one time because it looked so interesting from the outside.  Inside turned out to be pretty interesting too due to the fact that I witnessed bloodshed within the first five minutes.  Now, before you go assuming that those big bad bikers were brawling, please rest assured that they were not.  One big biker stood on a chair and fell over face first and hit his mouth on a table resulting in a bitten tongue and a trip to the hospital.  I would've laughed but was afraid he wouldn't think it was funny.
Flash forward a few years when I decide to give it another whirl.  Imagine my surprise to find no Beverly's, but a cool little bar w/ a GREAT outdoor area, excellent jukebox, strong pours and very friendly bartenders. And trust me, the fact that the place is now called "The Red Shed" does not escape me, considering my first experience with the bar at this location.

5 Stars for lovely sales associates who are super helpful, not competing for sales, and are open to some light chatting as well!

I was walking by and realized that I have never actually been in a Lululemon shop, much less tried on any of their gear. I'm what the French like to call "le cheapskate" and Lululemon always seemed a little rich for my palate. But when on Park Ave, one often finds oneself feeling fancy af. 

As soon as I walked in, I was hit with the most calming of scents, essential oils and white privilege. I kid! I kid! But the oils were on point, not kidding about that.

As I perused and wondered if I was going to have a Pretty Woman-esque "We don't have anything for YOU here" moment with the sales associates, I started to notice that they had tiny sizes for miniature people (I am one of said minute folks). I have the hardest time finding winter jackets that fit my small shoulders and don't make me look like a child playing dress up. But, here, I was in a tiny shoulders heaven! I quickly grabbed two sizes in a jacket and took them to the dressing room area to try them on in front of a mirror. 

I was struggling. One jacket fit me like a glove, but being my mother's daughter, I felt compelled to size-up so it would fit me if I grow. (I stopped growing in elementary school, mind you.) I looked around with fear of making the wrong choice evident in my eyes.

And in came Catherine to save the day.

She not only offered her opinion when I asked, but she talked about the similar jacket she has and how it faired in cold weather and fit over sweaters. She helped me with enthusiasm and not a hint of judgement. (She let me shop!! Queue excited Julia Roberts gif!)

As I contemplated spending a small fortune on this jacket, I remembered that in trying to be more minimal with my wardrobe, I am focusing on buying quality clothes that fit me really well, despite a steep price, knowing that I will take care of them and wear them for many years. Plus, it was cute and I wanted it. 

Last thing I'll say- when I went to make my shamefully expensive purchase I told the man at the register that Catherine had helped me. He looked up, smiled, and let me know that they all work together (no competition for commission!). Then I commented on the oils and the woman at the other register started telling me which oils they use and we laughed about essential oils while both knowing that I would later be selling a kidney on the black market to afford the jacket I'd just bought. 

So, yeah. It's pricey. But if you are the type of person who wears things until they fall apart, this may be the quality and fit you're looking for.

Nick Wood is an outstanding attorney who has helped me on various legal matters from simple traffic court matters to complex family law issues.  Whatever the issue, Nick knows the law, and more importantly, he knows how to apply it and argue it to the best advantage of his clients.  As an attorney myself, I understand the importance of choosing the right lawyer to defend yourself when confronted with difficult legal matters.  Nicks worked tirelessly on my behalf and I owe him a great debt of thanks for consistently and successfully resolving my issues.  I would recommend all of my friends and my family to Nick.  Nick is also honest to a fault which is a rare trait these days.  Thank you Nick.

Had the most unforgettable experience at Ledger. Came here with my sister and her best friend on Saturday night. Our wait time was extended a few minutes due to the busy season, so once we were seated, the manager Danny came over to our table and introduced himself. Such a nice and personable guy. He sent out a few appetizers on the house that were all excellent and so well presented. We ordered a few more as well, the fried brussell sprouts were mouth watering, the salmon tartar was incredible and the popovers were just what we needed! Thanks so much Danny!

Our server was Bethany who was an absolute delight, she made sure to make every second of our experience was wonderful. She was great and such a sweet girl with a bright personality (and it was her birthday!). Her first words when she came over to the table were "Sorry about the wait - I'm going to make sure you have the best night ever!" And we did! She picked out some ciders for us to try and explained that the Chef is friends with a lot of local farmers, so most of the vegetables and ingredients used in the meals are straight farm to table. Which we love and appreciate! Hope you had a very happy birthday Bethany! 

I ordered the sirloin steak for dinner which came with fingerling potatoes and farm fresh grilled (or roasted) carrots drizzled with a light but creamy white sauce. The steak was a bit undercooked for me. It was a thick cut, so understandable. I asked for it to be cooked just a little more. Danny came over to the table again to make sure they cook the steak just how I would like it. So accommodating and understanding.

Next thing we know, the Executive Chef Daniel came over to our table from the kitchen. Kindest, most genuine guy. He personally explained the way they cook their steaks at Ledger and wanted to know exactly how I wanted mine. (We felt awful, we never do that). He makes all of the ideas for the menu come to life, and takes each and every feedback personally and to heart. We all have worked in food establishments for years, so we know a really great thing when we see it. Thank you Daniel!

To end our meal Chef sent over the angel food cake dessert plate. Which may have been the most amazing part of it all. With a note written in chocolate that read "Sorry about your steak!". And we were all in awe over it. Candied pears, home-made angel food cake, home-made sweet granola, a light and buttery spiced mousse and a fruity sorbet all on one perfect plate. Delicious!

We truly did have the best time and can't wait to go back. And the atmosphere is awesome too. THANKS ALL!

Jenna

I love Hardee's! I think they have the best tender charbroiled chicken sandwich (white beast meat grilled perfectly, fresh lettuce, tomatoes, Mayo, and white cheese on buns). When I bite into it, the cheese just melts in your mouth, it gives a bit of sweet deliciousness. I am a chicken sandwich person and this place serves the best! I can understand why it takes time to wait for the meal because they have to prepare it freshly. They're not premade like other fast restaurants. I appreciate the freshness so I don't mind the wait. 

Service here is awesome! There is this lady whom worked here like forever! She's so sweet! After placing your order, you get a number and they will deliver the food to your table. How cool is that? Other than Chik Fil a, I don't know other fast food restaurants that does that. This establishment is clean too! 

Overall, this place gets a 5 stars from me. Too bad there aren't many Hardee's around where I live.

I just had my front entrance steps and back yard asphalt done this week by Mass Masonry and Stone. They are very professional and easy to deal with. They use less than a week to finish the two projects and did a beautiful job. John also offered me a good discount since I let them put their company sign in my front yard.  I will happy to hire them again for future jobs, but since they have 5 years guarantee service I guess I won't see them in a while :)

Yes, do it!
DOC is a great experience, as I love a meal that encourages me to slow down, savour, and explore.
I've been a few times and have always had a stellar experience.

We did two tasting menus with wine pairings.
The wine was for the most part very well matched, but if I don't enjoy something, and I'm not afraid to mention it- which I did, and our server was very attentive and poured me exactly what I had in mind!!  With a set wine pairing?  That is pretty dang nice and enhanced the whole experience as well.

Get the fish in the fresh green broth.
Get the risotto.
Get a cot...this is quite a lot of food!!

I must say it was dam good. Coming from California
lil good spanish/tapas/Mexican food is everywhere. But in Portland it is rare. One of the dishes wasn't my favorite. But I know what they where going after and that was on point. Also Andy? our server was great. He took care of a little hick-up and bought us dessert. I never asked but it was a great gesture. Food A+ Service A+ Wine list A- Decor A+. Prices are a little high but it is a cute lil date spot. Most definitely be back!!

Went here with my dad to grab a bite to eat before a show. We told the lady who seated us that we didn't have a lot of time and our waitress Brittney (sp?) was amazing! She got our food to us less than 10 minutes after we ordered and it was perfect! We even had enough time to eat without rushing. She was super nice about it all too. Would go back for that alone, but they have really good fries too. Can't wait to go back and try more from the menu.

My family came to Orlando to visit Disney, but we found real magic about 10 minutes away at the Escape Effect. We  have done rooms all over the English-speaking world and it is not often we are amazed, but Escape Effect's Knight to Escape was something new! It was a 120 minute immersive experience that had us puzzled, flummoxed and spellbound. I cannot recommend it enough! Make sure you show up ready to put your communication skills to the test! Oh, and Yary was a top notch game master!

This review is mainly for the wedding coordination and venue! My son and daughter in law were just married here, and after months of working with the best wedding planner ever (Paul Saltalamacchia), the wedding went off so successfully, that many have dubbed it the best wedding ever! Paul is the coolest, kindest, smartest and most creative wedding planner (As a parent it was our second in 2 years) you will find. He took many skeptics from wondering about a Holiday Inn for a wedding to singing its praises all in a few months time! The risk the kids took was that the hotel was undergoing renovations when they booked last fall, but were told there was a very good chance they would all be done by the wedding date. The 98% that were complete included the guest rooms, the entire gorgeous 15th floor (and ball room where the wedding took place) overlooking the Charles River and Beacon Hill and most of the lobby. (The view is also present from many of the rooms, and there is a pool which is not common downtown). Paul was such a pleasure to work with and made sure the couple got what they wanted, and more! From his gentle guidance and patient waiting for decisions to the coordination of guest rooms and our decorations, he was a solid rock and tremendously supportive! He also suggested a hugely successful rehearsal dinner site nearby and helped us arrange a day after breakfast at the hotel. Don't waste your hard-earned money at a bigger name hotel for your wedding. You won't be as satisfied as you would be here, thanks to Paul and the beautiful Holiday Inn renovations, service and delicious wedding food.

Dr. Broberg is always thorough, patient and seems to have your best interest as priority.  He referred me to a great oral surgeon, Dr. Theriot and completed my double wisdom teeth procedure there.  Great collaboration with the oral surgeon and my orthodontist.  Staff are all very nice and friendly, and competent with breaking down procedures and insurance coverages.  Plus, the office is very nice, clean, big rooms and comfortable!  I have had many other dentist and after 30 something years I feel I found one I can trust.

My husband and I came here to celebrate our anniversary last night. The food was fantastic. He got a ribeye steak with fries and I had the prime rib. The prime rib was so incredibly delicious. And the garlic mashed potatoes were perfect. 

However, one of the biggest highlights of the night was our server, Kelse. She's a complete sweetheart and made us feel like we were the most special people in the place. If you go to Ringside, ask to be seated in her area. She's the best server I've ever experienced, hands down, and she made our night so memorable. Thank you so much, Kelse!

Ok....I admit it. I adore being pampered, experiencing over the top service and receiving perks for being a loyal customer. Flying primarily with Delta Airlines has rewarded me with Diamond Medallion status. One of the generous perks is access to the Sky Clubs. I had a few hour layover in Atlanta that was spent in the F Concourse club.  Practically perfection! Every staff member is friendly and helpful...from the reception desk to the bathroom attendant. I don't think I've ever enjoyed a conversation in a public bathroom with a stranger before my visit to this Sky Club.  

Food is delicious, drinks are poured with a smile and seating is plentiful & comfortable.  Layovers aren't fun but if you have the opportunity to spend it here then you may think about scheduling one purposefully in the future.

I received wonderful guidance from the shop owner, Deborah, today. She greeted me warmly when I arrived and was readily available to assist me. As a bit of a pagan newbie researching my proper path, I had questions about which books would be best for me. Not only did she point me in the direction of some great literature, she took the time to ask me questions to get a better sense of what would be useful for me, and she provided excellent insight for getting started. I will definitely be back again!!

I've only been to the studio a couple of times (but that's only because I get lazy with my hair, which is long/simple)! I'll be back very soon :)

Rebecca has cut my hair twice. The first time she made the ends more blunt for me in order to make my thin hair thicker. It'd been a very long time since I had gotten it cut at my old salon in NY, and she cut off quite a bit (at my request). It came out so much healthier looking! The second time she added in some newer layers to give it some more shape once it had grown out a bit. I loved both cuts, and she was extremely nice and didn't make me feel bad about only getting it cut a couple of times a year.

Abby has now colored my hair twice and both times were fantastic. I am a natural dirty blonde, and after years of other highlighting methods she helped bayalage it back to my more natural color, but with beautiful dimension. The second time I went she touched it up beautifully. It's important for me to have the color blend out with my natural blonde once it starts to grow back in, and she does a wonderful job with this. She is so passionate about her work and personable while spending time on you. She also is constantly staying on top of new hair styling/coloring techniques, which is awesome considering her already natural talent!

You won't find many places that serve up a better burger than JewBoy. I drove up from San Antonio to give it a try and thought about the burgers the whole way home! Yes burgers...I ate 2. They were just too damn good! I had a double topped with a Latke for the first and the spicy one for the second. I'm guessing they are 1/3 lb patties so they aren't small. If you are in Austin and love burgers this place is a must!

BEST food at PDX!! I have had the cuban sandwich and the roast pork sandwich.  Both were amazing.  Especially loved the grilled peppers on the roast pork sandwich.  I work at PDX so I am disappointed we can't buy their fabulous homemade pastrami by the pound like you can at their downtown restaurant.  I would be buying that a lot.  Hopefully they read this review and think about it!!  Highly recommend stopping here for a quick bite between flights, or while you are waiting for your flight

First time eating here after hearing heaps of raves.  Wasn't excited about having to wait in line (they don't take reservations), but managed to arrive and queue up about 10 minutes before they cracked the door open for the dinner crowd, so we were seated shortly after it opened.  

Our server was working with a trainee, but they were both personable and our main server was extremely knowledgeable and peppy.  Our drinks were never empty (including the water AFTER the bill was paid...always a great sign) and they were totally on the ball to turn the table, though we never felt rushed.

We started with a pimiento cheese appetizer - which is a zingy cheese spread served with celery and crackers...it was the perfect intro to the remainder of the meal!

We both opted for the buttermilk fried chicken dinner with mac and cheese on the side...I also swapped out the veggies for corn bread.  After eating my first couple of bites of the chicken, I had to exclaim that it was the best chicken I'd EVER had!  It was juicy, flavorful and you could cut it with your fork....SOOoo delicious!  It came with mashed potatoes (DELISH!) and a spicy sausage gravy that was good, but I think it would be better suited to biscuits and gravy rather than mashed potatoes.  The mac and cheese was the bomb (not the best ever, but definitely in the top 10%) and while the cornbread was a bit on the dry side, the whipped honey butter made it worth having!

I would DEFINITELY eat here again and have already raved about it to several folks!

Probably one of best hair experiences in my life. Nikki is phenomenal, very talented, professional, and just as sweet as can be. Having worked for extraordinary salons in the past, I expect a lot from my stylist/colorist. Since moving to Portland 2 years ago from Atlanta, I've yet to find someone to cut my hair, so I'd travel back once a quarter to have my hair done.. until now. In this instance, I came into Ginger for the first time, wanting to cut off at least 8 inches of long blonde hair that I've had for about 12 years... and Nikki couldn't have been more amazing. She asked all the necessary questions to determine what style, length and maintenance level was right for me; and I couldn't be happier with my brand-spanking new style and cut!

Overall, Nikki is incredibly talented; and the salon is warm and inviting. They've created a wonderful environment that makes me want to come back sooner than later.

Mike Tinsley is absolutely THE MAN. Super responsive, professional and just an all around great guy. Took an entire day to drive me around Brookline and look at potentials rentals. At no point did I feel like I was imposition on his time and he really has a great feel for market in Brookline. Once we settled on a place, he handled all of the little details, including working with the listing agent and taking care of the lease agreement. 

I cannot recommend Mike enough!

We've been here a few times since we bought our new home a few months ago. Pizza is always good, and staff is always excellent. Today my husband and I decided to try different pizzas than we normally get. Husband got a pepperoni lovers, and this bad boy is COVERED in pepperoni. The only proper way to make a pep lovers. I got the Alfredo pizza with chicken and spinach, which is also topped to perfection and tastes great too. Definitely give this place a chance, you won't regret it.

I'm 100% sold on threading thanks to Boston Threading! Clean space, friendly and super skilled staff, and I've never waited more than 5-10 minutes (usually less) when walking in. My brows come out perfect and full, with great shape every time. No red forehead, no sticky spots left behind, and no breakouts as I usually experience after a wax. My threader (not sure what you'd call them) always leaves me with a few tips on how to keep my shape and fullness between visits. I usually come in when I have a groupon, but it's worth a visit even without one.

I LOVE the buffalo chicken pizza from here! It's a perfect amout of spice and combination of ingredients, on thin crust. I randomly found this place and I was instantly hooked! The bar is big, they have a decent beer selection. The pizza place is next door kinda, and you go over to order it and they give you a buzzer for when it's ready. I love the pizza here. Probably one of my favorites that I have tried in Columbus, so far. Definitely out of my way to go here, but I will always make it a point to stop here when I can!

I work right across the street and have been perusing the market when I can on a fairly regular basis for a few years now. I am glad they expanded to both sides of the park.

What I like - lots of choice, quality produce, flowers, potted pants, good pastries and now they have things like coffee and Iggy's bread. I got a sandwich here for lunch today and it was quite good. $6, large, but obviously made that morning. but still good. everything i have bought here, i have enjoyed.

What I don't like - sometimes the prices can be high. $4 for a half pint of blackberries? please! 

I am a Russo's junkie, since I live so close, so I usually get all my produce there. the Copley Farmer's Market is a good place to get midweek fruit, bakery bread to which i usually don't have access or baked goods that i shouldn't be eating in the first place:)

Yes, I am giving this gym five stars. I am giving it five stars because I am only comparing it to other planet fitnesses or similar gyms. For $10 a month, you really can't beat this gym. In over 6 months of going here, I've never had any issues, and the gym meets my needs. That equates to 5 stars in my book. 

The first thing you notice when you pull into the parking lot is that it shares parking spaces with a small plaza. There is ample parking, and you never have to park more than three rows away. Parking is a non-issue. 

When you walk into the gym, you are greeted by employees who are friendly, helpful, and courteous. I have had nothing but positive interactions with employees there. 

As you walk through the gym, you notice how clean organized, and squared away everything is. That is extremely important to me in a gym, and I have never had an issue with cleanliness in this location. Seem to go out of their way to make sure that it's in top condition. 

The locker rooms ( at least the men's one!) are big, modern, and very clean. This is so important, as your entire experience and comfort level often relies on this. Compared to most planet fitness is, this gym excels in that department. 

Overall, I am very pleased with this gym, and I love the fact that they are 24/5. Being in a smaller city, and especially on the outskirts, I can understand why they are not 24/7. If you were looking for a very reasonable gym, and lots of bang for your buck, this is a great spot to check out.

We have loved the Moretti's restaurants for over two decades and this place was no disappointment. It is a loud and frenetic restaurant with an open view of the kitchen and the people working hard putting your food together. Seems like a younger crowd than the Moretti's of Upper Arlington. 

The food is simple and tasty, and very kid friendly although there were not very many kids there on Friday night.  The "turducken" meatballs were absolutely delicious. The spicy pork balls pair remarkably well with the sweet bourbon barbecue sauce. Everyone loved their sides - from mashed potatoes to polenta to brussels sprouts. And I have to say the bartender did an excellent job with our "spicy grown-up drinks" as we describe them to the kids. 

We'll be back.

If you are looking for the best New York Style pizza in Orlando, you have found it with Pizza Xtreme.  I have ordered pizza for delivery to our home
over a dozen times from Pizza Xtreme, since we discovered it a few months ago, and we have never been disappointed.  They are consistently good. The crust, the cheese, the sauce... it's all first-rate.  And if you are in a pasta mood, try their baked ziti... it is also fantastic.   After so many years of being stuck with mediocre and inconsistent quality from the big chain pizza delivery places, we are so happy to have found such excellent quality in this locally-owned pizza and pasta restaurant:  Pizza Xtreme.

What a cool place! I am an avid superfood Junkie and their coffee menu is to die for (full of butter coffees and superfood add ins). Their dinner menu has a great happy hour form 3-6 and the food is mostly paleo and the menu is completely gluten free! How can you go wrong! I felt like a 3 year old at an ice cream parlor ordering their favorite flavor. Family friendly place with a beautiful setting. We ordered the chicken tenders for my daughter, which she loved. Also the guac, harvest hash with an extra poached egg (cooked to perfection), the Brussels, and two margaritas and a lemonade. Everything was amazing and we left full and happy. This place is a health conscious foodies dream! We will definitely be back often... did I mention they also have breakfast tacos

Next time you find yourself in Salem, do not miss getting brunch at Gulu Gulu cafe.  It is a great, offbeat cafe that does not take itself too seriously.

I'll be honest, normally anything that hints at hipster has me running for the hills.  I blame Harvard Square for putting the bad taste in my mouth.  What's great about the alternative atmosphere at Gulu Gulu is that at no point does it feel like they're trying to be different, they just are.  You can tell that every member of the staff truly enjoys what they do.  From the tattooed rock a billy waitresses to the long haired boys in skinny jeans every one is extremely friendly and helpful.  When my waitress helped me select a local draft it was because she was passionate about the menu, not because it was her job.  

I have been twice now, once with my little sister who is easy to please, and once with my mother and her friend who is never pleased.  Everyone loved it!  Both times I had the bagel and lox (creature of habit) and it was wonderful.  My sister had the cheese plate and judging by the samples I filched from her plate it was tasty as well.  

If you live in Boston, Gulu Gulu is worth making the trek for, even if you have no either reason to be in Salem.  You will not be disappointed.

I am a huge fan of J&P's and usually frequent the NE location... But I am so excited for the new NW spot! I literally ran in and proclaimed my love for everyone there  all the baristas were extremely accommodating to my semi-large four drink order and of course gave me no back talk for bringing in my own cups for all four drinks  they were all perfect and timely. 

The new store is very clean and nicely decorated/laid out. Not really a place to stop and chill for a long time unless you're going to study or read at the bar height tables. Easy to read menu. Not good for large parties to meet. This location is more for the "in and out" customers I'd imagine, as it is right across from Good Sam. 

So glad to have somewhere to stop and get a Soviet Mocha when I'm in NW now! So proud of the J&P family and so happy for them.

I absolutely love this place. I take majority of the classes-- they are no joke, anyone who took a Crazy8/Nasty9 here will know what I am talking about.

If you are a beginner, I recommend the Zumba classes. Personally I like Erica's Saturday hip-hop boot camp and Lauren's Wed night sweat class. Courtney's Tabata class is well balanced, Kristin's yoga flow complements fitness workouts very nicely. All these teachers play great music, if you are moved by the tunes like I do, that is a bonus. Also, every now and then they throw really cool deals ($80 for 10 class) which is great for Boston.

bf and i spent an entire day at the rose garden and then at the portland japanese garden and i must say that portland's japanese garden is actually almost nicer than some of the ones in japan! it certainly beats out the one in golden gate park!

the grounds are extensive, the scenery is peaceful and zen, and it's just such an escape from the city that you can't help be be contented and at peace. (cheesy! i know!)

there is a small entrance fee, but i do believe military gets a discount...so, good to know, and ask, if you fall into that catagory!

This is one of the few coffee shops in Portland that actually does the whole 'coffee shop lounge' thing properly. Airy space, lots of comfy couches and chairs along with plenty of tables for singles, doubles, and groups alike. Decent music not playing too loudly, a huge stack of newspapers (with some helpful clippings taped to the windows) and a fantastic staff. Then they had to go and add deeeelicious coffee, teas and pastries, all of the organic variety. 

To top it off? They do breakfast, and their homemade hot sauce is a sultry, smoky, incredible topper for eggs with biscuits and gravy. And yeah, Daniel Reed is spot on when he calls them the best biscuits + gravy EVER. period. 

One note to those looking for the artificial in their beverages: you won't find it here, so don't ask. My friend came with me once and made the mistake of asking for a 16 ounce cappuccino with Splenda, and she got a mini lecture on why they could not make her what she wanted. 

If you remember not to ask for the little pink/yellow/blue packets and you stick with ordering from their menu, this place is awesome.

This is my first time at Hocca Orlando and i will day I'm definitely impressed! The service was so friendly and his name is Tiago! He was very knowledgeable and definitely knows his stuff! Also the manger Leo was so friendly and came up to introduce himself and that just creates a great image! I will definitely come back and i want to try more things and really explore what else this wonderful restaurant has for me to try!! Definitely request Tiago as your server!!!!!

Being vegan is easy here! There is a "v" symbol to indicate vegetarian, leaf means vegan. Easy to read menu. 

We both got a Create Your Own TropiChop bowl. You can choose what base you want (White Rice, Brown Rice, Lettuce, Yellow Rice & Veggies, 1/2 Rice & 1/2 Lettuce) and we did yellow.  

For protein, we stuck with the "vegetarian" option. Which just meant no meat. 

Top it (with as many as you like)
Black Beans, Tomatoes, Peppers, Sautéed Onions. I did it all EXCEPT for corn bc it's not vegan.

They have lots of sauces to choose from. The one I know for sure is vegan is the Spicy Poyo Poyo, which I didn't care too much for but hubby loved it so just try it! ;) 

Regular size is around $5, large is $7.79.

I tried four or five salons when I first moved to Portland and somehow ended up at Salon 77 with Kiley Courtney. Thank goodness that I did. I pretty much go every six weeks just because I have so much fun when I am there. I always walk away with an incredible haircut and 100% trust Kiley. She has a unique way of cutting hair, listens to what you want and always makes you laugh. Thank you Kiley for always giving me killer hair!

Went to this resturant with my girlfriend.  After reading all of the great reviews here on Yelp, we decided to get some lunch here.  Being a busy Saturday, we expected to have to wait on a table but were bussed immediately and sat down to order our food.  The girlfriend and I both ordered the Fat Turkey Sandwich.  For $8 a person, we easily got two meals worth of sandwich and for an additional $.50 we were able to add seasoning to our fries.  I got the cajun and she got the garlic & parmesan and neither of us were disappointed.  All told, we spent less than $25.00 for two people and had enough to bring home leftovers.

Ooooooooh, it is NOW the future! My estimation of this place has improved by leaps and bounds, and the reasoning (I do love internet rhetorical questions)? The service. The service. The service. The staff are friendly, personable, professional and knowledgeable. Since my first review (way back in 2011) there has been a major staff overhaul for the better. Or perhaps new management to make people happier...who knows? The beer selection is obviously still vast and exquisite, the food is fair to good (although they do have deals every day of the week that me and my girlfriend take advantage of) and the televisions just do not bother me as much because perhaps I am not so damn grouchy. Anyways, wanted to give a much needed update!

I am not sure how to rate this place because there is nothing like it. It's like King Richard's Faire had an outlet store, but with every other sort of outside the normal football/lacrosse/hockey/baseball thrown in. It's for kids that don't mind being outside the box. It embraces unconventional programming and from what I saw the kids were having lots of fun.

Staff was friendly and super helpful.  General space and bathrooms clean.

This place made me a little sad. Sad that a place didn't exist for me when I was younger. Somewhere I could hang out with kids that liked science fiction and fantasy role playing.

We finally were fed up with sleeping on futon matteress and decided to go check out some bedding places. Went to Matteress World and my wife started talking with a salesman about the matteress we thought we'd like to own. Durring his entire sales speal he must have thought his teeth needed cleaning, and kept doing so with a finger nail. Yech! we got out of there. Went to The Matteress Lot and finally decided on a bed. Got it home and slept on it for a couple weeks and found it was too soft. We contacted the store and agreed to exchange it... great! but when the original matteress got back to the store, they are claiming it has stains, impossible! We use a matteress pad heater (like a electric blanket), and a matteress pad on top of that. and after a complete inspection, we've not found any type of stains on either of our pads... hum. We are going to the store this morning to see what is happening and will continue this post later, and let you know the outcome. Other than this problem, we think the store is a great place to shop, with wonderful people to do business with.
Finally, let me add that even with this inconvenience, we still recomend doing business at this store. We are more than satisfied and will continue to do our bed shopping at The Mattress Lot!

Well this is just an update........ We went back to the store to see what ever the stain could be on the mattress we traded back. Yep, sure enough the it was. Although neither one of us could imagine on how it could have gotten there... it was there. The owner expressed the concern that they were out the money, and... and I don't think they expected us to even return to the store, since we have gotten what we really wanted. But as they saw, that's not our style.
Fortunetly, on our way over, we had discussed different ways that we could approach the matter, and to keep friends, and since the mattress had been in our posession, we offered to repurchase it. We gave an offer, and they knocked $50. off that. SOLD!  I will speak very highly of the company and with two thumbs up, tell everyone where to go when they need a new bed,  "The Mattress Lot"  24th & Sandy

I took my husband and four year daughter here because we wanted to eat somewhere that would be fun for our four year daughter, but that also had delicious adult meals.  This was the perfect place to take our daughter because she loved watching the Celtic dancers and listening to the band so we were actually able relax and enjoy as meals while she was entertained.  They are limiting the number of tables that they are seating currently because of Covid.  We made a reservation the day before and had no trouble getting the time we wanted. The waitress said that they typically fill up every night, so a reservation is always a good idea.
     The dinners were delicious!  I had a barbecue cheese burger that was cooked perfectly, seasoned perfectly, ... I can't say enough about it...so good.  My husband had the steak and potatoes which was also delicious.  We will definitely be dining there again.

Sitting next to the Multnomah Whiskey Library, this small joint is a perfect spot for brief light snacks. It features many a familiar middle eastern options like libneh and hummus--but they are prepared to perfection. Because the place is a bit small (the upstairs space is for the prep kitchen), it's more for intimate groups. Beware that you may be seated at bar tables.

Suggestions
1) anything with hummus! They bring freshly baked pita (when you rip one open, steam comes out), and the hummus is flavorful and smooth. My vegan friend who often eats hummus for dinner said it was one of his favorites. 
2) ginger beer--they make their own! It has a distinctive ginger aroma and flavor. A little bit too sweet after a few sips, but still worth it.
3) great staff.

Anyone who knows me well will tell you that I LOVE FRIED CHICKEN!  Heart x infinity.

So when I found out my hotel for the week is a couple blocks away, I became giddy that I get to try some new places in a new town. I organized my teams lunch outing at Gus's early enough to beat the crazy lunch rush. 14 of us showed up, got seated, and went to town on one of the best fried chicken I've ever had. Yes, you all heard that right. The fried chicken is amazing. They have the perfect amount of crunch with some spices. Wow. I ordered two pieces of dark meat, substituted my beans for fries. The table shared fried okra and large mac n cheese. 

Service was great. Our server was patient with our table and our food came out in the timely manner.  The Crystal hot sauce is bomb. I found some at the local HEB and brought back a couple of bottles for my team. Also helps that the price is fairly cheap. Definitely a place to try when you're in Austin. 

I would also like to admit that I went again a few days later. Had to get my sister to try it too.

My husband, toddler son and I had a great experience buying a Honda Odyssey at Curry Honda with the help of Anthony Davis. Anthony Davis was wonderful to work with. He is very knowledgeable about the vehicles, is friendly and was accommodating of my two year old son (my son got a fun coloring book with crayons from the experience) and best of all for us, he didn't pressure us, just provided us with asked information to help us make a good decision. 

I'm also including my husband's detailed write up of our experience.

We went to Curry Honda to check out the 2016 Honda Odyssey.  We were greeted as soon as we walked in the door and after a short wait were able to see the vehicle.  We worked with a salesman, Anthony Davis, who was extremely knowledgeable about the vehicle.  With Anthony's help we were able to thoroughly assess the Honda's features and how they would work for our family.  Anthony was able to answer every question we had, and was very friendly throughout the whole process.

Anthony gave us a very competitive price--they were very motivated to move their 2016 inventory so it was a good time for us to buy.  Ultimately, we went with a Honda because it was the best vehicle in the segment.  We went with Curry Honda because they gave us a good deal and because Anthony did an excellent job.

Downsides for us were that the building is a little cramped and lacking in the perks that other dealerships have in their showrooms.  Also, the business manager tried to push a bunch of expensive extended warranties and a financing package that was worse than what our bank offered.  Unfortunately, this is par for the course for car dealerships so I don't hold it specifically against Curry Honda.  I would encourage all car buyers to understand that a car is a major purchase--do your homework on financing, accessories, warranties, MSRP vs actual prices, etc. before you even walk in to give yourself the upper hand.  To his credit, the Business manager moved on and helped us to wrap up quickly once we made it clear we would be financing through our own bank.

All in all, purchasing from Curry Honda was a positive experience because they delivered where it really counted, on price and in helping us to get the info we needed about the vehicle.

It really only takes about 5 words to describe the Highball: "Big Lebowski meets Mad Men."

But with karaoke too. 

Seriously, this 50's cocktail-inspired fun zone offers up food, druink, bowling (on classic lanes flown in from out of the area), private karaoke rooms, skee ball, and classic cocktails, all in a seriously classic vintage 50's setting. 

What was the most surprising to me about this place is that these types of outfits usually only do one or two things well. They have a fun space but shitty food/drinks, or the food is good but the arcade is falling apart. I mean, really... it's hard to focus on so many things at once and do it right without taking on a corporate/regulated feel. 

The Highball does this well. While I can't vouch for the food, the drunks care way beyond what IU'd expect for a place like this. The service was always pretty laser fast and on top of the situation, and amenities were held together well. Our karaoke room was tragically tiki, but I think some people are in to that, so I can't dock them points. Plus, it goes with the classic dated style. The fixtures and décor in the rest of the joint scream old-style class. 

I wish we had a place like this in Portland. So cool.

This is by far the best thrift store in Boulder! Every time I have come to the store it has been a pleasant experience. The staff has always been friendly and are in great spirits.  Really great vibes and I love that they support a bunch of charities. They are extremely helpful in helping you find your way around their huge store (which has a great selection of reasonably priced items!) to find what you're looking for. I was able to snag a spiffy coffee machine for under $10 and I was even given $5 Ares bucks for my purchase during one of their festivities (which clearly made this purchase a steal)! I also really love that they are pet friendly!

Oh my gosh, this place, oh so so good. I thought I'd learned my lesson by not judging a restaurant by its cover. Alas, I was a turd, and a few times, I walked past after looking at the bright yellow signage, and thinking "hmmm, pass". Don't let the outside fool you, it becomes part of its charm! 

But let me tell you something, these dumplings are THE dumplings! Hand wrapped, hand made dumpling wrapper, with just the right amount of luscious, flavourful, and perfectly cooked innards, offered steamed, boiled, or fried. Ugh, the bf and I had a plate each, the chicken and mushroom, and the pork and leek, damnnnnn that wrap, and damnnnn the filling is just right, and they don't skimp! Good filling to wrap ratio! And they have Xiaolong hao! Steamed just right, with delectable soup broth inside, drool, drool, drool.


I gotta say though, one of my favourite parts of the meal was the owner, the chef, and the pretty dingy decor. They remind me of how food was made in the old days, simple, delicious, no fuss about presentation, no bs, just a good solid meal.The owner does the serving, and will unabashedly ask you if it's enough food, and then gruffly suggest you try the salads. Now, I can't disrespect an elder, so of course we do get the salad, and if you haven't tried Fungus salad, ya'll missing out! And then sometimes the chef just comes out and drops off your meal, just like the good ol asian days. 


Common people, get ya dumplings!

Awesome place to get a variety of Japanese "dons", or rice bowls. My cousin introduced my family to this place, and they were actually quite receptive to it! (As long as there's white rice Chinese people are happy).

We got a bunch of rice bowls - pork katsu, fish Katsu, tuna poke, and fatty tuna. We also got a variety of appetizers like the takoyaki, nanban, and seaweed salad.

The best part about this restaurant is the prices - dirt cheap! I think cheap might be the wrong word because the ingredients were super fresh and high quality, so let's just say low prices. Back in New York, each of these individual dons would LITERALLY be DOUBLE the price of here. I'm not even exaggerating; a fatty tuna don in NYC is at least $20. I wish NY would have affordable Japanese food like here - the college students in Austin are so lucky!

Service-wise, they definitely have a few kinks to work out. You order first in the front, and the worker was nice. Definitely ask him to explain exactly what comes with each don, because the tuna poke also came with a bunch of seaweed salad. You get a playing card which signifies which order you are (like 9 of spades of something). It's a novel idea but I don't think it's as efficient as a normal number system. The kitchen in the back somehow messed up our entire order (we got like $70 worth of food) and they kept asking ME what I ordered. I told them, and then they asked ME for the receipt???  I had to go to the front and ask the guy so I could take a picture of the receipt (no paper receipts here) and show the kitchen staff in the back to confirm what I ordered... what a freaking mess. Luckily we got all of the food eventually but something definitely went amiss.

The pork katsu was a bit dry, but it was a nice thick piece of pork. The fish katsu was really well cooked and had the perfect layer of crispness. I opted for the fatty tuna don and I added avocado for $1.50. For some reason they also added an onsen tamago and charged me for it, but I never asked for it?? It didn't even show up on the bill as an item but I was charged the price for it. This kinda changed the entire texture and flavor of my don so that was a bit disappointing... fish wise it was very fresh and had no gross fishy taste to it. Also I love the fact that they use real wasabi here (at least I think it's real because it has that fresh wasabi texture and taste), so +1 for not skimping on quality ingredients. 

The takoyaki was quite good actually, and you get like 7 pieces for $5 which is a great deal. The chicken nanban (fried chicken with a sticky sauce) was great as well. 

Overall I'm in love with this place despite the messy service. The food here is great, and for the price, it really cannot be beat. I hope the next time I come to Austin this place is still around. This is LITERALLY half the price of New York I'm so sad.

Since starting undergrad at Harvard four years ago, I've been to Berryline more times than I can count. I've had to as a lunch or dinner replacement, as after class treat, a date with a girlfriend... They give you punch cards for a free small+toppings or medium for every 10 visits, and I've gone through way too many of those cards. The location is a little hidden, and generally quiet, but occasionally there is a line, sometimes even out the door. My favorite flavors are lavender honey (offered in June), ginger (offered sometime in the summer). and plain tart, and I love that the quality of their yogurt is pretty consistent and usually never runny. At 25 calories per ounce, it makes a pretty good snack.

Update: Holy shit. The blueberry lemon tastes exactly like bluberries and lemons, exactly as it should.

I have been to numerous salons in the Austin area since I moved here with some "not so good" results. I had pretty much given up on finding a good salon (I would just get my hair done when I went home to visit family) when I was referred to this amazing salon by a very close friend of mine. 

She promised me I would be amazed and let me tell you, she was right!! My stylist was Jessica Mazzoch. She did an amazing job! She brought life back to my tired hair, and I have never felt better! The salon is very nice as well with great products and a relaxed atmosphere. I definitely recommend this place!!

I was craving for waffles one day and came upon this restaurant on yelp. Even though it was a struggle finding this location because of nearby constructions, I was glad I found it.
I had a pleasure of meeting the chef and owner of the restaurant. He is friendly and could tell he is passionate about his work and cooking. My server that day was also very nice and attentive. 
Their summer waffle was yummy and had a choice of bacon or sausage. 
I highly recommend this place! Don't give up on your drive if you have trouble finding their location. They are located in the far back corner. (Right pass the corner of an automotive shop and a nearby clinic). This restaurant has great food and is so worth checking out! 
Muchas gracias Otra Ves! I will definitely come back and try the Chilaquiles.

The Hazel Room is my favorite brunch spot on Hawthorne!  I went there with my boyfriend on our second date, and the owners were incredibly kind and very knowledgeable.  The interior has adorable Victorian couches and rotating artists on the walls and the food is incredible.  I had the corn cake with an egg over easy and root vegetable hash and he had the tamarind pulled pork with the same delicious hash which I remember had beet greens in it because it gave everything such a lovely color! The four of us talked food for a good ten minutes, which was great, especially since Katie (one of the owners) was as excited over the idea of working with fresh ingredients as I am.  Since then, I have been back many times.  The coffees are always done well, there are incredible tea-infused cocktails, and while I have not really ventured into the selection of teas.... this woman knows her tea the way growers know their strains of weed.  If you get her on the topic, she will give you a thorough (and very welcomed) lesson about the many forms of tea.  

To sum things up.... YES YES YES.  Check out your new favorite spot.

This an underground paradise for dive bar lovers.  The drinks are cheap, there is a jukebox, a dart board, uncomfortable wooden booths, leather couches, dirty bathrooms, no ATM machine, no credit cards accepted, trivia night, free popcorn, and $2 pizzas (think Mama Celeste) with a purchase of a pitcher.

I have been coming here for almost 15 years.  Someday I hope to own this bar.  And when I do, I won't change a thing.  A most appropriate place for my 50th review!

What an amazing, relaxing experience. Just came back from a one hour foot reflexology massage and I feel so relaxed and content. Some of my knots have melted away. I was surprised at how much of my body they massaged other than just my feet, which felt like an added, unexpected bonus. The foot massage was amazingly detailed; they really worked all the little sinews of my feet that I didn't even know I had. And the environment the place and the staff created was warm, calming, and welcoming. At the price ($35 plus generous tip), it's a definite repeat! I'd recommend going with others and getting massages at the same time:) You can sit next to each other and enjoy the experience together:)

The Ranch is now my favorite place on 6th Street.  When you first get there you'll realize the line is pretty long but it was worth the wait.  They play awesome music, and the bartenders make great drinks.  My friend had a birthday a week ago and he got half priced drinks all night.  I even got free soda!  The shot I bought was $10 but I guess there's been more expensive places.

In short, the people here are attractive, the music is wonderful, the dance floor is huge, and I like the 3 floors it has. No one stays on the bottom floor though.  Oh yeah and the people here are friendly, with the exception of some typical douchebags scattered around the top level with their fancy drinks and fancy clothes.  If you can learn to ignore them you'll be fine.

This is one of my favorite places to eat in Atlanta. The employees are very nice and work very quick to make sure everyone gets their order done. This place usually packed during the evening hours, but they still get it done! On certain days, there would be a person singing in the restaurant to add a nice Hawaiian vibe to the place! The Super Combo is what I usually get because of the gravy over the pork and beef makes the taste very savory. And to add to that is the eggs and mac salad. Very tasty!

I had strong reservations about this place, so much hype and was not looking forward to waiting in line. However, we went after 9pm and were promptly seated, good sign so far! The water is flavored with pandan, so good! We got the infamous wings of course, they were off the hook and so flavorful. They reminded me of a Vietnamese dish, ca kho (braised catfish), in terms of flavor, which I don't mind because that's one of my favorite Vietnamese dishes. We also had the boar collar, oh man that was spicy, it hurt my stomach!  Definitely recommend the wings. You can even call in your order for pick up.

11/27 - This was my gym when I lived in Orlando. It was great when I went there but man! have they renovated the place. It is one of the smaller Planet Fitness I've been to. It is always clean, courteous staff members, and never too packed. Great for an after Thanksgiving workout. 

The treadmills have the tv above it on its own stand. So, as your running the tv is not moving with you and you get dizy. This was my favorite part as I ran 30 minutes. They have plenty of cleaning supplies. Must be the culture of the gym, everyone that I saw leaving a machine they went straight to the cleaning supply area, grabbed a towel, spray and cleaned their area. (Not like other gyms I know) The bathrooms/ locker room area are very clean as well. They had great upbeat music too! They were jamming with NOW music. 

They are located in a plaza that has many shopping and eating locations. I would highly recommend this particular gym.

This store has always been good to me, unfortunately AT&T's plans and prices suck and don't make any sense.

This store has sold me 3 phones. They made sure I walked out of there working and without any questions. 

I did have one bad experience, I purchased a Samsung Galaxy SII and the charger came out of the box defective. The man (not sure his name - he wasn't a manager. I think he had red hair??? Not sure. He was tall and slim) insisted it was physically damaged and charged me $19.99 for a new charger.

Can't say enough positive things about this place. First off, was recommended them by a dear friend and when I first talked with them, instantly knew why.

I was in the market for a cheap car from a private seller which already is a daunting task at hand, particularly since I was doing the hunting entirely solo, and counting my dollars to make sure I could swing it! Found a 98 Toyota Camry that I liked a lot. Called Honest Mechanic to see if I could bring it in to have them look at before I purchased it but unfortunately, they were swamped and couldn't get it in for three days which didn't work with my, or the seller's schedule. So, I chatted with a guy named Peter on the phone for what was probably a solid five minutes asking him my fears of low coolant under the hood and his speculations on the potential severity of it. He didn't brush me off sounding completely rushed and annoyed I was taking his time unexpectedly on the phone, and he would even answer my crazy, totally ignorant "what if?" questions with total respect and legitimacy! As a female chatting with a car mechanic, this is BEYOND appreciated as you often get unfairly dejected right off the bat when it comes to car mechanics simply because you lack male anatomy. When I got off the phone, I thanked him and joked that we will probably chat again since my saga continues looking for an old cheap car, in which he replied with a laugh and friendly goodbye.

I ended up buying the car, and brought it in for a overall diagnostic check and look-over, which included a fluid top-off for $70-$80. A guy named Steve called back by mid-day telling me what they found wrong with the car, which was more than I was hoping it'd be, (when is it not?) but overall not bad for a 98 Toyota Camry. He gave me his personal opinion of "Honestly, if it were my car, I'd invest the money because otherwise, it seems like a gem for a nearly 20 year old car. They're hard to come by but I think you found one." It wasn't car-salesman gimmicky of "yea, come on...spend $800 at my shop" that you so often get. He even had no problem with me getting back to him after I called other shops about price quotes which, again...past auto mechanics have tried strong arming me into staying with them. Overall, he answered all my questions with patience and poise and that I'm eternally grateful for.

The added perk: about four days after getting the car back and a mini road trip around Oregon later, I got a flat due to a leaky air valve.
