I called them, brought it back in and Steve thoroughly inspected the tire, replaced the air valve, and rechecked all of my tire air pressures on my car and had it ready within an hour or so FREE OF CHARGE!

It's so nice to stumble on a gem like Honest Mechanic. They truly are honest and treat you like they're working on their family member's car. And you know what? Over 4,000 miles later after a roadtrip through Canada moving to the East Coast, my car is still perfectly running! That's the good news! The bad news is I probably won't find a mechanic as great as this one over here in New England :/

Go Here. You won't regret it.

This studio is the perfect addition to the diverse neighborhood of Hyde Park.  Sandwiched between The Peddler and Flightpath, this studio has the warmth and charm of a cozy parlor.  Come on in and take class from any teacher and in any style; you will feel embraced, stretched, and pleasantly rested.  Not up for class? No problem, grab a book, snuggle on the couch and enjoy a cup of tea.  No snobbery here, just good people cultivating positive energy in a fantastic space.

I have no idea why I never went here when I actually lived in Austin. Good God, they make a mean barbecue sausage!!! Some of the best I've had! Word to the wise though, if you're looking for a taste of everything (well, ribs, brisket, and sausage at least), go with the all you can eat. The platter is only one rib and not really all that much meat. If you're a big bbq eater definitely do the all you can eat for $20.

This is a wonderful, authentic place to go for Thai food. It's a pretty nondescript place from the outside, with only a few parking spots in front of the small restaurant. It's located on busy Austin Ave., so it can be easy to miss. However, if you're in the area and want some good Thai food run by a sweet couple, definitely check this place out. I ordered pineapple fried rice with chicken and they had it ready for me in no time. The lady had asked me about my preferred spice level (from 1 - 5). I didn't want something too spicy, so I said from mild to regular spice level. Usually when you go to Thai restaurants in the Lower Mainland and ask for mild or even regular spice level, it won't be spicy at all. This pineapple fried rice, though, had a kick to it. So be aware that they do Thai spice authentically!

All in all, it was some yummy pineapple fried rice for $13, and a good place to check out if you want some good Thai food in Coquitlam!

Don was awesome! I had to have 7 locks rekeyed and had contacted a few other businesses. He, by far, was the most reasonable price and was quick to respond back to me. I was able to contact him and within 45 minutes I was at his house with my locks. It only took him 20 minutes. He also does mobile services and I would recommend him 100x over! Finally a locksmith that isn't trying to rip you off! Don is now my go-to locksmith for sure!!!!

Best bed buying experience ever! We've all seen the ads for Casper but saw Washington Square location opened up so being able to try the bed before bringing it home ideal. Completely different bed buying experience than typical bed store. No pressure and you have a room (Yes, you have a little bedroom!) to yourself, not a buncha of people staring at you while you try the bed! No pressure at all! Samantha who helped us out is great! We also paid with financing thru Affirm who Casper partners with and for a big ticket item purchase we were done buying in like 5 mins! Thank you again Samantha for all your help and love my Casper! Definitely reccomend anyone looking for a bed to come here!

It's the best record store in Portland for punk rock. Pretty much all the new CDs and records in stock are top quality stuff. You'll also find an odd assortment of some of the better mainstream rock, jazz, country, and electronica. The selection of that stuff is really small, though. There's also a lot of really cheap, random, used vinyl available. Run by Ken, founder of Dirtnap records, so you're sure to find whatever he has in print here. He's also a super nice guy and will talk to you all day about music if you so desire.

Looking to have that perfect Harajuku nail look?  

My new wife was definitely in the market for some colorful and trendy styles for our wedding day and she chose  OQ Nail Salon.

The result was really spectacular!  Very cool thick resin with deeply embedded glitter, gems and stars. My wife looked like she had intergalactic party nails and they glittered just as nice as her ring!  

She went with her mom to get her nails done for the wedding and everyone else thought they both had lovely nails.  

I will add that her mom's experience was a little more challenging because she did not have any idea what she wanted when she came in.  The nail techs were super sweet but her mom just asked for "the plainest, simplest style of manicure possible".  They offered to hand paint flowers on her nails but that seemed too flashy for her.  In the end, she chose a classic French manicure and she was really happy.     

We are close to 3 weeks after the wedding now - and their nails have both stayed in great shape.  

Do yourself a favor and collect some colors, images & inspirations for your nails and let these artists help you look like a star!

This place was so great.  When we(group of 5) arrived at about 11pm on a Saturday, we thought about how it may be too busy and how it may be too late for optimal service. This thought was wrong.  Their phones were constantly ringing but they got to us in a fair time & brought us our food out in one big order--also in a fair amount of time. I didn't want any cheese on my pasta so I kindly mentioned it to them & they made me a new one in 5 minutes!  It was amazing.  They gave us nice, soft bread(not hard or stale/too crunchy).  We made some special requests & they did not bat an eye on helping us out.  The workers were very friendly.

Was gonna go to another restaurant near by but it was crowded as hell so we stumbled upon here and it was actually really good. We came in around 7:30pmish and was suspicious if it was good because there wasn't a lot of people but i'm so glad we stayed. The chicken and waffles was amazing. I loved how perfectly the waffle was made and the gravy on top was great. The chicken sandwich was the perfect size and very flavorful. The cajun fries were light and the fry sauce was so good!! It had a little kick and zest to it. Definitely a hidden gem in portland and needs more recognition

I recently went to Swish Dental because I chipped my front tooth.  It was really easy to book the appointment online.  I booked last minute and couldn't get a sitter so I brought my 11 month old daughter.  The staff was SO AMAZING.  Isabelle was able to sit in her stroller and watch cartoons on their netflix on a tv in the exam room while I was getting my tooth fixed.  At the end she started to get a little fussy and the girls from the office took turns playing peekaboo and rocking her stroller.   It was SO NICE.  They were all ridiculously sweet.  I was able to get my chipped tooth taken care of as well as a routine check up.  The cleaning was so thorough.  The dentist fixed my tooth with some bonding and did a great job.  The dental hygienist gave me the best cleaning of my life.  My teeth still feel great a day later.  I highly recommend this office.

You know how the cookie monster eats cookies?  That's how you're going to want to eat your kolaches.  

Little bits of egg and bread and bacon will be flying in every direction as you tear into a fabulous little sweet roll like a buzz saw.  It's that good.    

If you're not familiar with Kolaches - it's basically the most delicious breakfast ever invented.  It's a slightly sweetened roll filled with egg or cheese or bacon or all of the above (there are actually lots of different combo's including veggie, cream cheese, sausage, etc).  You pick what you want in yours, they heat it up and you then enter taste bud heaven.  

If you go to this place after 1:30PM, you get half price Kolaches if you'll just politely remind them to ring you up at the "day old" price.    

The only caveat I would offer is that this isn't health food so you might want to visit as an occasional treat.   Enjoy!

TheyRRRRRRR back! Hands down, THE BEST PIZZA IN PORTLAND!!! It's been a looooong year without Giants NY Pizza. Was so afraid that they were gone forever. New location right in downtown PDX at the  Portland Food Hall, with just a few other vendors makes for a nice, intimate, cozy space. Really convienient to the MAX. Pizza is great as it ever was. Now also offering a smaller 10" size, which is appreciated and still gave me a bit extra to take home for later.

I eat here for a casual lunch.  Food is fresh, staff really friendly, customer service superb - I had an issue once and manager took care of it immediately, clean, comfortable seating.  I've been coming here for about 4 years and tried several items.  I think the only item I did not like was the chili, it had a spice that I didn't like.  Otherwise all the other soups are really good.  My current favorite sandwich is the turkey avocado.  It's made with warm whole grain bread, sliced turkey, tomato, lettuce, swiss cheese, avocado slices.  I asked for no Mayo.
The 1/2 sandwich and cup of soup combo is a good deal for about $9.  The cup of soup is bigger than your regular size cup at other restaurants, so it's very filling.

So many other choices you can't go wrong.

Kimberly is an incredibly talented, sweet person! My beauty session with her was SO much fun and my photos turned out more beautiful than I could hoped for. When I look at them, I think "Thats me?! That's the most beautiful photo I have ever seen of myself!" 

I suffer from two autoimmune illnesses and am often sick. It was such a gift to see myself through fresh eyes. Thank you so much for a fun girl power experience I will never forget! xo

Five stars for this old school bar and tavern. I met up with my friend who lives nearby on her recommendation. This place is classic. If it's been here fifty years, I would not be surprised.

Two rooms, one with the bar and the other is for dining. The bar is classic with a mirrored wall behind shelves of booze. Beer taps and fridges stocked with all sorts of stuff. A few barflies hanging out as well.

They do have a full menu and at least for the moment (July 2020), they're serving dine-in.

We got a round of drinks or two and just enjoyed the atmosphere.

[Review 13627 overall, 946 of 2020, number 320 in Georgia.]

*Round of applause for Moonshine Patio Bar and Grill!*

Took a large group here to celebrate a college graduation. Not an easy bunch but our server handled the 12-top with grace. He took care of all our needs and made great recommendations.

We did it up with appetizers, entrees and finished with dessert.

All of our food came out timely, hot and delicious! Everyone was happy with their entrees. 

Perfect atmosphere for our celebratory dinner! Warm, casual vibes and the timing of courses was perfect. This place is amazing! Great quality dinner, definitely worth the wait.

The first time I went here I was amazed. I expected L'Abattoir to be like any other of those "hip" new restaurant in Gastown. Good but not outstandingly amazing. Boy, was I surprised.

This is by far my favourite restaurant in Vancouver! I've basically tried everything on the menu. Everything is amazing. Their bread basket is the best I've had anywhere (including Michelin starred restaurants). 

It's not just the food that is delicious - The plating is beautiful and the service (sometimes slow because they are busy but always attentive) is amazing. If you get a chance to book or request to sit in the back room I would recommend it. It is an extension of the building in a glass encased room facing a restored back alley of Gastown. Very calm and beautiful. 

A few have complained that it is expensive. The price to me fits the quality of the food. If you read all the reviews everyone loves the food; just depends if you want to spend a little more to get an awesome meal.

I asked about the chef the last time I was there and was informed that he is the co-owner and worked at the Fat Duck. If you love food then you know that the Fat Duck was rated the #1 restaurant in the world for several years. 

Note - the one dessert I would not recommend unless you have tried all the others is the fizzy lemonade. It's interesting but the others are much better.

We stayed in the Animal Kingdom Villas which were hands down, my favorite Disney property hotel thus far. I am a huge animal fan and for anyone else who is, you MUST stay at either the Animal Kingdom Lodge or the Villas within the lodge.

Nothing is more amazing then stepping out on your balcony and seeing animals. We had a balcony with a pool view that had luscious greenery abound with some animals in the distance. If you stay here, or even if you just go for a meal at Sanaa, Jiko or Boma, take a walk around the property! That's an order! Outdoors is absolutely beautiful. It is so fun going around checking everything out from the animals roaming around to the cool rockers placed around the firepit. They read stories some evenings. Also, when night falls, be sure to go to the night viewing spot and check out the animals with the night vision googles. It's a lot of fun!

The hotel itself is beautiful as well. The lobby is magnificent with amazing decor throughout. Get a tour of the AKL if you can!  There are super comfy chairs everywhere. We relaxed while waiting for a Boma dinner one evening in the couches, just taking in the atmosphere. There are some comfy chairs around an indoor fireplace which my friend actually fell asleep in front of as I was reading the story behind it. Plus, there are a couple of big balconies that overlook animal viewing areas which make for some fun!

We stayed in a Studio Villa which was huge! It had everything we could need...free Wi Fi (this is villas only), coffee maker, microwave, sink, fridge, all the mini kitchen fixens. We had our big bed plus a nice couch, table, flat screen tv, tons of space for the two of us. Plus, I loved the Animal themeing to the rooms (I will post pictures). The beauty was in the details of the room and hidden Mickeys were abound!

I loved Boma their 1 TS restaurant, Jiko their 2 TS restaurant is simply amazing, I haven't yet tried Sanaa, and Mara their quick service area is great as well. 

The pool is so beautiful! It's as if it's plopped write in the middle of Animal Kingdom---trees and greenery everywhere!

They have the usual great Disney staff throughout. I love their gift shop, as well! 

The only downfall is it's one of the few Disney Deluxe Hotels that you have to take a bus everywhere. It's close to Animal Kingdom but not too close to the other parks so there are no boats, monorails, or walking paths to the parks. However, we had zero problems with waiting forever for buses here or anything like that.

I've been anticipating the opening of this place and it didn't disappoint. It's located on Sandlake Rd. accross from the Publix Shopping Center. I just came in for a late night drink, no food was ordered. The parking was ok. It was much smaller than I anticipated it would be, but to be honest, I actually liked it that way; nice, cozy and intimitae. It was packed in there. You seat yourself and the server, which was very pleasant, of course, takes your order. I had a pickle back......OOOO WHEE!!!! For those that don't know what a pickle back is, it's a shot of whiskey, my choice was Jameson and a chaser of pickle juice. I know....I know it sounds yuck, but trust me try it, you just might like it. There was a live band playing and I....LOVED....IT! They played a variety of music, reggae, country, rock and R & B. So if you're looking for a place to go and just chill. The Whiskey is it! I'm looking forward to my next experience where can enjoy one of those tasty looking burgers.

Back again!  Random night in Boston and in Beacon Hill so I decided to meet my niece for dinner/drinks without reservations.  Scollay, I heard was hugely busy on Thursday but I thought since we were early it might be a good try around 5Pm. I was right. It was once again the perfect spot.  Near empty patio on a warm summer Thursday eve.  My niece and I started with a Margherita  flatbread and cocktails. Our waitress Rachel (completely a coincidence) suggested a Lucky Pony for me. It was just perfect.  Rachel was most attentive without being intrusive and we enjoyed her input when we were trying to decide our orders.  After a few minutes,I realized, that this was the very same Rachel we experienced at brunch.  Public, be good to your wait staff. They can make your day/ night. 

Our other family members arrived a few hours later and we ordered the buffalo flat bread, a burger, truffle fries and short rib plate. Not one complaint from our table and not much left to clean on the plates either. Needless to say, another great dining experience. Rachel is a superstar and I hope the other staff is as delightful.  I promise we are not related and not stalkers! It was just a nice coincidence and to our benefit. We had a  wonderous experience. Too long a story to express how bad my week had been up to this point. I was certain I would fall apart at any second. But, to be treated so well and to enjoy such epicurean delights, all troubles melted away. Yes, hold our seats. We will return.

I visited Cafe Murano on a busy Saturday around 8Pm, the wait was 30-40 mins but they managed to get us seated at the dinning room area in 20. There is an outside area and by the bar area(where a band plays on weekends)  sitting also. The service was outstanding and the food phenomenal. Our waiter was Matt, he was very attentive, chatty and helpful... He kept checking on us constantly. He was awesome! My dinner companion had a steak(Bistecca) with a side of Rissoto...the steak was tasty and the Rissoto was delicious!! I had the Shrimp and Scallops Checca...over linguini with fresh mozarella....to die for... Simple succulent...lots of flavors!!! We also tried the bread pudding...it was delicious. Overall great visit...Good food and service!

I think I found a place I can call my go to "biker bar". Harleys and Triumphs and Indians and Ducatis hanging all over the place. Signage from yesteryear, cool old neon, gas pumps and a pretty damn good burger. Can it get much better? Well, I'm guessing when the weather warms up and the motorcycles are lining the street it will be more to my liking.

Even the bartenders have the attitude of this place. And at least the one I talked with has a motorcycle himself, or is getting one on the road. Of course, it goes without saying that the place has a good array of local beers as well as the low end cans that I've now seen all over the Portland area as well as a great selection of the hard stuff. Not sure on the costs but I got a pint and a burger and it was decently priced.

I know I will be frequenting this place many, many more times. I can't wait till the warm weather arrives.

Enjoy.

We stopped here for a late night experience and we were impressed. The late night weekday happy hour starts at 10 pm and offers $1 off beer and half off appetizers along with other deals. My boyfriend can't have wheat and thankfully for him our server Katie was able to find a delicous beer he can have. 

Our server Katie was amazing. She had a wonderful personality, very attentive and knew the beer on draft and on the menu inside/out. With her help he ordered two beers. 

 I got the ahi tuna app for half off making it only $5 and the 10 piece wings for $5 as well. You can't beat these late night happy hour deals and the food is awesome. Overall awesome experience.

This place has some of the best breakfast food I've ever had, and the prices are low.  All of their breakfast specials are delicious, the portions are large, and they are inexpensive.  The omelette special is particularly good.  Try putting jam on the omelette.  Yes I know, that sounds weird, but it is surprisingly tasty!  They also have really good coffee.  It's nothing fancy, but if you are looking for delicious basic coffee, this is the place for it.  They offer free refills on the coffee as well.

They also have some really tasty Chinese food.  The fried rice was quite delicious!  I would have liked to try more of the items on the Chinese food menu.

I never tried the poutine here, since Fritz is right nearby.

The staff here is really friendly and helpful, particularly if you take the time to talk to them.

When I was in Vancouver for the Olympics I had breakfast here almost every day.  I really miss this place, and plan to come back the next time I'm in Vancouver.

(There is some confusion about the name of this place. It is also known as The Grade A Cafe.)

My daughter has gone here since she was 3 months old and she is turning 2 soon. I looked at a lot of places before deciding on Bright Horizons. She is continually learning and always very happy when I pick her up or when I pop in to check "spy" on her. A new director came on in July and you can tell she is comitted to the kids and this place. I know it is hard to find a place you feel comfortable with leaving your child, it was for me, but seeing how happy my child is has made it easier.

NVC in Sanford is THE BEST vet center we've ever taken our pug to. While away on vacation, our pug was at a boarding facility in Longwood. When we picked up our pug, he was wheezing horribly and gasping for air. I've never heard him make such a sound (or any dog in that matter) in 10 years so I called up NVC and told them we were rushing over. As soon as we got there, they took him back and began examining him. They immediately put him on oxygen and sedated him so they could take x-rays and blood work. Many of us consider our dogs family, and ours is our baby. So, needless to say, I was beyond a wreck. Not only was the team at NVC over comforting to our fur baby, they were also very comforting to me and my husband. I cant see why there would be any negative reviews for this center because they are always there and willing to help. NVC is truly god sent and we are beyond grateful for them always taking care of our pug.

I've been to the Urban Waxx Division location twice now for brazilian waxes and both times were phenomenal. I've seen two different aestheticians--I can't remember the name of the first person I saw (she was also great) but I just had a wax with Lanie and she was so sweet I felt compelled to write a glowing review of my experience here both times which were as comfortable as can possibly be. I've had really great wax experiences in the past as well as very unsatisfactory ones so it's always a little unnerving going somewhere new and not really knowing what to expect. All of the staff at Urban Waxx have been really friendly, professional, casual and chatty which helps me take my mind off of the discomfort of the wax itself. I've been to "Sugar Me" and "Bliss" salon on Division for waxes as well and didn't like either very much. There have been times before where I've had to hold uncomfortable positions for longer periods of time and still come away with stray hairs remaining, neither of which is the case at Urban Waxx. Both times I've been have been quick, comfortable, and the waxes have been really thorough. Lanie is a self-described perfectionist and made sure that everything I wanted gone was gone.  I've also tried the wine and the mimosas before being waxed here before which helps me feel more relaxed and comfortable leading up to the wax. After my first appointment they would also send me e-mails about last minute spots at discounted prices because of appointment cancellations which was also really nice! I have been super happy with the service here and would highly recommend!

What an amazing experience! I had the salt room massage booked and was welcomed from the very start of the process. When I walked in, I was warmly greeted and since I was a new client, I had to fill out paperwork. Nice and simple - they had nicely decorated room for waiting. I filled out everything and the massage therapist brought me into the room and showed me where everything was and left me to get undressed. 
The room has a salt generator that fills the room with a fine coating of salt. It definitely was an interesting experience. The massage therapist was very professional and accommodating to my needs - even asked if I had any areas to focus on. She definitely targeted all of them! Thanks, Gaby!
Highly recommended!

This place blew my mind!!! I went to the crabs and karaoke night on Thursday here and I had such a wonderful time. I was skeptical at first because crabs and karaoke don't seem to go but was I wrong!! As soon as I got in I ordered a pound of snow crabs with their signature spicy and juicy seasoning which is spicy and sweet at the same time. Hands down the best crabs I've had in a long time and I know my crabs!!! The flavor was perfect a hint of sweetness with a kick to finish it off. Now let's talk about the ambience they had a live dinner before the karaoke started and he was playing all the jams I grew up on and what's popular now. It was such an experience eating this amazing seafood while jamming out to some good music felt like a good family cookout!!! They karaoke started and it was fun and exciting to see everyone cut loose and just have a good time. The service was amazing and I think I found my new Thursday spot!!!

Had an IPhone emergency! My aunts IPhone 4 accidently went for a wash in the washer... Verizons insurance would cost $170 for a refurbished IPhone 4 (their customer service at their kiosk in the mall was terrible). I opted to look in the apple store to see what we could do for a second option. The account had an upgrade available on a different line and Ben quickly solved everything and even called Verizon to cancel their insurance for us was a huge help! Ended up upgrading the phone to a new 4s ($99) and purchased apple care (which you cannot purchase through Verizon stores) for another ($99). 


Ben was very helpful and brought up the new ios6 that was introduced today and informed us of workshops and such to help with Siri and the new ios features. Definitely will return for any other Apple hardware!

if you are thinking about painting your home (interior or exterior), I  highly recommend working with Genie! We bought our home in June 2012 and just loved it, but the colors simply did not reflect our style.  I had so much anxiety around my ability to choose paint colors that I made endless trips to various paint stores picking up color chips and then never did anything about it -- until I hired Genie! Genie listened to my concerns, color preferences, and design ideas. Then she carefully selected a couple of colors for each room of my house enabling me to make a confident final choice! An unexpected benefit of working with Genie was that she gave me the confidence of knowing I actually DO have a good eye and should trust my instincts! (Yay). Oh - and I LOVED that she created a Pinterest board with ideas for my house. That was a complete surprise and a great bonus!

Completely intoxicated or completely sober, this place is AMAZING!

I stopped at this particular location twice while in Austin for a friend's bachelor party. The first time I got a spicy chicken kebob and it was... orgasmic. Spicy as hell, but highly edible and easy to finish. Its a good amount of food too!

The second time at this place, it was a bit later (2AMish), and they were out of chicken!? Kinda crazy.. I would think they would be better prepared... I got the felafel instead, and I wasn't disappointed. It was JUST AS GOOD as the chicken!

I love pitas, gyros, ect.. and this place is ONE OF THE BEST. The workers get a bit frazzled when there's a ton of orders, but a simple non-hostile conversation fixes everything.

NOW... GO GO GO!

I don't know if you can rate just on the playlist but it was amazing!  Then you top it with friendly service and ingredients that make your mouth jazz.  Even a quail egg on toast that just melts in your mouth.  Ahi tuna cooked perfectly, old fashion cocktail mixed just right, and sweet potato beignet dessert are upstaged only by the raspberry jam served with the house rolls.  It was a pleasurable experience in this Atlanta heat.  It made me incredibly happy.  Come enjoy the flavors.

A lot of people rate this restaurant based on the price; however, I think most people go in with the  preconceived notion that they will be spending a lot, so I will leave that variable out of the equation.

With such being said, every detail is done perfectly. It was my girlfriends birthday(first timer), and they made sure she was treated very well. Prior to going up, the two ladies at the reservation desk said happy birthday-- good to know they paid attention to the comment I made on my Open Table reservation. Service has been 9-10/10 the five times I have gone. The head chef did a grand job with the new menu. The food is full of savory taste that will leave you wanting more after every bite-- but will rightfully fill you up at the same time.  

The last two times were post the incident, so it wasn't spinning. Sure wish they'll start doing that again, but I still do think that they deserve a 5/5. Highly recommend for special nights and good food. Don't let the $ deviate from the fact that their service, ambience, and food-taste is SPECTACULAR.

Thanks for saving me yet again after a long day at work and no desire to cook!

We've had the Carnivore, Canuck,  Baked Lasagna with Meatballs and the Jalapeno Poppers (they are awesomely hoooooooooottt!) Tonight we ordered our favourite - the Hot Oven Select. It's stuffed - trust me, order it.
 
Staff has been friendly when I've called to order, gone in to pick up and delivery has been quick.  While they tell you the usual "45 minutes to 1 hour" for delivery, I've waited tops 40 minutes. 

I don't find the prices to be high, the ingredients taste fresh and there's so much, I'll pay for that.

One of the best decisions I've ever made was getting a giant sheet of marble cake from Beaverton Bakery for our wedding! After tasting a million different flavors of cake from a million different bakeries at various bridal shows, we found ourselves cake less with only 2 months left before the wedding.
 At a last minute food tasting at our venue, a slice of marble cake made its way onto our plates. It was love at first taste. We love it so much that for birthdays we find ourselves wandering in to bring home a small cake to enjoy. Beaverton bakery has some truly beautiful breads cookies and pies as well. Some of the items can be a bit pricey but I've never bought anything from here with any regret.

My partner and I have been here twice so far, we discovered this new location thanks to the advertising deal on Scoutmob for 50% off! 

This JR Crickets is in a prime location in midtown inside the Colony Square building. This is their newest location in town and definitely the nicest one!

JR Crickets seriously has the BEST chicken wings in Atlanta! We ordered the lemon pepper wings, medium original wings, and the honey BBQ wings. All were DELICIOUS! The staff here was great and SUPER FRIENDLY! They have a cool outdoor patio too! 

CHECK THIS NEW JR CRICKETS OUT!!!

Voted the best Minor league park for a reason!  Its awesome!  There isn't really a bad seat in the house. The tickets are cheap, beer is not, but that's expected. 

There are plenty of bathrooms to accommodate you and your peeps. 

The only downside is that the Sky Boxes are uber expensive now. At the old park you could rent one out and get 10 or so tickets or around $200. 

The location of this park is also top notch!  Right down town and walking distance to the Areana district and plenty of bars and reasurants.

Really awesome setup when you first walk in you have to walk up a slight ramp leading you to the host who takes you to the stairs leading into the dinning area and bar.  Having a half yard of Fort George 1811 Lager and the Ahi Poke Bowl this is all under the category snacks on there menu (small portions ) guacamole & chips, wings and the Smoked Gouda & Chicken Flatbread.  The music is loud but still enjoyable.  I've been here 4 times now and still have barely started to put a dent in this huge tap list let alone the menu is awesome so many snack option then appetizers also. The entree and burgers I haven't even gotten to try yet but I can only imagine there huge and delicious. . I will be returning soon.

Stayed one night prior to a trip and fell in love. Would stay again for sure.  Staying on an inside room and couldn't hear planes at all, nor the bustle of the airport. Great staff, loved the room and the restaurant was top notch.

 My only quibble is that the fitness center needs a spray bottle of cleaner for people to wipe down their machines. The housekeeping staff came by, but some people just aren't courteous enough to wipe off their sweat.

Darcie and her business partner Hilary made our home-buying experience in Portland a complete pleasure.  Highly recommend!

We started initially working with Darcie based on her strong Yelp recommendations.  After an initial meeting, we quickly felt comfortable.  Darcie is confident, knowledgable, responsive, savvy, and a great communicator.  We really felt like she listened first to what we were looking for in a house before speaking and providing her thoughts.  She has great knowledge of all of the various neighborhoods around Portland and Beaverton and provides the background or links for further information about location and schools.

Darcie and Hilary do a great job keeping each other updated, so we never felt like we would have to re-explain anything we discussed with one to the other.  A great team!

Buying a house in a completely new area can be intimidating.  The process is long and complex, and the stakes are high.  We felt that Darcie and Hilary were definitely on top of every detail and on our side.  They know about different house constructions and materials, can identify potential problems, and really take a close look at every corner of a house during a showing.  They're not afraid to point out potential concerns to you, either.

They made sure we were aware of all of our options at each step in the purchase process, and also knew how we could best protect ourselves as we were progressing through the home buying stages.  Another great thing they bring to the table is a good relationship with several local contractors whom they can ask to estimate how much a particular repair might cost, if you'd like.

Overall, our house search took about five months to complete.  I don't think things could have gone any better with Darcie & Hilary's patience, knowledge, encouragement, responsiveness, and professionalism.  Thanks so much!

East End Market is a little out of the way for me but it's worth the drive. Gideons Bake House is the biggest pull for me. Their cookies are amazing and I have never been disappointed. Once I am at this location I usually pick up a loaf of bread at the Olde Hearth. I love their fresh baked breads and other treats. Lastly I grab some coffee at Lineage. Their fresh coffee is amazing. 

There is more to see and eat at the East End Market but I usually stick with my routine. You can poke around in some pretty cool looking and unique shops. The food fenders offer delicious options using organic or raw ingredients and have healthy fun menus. There is an outdoor seating area that looks inviting and relaxing. Overall the East End Market is a great place to shop with a laid back and relaxing atmosphere.

Wow. This is an excellent salon, and let me tell you why.....
I am new to Austin, and found Method Hair through the awesome reviews on Yelp. I made an appt for color with Jeromy, and a cut with Sarah. I had some pretty tricky color requests, and once I arrived, Jeromy was honest and told me that it would take 3 times as long as my appt to get the color I was asking for. He was booked solid, and unable to fit me in any other time that day....but I was going out of town, and needed to get my hair colored THAT day. He and Sarah got together and called another salon that they work with, and got me a color appt that afternoon! Now that is amazing service!!! Then, I came back about an hour later for my cut with Sarah, who took me from long to short...and I LOVE IT!!!! She is funny and cool as hell, and looked effortless as she cut my hair into one of the best looks I have ever had!!!
My color looks great, also, and the colorist they booked me with at the other salon was fantastic. They have definitely earned my business with their great customer service and attitudes!! 

And oh yeah...the salon rocks, it's gorgeous! GO TO METHOD HAIR!! I know I will keep going back!!

I absolutely loved working with this dealership. They rolled out the red carpet even though I was buying a used car and not a new fancy BMW. Everyone was so friendly and approachable. Contrary to another reviewer on here, I had an absolutely amazing experience with John Zimmerman. He listened to what I wanted for price point and color and found me exactly what I needed. He answered all of our questions and taught me everything about my new car. I will purchase all of our cars from John. I can't thank him enough for finally getting me into the car I always wanted. I have to say also being DOG FRIENDLY was another area that sold me not just the customer service. Coach and I enjoy going to the car wash and hanging out in the lobby!

I tried this place 3 weeks ago.  The reason I waited to write the review is that I wanted to see just how long the polish would last.  Seriously, I am not sure if it is because I chose a brand new bottle of polish or if this place is just that amazing but my nails still look pretty great!  My nails grow very fast and I actually "outgrew" the polish before it started to chip!

The price is a bit higher than your typical walk-in high volume nail place, but the neck/shoulder massage, hot stone leg massage, paraffin wax heel and hand treatment that were included in my standard mani/pedi package made it well worth it.

Definitely going back.  Added bonus: they have pricing for men's mani/pedi so my guy actually feels comfortable coming with me instead of staying home and complaining about how he wants his feet rubbed ;)

It seems people's experience is varied but my husband and I couldn't be happier living at Portside. From the beginning, Stacey as well as the other agents have been not only been helpful but mindful of what's important to us as tenants. The quality of the apartment finishes, huge array of amenities and high level of customer service stand out. The maintenance department is incredibly responsive and their staff is professional, knowledgeable and generous with their time and problem-solving. We're lucky to have a view of the Harbor-that never gets old-and are only minutes from the T. Would highly recommend Portside to anyone.

I've gone to Lighthouse Seafood market for some time now. They have been my Go-to for fresh seafood. When I discovered they have expanded and opened a cafe I knew I had to try it. 

For our first visit we each ordered a Fried Basket. That's a great lunch with seafood, coleslaw, fries, and hush puppies. We were so excited to get started I almost forgot to take a picture for you. Needless to say, these baskets actually come with a little more seafood than the picture shows. Oops! Sorry. 

My husband ordered oysters and I ordered scallops. It has been my experience that inexperienced cooks can have trouble preparing both of these so I believe it's a good test if the quality of a kitchen. But really we just love scallops and oysters. 

These were cooked to perfection. If you actually LIKE to taste your seafood, this is the place for you. The seafood cases of the market line one side of the room, and the bar and cooking area line the opposite wall. You are immersed in a seafood culture. They were even watching a fishing program on the big screen TV. I thought it was appropriate. 

Back to the food. Everything was lightly seasoned and prepared expertly. I've never seen French fries cut into V shaped wedges before but I could see how customers who really like to pile in the condiments will LOVE these fries. They were yummy with and without my fav, ketchup. The server provided us with tartar sauce, remoulade, ketchup, and malt vinegar. 

It was more food they either of us could finish and we'll worth every penny. Seafood is never cheap so that should say a lot. These baskets were priced based on today's market price so I won't quote you a price. 

I've included pictures of the menu and a specials board they had out front another time I visited the market. You'll notice there are selections for the land lovers in your group. If they don't like seafood, order them a grilled cheese or a cheesesteak. :-D

Shannon is a life safer. Simply put. We have a Hungarian puli (looks like a walking white mop with dreads). We moved from Chicago last year and we had a special groomer there that treated him. Since moving we had the biggest pain finding someone that could groom him until we found mud puppies and Shannon took him in and has been doing the best job we could ask for. We've used them 3 or 4 times now and we're so happy we found "our spot". If they can groom our puli well they can for sure groom any other dog too. Freddie leaves so happy and stress-less they have of done a great job.

I love Maria Nails! The employees are super nice and the place is kept clean and up to date. Kelly and Mary have been absolutely wonderful and I never leave unhappy. I recommend you make an appointment, they can get very busy. They strive to keep their customers happy, and I go out of my way to get services done from them. My whole family uses them as a matter of fact. SNS is perfect every time! I've had it done in other places before and the work was not that great. I highly recommend them!

In the interest of full disclosure, we came here for dinner because I got an email from Pluckers for a free entree, but now we can't wait to come back. The Brussels sprouts app was excellent, with a great sauce that's spicy and flavorful. I got the club sandwich with crispy pork belly and Laura got Thai basil fried rice with pork tenderloin, and we both made sure that we had enough left to make a 2nd meal later this week. We're looking forward to bringing our pescatarian son up here.

This is seriously the best pizza I've ever had in my life! We made the trip from DFW because we saw this pizza on a Food Network show. It was completely worth the drive!!

We started with the Roasted Broccoli & Cauliflower. Who knew cauliflower could be so delicious? I'm pretty sure it was the balsamic vinegar that contributed to that. For our pizza we got the Detroiter. The smoked pepperoni, burnt cheese, and tomato sauce just make for the best pizza. Please open a location in DFW!!

Flank is awesome! We decided to christen our first visit with a giant seafood tower called, "The Mallard". Delicious! We followed this up with great steaks that are truly worth returning for.  I really enjoyed the speakeasy feel with the cool art on the walls.  I'm very jealous of those who have the budget to keep a private booze locker on site at the restaurant...very classy. Great and attentive service, especially by the AGM Mike. We felt right at home within moments of walking in.  I can't wait to take my old school Italian father to this joint to show him how the modern steakhouse can still be sophisticated, yet inviting.

My first experience here yesterday was fantastic. I came in for happy hour with a friend and though their happy hour ends at 6 and we didn't get the pricing we still stuck to appetizers. Their truffle Mac and cheese and French fries were delicious! Def recommend doing the Mac and cheese with the jalapeños and bacon. I will be back to do their signature jalapeño buttermilk fried check soon - it looked amazing as it was being brought out to the other tables. The atmosphere is fun, and they did a good job channeling the dive feel. Our server Dane was awesome - super knowledgeable and friendly. He even made a few off the menu recommendations - great service! I'll definitely be back :-)

Okay, so this place won me over with the prices. I ended up with the steak which was only $18! It comes with the Papas Bravas so I would suggest not ordering it on the side. The aioli they have with the potatoes is delicious, wish I could have taken it home. 

The restaurant does fill up pretty fast. We got there around 530 there wasn't too many peephole in there yet, but when we left around 730 there was a line. 

If you're looking for a good cheap date night spot, here it is!

I know almost nothing about Columbian food but I know plenty about GOOD food and this place is far beyond "good" and in a class all it's own.  Entering the place is a little odd because you just kind of "enter" there is no hostess stand or anything.  Before you will even get a chance to think "umm what now" the friendly staff will be right there ready to seat you.  

The entire place is clean and well kept.  They have two full bars for those that like to party while they dine.  The staff is responsive and eager to answer your questions if like me you have no idea what you are ordering.  The menu seems a little overwhelming if you aren't familiar with the style of food but it's nothing to be afraid of.  

The beans are amazing, the rice is perfectly done and the addition of an over-easy egg on top only makes these staples that much better.  It's the proteins that make the food extraordinary.  The black sausage is well seasoned and absolutely wonderful.  The steak was perfectly tender and also full off flavor.  Everything on my plate was an amazing experience in it's own right.  The real gem though was the fried pork skin.  I don't even know how to explain how amazing this sinful and delectable slice of piggy was.  It was a decadent addition to the already full and complete platter of perfection.  

If you are looking for excellent food that is well seasoned and portions that will leave you immobilized then this is the place for you.  This is one of those places that you take out of town friends or family to show off Orlando.  I will be a regular here, I'm hooked.

So nice and down to earth. Will tell you up front what you need and what options from hi to lo you can get for your car. My brakes are great and the price I paid was about half of what I was expecting, getting quote from other places (NTB, dealer,etc).
Super nice super friendly super efficient and strait up with you. Nothing fancy as far as accommodations if you r waiting but it makes up for it by the service you get !
Thumbs up

While picking up an order of needed things from Food Fight! On ne Halsey. I noticed Ditto!, and decided that I couldn't wait to eat. I ordered a Teddy and a Loomis to share when I got home.
I really enjoyed the Tamato soup, and the grilled cheese, and the burger a lot! I'll be back to try more sandwiches! This was a total spur of moment decision and it was well worth the very short wait. We need more great vegan food out here. Glad that Ditto! Is set up!

I've been using SPUD on and off for a few years now and their customer service is phenomenal. Shopping for local/organic/all natural foods on their website is super easy with the clear labeling. I'm also a huge fan of the "kms traveled" for products so i know exactly what kind of footprint i'm leaving with the foods I choose to purchase.

I usually put in an order when I get really busy and/or forgot something when I went grocery shopping and dont want to go back for a second round of crowded shopping. It's also really convenient for apartment buildings because you can buzz them in from your phone and they'll leave the order at your doorstep and pick up the empty bin for you from your previous order. Definitely helps with not having to haul some of the heavier groceries from my car (i.e. milk, juice, etc.). 

Definitely recommend for busy people.

Checked out The Barn for the first time last night for our wedding anniversary. It was spectacular. We both ordered steaks (she got the 8oz filet, I ordered the ribeye) and we agreed these were some of the better cuts of meat we've ever had. We also enjoyed the hip, relaxed atmosphere close to home. 


Small but tasty selection of beers on tap, extensive wine list, known for their bourbon collection. 

A bit pricey, but what do you expect from a Cameron Mitchell place? It's well worth the price. 

Will be back... Many times.

Joli Kobe is a great Japanese/Euro fusion restaurant with VERY reasonably prices. Their delicious entrees are around $10 and come with bread and salad. They also have an extensive bakery with fresh pastries and bread. 

The blue crab bisque is just phenomenal. It's so rich without being heavy and has very generous lumps of real crab (none of that imitation crab). The crab cake sandwich was also perfect. 

I HIGHLY recommend the blue crab bisque and crab cake sandwich at Joli Kobe!

Before I moved to Atlanta in July '07, I had only visited the city twice. I knew that I would be working in Buckhead, but beyond that, I didn't know a lick about Atlanta's neighborhoods. I know that everyone loves to rag on Buckhead (which is why I chose it for my 100th review), but for me, it has been a great place to live. I have a short commute to work, my cost of living is reasonable, and I feel safe despite the lack of walkability in this uptown 'hood. 

No, I don't shop on daddy's dime and no, I'm not a Buckhead Betty. In fact, I work next to Lenox and Phipps but I can't even tell you the last time that I was at either mall. However, it's pretty cool to think about how many upscale boutiques Buckhead has, and it's impressive that they do more than 1bn in sales each year. Buckhead offers easy access to MARTA (which is only good when it comes to getting to the airport and Braves games), has quite a few nice hotels, and more than a handful of good restaurants. I love Chastain Park and its Amphitheater, the Buckhead Library, and our two movie theatres. 

Yes, Buckhead Village and its dive bars encourage post-college debauchery and a delay in entering adulthood, but that's a choice. I've realized that there is no such thing as a neighborhood that has everything.  Buckhead isn't known for its night life for anyone over 25, but I've come to accept that. For now, Buckhead shows promise of things to come (Streets of Buckhead, Buckhead Greenspace) and I'm happy to call it my home.

Wops Hops is the best brewery around! Different than many other breweries, a majority of the craft beers are their own recipe...and there is a lot! Wop's Paradiso Coconut beer is my favorite craft beer of all time. Raspberry Cream Ale is a close second. Both are the perfect light craft beers for a hot Florida summer day. 

They have an amazing staff that always makes us feel like family. In addition to amazing beer, their menu includes a wide variety of Italian-themed dishes including original recipes by The Wop's very own family! I love this brewery...as they are one of the first brewers in Downtown Sanford. They have trailblazed the brewery scene in dt Sanford. I can't wait to see what beer they come up with next. Cheers!

This was my first Dominican salon experience and it was amazing to say the least. My hair came out so beautiful that I am now convinced that somebody invented relaxers just to make money. I am natural and I will definitely be back. The pieces are great $35 for wash and blowout. Deep conditioner is $10 but free on Tuesday-Thursday. I would recommend this salon to every single person who cares about how their hair looks and would like to stick to their budget.

What a great find.  This shoud be a destination cafe for all who visit or live in  Vancouver.  I work right around the corner.  Here is the ultimate quaint  cafe in a lovely quiet Strathcona  neighbourhood.   I am a sucker for all wood interior design.  The staff are extremely friendly  and will provide whatever  you wish.   The food is always healthy  and presented in an artistic manner.  I will continue  to return to this laid back jewel in Vancouver.  Say hello to approachable Cheryl,the owner..

My boyfriend and I came back to try the dinner menu and brought a friend from out of state. We decided to start with a couple of apps and drinks before dinner.  The fact they have drink specials on Friday's is awesome!!!  They has Mexican Martinis and Margaritas...Margs were AMAZING!!  We munched on crab hush puppies, which were the best I have ever had, and mine and my boufriends favorite, the calamari and fried okra.  Dinner didn't disappoint either....i had the Pasta Marisco which I highly recommend.  My boyfriend had the Fruitti di Mare, and our friend had the house special, Blackened Redfish.  It got completely silent around the table as we all enjoyed our FABULOUS dishes.  Dessert was hard to pass up, we ordered the key lime pie and the Banana Zango...totally worth it!   The food is wonderful, the wait staff are friendly, our server Matt was attentive and made really great recommendations, and the atmosphere is great!  This place just keeps getting better and better!  

The only thing I would change is the parents letting their kids run all over the place and down into the patio area while people are trying to enjoy their meals.

Our three year old has been with Hannah's world since it was a Mother's Day out program and she's now in part time day care there. I am very happy with the quality of care they provide. The facility is very clean and the staff are very happy and genuinely nice and are always coming up with fun projects for the kids.

We have had experiences at other daycares where the employees seem stressed and overwhelmed. This isn't the case at Hannah's world.  It feels more like family and is super down to earth! They have art activities and projects planned on a daily basis and send me photos throughout the day of what my daughter is up to.

The director, Hannah is very nice and sincere and continues to be accommodating to our child and family's needs.

I couldn't recommend this place more. I suggest taking a tour and seeing for yourself. I knew within minutes that this was my first choice.

What a find on our short trip to Orlando. Excellent service and food that makes you want to come back for more. We had the Patacon sweet plantain steak sandwich, New York Strip with rice beans and plantains, cachapa queso (cornbread with homemade cheese.) We got flan and tres leches to go for later. All were so delicious!!! Couldn't ask for better food or service. They definitely do a great job and this is a place not to miss for an amazing casual Latin lunch.

I went to Gaslight last Friday night for the first time and I cannot say enough good things about it. It was my boyfriend's birthday so I wanted to take him out and try somewhere new to celebrate. We had a reservation for 8:45 and the restaurant was pretty packed when we got there. Originally we were seated at a two-top that was in a pretty crowded row of people with very little space. Normally I'm not one to complain about where a hostess seats us, but since we were celebrating a special occasion I was being picky and decided to go up to the hostess stand and ask for a different table. I told the hostess that we didn't mind waiting at the bar until a bigger/less crowded table became available and she was super nice about it and actually ended up having a perfect table for us!!

After moving tables, we started to look through the menu and wanted to know everything (we are never shy to bombard waiters with questions and ask for recommendations). Our waitress was Tanya and she was EXCELLENT. She knew everything about the menu and walked us through what everything was and helped us to order. We started off with a meat/cheese board (it was a little pricey at $34 but SO worth it and everything on it was incredible) and then we tried the escargot, which was also delicious. For dinner, I order the chicken and my boyfriend got the pork chop. The chicken was so juicy and came with this sauce that I would literally bathe in, it was so good. The pork chop was massive and my boyfriend couldn't stop raving about it.

By the time we finished, we were so stuffed so we decided to pass on dessert. I had casually mentioned while Tanya was over at the table that it was my boyfriend's birthday (but never went up to her and asked her to bring something over for it) but she surprised us with a creme brulee and a birthday card from the staff at Gaslight completely free of charge. It was such a pleasant surprise and a lovely touch, not to mention the creme brulee was out of this world. 

I rarely write reviews on Yelp but I felt compelled to after my experience at Gaslight and I will DEFINITELY be returning!!!!

I am hooked on the fresh baked ciabatta loafs. Now I am seriously incapable of eating any other bread. I have been eating sandwiches for about a week straight. I walked in the soaking rain yesterday all for this precious bread, and I would do it again in an instant. 

Every time I come in and look at the pastries here my focus drifts to the bunt cakes, turnovers, cakes, bread....oh and if you look in the back their is bakers back their making everything fresh especially for you!!

This place was amazing. My family and I walked here from our room at the Westin Bayshore, we honestly weren't sure what to expect. We were lucky to get a table without a reservation. It was a wonderfully warm atmosphere. What really made the experience was our server, he came right over and listed the specials, then proceeded to make several recommendations. It was awesome, we ended ordering everything he recommended. We had the Hazelnut Gnnochi , the chicken and their shrimp and halibut noodle special. For drinks, I got one of the cocktails, Pearcello. 

For dessert, we got the Cherry Pie with ice cream and the Sticky toffee (that one what my favorite).

I am giving this place  5-stars for the entire fast paced, loud, interesting, experience. 
   Located in Boston's North End, it's nestled in the middle of the busy streets dotted with Italian shops and restaurants. It's pretty tiny, casual, and loud when crowded. 
   We arrived to find a line out the door at 6:15pm on a Saturday night. Even in the rain, we decided to stick it out and see it through. We had a feeling it would be worth it. And we were right. 
   The line would move up from time to time and once we got closer, a woman would come out and ask how many were in your party and to please form a single file line. We joked around that she was very strict, because she was. Maybe that was part of the charm here? 
   We finally found our way inside after an hour. We sat where she told us to. It was right next to the very loud and busy kitchen. So loud in fact it was difficult to talk at times. Also, the place had so much hustle and bustle that for me, it was difficult to relax at first. 
   We ordered our drinks and they immediately wanted to take our meal order. I realize they have a line out the door but I don't like to be rushed. But with their huge popularity I guess they don't have to worry so much about stuff like that. 
   So we ordered the Caesar salad, chicken parmigiana, lobster ravioli and a spicy fusilli pasta with lobster and shrimp. Everyone at the table agreed the food was absolutely some of the BEST Italian we had ever had. And we hardly ever say that. Seriously. 
    If you can overlook the busy, loud atmosphere and service, and are looking for a phenomenal Italian meal, this place is for you!!

This is hands down the best coffee in Columbus and I've tried it all. Not only is it good quality, but the employees are always so friendly and the atmosphere is warm and homey. I come here every morning and am always greeted like a friend which is exactly what I want from a coffee shop. Parking on the street isn't bad, there's always a spot within walking distance and the handmade drinks and take home beans are all fairly inexpensive for the quality you receive. There's also gluten free and vegan options. I have no complaints, check this place out for sure.

If you're craving the best fast food burger this side of the Mississippi, you'll probably find it at Culvers.  The name Butter Burger says it all.  After seeing Fast Food Nation, it's a stretch to willingly go out of my way to eat a fast food burger, but if you're going to take The Plunge, you might as well do it here.

The fries are alright--they taste a bit too Ore Ida for me--and it's really hard to go wrong with any kind of shake or frozen custard.

Service is typically good and you'll probably make it in and out of the drive thru in less than 10 minutes at any time of the day.

after an amazing first experience at tresca, my boyfriend and i decided to book table 77 (the bourque's personal table) for our 2nd anniversary dinner.  we arrived a little early for our 6pm reservation and were seated promptly.  we had perused the website beforehand and decided ahead of time that we were interested in doing the chef's tasting menu, along with the wine tasting.  a little pricey ($240 without tax or tip), but it was an important celebration and we knew we would not be disappointed.

i've done tasting menus before and, in my experience, they are typically items that are NOT on the menu, and allow the chef a little room for creativity, and some surprise for the diner.  tresca does things a little differently.  these are items that ARE on the menu, but entirely at the chef's discretion.  our waiter did ask us if there was anything we particularly loved or hated, so that the chef could make informed choices.  we're pretty open to everything, so i thought we would be pretty easy.  what i was not expecting was that we would actually receive entirely different meals; we each received a different dish for all courses, except dessert.  this was a welcome surprise, and allowed us to share different tastes.

appetizer for the lady: sliced bistecca with pesto and arugula salad.  the steak was cooked to a perfect mid-rare plus, and the salad was nicely dressed.  the pickled red onions were a good addition, and the pesto had a great zip to it.
pasta for the lady: spring risotto.  the risotto had a lovely touch of lemon in the background, and the asparagus and mushrooms played nicely together.  the rice was slightly al dente for my taste, but the flavors were quite good.
entree for the lady: veal milanese with black garlic vinaigrette dressed arugula.  the veal was delicious and, while i typically do not indulge in fried foods, this was light, crisp, and perfectly cooked.  there was no grease or heaviness in sight.  the arugula had delicious flavor and added a nice counterpoint to the veal, but- it was my second instance of arugula for the night.  i happen to enjoy arugula, and, like i said, the dish was wonderful, but i was a little surprised at the repeat of a featured ingredient.

appetizer for the gent: fried oysters.  OMG.  this was my favorite bite of the entire night.  the oysters were HUGE, i loved the little bibb lettuce addition, and the pickled/sweet element was lovely.  this dish is so perfect, i would encourage you to order it; you will not be disappointed.
pasta for the gent: fresh papperdelle with bolognese.  this was a knockout and, i have to say, my man very much appreciated the absence of the usual dollop of ricotta (he's not a fan).  the pasta was perfectly cooked, and the sauce was rich and deep.  this was a very hearty dish, right up my guy's alley.
entree for the gent: braised short rib over potato gnocchi with brussel sprouts.  first off- we've had the short rib before and it's to die for.  never mind not needing a knife- you don't even need a fork; you could eat these with a spoon.  the gnocchi were not the kind i'm used to; these were smaller and slightly crisp, which provided a nice textural element to the succulent meat.  the brussel sprouts were easily some of the best we've had.  they were practically charred and just awesome.

for dessert, we were brought a plate of tiramisu, along with partial cannolis filled with plain ricotta, chocolate, and lemon fillings.  the plain ricotta was bananas good.  i mean- i would have been happy with a bowl of the filling, it was just so light, creamy, and sweet.  the lemon was a nuance of flavor without hitting you over the head.  the chocolate was also quite good.

our wine pairings were good, though a little unusual.  we were started off with a moscato, which surprised me a little.  we had a montepulciano that was delicious!  dessert was served with an aperitif (i can't recall which) that was... different.  i wouldn't order it again; though it did satisfy my desire for surprise, i didn't think it married particularly well with the flavors of the desserts.

our experience was absolutely lovely, between the food and the warm and welcoming service we received.  our waiter was prompt and professional, the manager was attentive, and one of the owner's was absolutely glowing with pride and pleasure that we had chosen the restaurant for our celebration.

i can't recommend this restaurant enough if you would like to feel special on your own special occasion.

and, yes.  that same night we made a reservation for next year too.  ;-)

I LOVE this "World of Good" 
First, I can't even remember how I ran upon this store but once I entered, it was difficult not to make it a regular stop while I'm in Orlando-weekly, sometimes more. The amount and quality of product is outstanding & the staff have always been attentive and very helpful. Even via email and phone. I've been there when there are only a few people and when the store seems packed, in an "allof a sudden" way...they've never failed to make sure everyone is being helped and in as timely a manner as possible. 
They offer a wide range of bulk herbs, bulk spices, herb & herb blends in capsules & powder, herbal extracts (tinctures mostly from Herb Pharm), herbal teas, Ginseng, essential oils. capsules, incense, resins, aromatherapy supplies, soaps, containers, body care & books. They also offer certified organics when available and are marked with a CO on the bags. I also think it's fabulous that herbalist teach classes there on different days etc.

5 stars for the omakase!! The regular omakase is a mix of Sushi and cooked food - we wanted just Sushi and the restaurant was kind enough to accommodate us! We sat at the sushi bar and had an endless array of incredible nigiri - I think we ended up having ~12 pieces of nigiri plus the happy spoon (AMAZING- must have even if you don't do omakase) and two desserts. The cost was the same as the regular omakase ($99pp). The fish was so fresh and my favorite part was that it was really simple, not overdressed so that the fish really was the star. Favorites were the red snapper and the king salmon but they were all fantastic. I was actually STUFFED by the end which is rare for omakase!

I've also done the regular menu here- definitely get the A5 waygu beef! Definitely worth the price- melts in your mouth.

Cannot recommend Trent and Tech One enough. Brought my car in recently with a random cylinder misfire...it could be any of like 6 different problems. Trent diagnosed my car for free, and then called me to tell me that the work (bad catalytic converter) should be done at the dealership as it's still covered in an emission warranty.  The job at the dealership is valued at $1300, and an unscrupulous mechanic could've not informed me of my coverage.  I will be absolutely bringing my car to tech one if/when I run into any more issues.

This location in Beaverton is nothing compared to the "city of books" downtown, but you can go online and have any book delivered to this location for pick-up, convenient if you don't foresee the time to go downtown in your future.

I love this location in particular because one aisle has queer studies/lit on half, and political science books on the other, like it was built just for me. I can be found there, in the kid's section looking for stuff for my nephew, or browsing through some of the center shelves of staff-recommended reads.

Powell's is great, and as bookstores become a dying entity, we really ought to patron this place more often.

Excellent spot for our girls night out. Definitely a place you'll need a reservation for. Our party of 3 had reservations for Friday night at 7:30 and the place was full.  You'll need to have your entire party there before they seat you -- so y'all better not be late.  I pulled right up in front of the restaurant and handed my keys over to the valet (no charge, but you should tip accordingly). 

To start, they had a shrimp wonton dish as a special and man -- it was delicious!! Like no, I was mad when I ate them all....just SO GOOD!  Five miniature wontons exploding with flavor! My friend suggested the lychee martini - it hit the spot.  I really could've been straight with one, but I went for two -- hey, you only live once, right?! Ha!  

For my entree, I had the crispy beef. When I tell you...ooooo weeeeee! I've never had beef that tender and flavorful before. It was lightly breaded and fried, served with a side of jasmine rice and mixed with vegetables. My friends all tasted mine and LOVED it more than their own dishes (lobster fried rice and crab leg special). 

So yeah, I work downtown and will definitely be back to try lunch.  Try that lychee martini, friend -- just not during lunch hours.

This is the best discovery I've made in the Brighton/Allston area. It's quiet (but you don't feel the need to keep your voice down, it's just a nice relaxed place) nice but not overly fancy, fantastic food and wine list, nicely priced (and unlike a lot of places that charge $10 for small plate appetizers, here you get FED), and incredibly easy to get to. The music was great, and unlike most places around here it is spacious and you don't have to contort yourself oddly to get from your seat to the bathroom. What a fantastic place!

I've been going there regularly for probably four years, started when I was still in college. Now I moved to New York but I visit my friend in Boston regularly and we still go together. Every time I travel to a new city, I find their top rated ramen restaurants and try them, but I have never had anything that can top Pikaichi's ramen. You know how good their ramen is. Just go and try it. It's affordable comparing to many other restaurants in Boston. Don't hesitate. I love their food and the ppl there.

I've been going to Austin Dental Spa for about 10 years. I had a major fear of dentists as a result of traumatic childhood experiences with military dentists so I'm always wary of new dentists.  From my very first visit, Dr. Mark and the hygienist put me at ease, enough so that I have never been to another dentist.

I've had a lot of stuff done over the years, so I can vouch that Dr. Mark does excellent work both routine and cosmetic. And the best part is he warranties his work for 5 YEARS!!  I think they've actually lost some money on me because of the 5 year warranty. haha

Everything is very high tech (digital x-rays, water laser drill, the machine that makes crowns while you wait) and they are very generous with the nitrous oxide. They usually offer it to me as soon as I sit down in the chair (even if I don't need any work done that day!) and they are happy to turn up the nitrous and turn down the oxygen when I request it (which is most of the time haha).

Everyone who works there is really personable and they remember details about your life even if you only see them twice a year. Amanda at the front desk is super sweet. I've had lots of "emergencies" come up over the years, and Amanda always finds a way to fit me in the same day.  My hygienist Candice always remembers my vacations and that I prefer one massage therapist over the others.  

Dr. Mark's chairside manner is amazing. He tells some stupid jokes but they are funny for the most part. Even if your teeth are a mess, he has a way of making you feel good about things.  He has such a positive outlook on life that you'll feel happy even after he performs a root canal on you. 

The only thing I don't like about Austin Dental Spa is the music they sometimes play ...but with enough nitrous, I hardly notice the crappy tunes.  :)

Bunn and I met 5 years ago at a Crave event in Portland and it just so happened she had already been booked for my brothers wedding later that year. I immediately was drawn to her comfortable and excited energy about what she does for a living. There is nothing better than getting to work with someone that loves what they do.
 SO, When I was looking into maternity photos for this summer I called in a favor. I could not be happier. The hour of shooting was easy and very comfortable despite the heat of the outdoors. Then, she had the photos done about 5 days before she originally told us. And when we went to her studio I was just blown away by the beautiful display she had set up for us to see the photos for the first time. 
  She sent us a gallery to go through to pick out prints (after she had shown us in person), but I was so happy with her work I came to conclusion that I needed to have all the photos. And all the photos I now have. I will suggest her to anyone who will listen to me gush about her wonderful work.

OK, in general a review of Fenway is pretty much a no brainer

normally I wouldn't waste my time

BUT

I attempted to give it 6 stars today because for the first time in 10 years....

BEER GUY

Yes, Heineken, Bud Lt, Miller Lt, Coors Lt - all delivered to your seat for $7-8.  Beer is not cheap at Fenway anywhere - but the fact that for the first time in my 10 years, some dude brought it to me.  PRICELESS

the stars have all aligned - and I can die happy

oh, we lost tonight - but I am still on a 6 star high.

If you are taking a trip to Vancouver, this is my top pick for a unique and delicious dining experience! My friends and I spent some time exploring Gastown and after several recommendations, we decided to eat at The Flying Pig for an early dinner. While the menu is a bit pricey, we went during happy hour and shared a few dishes, which turned out to be a good way to eat quality food on a budget. Being in Canada, I was on the hunt for good poutine and the one I ordered here was the best I had during my visit to Vancouver. The truffle macaroni and cheese was also one of my group's favorites. I also ordered the Caesar Salad and was pleasantly surprised at how much I enjoyed it. The strong flavor made it unique and I would recommend it to anyone who is already a Caesar salad fan. The restaurant is dimly lit with candles at the table, making the atmosphere relaxed, but also versatile.

Awesome Disney park. It can easily take two days to go through the entire park. I mean, it is really two different parks ... the rides, and the expo. Add in the shows, and special entertainments and it is well worth the money. Every time we come it seems different. Is lovely at night so check for days when it is open late. The fireworks show is not to be missed, so plan for a late night. It is also good for bad weather because are lots of inside rides and things to do. Best park for finding food as well.

Unbeatably delicious pick to satisfy my hunger! I was there last weekend with some of my friends and tried their Momos. Tiny looking gracious packets of goodness! ... supposed to be eaten as a whole which then bursts with full of flavors in your mouth. We had ordered their Steam Momo, C-Momo with chicken and  Vegan Momo... all looked and tasted amazing!... enjoyed every bite of it. Their service was pretty quick, friendly staff and very reasonably priced (ten pieces on a plate with the choice of your filling and sauce). I am sure I will be a repeat customer whenever I am in downtown and just look forward to seeing them in more locations.

Frankly, we're so happy to have an Indian market in NE Portland that they probably could have overcharged us and called us ignorant yuppies and we would have smiled.  Instead, they were friendly and very helpful -- and very obviously a family business!  They saved their yelling for each other.

Namaste Bazaar is 1/2 Indian street food deli, and 1/2 Indian market.  The market is medium-sized, consisting of four aisles of groceries and a back wall of freezer cases.  Like most isolated ethnic markets, most of their stock are items which are dried, canned, or frozen.  They carry little produce: really just a handful of herbs, and a strange selection of low-quality produce sold "by the bag" dirt-cheap.  On the other hand, if you need to buy 5lbs of fresh ginger, this is where to get it.

Here's what the market has lots of:

* dals (legumes) and grains in bags from 2lbs to 10lbs, three different brands and probably 13 different kinds
* basmati and other Indian rice in bags up to 50lbs, maybe 20 different brands
* "masalas" (spice mixes) for every Indian dish you ever heard of, and then some
* enough different chutneys in jars to induce option paralysis
* an entire aisle of Indian snack foods in bags
* a half-aisle of Indian cosmetics and soap
* tons of frozen foods, including complete foods like kati pouches, ingredients like pre-made vada and idly, and breads of various sorts

One of the few things which was surprisingly scant was raw spices.  Anyway, the shelves weren't quite full, and I suspect that as the business matures (they've been open less than a month) they'll fill them up with more goods.

The deli is basically Mumbai street food as far as I can tell.  It's entirely vegetarian, and consists of around 12 different options, many of them fried.  The deep-fried spiced cheese (Paneer Pakoda) was especially good, as was the Tika Chaat (fried potato patties covered in chick pea curry and "salad").  And the chai, as is proper, is free.

So we got two big bags of groceries, and enough take-out for the two of us to make pigs of ourselves, and paid $77.  So this is a great place to come if you want filling spicy food on a budget.

Looking forward to many more visits.

This place was recommended by a friend. She's started coming to Frank & Angie's in the mid 90's and highly recommended it. I really enjoyed the vibe of the place the mural on the wall and the movie posters were cool. The salad was fresh and very large. The family and I had the Scorsese which we really enjoyed. The crust was great and it had a ton of pepperoni. Our waitress was great with the kids which I really appreciate. Good location and great parking which comes in real handy when you have 2 four year olds with you.

I ordered the spicy soup (bun bo hue) and the shrimp salad rolls as an appetizer. The soup was incredible, with an abundance of fresh veggies on the side to mix in, and the broth was delicious. The sliced beef and fish cakes were flavorful and a added great depth of flavor to the overall dish. There were a lot more noodles than I probably needed to eat, and though I prefer thinner noodles, the noodles were good regardless.

With the juice of the lime squeezed in, the broth became even more delicious if possible, and I literally drank the whole bowl down to the last drop. The shrimp salad rolls weren't anything special, but I do love salad rolls so I was all for them.
