The peanut sauce was as delicious as it always is, and though I'm not the biggest fan of iceberg lettuce, for some reason I don't mind it in Vietnamese cuisine.

If I lived in the area I would most definitely come here again!

We just moved with Jim's last week and they were awesome!  Meredith is super responsive to email and phoned after the move to ensure everything went the way it should.  Can't ask for better customer service.  Part of our move involved an 8 x 10 trampoline which was NOT easy to move yet the three guys worked their guts out moving it, doing a fabulous job of getting it into the truck (not easy!).  They worked hard the whole time, were courteous and respectful.  True professionals in the office and in the truck.  I'd highly recommend them.

I haven't been here since they moved right next-door. Used to be pretty casual. Great beer, mussels and truffle fries. We were out on the town and wanted to try someplace new. From the minute we walked in the door the customer service was superior. The hostess, our server Emily, and even the busboy Sharp were attentive and first class. Our server Emily suggested the duck. I was blown away.  My boyfriend ordered the halibut. That we both agreed it was very good. The duck. was to die for. We wanted to try sham bar because of the extensive beer list. I'm not a beer drinker. However, I had a delicious strawberry beer. He had Orval on the suggestion of the waitress. It was so delicious he had three! No dessert for us tonight, however, we were so blown away by the exceptional food and service. We will be back.

I want to meet the owner/manager of this location to provide some honest feedback. I'd also like for them to explain how in the world do you have some of the best waitresses but you put them in positions that don't make them successful. This 5 star is not for the location or the management outside of those at the location. Those that are remote should come see what the employees have to deal with when you have 1 cook. There is a lady there that works really hard for the company but it seems as she is not appreciated by giving her adequate staffing to be successful. Today I walked in and felt the worst for them as they had 1 cook that was visible and the wait time for food was over an hour. I seriously hope management reads this review, gives them a raise, and put processes in place to where they can call for assistance to get additional staffing to support or this won't work. Lastly customers were so rude for things that were out of the waitresses control which is on management for the staffing problems. I seriously hope management adds additional staff or puts new processes in place as I truly would like to continue to enjoy the waitresses with the best service.

This is a small (I think) independent pet store. Not super huge in size, but decent enough to hold a lot of products. 

We've been coming here for years for cat food. Good selection of quality brands. Their cat food products promote "no corn, no byproducts". Fantastic, since corn is not good for a cats tummy. There's also a weight management line we love that is sold here. 

Lots of toys for the companion. Chew bones and balls for dogs. Sleeping pads. Squeaky toys. Tiny mice with a bell in them. String on a stick. Several styles/sizes of scratching posts for the cats. 

Decent prices. The store also offers a loyalty program for repeaters. The staff are great. Knowledgeable about the products. Great at suggesting alternatives. Friendly attitudes. 

This store is a great alternative to buy pet products at a big box-chain store!

The atmosphere, the owners, the staff and especially the food are all a delight. Daisy's is a hidden gem, unlike any other bistro style cafe I have ever been to! It is so fun bringing friends and family here for the first time to discover this special place. You are made to feel like home and you can feel the love that is put into their food and customer service. 

I love how their lunch specials change everyday and especially their daily soup and salad features in the summer. Daisy's has become our go-to stop on North Shore bike rides. The fair price and friendly staff make it hard to go anywhere else :)

Everyone is very nice, cherry and knowledgeable! 

This was my first meal after landing in austin. It helped that it was a stones throw away from my hotel :)

I'd call this upscale southern comfort food. And it's damn good!

I ordered my first ever moonshine here! My server kelly recommended I try to Catdaddy since I didn't want something too sweet or something string that is best as a shot -- after all, this was lunch. Have to pace my drinking ;-) the Catdaddy looked like a small glass of water. .. but it was not! So good! Great recommendation Kelly!

Since I was dining alone, I only ordered one dish. Another first -- my first ever chicken and waffles! I know this is sad, why has it taken me so long?! I don't know. The chicken is oh so delicious, even a hint of spice baked in. 

I wanted to try the fried pickles (special] and the corn dog shrimp but I knew I couldn't eat them all by myself and I hate throwing food away. Just means I'll have to come back here!

Environment is chill. I was here around 3pm during ACL weekend 2. Music in the background. Not loud at all. 

Ps. Kelly is awesome! So energetic, let me ask her all my tourist menu questions and didn't rush me. And kept checking in (but not in the annoying way!) On top of it all, she gave me a complimentary dessert on the house since I was in town to celebrate my birthday!

Reese Cote, Reese Cote, Reese Cote! I just got my 2nd tattoo here. I was a walk-in and they were able to accommodate me immediately. I had an idea of a very simple tattoo and they (Reese Cote) immediately got to work. We collaborated and worked through the design together. It took some time, but Reese was so patient and kept telling me that it's an important process to go through. I never felt pressured. It was all up to me. Tattoo was quick. Just the very best experience. Since this was all sort of unplanned, I feel like I really lucked out with the artist I ended up with (REESE COTE). thanks so much you guys!!!!

This was my first time hiring movers, and it was FANTASTIC! I felt like they really cared about me personally and my move. Jay called after I requested a quote to get some more details about my move and my needs, which was so much nicer than the automated response I got from other places. On the day of the move (today) Charlie and Ian showed up right on time and were efficient, courteous, and friendly. They did an amazing and speedy job and I did not have to worry at all. I HIGHLY recommend these movers!

Privately owned by 3 very & kind Vets.  Provides kennel/overnight care.  In UCF Waterford Lakes area.  3 are great Vets but there's one heavy set lady Vet who's a whacko and works weekends...had the worst experience ever with her and one of the other Vets came in and dismissed her.   We moved right afterward or I would have told them NEVER assign her as our pet Doctor ever again - she's a nightmare a shame as the other 3Vets we've seen are awesome.

Definitely 5 stars! I love this massage place. I'll say it's the best one I ever been to in Atlanta. 
It just happened i had a whole weekend driving around. My neck and back were so sore. And i saw this massage place.  I got a one hour deep tissue. 
I have to say my masseur is GREAT! (#7 just for your curiosity) He explained why certain parts on my back I felt a little bit painful when he pressed. (It's call good pain) the experience is amazing. 
The room is not big but so clean. I have been to some other places, some of them have wired smell but not here. The waiting area is clean and bright. 
Overall I love this place and I will definitely go back. 
25% discount is a huge plus. And I already got the gift card for my boyfriend. 
Price is reasonable, service is great, environment is super.

Wow. Wow. Wow. This place is amazing.  When I first stepped in the doors I was completely overwhelmed by the nice southern however hip atmosphere I experienced. The check in via yelp was a great help as well since the restaurant was very busy. When we were seated we were help by Ruby who was very informative to all our questions and helped us craft the right meal and boy was it right! Everything was amazing! From the grits and the peach cobbler French toast. Omg! Sad this place isn't closer to me in Florida! What an excellent eat!

I had brunch at Hanks this morning, it was my first visit but I've been wanting to check this place out forever. 
We had a group of 8. Service was prompt and friendly, coffee refills came often. 
I got the pastrami hash, it wasn't lIke any  hash ive had before but it was very good. It did come with Brussels sprouts which I dIdnt expect and I don't eat but whatever. 
I sampled the lemon pancakes and they were amazing. 
Dining area was bright and not too loud. 
I was going to get a pastry to go on the way out but the case was empty. 
This place is near my home and I intend to come more often.

Edit to say I stopped by the cafe today and had mint ice coffee and a big old chocolate chip cookie with sea salt on top that was amazing. Lot's of indoor and outdoor seating.

Bella is the Bell of the town!

Since moving to the area, a couple weeks ago, I have quickly become a regular at Bella.  They are tucked away in a cute plaza off Butner Rd, in the Camp Creek area.  It is a quaint space with nice ambiance and some really good customer service.  You can tell they value their customers patronage and that is something makes me a repeat consumer.

Dishes that have become my go to's are their Lobster Tails that I couple with the Kale & Smoked Turkey.  The Lobster Tails can be ordered two ways steamed/sautéed  or fried.  I get mine steamed/sautéed because you can really get the full experience of the Lobster that way.  The Kale is so tender and cooked to perfection.  They aren't bitter and can really be eaten on its own it's that good.  I can only imagine how they taste coupled with their Sweet Potato Corn Muffin...mmmmm.  

For breakfast I definitely recommend their French Toast, Bacon, and Creamy Grits.  The French Toast aren't too eggy and not too dry there are just right.  They only give you one slice but for me that's all I need when I marry it with the bacon and grits.  The grits are so creamy and flavorful.  It's so rare that I don't have to add salt and pepper.  The chef properly seasons the grits and adds just the right amount of cream and cheese to them where it's a happy marriage of all the ingredients. 

Overall, I recommend this spot for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.  Oh, and they have some of the BEST mixologists in town so if you wanna wind down your day with a delicious craft cocktail then this is the spot for you! 

I'm just realizing I only have pics of the breakfast but I know I will be back soon so I will add them later.

I was sad when I heard Aprisa had closed down at this location, but Pica Pica fills the void without skipping a beat. Their menu is very similar to Aprisa's menu, but with more options for meat. 

The burritos are huge, with fresh veggies and the Asada has been cooked perfect every time I've gotten it. I'm not too crazy about their carnitas, as they're a bit on the dry and bland side. However, the steak and chicken burritos I've gotten have been absolutely delicious. They make for great fuel before I go sweat my soul away playing drums for 3 hours. 

Additionally, the staff provide great service and have been super friendly every time I've been there. There isn't a salsa bar, but they will provide some for you if you ask them.

I love this place! The food is creative, carefully prepared, and plated beautifully. I often come here with my 3 yr old daughter for Papa/daughter time and the place is *just* loud enough to allow her to feel at home.

The eggs are cooked well and taste amazing. The pancakes are HUGE and dense with a cakey inside and crunchy outside. The potatoes remind me of thanksgiving! My buddy who is a hash lover said his helping was good stuff.

The service is excellent. The waitresses are attentive and work hard to make you feel welcome. They are always eager to help. You walk in and immediately feel like your presence matters.

I might have given 4.5 but yelp doesn't allow that. Space is my only issue. While I like the quaint size of this place, it does feel cramped at times and I have had to wait outside once or twice. I wouldn't change this about the place but it is a slight negative. Again, this is a 4.5 negative, not a 4.

We need more places like this that clearly work hard to craft creative dishes that taste amazing, are prepared with care, and are served with a welcoming smile.

Love this place!

We went to Fuller's on a random choice on a Saturday morning, the worst time to go to a popular place in Portland. We walked up expecting the normal long wait. Also looking at the small space I was thinking it was for sure going to be a really long wait. The hostess said 10-12 mins and really we only waited about 3 mins. We were seated at the cute diner seat at the end, getting to look at the diner kitchen and all the delicious looking food coming out. One server got us coffee right away, while another took our order about 10 mins later. Food came out shortly after and was just as tasty as it looked. We split an omelette special and a side of bacon.

True diner feel and food was great. Would definitely come back again.

About 2 weeks ago I got a nail in my front driver side tire. Brough my car in here to get it patched, in total it cost me $32 (tire patch + new pressure monitoring system). I was in and out, without an appointment, in 40 minutes: pretty quick honestly. My service was good and efficient, for this alone I would of given this place 4 starts. 

BUT, today I got ANOTHER nail in the same tire. I brought it back in to get patched and the guys remembered me. They said they understood how annoying it must be to be coming in again for the same issue (even though it was totally my fault for driving in messy roads), and offered to patch it up free of charge. This really blew me away as they did not have to do that, but they cared. Thank you! Wish I could give more stars.

My family and I were invited to attend the "soft opening" a few days prior to their official opening on July 21st. Wow! Great food! The signature sandwiches are fantastic! Fresh ingredients, and absolutely delicious. The Spring Rolls are fresh and tasty and could be a meal in themselves. A real treat was the Vietnamese coffee at the end of the meal. The staff, though extremely busy, were very friendly and efficient. I wish Dave and his partners every success for this wonderful little eatery.

I loved this place. As it should be, the focus is clearly on top-notch burgers.

 The toppings interesting and varied, the onion rings were perhaps the best I've ever had. I got a cheeseburger with the roast bone marrow, blue cheese, sauce and onion rings and left fat and happy after spending a reasonable amount of cash. The selection of beers is good and reasonably priced as well. Who can resist a beer called Pork Slap?

It's verrry casual, ordering almost cafeteria-style which is fine with me but takes some getting used to if you normally go to restaurants with conventional sit-down waiter service. We went during the off-hours and there was no wait whatsoever; the food came out quickly.

Undoubtedly my favorite bar in East Austin -- and probably maybe my favorite cocktail bar in all of Austin. You may not ever know that Whisler's exists if you're just driving by. It does. And you should find it. 

The building itself is 100 years old and shows so many original features. This adds some nice oomph when you're sitting at their awesome bar, sipping on one of their top-notch cocktail creations (which can compete with the fanciest, must more pretentious bars on the other side of I-35). 

Want to save some scrilla? Come to happy hour - a selection of their finest concoctions for $6 (4-7pm). Think the kind of daiquiri that Hemingway would've given five Yelp stars. Want to impress a date?  Come here after dinner and have the bartenders--exquisite in their craft--mix something special for you. 

Hungry for the best thai food in Austin? Well you've stuck gold, because East Side King's Tai Kun sits in their parking lot.

My search for auto insurance stopped here! Mass has a new rule where most places need to quote you about the same but what sold me on this place was the service. I spoke to Jason who was fantastic. I had been thinking of buying a new car and had been registered in RI previously so wasn't too familiar with the differences. Jason was able to scan a bunch of different carriers like Arbella and Travellers and give me the best price. He also helped me with the level of coverages that were right for me and the car. When it finally came down to me getting the car and going in there for the paper work he did everything so professionally and honestly. They do DMV runs for you too!

I rarely give anything 5 stars but I feel, in this case, it's a must.  A cold and rainy October afternoon seemed the perfect time to try the pommes frites at Sideshow.  They're perfect, crunchy and crispy on the outside, just right for dipping in the best mayonnaise I've ever had.  I now love and hate this place in equal measure, love it because of the pomme frites perfection , and hate it because it's right on my way home, providing temptation on those nights I don't really feel like cooking.  My only critique is that one sauce with the small isn't enough.  I ran out before I'd finished all the frites.

My partner and I came to Rosa Rosa for breakfast on Christmas Day, expecting it to be crazy busy. We had made a reservation the night before in preparation. Surprisingly, there weren't too many people. We were the second pairing to arrive and we got free choice of the tables.

The atmosphere in Rosa Rosa is elegant and refined, but there's no pressure put onto the guests to look a certain way. The servers bring you a pitcher of water (which is the best at a restaurant) and every person working there is very friendly. We got the brunch menus, which do change semi-regularly (we found this out once we arrived since we saw different items on the menu in a yelp photo). Many items on the menu looked delicious, but my partner and I decided on the eggs benedict and spaghetti pomodoro. Both were brought out fairly quickly and had perfect portion sizes. We shared each other's plates since we both wanted to try each dish. The eggs benedict was cooked to perfection, the bread underneath being just crisp enough to not become soggy from the hollandaise. The pomodoro was very well seasoned and the noodles were perfectly al dente (as you would expect from a partly Italian restaurant). I loved the pomodoro, but I was jealous that my partner got most of the eggs benedict. It was very addicting!

I highly recommend Rosa Rosa to anyone looking for a delicious brunch experience. Maybe come early, though, as street parking around there is terrible.

I had a random craving for Pad Thai today and this place was just a few blocks away. We ordered the crab rangoons, pad thai, praram rong song, and yellow curry so the boyfriend and I could try different dishes and have leftovers. The takeout was ready on time and the service was friendly. 

The food was all delicious! I am not normally a fan of curry because I dislike spicy foods but this curry was flavorful and good, with just enough spice that I had to keep a drink nearby but not so much that I didn't want to keep eating. The Pad Thai was pretty standard but tasty as well. The praram rong song was extremely tasty and neither too spicy or too sugary as peanut sauces can tend to be. And I loved the crab rangoons! They are about 150% better than the ones at Happy Panda. The servings are generous too. We ate huge platefuls of food and still have enough for 2 days of lunches.

EVERYONE LISTEN UP! This is the only place I will do my printing services from now on. The services are immaculate and the final product is spectacular! I was recommended to use Miller by a co-worker and I feel the need to spread the word. I had a very quick turn around printing project and Miller came to my rescue. If you can specify, work with Ryan Bruce. He is a Rockstar! He followed up with me every step of the way, and was so adapting and patient with my last minute changes. Boss, give Ryan a raise! Thank you Miller and special thanks you to Ryan.

Wonderful service and fantastic communication. I found this service through a Disney forum and I'm so glad I did. From first communication through delivery we couldn't have asked for a better experience. I can't recommend them enough. Such personal service, and attention to detail. Paying through PayPal was so convenient. The extra touch of a thank you bag with little first aid kit, hand sanitizer, etc was so unexpected and was above and beyond. You absolutely can't go wrong with Dizzy Dolphin Delivery!

I would drive from Gainesville or Fort Lauderdale to go to this salon. Kristen works wonders with curly/wavy hair. I got the best haircuts ever from her. I'm sad I've relocated to New York because now Orlando is just a smidge too far away to go for a haircut. Shame because, again, great cuts and at a low cost, too. The salon itself has a great atmosphere, and everyone there is really nice. It looks like the kind of place that could be pretentious, but it's really not at all. I love Alchemy.

I can confidently give them 5 stars! There front desk team is so caring, comforting and informative! The doctors are so amazing and go above and beyond! 

My puppy was so sick today and they made us feel like a priority, they worked so hard to sort out what was wrong with him. I know because they squeezed him in because he was so sick, Dr Jill ran behind and I felt terrible. But at no point did she seem rushed or non attentive to us. She was so sweet and really reassured me he would be okay! I'm so glad that I have such an a amazing clinic to go to with our dogs. I feel extremely confident they will have the best care. 

The clinic is amazing from start to finish! The front staff is so sweet and caring, the doctors work so hard and really love what they do! 

Thank you for making today easier on us!

I commute past Giulia twice a day and watched with excitement before it opened last winter. I finally went last summer to celebrate my birthday and have been back three other times since--most recently to celebrate my birthday this year and sit at the pasta table.

I've never been the slightest disappointed with anything here. The food is all so fresh and delicious--not the extremely heavy Italian food you might have in mind. Ingredients are all as fresh as can be and the pasta is cooked to perfection. As with others, I highly recommend the parpadelle dish and we had the most incredible sweet corn ravioli when we booked the pasta table. Their desserts are amazing--the chocolate terrine is probably my favorite dessert I've ever had (it hits the salty/sweet notes perfectly). Portions are perfect--not so much that you want to die from being so full after but plenty to leave you sated.

The pasta table is also wonderful for a special occasion--we were a group of 12 (although I think you could definitely fit 14 if you were willing to be a bit tighter around the sides). Everything was served family style, which worked well for picky eaters (to avoid things they didn't like). There was an appetizer course with a big variety, then a mix of antipasti, two rounds of pastas (with two pastas in each round), a wonderful lentil, rabbit, and sausage main, and a variety of fabulous desserts. We did a wine pairing which was nice and the sommelier did a great job of explaining interesting things about each of the wines. It's not cheap but it's a once in a lifetime experience. The chef/owner came out twice to chat with us, which was really nice. We couldn't believe when we left that we'd been there for four hours! It was such a fun evening. They are also great about accomodating allergies.

The decor is both casual and relaxed but still thoughtful and charming. I love coming here and look forward to coming back many more times (perhaps even just for dessert at the bar).

Listen, I am all about a bar with an extensive and not "typical" selection of spirits. Located inside Ponce City market is Biltong bar...you first will be drawn in by the variety of beef jerky (that you can sample before you buy) on display...delicious. We tried the Wagyu jerky with the Peri-Peri spice and it was delicious and paired well with the Rusty Nail I ordered. The bartenders were attentive and very knowledgeable of the menu and classic cocktails. I was definitely impressed.

We were looking for some place for breakfast. 
It was most popular place on yelp. 
We didn't want to try because we thought there gonna be huge waiting or something. 
But we decided to wait. 

And then what! There wasn't A withing time! 
How lucky. 

Start with foods. 
It was amazing. Omlet with caramelized onion. Biscuit and gravy.. Yumm
Pancakes were perfect texture and flavor. 

Atmosphere is also great. But we felt kinda crammed. And it was pretty hot. 

I think they put too much people. 

Other than that it was great experience.

If you are there and Eric is working then you are in for a treat. I've lived in Atlanta for a while and use the airport regularly, and this is by far the best bar tender in the airport I've come across. Most bartenders just take your order but you can count on Eric to remember your name, remember your drink, and serve you with gumption and killer service. Also the burgers are delicious; grind house is a local Atlanta favorite and with good reason!

Cameron is absolutely the best and I have had plenty of massage. She has years of experience. She can really do the work you need and you feel like a million dollars when she is done, no kidding. You will receive a treatment meant for you, because she really listens to you and how you are feeling. When I am unable to see my clients I send them to Cameron and everyone has really liked her work. She also is well trained in Zero Balancing and I throughly enjoyed those sessions and felt more centered in my being.

Stunning!!!! Absolutely stunning place!! The interior Decorator for this place can have my first born child! Absolutely impeccable!

We went for brunch and smartly got reservations.. highly recommend getting reservations, it was almost a 2 hour wait without one. 

We waited for our table with cocktail at the bar. All handcrafted with fresh ingredients and beautifully presented. Smooth going down and makes you feel real bougie. 

We we're lucky to get a pretty table by the window, and sipped our fancy cocktails. The Brunch was fantastic, beautiful presented, French inspired cuisine from fluffy egg dishes, beautiful fresh baked pastries and breads. 

Perfect location for a special occasion, girls day out or romantic dinner. Love it!

Best place on the North Shore if you like sports and music. Regular townie lunch/after work -place (burgers/wraps and such). Different dinner/night time crowds depending on night of week, sometimes, trivia, sometimes karaoke. Live music Thu, Fri Sat (Careful, that's why the kitchen closes at 9 these nights). Best Friday after work crowd in town w/ Tobin and Leahy playing Celtic music from 5 to 8 PM. Owner Peter Kelly runs a top notch place (and does tons for local charity, most don't know this). Friday transforms into quite the nite spot at 10 pm + when they run the old fogies out for the band scene. Lots of great local music talent, definitely worth a night out.   Oh yea, and always a perfectly poured pint!!

My favorite thing about Food In Bloom Catering is that they are associated with a great venue space as well...Montgomery Park in NW Portland. The venue location in and of itself was amazing! Great natural light and plenty of space to move around. We had a large number of compliments on how fantastic the venue was -- modern and sophisticated look and feel. The architecture makes for fun photos too! Even from the beginning of our planning with Food in Bloom it was like we were the only clients they were working with. They gave us a dedicated event coordinator (Erin Hight) that met with us as often as we needed. She was AMAZING. Had a ton of great ideas and thoughts on how to make our wedding unique and fun. She was VERY detailed orientated and made sure that we got exactly what we wanted. The catering aspect was amazing as well. The food options were abundant but easy to narrow down in relation to our preferences. We did tastings before final decisions and were cautious of how the food would actually taste at the buffet on the wedding night. Shouldn't have even worried...the food was exactly the same even in the large quantity. Every single food item that we ordered had an awesome taste and looked very upscale. The meat (steak and pork) was cooked perfectly! All guests were talking even couple weeks later about the food. Food in Bloom also made it very easy to get the right event rentals - tables, dinnerware, linens, etc. Reasonable price and something we didnt have to worry about. Food in Bloom is very professional; what you receive in service, product, food, etc. far outweighs the amount paid. It was a pleasure to work with Erin and Food in Bloom -- I didn't need to worry about anything!

This place was great. Visited with my parents (my father may still be chatting up the waitress), and I ordered a provolone and hot Italian sausage omlette which was very good and almost excellent. The waitress asked if Id like to try a special hot sauce reserved for people, I think, they didn't particularly care for.  It was made from Scotch Bonnets, Brazilian Rum and "you know, other hot things.', the owner told me. It burned my teeth. My daughter had 8 slices of French toast with strawberries and my father had a 'the best BLT he's ever had.'  My Dad hugged the waitress when we left and I got a discounted bottle of toothburn when they saw I left a 35% tip. The coffee was really good too. The owner told me to put the sauce on everything but definitely not ice cream which I figured was pretty good advice.

I stop by this Sweet Tomatoes every time I am in the Orlando/Kissimmee area! Most of the times I have come here they have been very good!  Being in a tourist-filled location, they handle overwhelming crowds efficiently. The food is consistently good and refilled frequently. The staff are very friendly and quick to clean the tables. If you are like me and want a less crowded time to go, I suggest going during lunch or before the dinner rush that starts around 6:30pm and goes until the restaurant closes. Overall it's a good location, but if you cannot handle large crowds you may want to go to another location.

On the pure cain sugar fountain drinks alone this place gets 5 stars!! So I went in because it said dublin dr. Pepper sold here, I love a great soda w/ my meal......and to my suprise...it was on the fountain as well as my other all time favorite soda Big Red. I had never had Big Red like this and hands down is absolutely f#@$%ng delicious!

The decor is surfing wich I like I just wish they would have had some surf videos playing or at least fuel t.v.......just a suggestion.

The burritos which is what I ordered for my first time was pretty damn good I chose the homade flour which they pressed and cooked while I waited..a.plus nothing worse than old or stale tortillas. I chose the carnitas or pulled pork...could have been better seasoned...or maybe that's just me...the salsas delicious the xxx chipoltle hot sauce exxxcelent....I would have chosen rice but it comes w/ cilantro already in it..not a big fan of the cilantro but two friends w/ me loved it it also has jicama in it....very interesting...three kinds of beans pinto, black and I believe baja. Overall great first experience will definetly go back even just to stop in for a great fountain drink...maybe y'all could start carrying Blue Bell homemade vanilla to do floats w/ the Big Red, Dublin Dr. Pepper and Rootbeer...just another suggestion.

See ya soon!

Wow. While not strictly Napoletana pizza, it's a really great iteration of wood fired pie.  I was impressed by the owner's dedication to the ingredients and the craft.

I had the Bolognese pizza.....not for the faint of heart as the chef is heavy handed with nutmeg......but this was a wonderfully welcome expansion of a classic Bolognese sauce.

(BTW, I'd only recommend eating pizza *here*.....otherwise anticipate a soggy pizza)

The wine offerings were solid and my pizza paired beautifully with a Willamette pinot noir.

For what puts this place to five stars.....the ice cream.  Really.  I tried three: bay leaf; farro; potato. The bay leaf ice cream was beautifully balanced with prominent notes of pine and a sweetish-lime flavor. The farro tasted of toasted cereal and cream.....perfect on a chilly day. The potato was subtle....you had to wait for a very soft potato/starch flavor....the texture was just a nick off as it wasn't as creamy as I would anticipate, but really nice nonetheless. 

I'm glad the hotel recommended Nonavos....I'll definitely be back whenever I'm in Vancouver.

I had the pleasure of working with Jess while searching for and ultimately buying a new home. I can't say enough wonderful things about working with her. As a first-time home buyer in Portland, Jess skillfully and patiently guided me through the process and took care of all the details, which made everything so easy. Having taken the time to understand what I was looking for, it was Jess who saw my new home online and sent me an email that said, "this is it." And it was 100% true. Jess found my dream house, and I couldn't be happier. In addition, when all was said and done, and the paperwork signed and filed away, Jess continued to help me by connecting me with the right services around town. She continues to follow-up to make sure everything is great and always makes herself available for questions. I highly recommend working with Jess!

This is a really good dentist place they have a really nice and attentive staff which really help out and the place is really clean. Every time they I go for my appointment they help out and seem happy to help and help my teeth out a hole lot. The staff speaks both English and Spanish and that is good because in this area there are a lot of Spanish speaking people. I hope more people come to this dentist because it is a really go one.nice

I have taken my dogs here for over 17 years and they have always done a great job of keeping my dogs healthy.   My Jack Russell who was 16.5 years old contracted  cancer in her leg .  Dr Kennedy and Dr Butcher treated and gave my dog the best of care and checked on her weekly.  But sadly she passed painlessly with the help of Dr Butcher.  A few days later I received a sympathy card signed by Dr Butcher and Dr Kennedy .  Enclosed inside the card was a Norse poem for your pet .  The doctors here have great bedside manners while your dog is heathy , sick , or at the end .  When I find another JR I will definitely take it to Arbor for care.

Aw, I loved this place. I thought it was very quaint and authentic. The women servers were very sweet and interested when I told them I had just gotten back from Japan (a few days post earthquake/tsunami). 

I had the tonkotsu ramen, extra green onions (the only way to order it). In my opinion, it's the best tasting in Atlanta. Better than Yakitori Jinbei in Smyrna. 

The sushi was good too. I forget what was ordered, probably a mix of nigiri pieces. Toro, salmon, maybe a scallop.

As I now say with all places that serve decent tonkotsu ramen, I'd kill for something like this in Texas.

I am a sucker for fresh meats and seeing them right in front of me, well done Little Greek well done. The store is usually pretty quick, but sometimes there is a wait. A lot of healthy choices which is why this place is one of my favorites. There is just not enough resturants with salads that don't feel like a rip off. The meat is also seasoned well, not over seasoned nor under.

I just wish this place gave itself more credit. One day maybe it will be the Big Greek :)

Oh, the Roxy ... looks like a dump from the outside but it's one of the best bars anywhere.

I started going here years ago when I visited Vancouver and it's always fun.  

The first thing we think of for the Roxy is the band.  I've seen the same band most nights -- thin male bassist, shaved head guitarist and short brunette lead singer.  They sing EVERYTHING and it sounds amazing.  Two of my favorite covers they did were U2's One and The Outfield's Your Love.  I still remember that and they're a cover band.  They are so talented.  One of my coworkers said they'd make a great wedding band ... but then nobody would leave your wedding because they'd want to hear the next song.

There are two bars so it's convenient.  The crowd is mixed from 20s to 40s at least.  We've seen the Canucks' opponent here after a game and the girls flock to them.

If I had one issue, it's the music is always super loud.  I try to stay in the back because I'm concerned about my hearing but it tends to be loud.  No one wears ear plugs because it's not cool but I couldn't go here every night or once a week if I lived in Vancouver because of the noise level.

Thank God for booking.com and introducing me to the Intown suites! I am here in town helping out with the hurricane rehabilitation and needed a place to stay... Everything was taken because originally they were going to be shelters all over the place... The only room I could find in town which was the last one was at the Intown suites... After coming in and meeting the Front desk representative Susie, I was put to ease and have loved every second since.

It is a very good value for the price and the service from the staff is exemplary. Kris, Joe and Susie along with Jaime have been amazing!

I am definitely coming back again I'm going to be bragging to everyone about what an amazing value and wonderful location this is.

Thank you again Susie for all your Austin Style Aloha! You bring this property up a couple starts

Mmmm!!! Delicious food , great atmosphere and friendly service! My husband and I are regulars in Vancouver from Grande Prairie, AB  and we were in the mood for some Greek food and came across this place and sooo glad we did!

We both ordered the Country Lamb which came with potatoes, lamb shoulder, rice and vegetables and it was to die for. Everything was packed with so much flavour!

Make sure you go there on an empty stomach because that is a lot of food and well worth every penny. So delicious we will definitely visit again when we are in Vancouver next, which im sure won't  be long!

This is one great place, I loved every minute of it. The ingredients I found very fresh, the service was great, and you can't beat the cost. The hardest part of it all is figuring what you want to add what you don't want and the broth of your soup lol. I would highly suggest this as a date idea. Especially if you're like me and a fellow foodie. It's a lot of fun too. The servers go out of their way to help you and show you how to make it the best experience. They will even make you a sauce that they like. They have some amazing hours too so come early, come late just go! I would like to try more of their dishes besides just the hot pot but it's just so good I always get it!

We stayed at a B&B down the street from here and I had to make  2 visits here. The chicken and waffles are nothing like I've had before! Chicken was very flavorful and moist and waffle were a different flavor but very good. The 1st day we sat at the bar and the waitress who I did not get her name was very polite and friendly she gave me and my wife a complimentary homeade shake which was delicious. I do recommend this place whether breakfast or late noght. Breakfast served all day

What's great is that you can revisit - for the same price - as many times as you want on the day of your ticket - midday, sunset, dark, etc.  You can also stay as long as you want. The lift ride up is cool in and of itself. It's an external glass lift. A the top, while it's not competing for the highest observation deck in the world, it's a great view for Vancouver and is as high as it needs to be. I really enjoyed the view, reading the signs all around the platform describing what is below, and listening to the guides leading tour groups. The place was clean, not too crowded, and the windows were clean and slanted outwards making for great pictures! 


If you are using the Vancouver Trolley Company there is a $2 coupon available from the VTC.

Went here for a quick drink and some appetizers, our server Juliana was amazing. As a server myself, I pay attention to the small details and she missed absolutely nothing, even managed to make me feel as though I could do more myself when working! She made sure to check on us throughout, without being too on top of us. Made sure to take empty glasses and plates from the table and leave us comfortable to talk and drink without having a mess all around us, she's a great server who I would definitely recommend to ask for if you come here!

Outstanding service that goes above and beyond. The owner not only squeezed me in for a same day appointment, but walked me through the process for repairing a chip on my windshield made by a flying pebble while driving. He was more than fair, but most importantly he was genuine, honest, and generous. The business has a loyal customer in me because such qualities are hard to find these days. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND working with Avenue Auto Glass. I'd give more stars if I could.

This is a wonderful place for a nice casual dinner with friends.  It's beautiful setting - surrounded by mature trees that border a small, modern strip mall.  But, it's nicely laid out so that it blends in well with the surrounding area.  It's a handsome, one-story brick building.  There is a nice outdoor patio in the front and upon entry, the casual but relatively dark interior indicates that you are in a very classy place.  The bar is lively but still very classy and the dining room is also a gorgeous place with superb ambiance.  We were really impressed by all the staff - all were enthusiastic about their food and drinks and were so very friendly and helpful.  We were especially impressed by the manager on duty, Janna and our server, Andrew.  It was very obvious that Andrew knew their food, menu, ingredients and preparation methods.

We were here once before as part of a larger party and we were very pleased with that visit.  So on our next trip to the Portland area, we wanted to come back on our own.  So, that's what we did and we were rewarded for our efforts.  It was weekday night about 8 PM so it wasn't terribly busy.  The benefit for us was that we were able to visit with the staff and learn all about the menu offerings.  Andrew was very helpful and in the end, we both had fish entrees.  During our relaxed start, my wife ordered an Old Fashioned cocktail.  Not many places make a good one but she really liked this one.  That was a great start!

I started with a cup of Turkey Curry Cream Soup, recommended by Andrew.  While it sounded kinda odd, it was delicious!  I ordered the Parmesan Encrusted Snapper.  She had the Grilled Steelhead.  My Snapper was perfectly done and it was good portion of fish.  It was fresh and real bargain at only $17.99.  My wife was also impressed with her Steelhead.  It was just $22.99.  We finished by sharing a Berry Cobbler with Vanilla Ice Cream.  It was truly a superb dinner and it was a flawless  performance by Oswego Grill.

We highly recommend this, unequivocally and for anyone and everyone!

Jim

We really enjoyed this place and I'm glad we finally got the chance to try it now that we're Longwood residents. I've had it bookmarked for months but hubs had the day off so we went on my lunch break today. I love what they've done with the interior (I used to come to this location when it was a Greek place). It's small but they put in quite a bit of seating and a table outside. Service was super friendly. We were each given the bacon jalapeño hush puppy to sample and YUM. I'd be back for those alone, and I'm a hush puppy snob. Hubs has the cuban with lattice chips and he really enjoyed it. I did the beer braised brisket and I am a fan! The meat was tender, the bread was crispy, and the sandwich had a nice kick from the pickled jalapeños and pepper jack cheese. Next time I'd ask them to leave off the arugula (I hate warm lettuce, not their fault, just a personal preference) and ask for more of the cilantro sour cream on it. I'd definitely order it again. I got fries instead of chips with mine for a small upcharge and they were seasoned and cooked well. We will absolutely be back and I'm excited to try their other offerings.

I can't say enough great things about my experience here during Portland Burger Week. This was stop 3. A coworker and I came and were a little overwhelmed by the line, but it kept moving and we were eventually second in line behind a big group that took at least five minutes to order; after standing in line for 15 minutes, they still waited to get to the register before deciding what they wanted. The group was pretty difficult, going over every side and drink and the pricing, and then they didn't tip. The poor cashier handled it like a champ and kept a smile on her face the whole time, while a few other employees started taking orders down the line to make sure everyone felt taken care of. Finally we were able to order and grab a table, and our burgers came out in less than 5 minutes. They were such good burgers. The fries and tots were perfect for a burger joint. When we got up and started clearing out table, an employee jumped in to bus it for us. All in all a 5 Star experience. Will be back for sure! Pricing was great too- a side of fries was only an additional $2.

We traveled a long way from Oregon to find this wonderful experience of an Italian restaurant. Surely, this must be Italy. 
All our entrees, (6 of us) met all expectations after we got a chance to watch the chefs while waiting for our table out in the garden. Squid Ink seafood pasta...just like the photo. Salads fresh from their garden. The Bad Dog bread...met my definition of great "chewy bread". The staff wore us out with their hard work..they'll need tomorrow  off to rest up. 
We'd go here again and again to exhaust the menu...

Hands down the best Chinese food in the Billerica area, and the only one that serves combination style plates. You can get delivery through doordash, but half the fun is picking it up. The owner is a super nice guy and makes you want to go back, people like to do business with people they like and he definitely gets that.

I've never had anything messed up in my takeout/delivery orders and the food is always great. Every time I need to grab something at O'Connor's I call an order in and grab it on the way home, never had a bad experience.

So, check this out: I'm not Vegan.  Nowhere near. As a matter of fact, I'm probably the farthest thing from it. So... why am i here? My wife is flirting with the idea of becoming fully Vegan, and our foray into Portland quickly became a tour of the Vegan underbelly with yours truly being pulled along for the ride. This was our first stop, and she dragged me here kicking and screaming. I walked out of this place full, satisfied, and not craving a cheeseburger in the least bit. Seriously. 

The food here is fantastic. We had the Mac n' cheese, the pierogis, the bibimbap, and the wife had the cheesecake for dessert. The Mac was creamy and rich, the pierogis were toothsome and reminiscent of a potsticker, and the bibimbap was by far my wife's favorite (not Dolsot, mind you, but still quite delicious). My wife tells me that the chocolate swirled cheesecake was clean, smooth, and sophisticated (her word).

My best Vegan food experience prior to this place was The Ravens restaurant in Mendocino, which is nowhere near as tasty and seriously twice (or in some cases, three times) the price. If Vegan food this good was consistently available at more places across the country, I might consider making the switch. MIGHT. All kidding aside, though, I was seriously impressed with this place and would be fully docile and cooperative if my wife wanted to take me here again next time we're in Portland. Peep it.

It's tough to find a great dentist and I'm SO STOKED to have landed with these guys. Dr. Jason is awesome and used to be a whitewater paddler which immediately endeared me to him. Despite my paddling bias, the office is beautiful, convenient location; they go all out to make sure you are comforatble with warmed neck pillows and while you are getting extensive work they have large TV screens with big ear phones and any netflix movies you'd like to watch while they drill- I actually laughed through most of my last filling while watching Super Troopers- who does that at the dentist? You will here. They are affordable if you have to pay out of pocket and they also have in-house machines to make crowns and other molding pieces that other places will take more than one visit (and temporaries) to make. They can do all of a crown in one day which is amazing. The staff is really cool and very down to earth and I actually enjoy my visits there. Super bonus for being "green".

I went to Amy based on the other two reviews and since she is so close to my house. I was not disappointed. 

I called Amy and you should note, that the number listed here is her cell phone. So, I wouldn't call her until 9AM. I called at like 7:30 and she was awake (fortunately) but wasn't at the salon and couldn't tell me if she was free. 

Also, her location is a little hard to find, so just remember that the salon faces Foster, so the Firestone is on your right and the salon is on your left. Amy had to stand outside and wave for me to see it. Just another FYI.

The salon itself is fine, but your not going to this salon for its ambience. I found Amy to be very good, straightforward and friendly. I used to do hair, and am very picky...but also, thrifty.

I chopped off a little over a foot, and am very happy with the results. Amy squeezed me in, so it was a bit of a wham-bam cut. But she took time to talk to me about deep conditioning my hair at home and what I should do if I was going to do some at home coloring (which I did...and its fabulous).

Very Very Very pleased!!!"

Ryan Kaufman is 'THE' therapeutic masseuse to go to in the Portland Metro Region. I drive from the Columbia Gorge to Ryan's offices to receive therapeutic massage due to injuries sustained in an auto accident 17 years ago. I go to him for results and that is exactly what I receive, results, positive results. He's amazing! It's so nice to feel human again after one of his massages. His treatments have greatly improved the quality of my life. He's a real-life miracle worker. I highly recommend him.

My boyfriend and I have tried this place twice now. The first time I got the green gringa and a build your own breakfast taco. The green gringa was delicious! Flavor wise very tasty. The second time I did the build your own and got it "loaded" which comes with lettuce, tomatoes, and guac for only 75 cents. My boyfriend has tried the chorizo and the migas tacos. Both delicious! The best part (beside the amazing food) is how cheap this place is. We had two coffees, chips and salsa and four tacos all for $17! They have shaded picnic tables if you want to sit and eat your tacos. If you've been meaning to stop by this place, do it! You will not be disappointed.

Let me start by saying that I am a very regular guest at this location!
I eat here very frequently, normally every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
I'd have to say that today would be the best service ive been served at this store (which is usually great anyhow, aside from most Fridays)
I have just recently ate here today around 2:00pm and enjoyed a beautiful meal with my Husband! (Asian Salad) we ate inside the establishment and the two young people working are always very delightful when serving us.
We always anticipate great service on the weekends, but today has just surpassed our expectations! Expect us there tomorrow!!
Best possible thing I could say about this location is the staff meets all needs with no hesitation.

This is a new favorite for sure! It feels very open and is a great place to work. My favorite drink is the "Shake, Shake" with vanilla; it's their version of an iced latte and simply delicious. I've also had their avocado toast with egg. The avocado toast is served on sourdough bread, which really adds to the flavor profile. I've been to the Ponce location as well, but prefer this location. 

If you need a dairy alternative, they have lots including oat milk!

Note: If you choose to work here, look under the seats lining the edges of the coffee shop for the electricity outlets.

I'm so lucky to live close enough to walk to this wonderful theater.

Usually I avoid movie theaters because I get annoyed by people pretty easily. But the people who frequent this place are generally much more mature than average people. I've never had to deal with people bringing crying babies, or people talking on cell phones, or tall people sitting in front of me. 
I also like independent films, so I enjoy the selection of films that they show.

The bathroom is also very clean!

I came with high expectations based on Le Crocodile's reputation and was not disappointed. From the moment I got out of my car for the valet parking to the moment I left, I received superlative service. Our service person was perfect:  attentive without being intrusive, and a huge help with making our choices from the menu and specials. The menu was extensive, and there were an amazing array of specials. 

The food was amazing. We had pan-seared fois gras, lobster and scallop tempura, and the beet salad for the entree. All were fantastic. I had the yagyu ribeye. It was perfect, and the rack of lamb my companion had was excellent. It was tender and tasty. 

It was a birthday, and I order a chocolate ganache cake for the celebrant. It was rich without being overly sweet. The coffee was strong and wonderful. 

I am definitely coming back to experience the other menu items again and again.

I am from Tennessee, and used to drive a multi-state truck route one day a week; I have been to a few barbecue places. 

I laughed when I saw a pretentionus barbecue place (not redbones) in Cambridge using a jennair! Hilarious.

 I love Redbones. the pulled pork is great, as are the ribs. If your taste runs to catfish just feel free. They do smoke their meats for a long time and the flavor is deep and delicious.  Some find that the long smoking renders too much of the fat out and makes the meat not as tender as they would like.  but not me. Big portions! Great greens, cole slaw, and cornbread.

I have had the pecan pie there at least 10 times and had it somewhat overdone a time or two, but it is not to be missed. If you do not think you are all that hungry split it with someone you love. As good as mine is at home, (and I was a pro baker for over 5 years)

Barleywine in season and great beers and knowledgeable advice from the bar staff. 

YUM!
