She did a great job of monitoring the entire class and making sure everyone's form was perfect without making you feel like you've been called out. (Like they do in Bikram Yoga! Sorry having flashbacks of militant instructors)  A little tilt of the hips or the legs can make all the difference. 

The class itself....I have to put it up there in my top 3 favorite studios.  If I lived in Orlando hands down this would be my #1 choice!!   (I am a Flybarre, Physique 57 fan and now The Bar Method) 

Why I do I like this over Pure which is right down the road? (To be upfront I didn't take the Pure here in Orlando and am basing it off my NYC experiences but I could have gone on Classpass but opted out) I prefer the flow of The Bar Method and the challenging moves.   While I don't really break a sweat during a bar class they got my legs and booty working and had very creative moves. Barre classes have REALLY helped with the inner thighs as my other classes (outside of Barre) work on the larger muscles (think squats, deadlifts, lunges).

If you are thinking of trying out a Barre studio....give this one a try and I am sure you will fall in love with it (all while your legs shake like never before!)  I was able to get in 3 classes during my stay....wish I could have done more!  

I will def be back the next time I am in Orlando!

My family and I are on vacation from northern Florida.  We decided to order from TexMex Express after browsing the menu provided by our hotel, Royale Parc Suites.  A very cheerful lady answered the phone and took my rather large order....not only were ALL the special requests taken care of, the woman and man who delivered my order were incredibly nice!  If I had had any cash on me, I would have tipped even more than what was included on my bill.  Thank you to the staff & friends that helped make this meal the BEST that we've every has here in Orlando...and we come down at least twice a year!  We will definitely order again!!!

Working with Travis and Nina was the best part of our wedding. I generally hate having my picture taken and am definitely not photogenic, with them I felt so calm and at ease and I have never looked so good in a picture in my life! Even when I brought my own props to the bridal shoot, they were open-minded and incorporated then in a sophisticated way. They were very organized, asked all the right questions, and were able to capture every important moment at the wedding. Everything they did was tailored to our needs and wishes. There were absolutely professional and are genuinely good people. They have a very energetic photography style that is vibrant, colorful, and creative. I would recommend them to everyone!

I saw this new service in Portland on a morning news channel. I wanted to purchase an artificial Christmas tree from Costco but had no way to get it home. Not wanting to ask a friend to help me with this I contacted Dolly. I received a quick response from a Helper and easily set up a time to meet at Costco. Once there, they already sold out. I called Andrew G. to see if he could meet me at another Costco farther away. He did and once home he set the tree up for me and made sure the lights worked before leaving. Awesome service!!

Super cool vibe, good beer selection, and a menu that leaves you torn between several delicious dishes. I came here with my wife, sister-in-law and future brother in law, and everybody enjoyed their meals. I had the "Porch TV Dinner" - freshly breaded chicken tenders, Pepperidge Farm adorned Mac and Cheese, corn on the cob, and sweet potato tots (subbed in for mashed potatoes) served on a plastic tray. Oh, and you get a random "dessert treat" (like a Twinkie or a Little Debbie's snack) to top it off. The 3 sauces that were served with the chicken tenders were great, covering the range of sweet to spicy. My wife got the Buffalo Chicken and Waffles, and they looked superb as well. We'll definitely be back!

seriously, put a gas station in and i will probably never move out of south austin.  costco has officially stolen my pizza money from double dave's, papa john's and pizza hut :) i stop there almost once a week at least for the chicken caesar salad for dinner.   i seem to go there so much, i might as well work there.  their bagels do go bad really fast, and i thought i didn't eat them fast enough! their thin crust pizza is TDF. the quality of the shrimp ring has seem to decrease though. but steaks are still good and esp the dungeness crabs and crab legs. costco, i love you. LOL.

I liked the brussels sprouts sandwich (seasonal) so much I'm Yelping and I haven't even finished eating it. Crispy fried/seasoned brussels sprouts, red cabbage slaw (same as used on the chickpea fritter), cheddar cheese, and some herby creamy spread. Mmmmmm. 

Clover is great, cheap, healthy(ish - ignore the word "fried" above), and if you go at non-peak hours (which you should) it is very quick. My regular favorite sandwiches are the Egg & Eggplant and the BBQ Seitan. Rosemary fries are always on point, especially with Sriracha and malt vinegar. Love the breakfast sandwich with soft-boiled egg although I wish the cheese had time to melt instead of being stuffed in cold. 
Pourover coffee is always some schmancy roaster on rotation and generally good (but pricey at $3 for a small cup).

Great selection and food quality, especially for those with dietary restrictions. If you're interested in low carb, high protein, vegetarian, you name it, Dig Inn has an option for you. I'm a huge fan of the market bowl- being able to switch between a carb dense base or greens is a great option. The quality of the market sides is high, I'm a huge fan of the roasted broccoli and the sweet potatoes. Solid options in the meet department as well, the roasted chicken is a staple. Breakfast is excellent as well, plenty of options for bowls or sandwiches. Coffee is also a must, they serve Counter Culture beans. Swing through next time you're in Copley!

My mom has been coming to this place to get her nails done since before I was born (over 19 years), and now I continue the cycle by doing the same. Their staff is always so friendly and well aware on how to treat their customers. Sometimes they are a bit understaffed, but it is well worth the high quality of customer service that I receive. I've been to other nail salons in Vancouver and none of them compare to Q Nails.

I had a fantastic experience working with Allen Morris from start to finish! He dealt with my multiple emails looking for the perfect new car. After a couple of months of misses, I finally landed on one I had to have. Allen made the process so simple and easy. Within just a quick hour and a half I was in and out of the dealership - and that was only because they were slammed that evening. I would HIGHLY recommend the dealership. Ask for Allen. He's still in touch - the customer service has been impeccable.

This place is, for better or worse, superior to what came before it. I've been here a few times and the staff are super friendly and conversational. It's definitely the kind of place you'd want to go to hang out and get to know people from the neighborhood. 

The soundtrack varies from rock ballads to top 40. The sound from the vintage Pioneer speakers is to die for. The atmosphere clearly took a lot of planning; there are couches to sit on; stools, a pool area, and of course the bar itself. 

Not really a whole lot else to say, except that I live in the building and I've had no complaints about the noise levels. They are courteously conscious of their neighbors.

Food was awesome!!! 
We stopped in here for a quick bite on a Tuesday afternoon. I had the mixed green salad with cranberries and goat cheese, boyfriend had the wings and his sister had the onion rings. The bf said they were the best wings hes ever eaten and I wasn't going to argue because they were pretty good! The onion rings were good too and I hate onions! But hey, deep fry anything and its bound to be delicious right? Bar staff was awesome and attentive. If we lived around there it would probably be our go-to bar! Yaggers...COME TO THE STATES!!!!!!!!

Working with Jamie was wonderful! After my boyfriend and I tried looking for places on our own and had a not-so-great experience with another realtor, we gave Jamie a call and are so glad we did! 

Jamie was prompt in her responses and listened to our needs in terms of budget, amenities and other "must haves" when looking for an apartment. She made us feel welcomed to Austin and even gave us greater insights and opinions into the neighborhoods we were looking at. 

We were able to find an apartment the first day Jamie took us out. We're SO excited to make the move from Chicago to Austin and can't wait to move into our beautiful apartment. I definitely recommend Jamie as an apartment locator!

I am so grateful for the Children's Emergency services!  My daughter was sent home from school Friday with a stomach ache and a temperature.  Her fever quickly broke but after 36 hours of continuous vomiting and increasing pain I decided at 4AM Saturday to take her to the  ER.  

My last ER experience on a Saturday night 10 years ago was pretty awful, but that was before this new Pediatric Emergency branch was open.  We didn't even know it was a possibility until we saw the "Children's Emergency" sign on the way through the parking lot.

So this visit took less than 70 minutes start to finish, and all the staff were efficient but kind.   We did not even stop in the waiting room but I did notice age-appropriate programming on the TV and plenty of space there.   

I know that how much time you spend waiting in an ER is dependent on how may other people are there, so we were lucky.  We were immediately taken into the triage room,  and we did not wait after triage to be taken to an examining room.  Minor waits for the doctor, but my daughter could lay down so even if the wait had been longer we would have been okay.  

I will update my review once I get the bill (!) but since no unnecessary testing was ordered I feel confident that the charges will be reasonable.  My daughter came home with a prescription and slept until noon without vomiting once so I'm confident she'll soon be be back on track.  Thanks again to all the staff at St. Davids Children's Emergency on the Saturday 4am shift for their excellent care.

What used to be fabuloso is no longer...

...because it's inside my belly being ultra fabuloso! 

I finally got to stop in and try the El Nutri Taco experience today, and all I can say is... wow. That's a mighty good vegetarian burrito. 

El Nutri offers meat, vegetarian, and vegan Mexican food options, and of course, I had to start with the vegetarian Fabuloso burrito because the name alone sucked me in. It's a mix of all sorts of goodness (onions, button mushrooms, nopales, other veggies, lettuce, rice, sour cream, cheese, beans and soyrizo) wrapped in a whole wheat tortilla. Is it an "authentic" Mex dish? Not any less so than any other burrrito. Was it delicious. Hell fuck yes it was. 

For the staggering price of $8 (yikes!) this expertly seasoned mix of hot and refreshing (crispy iceberg) had me immediately. It was love at first bite. 

You know when you start eating something and the experience of the flavors, the textures, and everything entering your mouth is so intense that your vision narrows as if you're wearing blinders? Your brain fixates solely on what you're putting in your mouth? About half way through my burrito I snapped out of "the zone" to realize that I was just sitting there making audible food-pleasure noises while face-diving into my burrito and blankly staring, unfocused, at the table beyond by prize. I was almost embarrassed for a second until I realized that the only other customer there wasn't paying any attention to me. Heh. 

Yeah, that's how good it was. It was the perfect mix of delicious grilled veg, tasty beans, rice, soyrizo (I think it was a chipotle soyrizo) and some crema. Yum. Let me say that again. Yum. 

While this might not satisfy a strong meat craving, as a burrito and a simply a filling-as-hell meal (I was stuffed at the end), this is an incredible burrito. I wish it wouldn't cost so much, but I know that quality ingredients cost $$, especially veggies. I also kind of wish it wasn't on a whole wheat tortilla. But hey, that aside, it's still a five-star burrito.

Go here!!!!
This place is one that you find and you're like how the heck is this in a strip mall! The tour is great each guide knows their stuff. There is one random selection of chocolate busts....if you can tell me what Christopher Columbus, Barack Obama, and Andy Warhol have in common we will both know!!!! 
The chocolate and wine pairing is a must! The house made truffles and chocolates are fantastic! The peanut butter bacon and honey rosemary will blow your ever loving chocolate mind!

We brewed 15 gallons of honey ale here and it was such an awesomely fun experience! We have been home-brewing for a couple of months now and North High has made us envious of all of their wonderful equipment! Brewing beer here was not only easy, but it was a bunch of fun. We designed our own labels, came in and bottled our own beer, all the while drinking beer from their bar. I would highly recommend coming in and trying this out for yourself!

I'd been looking for a good eye lash salon in Portland, and finally found a good one!  Lash Club is in a very convenient location in Pearl district (also there is a branch in SE as well), and the lashing quality is VERY high.  Before finding Lash Club, I tried a few other lash salons in Portland, most of them were unsatisfactory, and the only one which was good was far away. :( So Lash Club is perfect for me! High quality and convenient location.  I also enjoy the talk with Yuko while getting lash service.  If I'm not quite chatting, that's when I'm falling asleep in the comfortable salon bed....  Highly recommend this place. :)

We went to Dr. Valentine after an unpleasant experience at Affordable Vet Care and she was a breath of fresh air.  Such great bedside manner, my pup loved her immediately! For me, I'm a big fan of the really reasonable pricing and the fact that she took time out to actually look at and examine my girl and make sure that I knew everything I needed to know about her.  Her staff is also A+ (I wish MY doctor had staff so good!) and I'm looking forward to seeing her for many years to come.

10/10 would recommend.

We were blown away by how good the food was here, from the perfectly fried chicken to the coleslaw to the corn bread. We ordered the whole chicken family meal and a side of fries and the wedge salad. Best wedge salad we've ever had! Loved the addition of fresh avocado and radish and there was lots of dressing just the way it should be. The service was great, our server Irene was very attentive and was a happy person which is so important to have this is a server when you go out these days. The chef came out and talked to us after the meal to see how everything was and we really appreciated that. The chicken skin was so delicious as was the chicken. If you like fried chicken you 100% need to try this place! Also, I really loved the decor, so inviting and clean. Richmond has been needing a place like this for a long long time. I will definitely be coming back for a girls night! Thank you for making our dining experience so pleasant and my Mother and Husband were so impressed with the food.

Some of the best coffee is hidden in the Arby's parking lot. I think this place gets more traffic than Arby's, and I see why. I discovered this place over 3 years ago, when I went shopping for wedding shoes. I tried a White Mocha Kicker, which is a frozen, milkshake like concoction from heaven, with ground up espresso beans. 

The first quarter of my drink was good. But as I got further down into it, it's like the drink magically transformed into the most kick ass white mocha kicker alive. It was crack. 

I brought a friend, who started out saying, "It's ok" and halfway through her drink she was in love. She started going a few times a week. I go as often as I can. Now the kicker tastes perfect from the first sip, so I guess it just takes a few sips to get hooked from the first drink. Try the white mocha kicker. Try everything. Just try Perfect Cup.

I've just left Claiborne's after seeing Rusty for base color & some low-lights added.  Five stars Rusty! I love it, I feel better after every visit!
ALSO, last week I called for a 911 appt., my hair was so thick I couldn't style it. My stylist,  Rusty, wasn't working that day so on short notice I got a same day appt. With Kate for a cut. She did a wonderful job & I'm very happy with my cut.
This Salon & the people who work there are really outstanding!  I'm SO HAPPY I found a great place for my hair.

A group of 10 of us visiting from out of town ended up booking a private tour in the N Mississippi Ave area. We didn't know what to expect and were very pleased with our experience! We started late morning and got to experience a little bit of everything in terms of types of cuisine. Our guide, Amy, seemed to have a great relationship with all the restaurants and was super passionate not only about the food, but also the history of the neighborhood and the back story behind each restaurant. It was a truly unique and engaging experience that we all enjoyed thoroughly. I highly recommend a food tour with these guys - it's a great way to get a true feel of Portlandia's food scene through the eyes of a passionate, entertaining, and knowledgeable local.  As for the cherry on top, Amy spent a good 20 minutes after the tour writing down an itinerary for us for the rest of our trip!

Hranush is nothing short of a miracle worker! She took a complete mess of a dress -- butchered by another alterations person (see my review of Jean's Dressmaking) -- and turned it into a lovely cocktail dress that I wore to my rehearsal dinner and will enjoy for years to come! She fixed the halter, made the plunging neckline much more respectable, replaced the lining of the skirt (which the other so-called seamstress had made so crooked, it hung just at my knee on one side, and four inches from my crotch on the other), and took in the sides of the skirt for a better fit. Hranush's brilliant work made me believe that she can transform any dress into a masterpiece....

An amazing gem on 5th street! 
I went to Tapelenders for the first time to check out what they had. The staff was very attentive and friendly. There was a nice selection of clothing and underwear upstairs. Many quality brands to choose from, which were reasonably priced. 

MOST IMPORTANT PART** I didn't even think to take the stairs down to the bottom floor. There you will find a huge selection of films (old/new release flicks and adult films). They are well stocked with adult toys, and other novelty items. I absolutely love having them in the wonderful world of Austin!

 A+++

Hair is such a funny thing. It's really just protein filament, but cut the wrong way, and it will send any woman into a state of horror, embarassment, shock, and anger. At least.

A friend of mine recommended Kim and I love my friend's hair, so I figured I'd be in good hands. I gave Kim a general idea of what I wanted, but she really had the vision to take it to the next level. 

Beyond her hair expertise, Kim is really a perfect hair stylist because she knows how to talk to her clients. Getting your hair cut, as my boyfriend will never understand, is not just about getting your hair cut. It's about bonding with the person that holds your (ok, my) favorite physical feature in her powerful hands. It's always good to be friends with that person.

Tyler and Brian moved us today. I'm truly blown away. I searched and searched for the best moving company. I looked for low rates, good reviews, and someone who had a big truck. Off the bat I got great vibes from the company. They finished my move in 2.5 hours...The minimum time
They require! I feel like I blinked and my apartment was all packed up In their truck. The guys were super sweet and kept asking if they were doing okay. They took apart my furniture and put it back together..they moved my heavy dresser, no problem. I would 100% use this company every future move I do. Definitely give these guys a call!

I Googled "best bloody Mary Atlanta" and came across this spot. I'd been eating clean and not drinking and working out. Snorefest. It was time for Bender Sunday. I eat At Camelis all the time and hadn't even noticed this was next door (more on that later).
I walk in and quickly realize that maybe just maybe they cater to a gay clientele? Score! I stereotyped and immediately felt set free. No freakshow aging day drinkers hitting on me, no pressure to have polite conversation or hold in my tummy. Nada. The decor is very Bird Cage-esque. Lots of "things" all over that come together to create rainbow magic. As if I'd entered his home, I'm greeted by Ron. Such a sweetheart. It's obvious that I'm new as every single person at the bar is familiar. There's a splash of everyone there. Black, white, old, young (less of these) you name it. Other than age (mostly older), what do they have in common? KENO! Double score. I get lost in the game, win and eventually lose. All while having fun conversation and CHEAP drinks. 
Shift change, enter Michael. Gorgeous with amazing highlights and sweet as a honeycomb. 
This place is certainly not for everyone, but for everyone else it is. You gotta be okay in alternative environments. Also, like everyone said, it's adjacent to Murder Kroger, not Flower Kroger. You get what you get. 
I would have removed a star for the super intense ass smoke, but the service and prices totally made up. Bonus: I sorta ended up with two phone numbers. Both were straight guys. Yes they were so shut up!!!
Fun lookie look: Check out the cool new sign that finally identifies their business from the exterior. The guy who designed it was actually there that day. Super talented craftsman.
Lastly, there was a dog there enjoying the bar. They support all sorts of canine-related charities and welcome pups to join you when food is not being served. Call first if it's your first visit before bringing Fido though. Have a feeling it may be limited.

My wife and I just bought a new Murano from Kevin and John last night and were pleased with the car and the process itself overall.  Both Kevin and John were helpful and polite from the beginning and really helped seal the deal in buying from this dealer.  
One caveat, as others have said, this dealership is a bit of a dinosaur in that it is old school in their approach on how the sales managers offer deals.  Not a big issue, just be aware going in that the sales managers haven't quite caught up to the times yet so make sure to do your homework before talking numbers (price and interest rate) and be prepared to turn down the first couple or so offers the sales managers send out to you.  Other than that, great experience, friendly and helpful people all around.

I absolutely adore this place I give them 10 out of 10 on all points. Every time I'm in I chat with chefs and the cashier; everyone is very friendly and willing to answer any and all questions I've had as I've explored their menu. 

I've eaten in the store and also have done take out many times. The seating area and tables are always clean and I love the couches if I want to read or do some work. 

Service and ambience aside- the food is FANTASTIC. I have explored their menu and I have never been disappointed! The spicy chicken shawarma on saj with everything on it, spicy garlic sauce and hot sauce is to die for. The sides are also delicious- and huge portions! The combo is totally worth the money if you're really hungry, or want some leftovers. 

Honestly I cannot say enough good things about Garlic and Lemons.

I was craving ramen a few weeks ago, and out of nowhere and old friend happened to call and ask if I wanted to tag along to G-men. I am so glad that I said yes.

I had been to this storefront back in the day when it was a different business, so I was having a major case of deja-vu when I walked in the doors. We got there right at 5:30, so it had just opened. The wait staff was very polite, and helpful. I had a lot of questions since G-men seems to do ramen a little differently than most ramen spots. I settled on the "RCMP" bowl. All I can say is it was amazing. 

The flavours were rich and satisfying, and the serving size was huge. The food was also very fast.

The restaurant filled very quickly, so I wouldn't recommend it for a quick meal, as many people were waiting to be seated. If you have a bit of time however, or if it is near opening time, check it out. I guarantee you'll like it.

This place is exactly what it looks like...a hole in the wall, but in the best possible way. Super chill, always a place to sit. You get the downtown feel without the bro-vibe places like Bit Bar bring. Drinks are really inexpensive to be as extravagant as they are. 

Now, what really matters: FOOD! Get the chicken slider and single patty slider. Trust me on this! I've been here sober and drunk. I've taken friends from all walks of life. No one ever believes me until they've had it. Best chicken sandwich in Columbus--PERIOD. Stay away from the polenta fries. That's a mistake I made last year--and even drunk they were the absolute worse. Everything else on the menu is solid.

Sadly, last Wednesday was the first time I've been to Steamhouse Lounge, period.  And I've been missing out.  I love the fact that their special are not only for happy hour but until the kitchen closes.  Score #1.  

Score #2:  Their staff is so nice and accommodating.  As an event planner, I'm a stickler for customer service and I was pleasantly surprised at how patient our waitress was when we changed tables like three times on the account of our party and then rain.   The valet staff was also very nice when trying to find a spot for my boyfriend to lock up his bike.

I love the environment, although it's a big house, I was still surprised at how much space the restaurant has!  Perfect rooftop bar, back patio and indoor dining with TVs to watch any sport to your heart's desire.  This is a great place to just kick back and enjoy a glass or wine or beer with friends after work for dinner.

Last, but not least, the food was legit.  You can't beat a dozen oysters for $7 and $4 table wine.  I know oysters is super big in Atlanta right now, and I love how SL keeps it real and leaves pretentiousness out the door.

Although it was my first time visiting the restaurant, it certainly will not be my last!

Jody is AMAZING!! For years I have wanted to get my brows done and I feel so blessed to have found such an amazing place to do it. Being able to do this with such a great artist like Jody was one of the best things I've done this year. It truly changed my life and I couldn't imagine going anywhere else. I have so much love and respect for the staff at the Swamp for helping me restore my confidence with my brows. I knew the transformation would be good but I didn't expect to be so incredibly happy with them EVERYDAY I look at it. Mermaid Brows truly are the BEST brows. Don't bother looking anywhere else!!

Updating my previous review. Since my last post I have been in several times and it has been a pleasant experience. I'm not sure what happened to the old crew of young women that used to be in the front but they are no longer there and haven't been for a while now. The staff there has improved and I am received in a courteous and professional manner. And of course I positively reviewed Dr. Richards before and still do.

I had many problems before with calling in to schedule appointments with never receiving call backs. After my last review I began to email requests for appointments and they have been answered in a timely way and I have gotten in the office within a few days.

Unsure of if poor reviews led to necessary changes with the staff in the front, or if by coincidence they happened around the same time, but I am glad for it. Noting some of the more recent reviews are positive as well, so wanted to update mine to reflect acknowledgement of the positive changes.

My dog Fynn has been jumping up and down at the same time every morning for three years now... he knows Doggy Dates is coming!  I cannot say enough good things about this company.  Every single staff member is equally amazing with dogs as they are personable!  Although Fynn is a perfect dog ;) he doesn't always come back when we call him, which is why we love Doggy Dates!  Fynn gets to race around in a private fenced in acre of land for 45 minutes and by the time he gets home he is completely exhausted.  We've gone through 4 different dog care services over the past few years, and Doggy Dates is far and away the best we've ever seen.  Thank you Doggy Dates!

My husband and I have been enjoying Cooper's Hawk for several years and the quality, service, food and drinks have always been consistent and positive no matter which location we go to. My only disappointment recently was when I realized my favorite scallop dish is no longer on the menu. Luckily there are plenty of other delicious options for dinner. We had placed our wine club membership on hold when we had our first son and recently activated it again. No additional fees or anything, just the standard monthly fee and we kept all our benefits even though it had been on hold for years. We are so glad to be back in the wine club and looking forward to our monthly outing for date night.

Best. Haircut. Ever.

After one disappointing haircut too many, my tween daughter recently gave up her desire for her very own stylist and saw my hairdresser, Andrea, at her new digs in NW.  She can't wait to go back--and it takes a lot to impress her! 

She's not alone in her delight:  All her friends and family were amazed at her awesome cut.  All the ooh's and aah's were just what a tween girl needs to hear.

The salon is beautiful, cozy and airy at the same time.  It feels clean and crisp, not loaded with smells or chemicals.

And of course Andrea did not disappoint.  She was able to create a highly functional haircut that brought out my daughter's curls and waves.  I am impressed that she created a style which stays out of my daughter's face but has so much movement and the same oomph and pizazz that are hallmarks of my daughter's personality.

Fantastic as always.

Are you even second guessing to come here? Are you crazy? If the answer to the first one is yes, then you should go with your gut... aka... yes is the only answer. If the answer to the second question is yes, then I can't help you... but eating here might! 

I had wanted to try here for a long time... I have heard so much about it, and the idea, the name even, is enticing. 

Environment: While the actual setting is small, it actually feels big while you are there. I think its because the ceilings are high, and the seating is on different levels. It has a very 'chill' vibe, with wood floors, wood tables, wood ceilings, bright red colors, with good lighting but still feeling dark and cozy. The wamrth of the brick oven fire lights up and generates heat throughout... theres some booths but also lots of high top farmers style tables. It was aesthetically unique, curious and comforting.

Food: I got a pizza, and they have the recipe right. 5/5 for everything from the description in the menu, to the sauce to cheese ratio, to the crust, the woodfired smell and the combination of the experience.... I was impressed.

Came here on a Friday night for dinner and I really liked it. I didn't realize how big this place until I actually walked in! Two floors of bar and dining space, great! Lots of big TVs as well. The chairs they have are super comfy, too. I got the fish and chips and honestly, they were some of the best fish and chips I've ever had. The service was pretty good. No complaints about this place, I'll definitely be back again.

Luba is the most wonderful Ukrainian grandmother you never knew you wanted or needed. She takes such care with everything I bring to her and will even tell me if she thinks the item is not worth fixing. I recently brought her three pairs of pants and four skirts to alter, and she did an amazing job on each one. She even narrowed the pant legs to make them more modern. And, its really reasonably priced, even cheap compared to some other alteration places... CASH ONLY.

Oh my gosh. I probably went here when I was 6, but I don't remember a thing. Now that I'm much older I REALLY appreciate and love Epcot. Well, I love Epcot during the Wine and Food Festival. I can't really imagine what else you'd do if they didn't have that festival going on. 

During the festival you can just walk around the World Showcase area and eat and drink while you walk and enjoy the Disney magic. 

The ride I loved the most was Frozen Ever After, which is magical even for adults. I also loved Turtle Talk. Seriously... how do they do that!?! The Land ride was educational and cool too. 

I recommend at least two days at this park because I just didn't have enough stomach to fit all the food I wanted to eat in one day. LoL.

Foxy Fitness Studio is awesome.  This place genuinely cares for the fitness and well being of their clients.  Its so much fun there!

They make ladies of all shapes and sizes feel sexy and vibrant with their pole and chair classes, and they wake up your metabolism perk up your curves with their interesting and fun mix of cardio classes, dance, pole ballet and yoga, and more!

I drive about 40 minutes to get to this gym from where I live, and let me just say, its completely worth the drive. The atmosphere and the instructors and the classes just make you actually WANT to go to the gym.  They're just that awesome.

To anyone looking for something new to energize them on the path to a healthier and fun lifestyle, I say try them out, if even for one class.  You will feel welcome from the moment you open the door, and I dare say you'll ever want to leave!

Vindalho was great. We went there for Dining Month on a suggestion from another and it was worth it. The food was delicious and the service was exceptional. And by exceptional I mean that they were both attentive and kind, something all too rare at many establishments in this neck of the woods. You should go there and reward them for this and then receive a great meal in return, sounds like a good deal to me. 

I should also note that I was in a shitty mood when I went here and would have exploited any flaw to indulge my guile. I found nothing to hang my hat on in that regard and wound up leaving in a much better place when I left than when I arrived. If that doesn't convince you of the merits of this wonderful restaurant I got nothing else for you.

Being from Hawaii, it's hard to find good chicken katsu around. Ichi has by far surpassed the katsu they offer at other places in the Portland area. The service was excellent especially not having to wait long for food to come. They also offer free miso soup with dine in order & this is great while you wait for your meal. The teriyaki beef is delicious also & everything tastes fresh. I'm glad I don't have to drive far anymore to find good food that the whole family can enjoy.

I had the pleasure of getting a visit from Mike and Ernie of Mr. Rekey, and I received exceptional service. I'm leasing a property, and my property manager hired Mr. Rekey to fix the locks on the sliding glass door in the condo. This is very important because this is the main door that we use to get in and out of the condo.

A previous locksmith from a different company came over twice and finally fixed the lock, but left it in somewhat shoddy condition -- the sliding glass door handle was very loose, and susceptible to breaking in my opinion. Ernie installed a door brace within 5 minutes and it now works properly, without any jiggle. They also completely removed the faulty charlie bar on the door and installed a pin lock for added security. In addition, they did a check on the front door, which was completely above and beyond what we hired them for, and made sure it was working correctly. Mike and Ernie completed the job within approximately twenty minutes, where a different company took around an hour over two days, and didn't even completely finish the job.

Lastly, Ernie did a quick repair on our bathroom door lock, which again, was completely above and beyond what I was expecting. It now functions a bit better than before.

Mike and Ernie seem to be locksmiths who truly value providing quality service. They completed the job efficiently and confidently. I want to thank them for a job well done.

One of my all time favorite brunch spots! My party of 3 arrived around 9:40 a.m. on a Sunday and had around a 75 minute wait (about 15 minutes more than quoted.) We enjoyed the delicious bottomless coffee on the porch while we waited. Once inside, multiple servers made sure our cups stayed full. Today I tried the chicken biscuit with pimento cheese grits. Both were phenomenal, with many different flavors combining together perfectly. Our food was out within 10 minutes of ordering, and our server was very friendly and accommodating. The southern decor was adorable. I will continue to visit when in ATL!

I just learned about NUCCA style of chiropractic recently. I wouldn't have paid much attention to it, but several people I know, from different social circles mentioned how amazing it was. When they told me that once you're in alignment you don't have to return for months or even a year I thought "This is different". A couple of my friends had seen Dr. Laura Ferrao, so I decided to go to her.
The process was interesting because she takes exact x-rays of your head to see what position your atlas bone is in. Then after carefully analyzing my alignment she said that my head was tilted to the right. Laura adjusted me in a surprisingly subtle, yet powerful way. She explained that some benefits of having my atlas bone back into place would be immediate and that others would take place over the next several months. She was right. After she adjusted me I felt a little strange, but I could tell that the change had made the head tilt go away. 
I slipped out of alignment before my next appointment and got in earlier to fix it. That was the only time that I've fallen out of alignment since the first adjustment. I have been to see her a couple of more times and she's made small adjustments to other areas, again, subtle and easy. 
Although I love seeing Dr. Laura, I know I will be seeing her less and less because my body is simply adjusting to the initial, most powerful adjustment of my atlas. I highly recommend NUCCA chiropractic and Laura Ferrao!

Seems to always have a consistent lineup, maybe because it's a holiday today.... but the brunch food is great. I had an avocado smash and hubby had a BEC.
Kids shared a grilled ham and cheese croissant and we all shared a huge carrot cake. All the pastries and cakes looked delicious. Cappuccino and latte were very good too. 
Tables are all "grab it yourself" type as it's a cafe, but we ended up getting one once we got to the front of the line. 
I noticed some of the patrons who go here don't clean up after themselves and the next people to take the table need to clean up... (how rude!)
All in all, a good experience.

From the second we arrived in Austin we heard about G'raj Majal... intrigued, yes... but hard to convince me to eat Indian food when its 95 degrees and humid.  After two days of hearing about this place we just had to try it.  We saved our appetites all day in preparation of the feast we were going to embark, and I am so glad we did.  When you arrive at G'Raj Majal and you take in the sights and the smells, you know you are in for something special. The restaurant embodies the very Austin "charm" the city is known for.  

We pretty much went to town on the menu (one of everything please!)... we started with Papadam, Chapati, Potato samosas, Goat samosas with delicious pineapple chutney (these were to die for. if they have them, these are a must!).  For mains, we ordered chicken vindaloo, chicken tikka masala and lamb korma.  We asked for spicy, and that they did! It is hard to say what was the best but the korma was absolutely amazing and the flavor of the lamb was not overpowered by the cream sauce. 

This is one of those restaurants that if you do not live in Austin, you will remember for a long time.  The ambiance, service and (most importantly) food was fantastic.

We called window genie to put window tinting on our bedroom windows as well as our sliding glass door in our family room windows in August. We had used window tinting before in another home and found it very very useful. It was a question of either getting window tinting or buying room darkening shades. We found the cost of the window tinting was less than custom blinds. Ron Brown the  owner of the company was very professional explained all of our questions and his price was very reasonable we felt! Two weeks later we had our windows done and what a difference! We should've done this when we first moved in.  It's well worth  It Protects your furniture it's a little darker but not objectionable,  prevents the glare and  reduces the heat. We would highly recommend this company.

Came on a Wednesday at 9 pm, had reservations but there were lots of tables open. Ordered the samosa chaat and tandoor chicken for an appetizer. I got the Khuroos-E-Tursh, and boyfriend got the chicken tikka masala. Also got 3 cheese naan and jalapeño cream cheese naan. Everything was delicious, but the naan is next level. Literally would come just for these stuffed naans to dip in sauce. Can't wait to come back and try more things, but with the same naans ;)

CANT SAY ENOUGH GOOD THINGS! They catered our wedding dinner for 150 on location in Washington, AND they provided an amazing breakfast the next morning for 110 (again on site). They have exceptional food, service and were easy to work with on contracts, payment and meal alternatives (gluten free/vegan options). The owner is amazing and is greatly concerned about quality of food and presentation which we really appreciated. We love eating here for dinner just us two, but would also HIGHLY recommend them for catering an event.

This was my 2nd favorite Disney Park.  It seriously is like a fantasy land.  And, holy crap...the fireworks at night are the greatest fireworks I've ever seen.  It's amazing to me that they do this several times per week.  Because, before this, the best ones I'd seen would have been the WEBN fireworks in Cincinnati...and that's pretty good, but just once a year.  These put those fireworks to shame and happen several times a week! It's amazing.

Plus, all the rides here are the great ones you've always heard about...and they do not disappoint.  Enjoy this place just like you were a kid...it's well worth the trip!

Sweet little studio that just opened this summer. Nice space with two large gender neutral bathrooms, with plenty of room to change. Has some mats for borrowing, and blocks/straps if you need it. Cubbies in the room for purses/shoes. The owner was very sweet and welcoming and taught a perfect Saturday morning class. She gave lots of options for each pose and kept an eye on all of us to make sure no one was hurting themselves or in pain. I'm looking forward to joining other classes soon!

Easily one of the best meals I've had in a long time. Maybe ever. I had the escargot, green salad, a cheese plate, and the cassoulet. All of it was absolutely amazing. I love brie, and this was the best brie I've ever had by a long shot. The waitress said that they import their cheese from France as well as their flour. Speaking of which, they bake their own bread and it's incredible.

The staff was extremely friendly and helpful. In fact, they recommended the entire meal and I'm really glad we followed their advice.

I was really surprised how few people were there, even for a Tuesday night. Especially when this place gets such good reviews. I hope they don't go out of business. I'll definitely be back to do my part in keeping them around.

I'm an avid Crossfiter, runner and Peloton person.  I've been to Fuel three times in the last three years.  Those are the three hardest workouts of my life. I literally look around and ask myself how in the hell do these other folks do this all the time.  I love this place even though I want to leave halfway through every time.  If you're looking for a place to either go to on a regular basis or drop in to get your "butt kicked". This is the place.  Oh and they're super cool people!  Next time I'll bring my own Yoga mat along with my own towel.

I wish these places were all over the country.

We went to Carmen last night for the first time. We used the Gilt city deal which allowed us to have 2 apps, 2 meals, and 2 glasses of wine. What we had:

Homemade meatballs w/mozzarella: you get 5 smaller meatballs, but they're pretty money. The meatballs come drenched in a spicy plum tomato sauce and are smothered with cheese. Excellent.

Fiori du zucchini fritti: when we ordered this I wasn't sure how it would work structurally but it came out great. The zucchini and goat cheese were fried in a light, almost tempura like batter and were served piping hot. The balsamic dribbled on top was a great touch.

Orchiette w/sweet Italian sausage: This was the highlight of dinner. The spicy sauce complemented the sweet sausage well, and the orchiette (not a pasta I've seen on many menus in the north end) were outstanding.

Black pepper tagliatelle with shrimp: the shrimp and pasta come in a not-too-heavy pesto cream sauce that we loved. There were only 4 shrimp, but they were MASSIVE and tasted like they were caught that morning.

The decor is cool, very dark and cosy. Plenty of candlelight, probably more ideal for a date than a group given the small size of the restaurant. Size-wise, the place is tiny, but still feels more intimate than cramped like some other places in the neighborhood.

The place is relatively expensive for Italian food, but the cuisine, ambiance, and service were worth it. They don't serve dessert, but I think it'd be a challenge to have room for it anyway as the portions are ample. After one night, challenging for one of my favorite Italian restaurants.

One of the best up and coming apartments in the NW area in my opinion, and I toured quite a few. Here's why... brand new apartments in a great location! Not only is their community space brand new, but they also have a full demo-kitchen in it as well. There are also a bunch of restaurants within walking distance, including Boke Bowl right in the same building. The inside of the apartment units are tastefully done with all brand new stainless steel appliances and wood cabinetry. 

The apartment itself is well managed by a friendly team. Michael (the assistant manager) is awesome! He was really helpful and helped me through the whole process while taking the time to answer all of my questions. The leasing process was painless, and it was professionally done from start to finish. They also have an on-site maintenance team which is great too. Would definitely recommend to anyone who is wanting to lease in an awesome area of Portland.

Looooooved this place! My girlfriends and I visited Peace Love Nails for my best friend's bachelorette party. Booking was so easy! I just gave them a call and they booked our party. I liked the personalized care that the techs offered. When they were ready to assist us, the ladies called us one by our names and had the lavender copper tubs ready for us to soak our feet. We brought a bottle of sangria and the ladies offered wine glasses and ice. 

The decor was amazing (sofas in light shades of blues and purples), plus a cute little shop to browse around while you wait, and did I mention the staff were super  friendly!?

The bride was so happy with this whole experience- and so were we! I'm so happy we booked our pedis at peace love nails! 

Can't wait to be back!!

Slick, sleek, stylish, asian, with a twist.

From the graceful and intriguing decor to the very fresh sushi, this place is a keeper.   It's downright beautiful yet not overstated.  The service, the sushi, the sake, all are great.  I've been here 10+ times, mostly for lunch and I've never been disappointed.  I'm a traditionalist so I don't go for the funky rolls but stick the straight sushi and sashimi.  The fish quality is top notch.  I don't order it, but my favorite co-worker always orders the firecracker chicken and she loves it.

The bathrooms are totally cool, seriously.  Make sure you check them out when you come.  

I never knew about the monday specials here, have to hit up Kenobi on one of these monday nights.
__________________________
Bah.  I tried to paste a Japanese sentence in here but Yelp wouldn't take it.  You'd think Yelp wouldn't be holding grudges from 1941.

If you want a reliable company with fast response times and low cost solutions, then Ideal Pest is the company for you. Last year we called Ideal Pest for an initial consultation and were really impressed with how reasonable their services were. They now come and treat our home inside and out every quarter. I've never had an issue with scheduling and their customer service is very good. They always come back free of charge if we need them to come back for a follow up service or if we still see pests/ants after our quarterly home service. Usually they are available same day or if not, then the same week. Will gladly recommend them to anyone who wants friendly and reliable pest solutions

Had a GREAT experience today with SuperShuttle!  I appreciated being able to book my ticket online so I knew what the plan was once I got off the plane.  I didn't have to wait long before being picked up with another group of people.  The driver was very pleasant and friendly and we had a good conversation on the way to my hotel.  He takes pride in his job and in being a safe driver.

My only disappointment was finding out that when a coupon is used to make reservations online, the drivers don't make as much money!  That is wrong in SO many ways!

One last thing...  Don't forget to tip your driver!!  They are providing a service, and like any other service, should be tipped accordingly.

I bought my 2003 Honda Civic from this location in March of 2003. I had just come off a lease of a 2001 Kia Sportage. (Cute car, needed to move onto something more reliable). Anywho - I brought my Mom along for some moral support. Keep in mind this was before I was dating or married to the hubby. Anyways, we were greeted by a salesman and I told him that I wanted to look at a new Honda Civic. I did not have a trade in, so I pretty much had to 'wheel & deal' on my own to get into a car. We test drove a Civic around the block and I quickly fell in love with it. It had the pickup and was easy to drive. LOVE it! We returned to the dealership and told the salesman that I was ready to make a deal. Of course they are all trying to sell you the rust packages, the protective stuff for the car, etc, etc.  No thanks. It was finally time to go talk to the finance manager. He advised me that I had great credit (duh, I already knew this, hence I could pretty much name my own price at this point). He kept asking for a $500 downpayment for the car. I told him no. He went back to the drawing board. He came back with another number. Nope. He asked again for the downpayment. Nope. Again, he came back again. Nope. Finally after the third try, I told him that if he came within $5 of the price I had in my head, we'd talk. At that time he dropped the monthly price considerably. It took him another 2 times before he kind of came close to the monthly price I was looking for.  You could tell that he was getting frustrated and wondered why some 20 something was 'wheelin and a-dealin' and playing hard ball. Finally I told him that I could not put a down payment down given that I just purchased a condo just days before walking into the dealership. He asked my price, I gave him $319, and he agreed. That price for 5 years at 0.9%. We finally signed the paperwork and walked out of the dealership about 2 hours later. New Honda Civic too!!

Talk about someone wheelin' & a-dealin'!!!!

The Naam is by far one of the best all vegetarian restaurants I've ever been to. Situated in the quaint Kitsilano neighborhood and open 24 hours, there really is no better place to go for a late night eat or a Sunday brunch!

The menu is packed with variety - from Mexican to Indian to Italian, the possibilities are endless. (PS. their blueberry smoothie is "to die for") Every visit to The Naam, I make sure to order something new, and I have never been disappointed. The staff is always super friendly (and a little eccentric), but they always have something to suggest if you just can't decide on what you want.

The Naam is also Vegan-friendly, as all the dishes that are dairy free are clearly marked - making the dining experience a whole lot easier.

ps. the orange juice is AMAZING

Where has this paper store been all my life? 

Randomly stumbled upon this store while going to get ice cream and a beautiful space and service. The outside with a type writer caught my eye then the cards displayed on the inside. The feeling of being overwhelmed but in such a good way! 

I only stayed on the side with the cards as I was drawn in the various sections and love the organization. I picked up two wedding cards and checkout was in the middle of the store. The prices were reasonable and I would say a better value for hand crafted and beautiful cards compared to other boutiques or little stores in Portland as they had more decor on the front and offered more varieties. The staff was quiet and helping another customer while I was browsing. 

It's like you get transported to another time or can just get lost within the store as there is so much to see. Excited to come back and explore all that they have!

Their services are excellent here! If you have anxiety and nervousness and you need a dental procedure, they are great to work with. The staff is friendly and understanding. I needed full wisdom tooth extraction but was really nervous. They offered options to help make this as comforting and smooth as possible. 

We split the extraction into two different visits taking out one side at a time making chewing and recovery easier while providing the laughing gas option to ease the anxiety I had of more intense sedation. When it came time for the actual procedure, they were wonderful. The dental assistant was great, she was really friendly and we made conversation easing the tension. The dentist executed the extraction with such finesse that I didn't even recognize when he pulled the first tooth which was shocking. He was great about making it as pain free and smooth as possible! The only thing I wish they had was more than two options in terms of pain medication because I was allergic to one and didn't react well to the other.

Other than that, these visits went completely smooth and problem free. The routine cleaning procedures are wonderful as well, like a spa treatment for your mouth! I will be making this my regular dental place from now on.

Maids Around Town though located in Austin also work the San Antonio area.
i have had a very hard time finding a cleaning service that would clean the way I would if i had the time.  Truly that is really why we hire someone to help us clean, we gave too much going on in our lives and we wa t someone that would do it they way we would right?
I was about to give up when I got Megan!  She laughed when I told her dhe is the best thing since sliced bread.  She has such heart and truly cares about her clients and cleaning even more than asked.  i don't know what I would do without her!

I started vaping a little over 8 months ago and have been completely cigarette free after 18 years of smoking.  I frequent several shops in town, and Phoenix is one of the best!  As the market gets more and more saturated, I expect that those who are in it to make a quick buck will be weeded out, and things like quality products and  excellent customer service will be even more important.

The whole staff at Phoenix is excellent.  I've dealt with everyone there at one time or another, and have had nothing but the best service. They keep up very well with new products in a very fast changing industry, but have the basics well covered if you are just starting out and want to keep it simple.  From Ego set ups, to mechanicals and rebuildables, they have it.  

Thanks guys!  

(PS the Copper Nemi is perfect!)

For me outback it's my pick-me-up place, I like to go there for comfort, I know what to order and that I always would like it. Outback is definitely My comfort food, and I like to go when I'm feeling kind of down, and it makes me happy. I usually order  the sirloin steak with the chicken tortilla soup, and one their baked potatoes. I have visited this location a handful times now since I moved to the Waterford lakes area, and I have to say that the service has been excellent. I enjoy coming to this Outback and definitely would recommend.

Isn't it awesome when service people do exactly what they say, when they say they will do it and for the quoted price!  Oh, have you never experienced this?  Then call Jose at All Surface Renew!

I highly recommend All Surface Renew.  Jose is a complete professional.  He took my call late in the evening, told me exactly what I could expect in the re-finish process, and gave me a quote for re-finishing my tub and repairing missing tile grout.  We scheduled a day and time, and Jose showed up right on schedule.  He and Jorge completed the work in around four hours.  Then Jose reviewed care procedures and processed my credit card payment on his mobile device.  What more can you ask?  The service was outstanding, the price was great, they left my bathroom cleaner than they found it.  The tub and tile look spanking new and clean!  I am really impressed.  I will be calling him back out in a few weeks to refinish my cultured marble vanities.

I cannot recommend these guys highly enough!

Super impressed this was my first time so I honestly found this place looking for a new client deal had no idea what to expect or what to ask for besides me wearing fakes on weekends it was something I had never done and Rachel was amazing we did a quick consult while I had some test glue on me making sure I wasn't sensitive to it. We went over sizes and styles and it came out just like I wanted . Definitely go in not Hungary it's a two hour deal but well worth it. Heads up its in back of a jewelry shop but I promise she is good

I can't say enough good things about Genuine Automotive & Diesel. Check out all their 5 star reviews on SureCritic and you'll understand. I've worked with them for years, and Dwayne Saunders and the whole team are the best. Dwayne has been available twice for a phone call when my car broke down on two different road trips. Melissa gave me her personal cell and wanted me to check in with her to let her know I was okay.  I had to get my car repaired on the road, and when I got back to Austin, Genuine checked the other shop's work at no cost to me. This is a family-owned business, and Hailey is great too. Trusting your shop is worth gold, and these folks have integrity. They always explain what I need to do for maintenance and why. And I love it that they'll pick up my car and leave me a loaner, then bring my car back when the work is done. They make it so easy!

I absolutely love this place for so many reasons! It's super close to my apartment but more importantly they have the best bartenders ever ! Their burgers are great too my favorite is the jive turkey ! But let's go back to the bartenders , Stuart is hands down one of the best bartenders in Atlanta! Awesome personality but he makes the best drinks too!! The staff overall is great here too between the other servers and managers as well. Definitely will be back ASAP!

This banh mi place might have to be the best banh mi place in Vancouver as of right now. I've eaten from here so so so many times but now I've decided to write a review. I've tried many of their banh mi's from their lemongrass chicken, to their vegetarian, and even their ice coffee and avocado shakes. However, the best thing on their menu has to be their Deluxe pork banh mi. Whenever I go, I always get extras for the rest of the week since my partner and I love banh mi! The deluxe pork one has alot of cold cuts plus the pork belly, pate, and has a really good mayo sauce. The portion, quality and price here is amazing and I am always so full even after eating only half. I've been reccomending Obanhmi to my friends and they love it as well. I'm already a regular here so just wanted to show some love!

I have been trying to go to a more plant-based diet lately and this was one of the best vegan burgers I've had!! My boyfriend picked it up for us so I didn't see the environment in the store, however, the food was absolutely amazing!! I got the standard cheese burger and fries (although next time maybe no cheese, still have some trouble eating vegan cheese haha) and it was amazing!! The best part was after eating it, you didn't feel that normal bloated feeling after eating a normal cheeseburger. Will definitely be going back here soon!! I want to try a shake as well!!

This place is a must stop next time you are in Plant St Market. They make tiny, adorable donuts right in front of you and top them with various garnishes and icings. I wanted to just stand there and watch the machine make the donuts, it was so neat! We got the cookies and cream and churro and both were so delicious! Our friend had tried them before and said they were great but we didn't fully understand what she meant until we tried them ourselves. They literally melt in your mouth! I mean, what's better than a warm donut? It's one of the few simple pleasures in life. If you are in Plant St Market and don't get some baby donuts from Sir Benji you are doing yourself an injustice.

After four dogs, three cats, and a rabbit, we have a long history with Laurelwood and more specifically, Dr Erdman. 

We also have experience with a couple other local clinics.

Suffice it to say no others come close to the sincerity, competence, nor empathy Dr Erdman has provided us and our pets. 

As a bonus, they don't try to up-sell you on unneeded services and products at every turn. I find that tactic highly annoying.  

Like pretty much everything, animal medicine has advanced greatly over the years, as have associated costs. Owning and properly caring for a family pet is an expensive task regardless of the vet you choose. 

That's just a fact. 

As well, and not unlike the medical doctors that oversee our care, their time is in high demand. 

So be prepared to wait, and expect that the ensuing bill may be a shock to your wallet. 

That said, know that in consulting Dr Erdman at Laurelwood, your pet will be on the receiving end of exemplary care. 

Trust me, I know.

This place was wonderful. I  booked an appt 1 week ago with another nail salon. The other salon cancelled my appt minutes before appt time as technition called in sick. They could not work me in the next 2 days and I was flying out for a wedding in 2 days. Needless to say I was not happy. Checked on line and found New Life Nails on E Burnside. They got me in within the hr. Tara did my pedicure and manicure  and I am so happy with it. Tara is just wonderful!! I will be back here.  And now off to the wedding!
Also by booking through Yelp I got an appt and confirmation within minutes at New Life Nails. They are the best!

I went in for brunch a few weeks ago and I can't stop thinking about how delicious it was! What stuck out the most were the desserts. We tried the apple cider donuts and the pumpkin cheesecake. The donuts were so amazing and baked to perfection. The pumpkin cheesecake is an absolute must. It is the lightest piece of cheesecake I have ever tried!! Light, fluffy and not dense and too filling like most. I will most definitely be back soon, and maybe next time just for dessert because it was amazing!! Keep up the good work!!

If you live in Milwaukie you know Mike's Drive-In. If you haven't been here, what are you waiting for? I've been coming here as long as I can remember and it has never disappointed. My family loves Mike's! The deluxe burger is generally my go to burger. But, you can't go wrong the special deluxe burger that has a fried egg and bacon, the clam strips, fish and chips, and other items only served during seafest. They have a great variety of shakes. We probably come here twice a month. I've had several friends that have worked here over the years and they continue to eat here. That should tell you something. If you're looking for a great drive-in burger, go to Mike's.

First of all, I know Dosha is well known and they're all around Portland, so keep in mind that I'm just reviewing the Northwest location. :-)

Walking in, the staff was very friendly!  They explained my treatments and where I would be going.  The woman riding the elevator with me was friendly and made jokes to make me more comfortable.
Kristina was my aesthetician/waxing was very professional and made me extremely comfortable.  She was friendly, but not phony, VERY IMPORTANT!  She gave me suggestions for treatments for my post-waxing, but didn't try to push me to buy products that she was using.  She was very knowledgeable about the skin and how to wax most effectively.  I highly recommend her for any of your waxing needs, especially bikini!
Next, Lisa gave me an Aromatherapy Pedicure.  She was very friendly and very professional and efficient.  She was talkative, but much like Kristina, she was not phony.  Thank you for being genuine! 

It is a little pricey there, but for a good experience, it was well worth it.

Great little taco place with vegetarian options! I am not a vegetarian nor vegan, but I was doing a vegan challenge that week, and it's pretty sad not able to try the meaty taco. However me and my boy both just had one taco for a small bite while shopping at the free market. 
He ordered pork and I ordered the seasonal veg taco.
I am impressed! Mine is really fresh but still filling, very flavorful and the sauce is amazing. So many different flavor hit you at once yet not overwhelmingly strong. It's fresh yet flavorful as a veg taco! the veggies are well grilled which you can tell the difference it made. 

My hubby didn't say much about his pork one but he says that was better than the taco place we always go in Seattle. That's pretty damn high standard. And he mentioned it's more juicy and spiced which makes it really good. 

Go try it! We fell in love with just one try and I hope you too!

I don't know about world's best sandwich, but Boston's best it is HANDS DOWN.  The quality of nearly all of their ingredients is top notch.  They also have some of the best pastrami I've ever had, and I've had pastrami all over baby!  And yes, it does get busy during lunch but the line moves fast and the tables turn over quickly. 

Lagrassa's is one of my favorite sandwich places in New England.  I was there today, and once again it was absolutely phenomenal!  In my opinion the pastrami and nearly of their hot dishes are best - london broil, pot roast, cubano - they all kick butt.  And their pickles are awesome!

One more thing - people constantly bitch about their prices being too high, but you know what?  Anybody that thinks a $10 lunch is expensive is a cheap ass and should be packing their own lunchbox.  You get what pay for and Lagrassa's is worth every penny.

We had a great time here!  We rode most (if not all) of the major rides.  We made it to A Bugs Life, which is really fun and cute.  We did The Festival of the Lion King, it is incredible, and next time The Lion King comes to town, we are definitely seeing it!!!

The park is beautiful, it's clean, it's just so fun. The animals are amazing!  Definitely walk to exploration trails and take the safari!!

Food was good.

Definitely want to come back and highly recommend you make it part of your Disney memories!

We went in yesterday evening for our tasting as we were considering Dickey's to cater our wedding.  We were able to try some of everything that was offered which was great considering I am usually very picky about my bbq and am not big on chain bbq.  Sharon, the manager, could not have been more fantastic!  She answered all of my questions and even some I didn't think to ask!  She was so accommodating and even told us she will personally be the one at our wedding!  I am normally a very indecisive person and she made things so easy on us that I had no problem signing a contract with them the same night.  I highly recommend them!

We moved into WOC in May and we've really enjoyed living here so far. The building is well maintained and cleaned frequently. Maintenance staff complete requests within 1-2 days. The apartments are brand new and have nice appliances. I love the Nest thermostat (and our energy bills are very reasonable). The office staff members are very friendly and helpful. I enjoy living directly above Orange Theory Fitness as well as some great restaurants. Very convenient parking garage. My neighbors are all working professionals so it's generally pretty quiet. Overall, great place to live.

Nadege is one of the absolute most incredible hair stylists I have ever met. Not only has she brought my hair back to life from the dead with her wonderful protective styles , but, every time I sit in her chair I leave the salon feeling spiritually full (and looking famous). It doesn't matter what kind of braiding or twist style I experiment with - she is in - freaking - credible. You can tell how dedicated she is to her craft and clients. I am so blessed to have found such a wonderful hair goddess. If I could do 100 out of 5 stars I would. HIGHLY HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!

This location is LITERALLY across the street from us, as we can see the "open" sign from our balcony. 

They are the nicest sweetest (no pun intended at all) people that work there, and they have a variety of flavors that cycle in and out, along with several staples. The yogurts are labeled as "non-fat" or "low-fat" as well! 

The toppings provided are generally the same, but they're delicious - anything from breakfast cereal, to syrups, to whipped cream, to fruits, and Halloween type candies...

They even offer a discount to Domain residents! 

It's no wonder we go at least once a week.. any more and I'd weigh 350 lbs...

So good - my new favorite Indian restaurant in Massachusetts, mostly specializing in North Indian cuisine. Lunch buffet is always packed because it is consistently amazing....somehow they manage a la carte quality in a buffet setting. I took my whole family here, they are hardly indian food fans but they all loved it. I just wish there could be a North Indian restaurant this good in Boston or Cambridge...if there's a paneer tikka masala equal to VDP's within the city, I've yet to find it (and not for lack of trying!)

You might have read in some of my other reviews that pizza was one of my least favorite foods... that was, until my date with Mr. Figs. Because he wasn't expecting me (I hadn't called ahead...), he was not quite ready for me when I arrived for our "date." He actually had a whole line-up of female and male enthusiasts waiting to dine with him! Luckily, within about 10 minutes, he invited me to a cozy table.

At first I was overwhelmed by his extensive and delicious menu. Luckily, my wing-man and wing-woman were there to help me tackle some tough decisions. We started with the mango bellini which was yummy and served in an awesome champagne glass missing the stem. At the same time, the phenomenal bread arrived complete with olive dipping sauce to-die-for. Then, we sucked on the amazing mussels and nibbled a greek salad. Finally, the forplay was over and it was time for the big event. For a super-reasonable $18, we enjoyed an amazing pizza that could have easily served four people. We chose 1/2 Red Sox and 1/2 Eggplant. I cannot describe each 1/2 in all of its glory but can brag that the Red Sox included some of the most delicious veggies I have ever sampled and the eggplant was fried to perfection. On both halves, the crust was thin and absolutely perfect!

I wish I lived on the other coast to visit Mr. Figs more often! Or, Figgy, maybe you could venture out West sometime?!

After a wonderful and full day at the Kennedy Space Center, Joe K had another place planned for us that consisted of southern style seafood cooking and cocktails.  Joe researched this restaurant in advance for our vacation.  We both love seafood and apparently this place is known for their shrimp!  

It took a little extra driving for us to find this place, and even noticing it from the main street was a bit of a challenge, but once we found the driveway, a feeling of relief came over me and I couldn't wait to settle down for some dinner and a drink!  Jeri was our server who made every effort to make us feel welcome.  Menus were handed to us and a complimentary platter of Corn Fritters got us started.  I always love to try new and signature cocktails at restaurants, so I chose a Dixie Delight and Joe got an Orange Blossom Pilsner.  The selections on the menu made it hard for us to narrow things down, so instead, we ordered a small banquet of dishes to share!  

Joe began his meal with the soup of the day - Shrimp Gumbo.  Then our food just kept arriving to the table!  Red Shrimp, and Rock Shrimp served with garlic butter, fried clams, fried oysters, and a side of cheese grits.  Our food coma was achieved!  Everything was delicious!  I only wished that the fried clams were a little more golden brown and the grits were less thick and dense.  But you definitely can't complain about not getting enough food here!  

I was impressed with this restaurant as a whole!  Even the ladies restroom was designed like it was meant for a 5 star hotel!  But in reality, it had a laid back, casual atmosphere with fun, interesting decor and plenty of dining areas.  In fact this place is huge!  Probably with good reason due to it's popularity.  I just wish we were able to return here again.  Now I can only remember it as one of the highlights of my Florida vacation..... 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2DifgkY8LiM

So I'm glad this place isn't within walking distance from my work or I may go broke. 

My colleague introduced me to this place and I love it!  Knowing this place is open til midnight during the week and 3 AM on the weekends is just a good to know so you can tuck that info away for when you have a late night huger hit you.  

The pizza options are great.  Not too out there but good combos.  I was tempted to order three slices but bought two and both were equally delicious.  They also serve salads but that's a bit too healthy of an option for me.

It's Disney's Magic Kingdom... how can it not earn 5 stars?

This was my first visit since I was a kid - I remember bits and pieces, but I'm glad I got to experience it again, and have some more dates to look forward to this year.

Getting into the park tells you how they've updated their park:  they're technologically up-to-date with NFC working at the heart of everything - ticketing, Fast Pass, and paying at the vendors.  If you have Apple Pay on your iPhone, all of Disney is Apple Pay friendly, and we used this the entire day.  Although, it took some clerks a few minutes to realize what was going on and to get the register to, well, register; but this is fairly new.  

The rides and themes can seem a bit hokey at times, but it's Disney - They've got shows scattered throughout the day for music and character fun.  If you are going you MUST register your tickets with your Disney Experience account - if you don't have one, download the app on your smartphone, create an account, and register your tickets.  Then you will have access to Fast Pass on your phone and can select which passes you'd like so that you won't have to wait in line to do so at the park.  Fast pass is FREE but you are limited to three per day at one park (if you have a park hopper, you only get to choose one park).  Fast pass is great, so look ahead at ride times the day before (at the latest) to see what the waits are, and select the passes for the rides you want to ride with the longest wait times.

We really enjoyed our experience and can't wait to come back!

I've had many things framed here at Beard's and have been absolutely delighted with each and every piece. The skill and patience of choosing just the right color of matting or combination of mattings, not to even forget the right color, texture and width of frame is what they excel at! What seems daunting to me is so seamless to them. I would never hesitate to take the most expensive piece of art to them or even a small inexpensive token. Both will come back being shown at the optimal best!

Very helpful! Came in here to get my husband a gift and they explained everything, walked us through the different types of razors and different types of gift sets they sold. Once we told them what we were interested in, he showed us how everything worked and in what order they need to be used and why they needed to be used...it was great! You can also get a shave here, my husband just wasn't interested but it looked very nice. The prices were reasonable for how little you use each time you shave as well.

I walked by this placw probably like a hundred times but never stopped by and that was my mistake. Their crispy pork belly is just done right. And what I meant by that is the skin is still crispy and evenly coated with your choice of sauce! Highly recommended the golden bags appetizer! Crunchy on the outside and the nutty of the taro on the inside makes the name. And no, it's not oily at all! The staffs are friendly and upbeat. Overall, wish I would have known this place earlier!!

This may be the best food I have eaten anywhere. The antipasto, soup, bread, meatballs, chicken parm and whole fried fish were as good as any I have had anywhere, Dessert tray of cannoli, cheesecake, tiramisu,& limoncello topped off an amazing dining experience. The staff was equally amazing and took care of our party of 6 and with no problems whatsoever. On site owners who give a damn along with a fun, festive atmosphere make this the best Italian place in the city. RUN dont walk to this neighborhood gem. You will not be disappointed.

I have visited this Apple store to make purchases ranging from a few bucks to a full laptop sale, and every time I've received the same high quality service from very friendly staff. 

Recently I went in to get a new set of headphones and a Nano SIM for a phone I'd bought from the Apple website. Despite the fact that the store was slammed with customers, I was served in under ten minutes-Apple does a great job of ensuring that they have adequate staff on to handle the demand. 

The employee was able to process my transaction incredibly quickly, emailed my receipt to me instantly, and got me out the door in under 15 minutes. I was very impressed.

The store itself is always clean, always well merchandised, and all of the demos (in my experience) are fully functional).
