Rude service and lots of excuses.  Had me wait 1 hour for a cab overnight (1-2am) and blamed the weather delays.  Reality is they gave poor directions on the phone and did not pick up phone in a timely way, after 45 minutes of waiting and a 3rd phone call, they gave new instructions on where to get picked up.  
Cabs are unfortunately the best way to get out, but if you do not plan to go far they won't take you. Uber has high airport fees - worse than cabs. If your trip is super far, cab to downtown then uber. Definitely do not pay these people to take you back to the airport, uber it back (no fees on your return).

I would not recommend Sleepy's to anyone looking to buy a mattress from a company that stands behind their product.  I purchased a mattress a little over a year ago, and spent over $1,000 thinking I would have it for a long time to come.  This mattress has not held up and is so lumpy that my girlfriend and I have resorted to sleeping on her ten year old mattress!  They sent someone out to look at it, who deemed the dip was within compliance from their antiquated string test!  Serious?!  We are so frustrated with this whole experience and regret buying our mattress here.  Sleepy's is offering me back 50% of the purchase price towards a new mattress.  I don't understand why I need to eat half the price on a mattress that I haven't even been able to sleep on due to a defect?  Money down the drain.  Anyone have any ideas where I go from here?  BBB?

I've literally been here 100 times before and it was always awesome (every week for 2 years that I lived in the Domain). I moved 15 minutes away and finally came back after a year. All new staff. The car was in 94% condition when I brought it in (very slightly dirty). It was 94.1% when I got it back. They did absolutely nothing. When I pointed it out, it was like a speed wiping contest where the guy just kind of flung a rag around for a moment and then looked to me for approval. I basically paid $25 for an hour of parking. I am going to do a chargeback out of principle and will never ever ever ever come back again. In fact, I might even stand in front of them and make sure nobody else wastes their time and money as a public service.

This could very well be the worst restaurant I've ever been to.  First attempt: it was a busy night over the Christmas holidays.  Ok, so it took 3 hours for dinner.  At least the drinks were decent.  Second attempt: went with two other couples on Valentine's Day and it took an hour and 20 minutes for our drink order to arrive!  It still makes me furious.  The apps arrived, then the entrees, but still no drinks.  The service was unbelievably bad.  Finally the manager came in and tried to apologize but it was too late.  The room was freezing cold and the food was terrible.  I mean, Chinese food?  The chef must have been smoking out back that night.  Strongly recommend avoiding unless you enjoy suffering on your night out.  (We Went over to Oye's in Reading afterward and had great service and delicious drinks)

I was very excited about this trip to Malaga as I had been there before with my daughter and her room mates, this time the girls were going back with me as well as my boyfriend, who loves Tapas.
The first time we went they were completely out of beef and chicken items but the rest were tasty. This time everything on the menu was available - however, the tenderloin was not tenderloin - it was tough and chewy, the rest was just okay. We brought this to the attention of the waitress and she was receptive mentioning that she had heard that comment more than once, we just thought the manager might want to know - no big deal. The waitress (who was terrific) asked if we wanted to speak to someone and we said sure. When the owner, general manager, chef arrived at the table we explained that we thought he may have received a shipment of the wrong kind of beef as it was tough and chewy; at that point we were rudely reprimanded and informed that he personally checks in every shipment. I reiterated our experience quite calmly, he proceeded to get red in the face and defensively told me to calm down and that he would credit our bill for the dish (which we did not ask for or expect - we just thought he'd like to know). As he left our table he let out a very loud "jeeezh." 
I'm not interested in a place where you are trying to help and the owner is a jerk.

So today I tried to support a Black business  and give this restaurant another chance . I have been here  once but it wasn't a good experience because of the waitresses attitude and it was so slow . So today me and my friend sat down and we order . I order the lamb chops he orders cornbread , Mac and cheese and chicken and waffles .  Service was slow and it was only 4 other customers inside . After waiting The waitress/bar brings out the food in small paper to go containers. .  she places  the food down my lamb chops aren't there, which is fine but if i wanted  my food in to go containers i would've ordered to go . . I feel like that shouldve been explained to us before we ordered. That was the first straw that messed up my entire experience . having to eat out of small containers. I watched my friend eat his food for 30 minutes as I'm sitting there looking stupid wondering where is my food . I call over waitress and she looks confused. We are thinking she forgot to put in my lamb chops . She goes to the back and we see her talking to kitchen staff and they start to look at my table. 15 min later (my friend finished all his food ) the waitress comes back and drops my food at the table and IT IS NOT LAMB CHOPS ITS LAMB STEAK . I inform her it is not what I order and that i order lamb chops . Instead of being apologetic she states that's what they have been selling   on the menu for a week . I tell her that she should've informed me they didn't have lamb chops. I waited 45 min for some food i didn't even ordEr . Also the lamb steak was missing the side item . no excuse for this bad cuStomer service and the waitresses slow and nonchalant attitude . If you don't want to work stay at home. IF YOU HAVE  MODIFICATIONS LET YOUR CUSTOMERS KNOW INITIALLY !!

I know we all love the HSBV but they really hurt our puppy. Brought him in for neutering three days ago  (he's 8 months) - 7lb 6 oz puppy.  The neutering went fine but as they've explained it, they dripped excess glue on his belly near his penis area.  The skin came together and then tore upon leaving a little cut that looks like it was made with an exacto knife.  Now getting infected.  

We should have gone to our regular vet, Alpine Hospital for animals.  

They were sweet and attentive and they're very nice on the phone.  And apologetic.  But this sounds like rushed carelessness and I would have expected better care.  I should have known a cut wasn't normal but I didn't.

Incompetent is the only way to describe Friendly Car Care. I took my 1982 corvette to them on July 21, and they replaced some parts in the differential. I get the car back and there is a binding noise in the rear end, meanwhile I also had an idling problems, which I had them diagnose. It soon became apparent that their method of fixing a car is just to start replacing parts. Each time they fix something it does not fix the problem, but of course they charged me for it. So I am now out of pocket $3000+ and I still have a rear end problem and idling problem. They are completely incompetent and have no clue about customer service, Beth has no mechanical know how whatsoever and Greg the owner is dismissive to the point where everything about what they have not fixed is somehow my fault. In this case they say the parts I supplied that were brand new HAS TO BE THE PROBLEM, and want to charge me $99 to diagnose, yet for the last month and half they have been DIAGNOSING and charging me every time.. And Greg,  when you give a customer back a car that s revving so high it almost snaps the drive-shaft when put in gear, don't tell me that it is my fault and that I needed a new O2 sensor and that I was told that by Beth. Her words were that it MAY need a new sensor because it is reading slow, and just so you know, you DID PUT A NEW O2 sensor in and it did not solve the problem.... I am now going to take the car to another repairer, and decide if I need to take any action regarding their repairs!!

This place should be condemned. Disgusting asbestos, smoke filled, dirty, humid, unsanitary, bug infested nightmare. Don't freaking stay here. Sheets are slept in, pubs, mocos and everything you can imagine. Nothing is clean and forget asking for fresh linens, yeah right! Sleep in the dirty ones! Gag bed bugs everywhere and when you complain the night shift manager will let you know that "sometimes the maid may get a bit lazy"...really? You're better off renting a car and sleeping inside of it. So freaking gross!! This place is falling apart! The breakfast is cereal too...enjoy that nasty dirty milk jug  warning to all and don't trust the hotel.com reviews!

I've been to this location around 7 times.  Had a similar experience as a couple of the other negative reviews.  They get confused on the size (trying to push the larger size) plus upcharges that don't make sense.  Most importantly, I'm convinced my drink is watered down with carrot juice, lemon juice or whatever.  I get the Fountain almost every time, 2 out of the 7 times it tasted like it had a good amount of greens and I felt energized.  All the other times it was weak tasting and definitely had very little greens.  Getting a green juice made at Whole Foods or Austin Skinny Limits I've never had this problem, also they are less expensive and taste much stronger.

This place is for the regulars that come here every day. The food does showcase the chefs talent, but it is generally super loaded with fat and sugar (probably why the every day regulars are addicted to it?) As many others have said, the male owner is prone to fits of rage towards customers as well as employees but seems to make an immense effort to cover this fact. Was also super creepy with me and the other women inside and would not get out of our personal space despite our obvious discomfort.

If you see this place in a Craigslist ad, just disregard all together. THIS PLACE IS A SCAM. We emailed about a listing, rearranged our schedule for the day to see the place listed. We arrived at the street crossings listed (not the address, he wouldn't provide this), only to be stood up, with no phone call. I understand that things happen but notice is necessary-this screwed up our whole day! 

When I called, I was told that he had shown up and waited for one minute. Hmm. When I asked for more detail, I was responded to with strange, one word sentences, and then hung up on. 

COMPLETELY UNPROFESSIONAL. THIS PLACE SHOULD BE OUT OF BUSINESS. 

AVOID AT ALL COSTS... landlords, you are better off listing apartments yourselves! Don't keep these people in business!

Been there for 2 years both Dr P and Dr R failed to diagnose a rare condition I had, although clearly scar tissue was present on the cornea If I was informed of that immediately I would have taken action and go to the best specialist in the country, in notes it was put, patient is wondering if she has ocular rosacea.
Hello who is the Dr here? 
If you are getting nowhere please do yourself a favor and go somewhere else!!

Had reservations there at 620 on December 21 a Wednesday  We arrived and were told to go to the end of the line which was probable 75 yards long. By the time we got to the front it was 7.  Why have reservations if you are not going to honor them!!!  After sitting down we ordered drinks and a appetizer. we did not receive our drinks until after the appetizer was already eaten.  Then the hamburgers were 20 and the bread surrounding the hamburger was three times the hamburger.  Needless to say Disney is ripping people off  SURPRISE SURPRISE!  Never go back there again to say the least.   Also if you dont show up for your reservation you get charged 10 dollars a head.  WOW

Ridiculously overpriced. A cup of coffee is $3. Food is terrible. Sad that they take advantage of the lack of options for truck drivers. Went here for lunch. Got the roast beef melt. Beef was decent, but the sandwich was so soggy that it fell apart when I picked it up. The bread had disintegrated. My husbands fried chicken was almost burned. $40 for 2 meals, sandwich and fried chicken and 2 sweet teas. Holy cow. 

We were stuck for the night, so in the morning we decided to give them a second try. Breakfast is an easy meal and hard to screw up. I was daring, even though I shouldn't have been and tried the salmon hash. YUCK The potatoes were not cooked all the way and still somewhat crunchy, the salmon was so over cooked it was hard to swallow. The hash was disgusting, dry and WAY overly fishy tasting. I have to wonder how long the salmon was lying around. I ordered over medium eggs. I like some runny yolk but hate runny whites... they were barely cooked. In fact calling them over easy would have been a stretch. My husbands pancakes were rubbery. Same story with his eggs. The bacon and sausage were only half cooked. The sausage was raw in the middle and bacon super soft.

$40 again FOR BREAKFAST... 

So $80 + tips later, I can tell you to stop at Walmart and get stuff to make yourself or have a pizza delivered. Two chances were enough to convince us that the owners are greedy and the cooks could care less.

Sad that hard working truck drivers get these kinds of ridiculous options while on the road... and you wonder why we are so cranky.

Writing a negative review gives me even less pleasure than the kebab. I prefer to talk to the restaurant staff, but in this case a general warning seems more appropriate.

I knew not to expect the transcendent quality of Berlin street food, but I was hoping it would be a reasonable attempt. It was not. Dry bits of beef/lamb from the bottom of the grill on criminally dry and stiff bread don't even make a palatable meal. 

Could I have been there on an off day? Maybe. Will I ever go back to see? No.

I used them to move from San Francisco to Boston, with 1-2 months of extra storage in Boston before I actually moved in.  The people in SF were friendly, helpful and got me moving permits from the city -- all in a very tight time span. I would highly recommend them for their courteous, convenient service.

But in Boston... what a different story. The guy at the depot here was really unpleasant, unhelpful, uncommunicative and condescending.  All his communications to me had a mildly threatening tone.  Even though I gave them 3 weeks notice of drop-off (they only required 2) he "warned" me that they might not be able to do it because of Labor Day weekend.  He was completely hands-off in regards to arranging a parking permit. In the end, things worked out though not on my schedule.  I would never use them in Boston again.

I've been to some pretty great rooftop bars, and this one just didn't hit home for me. It's changed a lot since I was last here, bringing with it a younger, more "barely legal to drink" age crowd that equals loud and club-ish. 

There are quite a few drinks to pick from for happy hour so that should satisfy most liquor drinkers out there. However, I am a wine drinker, and they only had two options for happy hour wine, a Rose and a Prosecco (no white and red? Weird). The Prosecco wasn't even the Prosecco on the menu, so I had no idea what they were serving me. The wine pour was generous at least. 

The rooftop does promote local live music, but it doesn't star until 9pm, so as not to coincide with happy hour I guess? It's ether low priced drinks or better ambiance it seems.

Avoid this company, they are disorganized and give out misleading information! Their application and screening process are ridiculous and they are not honest about what is required to qualify for an approval. When I went to meet their agent for a viewing, I specifically asked about using a combo of income and savings instead of just one or the other to qualify. The agent said that this would be fine as long as the combination amounts to what is required. So, I applied, because my income/savings combo was more than enough to qualify. I have good-excellent credit, by the way, and a decent 2 year rental history. 

Five days later, I get a call from Bemrose Consulting (the screening company) that I'm about to be denied only because they have not received a rental reference from our current landlords. So, then I get involved as a middle man to resolve that issue: I make multiple back and forth phone calls between the landlord and Bemrose due to supposed problems with the landlord not getting their FAX (what is this? 1990? Most places use email now!), the landlord and Bemrose blaming each other for the miscommunication - this went on for about an hour before I ended up resolving it as the middle man between the two. Finally, I call Bemrose to confirm that they got the fax from the landlord. Good, they finally had received it. 

So I wait to hear back from RPM. RPM finally calls me - I'm denied because I don't have EITHER an income of $50k OR $50k in the bank. Or you can get a guarantor who makes or has 5x the monthly rent, so above $80k. They don't accept a combo of income and savings from either applicant OR guarantor, despite the fact that the agent TOLD me that this would be fine! So it ended up being a stressful and complete waste of my time and money! I would have never applied if they didn't accept a COMBO of income/savings. This place is unprofessional and charges a ridiculously high application fee of $52 per applicant for Bemrose to turn around and basically force me to do their work for them - obtaining a reference from the landlord. 

I would give zero stars if I could. Stay away! Just look at the other Yelp reviews - this place is consistently subpar and doesn't even seem to care. What is absurd about all of this is - not only did the agent tell me to apply anyway when I disclosed my situation (income/savings combo), but before the miscommunication between Bemrose and my landlord happened - RPM had already seen all of my financial documents as I had submitted it 5 days prior to Bemrose contacting me about the landlord reference. Why did they not just flat our reject my application when they saw I did not have enough or at least contact me and tell me that it I did not qualify solely based on income? Instead I had to waste an hour of my day stressfully acting as a middle man between Bemrose and the landlord only to have them call me hours later and say that the income requirements did not suffice anyway. RPM needs to train their agents not to give the WRONG information to people - otherwise your business just looks like a racket trying to collect application fees from people when you know for a fact they will not meet your income requirements. This, combined with the absolute unprofessionalism of Bemrose makes this entire application process not even worth it - even if you did meet their income qualifications.

Showed up about 8:30pm with 8 people.  Inside seating was dark, felt dirty and had some kind of rap music blaring over the loud speakers. Usually I would give a place a second chance,but after tasting this pizza, I can honestly only give it ONE star. I was looking over the other reviews, and can't believe the praise from other diners.   I've been here several times, but only for happy hour drinks, and have never had the pizza.  Tonight, after happy hour, decided I would get a pizza to go.  But, before I get into that, let me talk about the wait staff.  Our waitress "disappeared" three times, and we had to flag down the manager to get service,and finally our check.  The place was not that busy, and there was no reason for us to wait over 20 minutes for our drinks and our checks.  Horrible.   OK, now to the the pizza.  Pizza is usually one of those things where even if it's not that great, you can still stomach it.  Well, this pizza changed my mind.  I ordered a small, pepperoni, sausage, and mushroom to go. When I got home (5 minutes away), it was ice cold already. So, I warmed up the oven and waited for the pie to re-heat.    After the first bite, I was ready to stop eating it.  One...there was almost no cheese at all on the pizza.  It was all sauce and toppings.  First I'll talk about the sauce.  Acidic, metallic, and no tomato taste at all.  It also had the consistency of tomato paste. Horrible.  The toppings:  couldn't even taste them, because the so called sauce was so overwhelmingly bad.  Pepperoni seemed to be OK, but there was barely one piece on each slice. Mushrooms--actually tasted great, but again, very few and far between.  Sausage--I don't know what this was.  Little grains of grey substance,that had no taste.  Not even worth adding to the pizza.    Long story short, I suffered through one slice,and thew the rest of the pizza in the trash.  Worst pizza I've ever had.  Pizza Hut is better than this, and I HATE Pizza Hut.  
In summary, I will probably still go here for Happy Hour because it's close to the office, but will never, never order this pizza again.  I heard some horror stories from a friend who used to work here, and I should have heeded their warnings.   I won't get into that, because it was pretty bad.  Let's just say the sanitation in the kitchen was non-existent.    
Thank you.

I waited 6 weeks for an appointment, so that I could see their retina specialist, Dr. Feldman. This is certainly not run like the normal B&B and is really a bed and make your own breakfast if you get up before 9am. We arrived on Thursday a half hour before the scheduled check in time (4-7pm) for a four night stay and no one was there.  So we left to do some things for awhile and came back at 4:45.  Still no one there, we waited awhile and then made a phone call to an answering machine before we left, ready to find other accommodations. When he called back he stated, " I forgot you were coming". He said he'd leave a key in a basket on the porch.  There were no instructions on where to go, what to do.  We wandered through the house looking for our room. The next morning we came downstairs at 7:15 and made our own coffee.   Got a voicemail at 8:30am from the owner that breakfast would be at around 9am, call if any problems.  We had stuff to do, couldn't wait until 9.  The next morning (Saturday) it was the same routine, and we met another couple who had arrived the night before to the same circumstances.  The owner (husband) showed up at 9 to make breakfast for the 4 of us, and at first his attitude was as if he was doing us a favor.  He then sat at the table with us and was quite pleasant but that was the only time we saw him, and we never met his wife.  On Sunday we had brunch plans so there was no sign of him all day and no housekeeping service.  We were hoping to get fresh towels after 3 nights but it was not to be.  While in the house for the two days before we met the owner, we noted that there was no toilet paper in the downstairs bathroom and a dead roach on kitchen floor which we mentioned to him and was rectified on Saturday.  Our room was comfortable but there was no lightbulb in one of lamps.  The website stated that guests had Neutrogena products in their rooms - not the case - and Ozarka water.  There was a water cooler in the kitchen that remained empty throughout our stay and there were no water bottles or any other water offered. The front porch light was never on so it was hard to find the door lock when coming back in the dark at night.  Monday morning we had to leave around 7:30 to get on the road so again we made our own coffee and left the keys near the front door since we were not given any instructions.  Most B&B's advise their guests of the hours of breakfast service and are on the premises to greet their guests. We would not recommend staying here if you want any kind of service or interaction with the proprietors.  It was the oddest experience we have ever had at a B&B

If I could give them a negative rating I would. I ordered some wings online near their closing time and the order was accepted and my card was charged. I showed up 15 minutes later and was met with some of the rudest behavior that I have experienced from a hospitality person. I will never eat at any Pok Pok establishment ever again and will gladly share this horrible experience with others. They do not deserve to be in business with that attitude. There were several out of town guests with me as well that witnessed this behavior and were equally appalled. If they have any sense at all they would get rid of the rude clown that was closing the place (assume it was a manager).

We called the Aarm dental location on Denman st to find out if we could have a dental procedure done for our 4 year old son that would require sedation. They asked us to have our sons files sent over to them so that they could decide weather they could do the procedure. We did and they booked us in. When we brought our son in for the appointment and they told us that they cannot do the sedation but still charged us for the visit. We were proactive and sent the information to them ahead of time to make sure that we weren't wasting their time and our money and they lied about what they could do in order to charge for the visit. Very disappointing.

Not really surprised given other reviews, but yep, I couldn't get in with priority pass just now. Asked anyway, just out of curiosity, whether the sign out in front was true, and the person there said, with a huge smile, "yes, it is *very* true", and started in on the spiel of other places I could go (implied, but not stated outright, "to hell" being one of the available options). I don't totally blame her, I'm sure she gets that same question a hundred times a day and she's super sick of it, but... if I look in and it's maybe 30% full on a Monday afternoon in the off-season, and an hour later I look in again and same thing, clearly they just never participate in PP ever. Which is fine, that's their choice to participate or not, but if they never participate ever, why advertise that they do? I don't assume other lounges will take priority pass - cause they didn't say they would. Being full is one thing, but they... weren't. At all. Or if it's just based on day and time of day, they should just put the times they do or don't accept PP on their sign and the PP website like some other lounges do instead just saying "based on capacity", which really seems to mean "whenever we feel like it, for no particular reason".

I hate when people post bad reviews based on "it wasn't open", but in this case I feel that's kinda justified. (But do note, people who don't have PP and could get in for some other reason: I don't have any idea how good the lounge is, first-hand.)

The place itself isn't anything special, but the rude attitude of the staff and especially the mean-spirited manager turned a good night among friends into a negative experience. Now I'm not surprised that many reviews spanning many months mention words like "power trip" and "aggressive"...which isn't really the kind of staff you'd expect at a place like this where you want to just enjoy a drink with friends! Bad taste in my mouth and will be going to one of many nearby spots instead to enjoy a friendly, mature staff and a better atmosphere in the future!!

9/10 absolutely HORRIBLE service. When we lived in the apartments next to the mall in the area back in 2014, we'd come here because we liked the food, just simple, casual American food. We soon stopped coming for years because the service became so horrible. We have decided to try them again recently and today was definitely one of those days of HORRIBLE service!!! First of all, how do you justify waiting 15 minutes for two glasses of water!? Since we waited so long in the first place, we ordered our appetizer and two entrees all at once, yet that still didn't speed ANYTHING up. Upon attempting to complain to the manager when one finally came out, he just said our server was busy, yet he CLEARLY was not! He had only four tables. One walked out, who had been there before us. Another table that came in after of a family of four also walked out because they weren't even greeted by the server after being seated several minutes prior and saw how frustrated everyone else in that section was. We ended up finally receiving our app from another manager who finally decided to check on tables himself and bring things out. Unfortunately, he wasn't on the floor for longer than a few minutes. The whole time, our server was basically just walking around doing absolutely nothing. It was so unbelievable, especially due to the fact that he basically had one of the managers vouch for him being busy when the restaurant was actually pretty EMPTY and none of HIS tables were getting any service. How do you vouch for a server, especially as a manager when there's only a few tables full of people in the whole entire restaurant and the ones that our server had were either walking out or complaining!? To top it off, when my entree came out, it did not look the least bit appetizing. The little bit of time that I had to spend with my husband for lunch today before work was horrendous and so extremely disappointing. 

This location is a joke. They MUST do good with the late night happy hour crowd because every single time we've gone during the day, the place has been empty, even though it's in a fantastic location! Unbelievable. 

If you go, sit at the bar area. 

Better advice? Don't even come to this location.

Unfortunately I just had the most distressing experience with the owner of this store. I purchased a pair of $180 Adidas UltraBOOSTs in April of 2019 for an extended trip abroad. I came to the store to have my foot fitted for the correct size shoe as I would be doing a significant amount of walking. The salesperson did not have this shoe in my size (9.5 or 10) and kept insisting I needed a size 10.5 which he did have in stock. I knew when I paid for the shoes that they were too large for my foot (toe long and the heel slipped) but I felt the salesperson was annoyed by my questions and he knew best as he was the professional....and I just needed a pair of shoes as I was leaving for the trip the following day. Got home, decided they were just too big and put the shoes on the shelf in my closet and forgot about them. Quarantine time allowed me to clean my closet and locate the sales receipt. I called and was told by Allie (super nice young lady who is very polite) that they would be happy to exchange them for a shoe that fit me properly. I did not want a refund, just to exchange the shoes for a half size smaller that fit! Came into the store, located Allie and she spoke to the owner.  I was told because of the length of time since purchase that they could do nothing. Ok...that's fine. On the way out I saw the owner and very politely let him know that, while I took responsibility that I was not prompt in taking care of the return, I felt it was the responsibility of his employees to fit me with the correct size shoe. He grabbed the box from my hand and his exact words were "I don't give a s*it, I'll give you your money back". Excuse me? I told him I did not expect money back, only asking to exchange for a pair of shoes that fit properly. I asked for my shoes back and left as his behavior was embarrassing me and the employees and other customers were staring. I've purchased many shoes here and have recommended this business to others in the past. This was my final visit. Apparently, the current climate is making people completely lose all sense of manners, politeness and common human decency. Why would  you speak to anyone in that manner when you depend on customers to purchase your product?

On 1/17/19 I made an oil change appoint for 9am 1/19/19. 

When I took the car in on the 19th I was told it would take about 1hr. I asked if I could use the complimentary shuttle to get a ride home and was told it was in Arlington. Previously when I'd used the shuttle i was told repeatedly that its only offered in a 5 mile radius. I was confused why they would send the shuttle to Arlington which was significantly further than that. The person at the desk very rudely responded with "We decided to help out an 80yr old woman is that ok?"

Since this employee decided to violate the company policy I was denied the shuttle that they said would be available. Instead I called my father to come pick me up and told him that I'll be back in 1hr to get the car. I called 2hrs later to ask about they car, and he said they still hadnt taken it in. 4hrs later I called because I needed to go somewhere that evening and again he said they still hadnt taken the car inside and that the shuttle was still not available. At this point they've had the car for 5hrs and havent even started. I did not expect it to take this long given that I went through the Sullivan tire website and made an appointment. I not longer had time to wait for me car

So again I had to call my dad to give me a ride to the shop. When I asked for the keys back I was told that they didnt take my car inside because there were people waiting in the shop for their cars. I didnt know that superseded the appointment i made to the tune of 5hrs. Ultimately they never did change the oil in my car and I had to go elsewhere. 

If this is in fact the Sullivan tire policy I cannot reasonably take my car back there. It just doesnt make any sense when Jiffy lube will change my oil in 15 minutes and they are 2 miles down the street.

I wasnt even going to post this review, but they just did the same thing to my wife today with our other car. When she reached at 9:15am this morning she asked how long it would take. At first they said 11:30, to which she said "well then I cant do it now because i have to pickup my daughter from school at 11:30". Then they said they could get it done in 1hr. When she called back at 10:40, they said they just took the car inside and said it would take another 1hr.

If the estimates for completion are off by such a large amount, then they are useless. We plan around car maintenance since it means we will be without a car and thats very limiting in Bedford. Its really hard to plan if the shop gives such bad information.

Not what it used to be since Dante Pecora (the previous GM) left. The restaurant now is a shadow of its former self. The Service SUCKS. If you like terrible service come here. The lady that finally did wait on us didn't like it when we didn't have a big drink order. After we ordered we waited for a while just to get the drinks then waited and waited and waited some more to get the food..... 

After the food came the Triple Dipper & the Cheese Dip with Chips were both very good but the fish entree (Tilapia) was BAD. Like make you sick BAD. 

The lady that took our order never did come back and ask how our meal was! She just disappeared into thin air. Speaking of crappy service!

After what seemed like forever she reappeared and I called her over to the table and told her about the fish. By this point we just wanted to LEAVE. We finally figured out how to pay with the small computer thing at the table & then LEFT.

Bottom line, eating at Chili's today was an ORDEAL. 

Next time, (IF there is a next time!) we'll order the food TO GO.

This is one of the worst dining experiences I've had. The service is terrible, the portions are tiny, everything was disgusting and covered in dust, and the prices are twice as much as they should be. I can't believe this place is allowed to be open by corporate it is absolutely awful. Waiters, and waitress'es, and obviously cleaning staff could all care less. Our cook was really good and tried hard, but he wasn't getting much help. Also, we asked for some extra butter and were told "we aren't supposed to do that." Making that statement, about a scoop of butter, sums up everything you need to know about Benihana. There are too many good Japanese options in Atlanta for you to ever eat at this place. I would rather eat at TGI Fridays than ever have to come back here.

I interviewed several moving companies and finally chose Gentle Giants because, even though they were the most expensive, they sounded like they would take the most care and would send the best of their crew.

 The movers were nice, courteous and the move went quite well. Because I was going to a temporary residence, I had to put everything in storage with Gentle Giants. 

When I was able to have my belongings delivered to me, I unpacked everything and discovered a lot of things were missing. When I contacted them they sent a manager out to my house. Because I had kept all of the inventory papers, he spent hours going over them and determined that there were 6 boxes missing. He reassured me that they must have missed a container and would find it and promptly deliver them.

When I heard nothing back from them I called and spoke to the head manager of the company. He was rude and told me that they couldn't find my belongings. I was very upset, as there were many extremely valuable family heirlooms, irreplaceable paintings and many many other things of value which were very important to me. 

When I told him that I wanted them to search the warehouse until they found my things he got rude and accusatory. He implied that the boxes of my precious belongings never existed!!! I was livid at this point. He said her would continue looking and would get back to me. 

I didn't hear back from them. I allowed what should have been sufficient time for them to find my belongings and called them again. I was told that they could not find any of the 6 boxes!

I had to contact the Consumer Affairs Dept. and when I did the movers said that I should write out an inventory of the things that were missing. I listed everything I could think of and was very honest in my assessment of each items worth. I was reimbursed for those things.

For months afterwards, and to this day I frequently remember something else of value that I had forgotten to list. I knew that they would do nothing after they had already settled with me. I was out thousands of dollars more as I remembered more and more things that were missing. 

It was one of the most difficult experiences of my life. I am still heart sick over the huge losses I incurred. This was inexcusable and to make matters worse I was treated terribly when trying to claim what I was owed. A terrrible experience that I have not gotten over all these years later.

I was going to at least give our server a good review, but I take that back. We got here at 10! And right now right In Front of me...the couple left when we got here! It is now exactly 1043....their dessert is STILL there.

When we got here we ordered our drinks. Sent it back bc we watched the bartender and she used her hands that she just used to hold cash down the ice. One word...disgusting! 

***still looking at the bar.:.45 minutes ago the couple left...their dessert and empty glass STILL at the bar....


All honestly, 1. Hire on another bartender is she can't do it herself.
2. Manager should go around and see how  everything is.... 
3. Fajita plate should be hot. By the time I got it, it was cold ;/

So I guess I'll start with the only good thing about this place...the DJ! The music was great and created a good atmosphere. Besides that everything was terrible. I went on a Wednesday around 10PM. There was a nice crowd but it wasn't overly crowded. It took 10 mins for our server to greet us and wipe off the dirty table. We ordered everything at the same time. This included our water, bar drinks, apps, and food.It took 15 mins for our water and drinks to come back. We waited patiently for our food that never came.  We paid our tab and still hadn't gotten any food! After 45 mins and hunting our server down several times we finally got an order of garlic knots. The management was unprofessional and unaccommodating which I guess can explain the behavior of the staff. He offered no apologies and did not want to refund our money for the food we never received! Don't waste your time or money!

​I visited McKendrick's Steak House for my 25th birthday on October 6th, 2018. This was my first time here, and I have always wanted to visit the restaurant after seeing it a few times while at Cafe Intermezzo. First of all, my party was 15 people, we called ahead and made sure we had a reservation. Upon arriving, everything​ was perfect. The food, the staff, and the atmosphere. I loved the restaurant. When it was time to pay our bill, our waiter returned with the entire party's bill on one check. We quickly clarified this issue, and we did. The waiter proceeded to snatch the check​ back and stormed off. After that episode, we never saw him again. ANOTHER staff member appeared with the spilt checks, which were still incorrect. She was very calm and friendly. It ruined my evening that the waiter was angry over some miscommunication​. When serving a party of 15 people, one should always ask how the check will be paid. It is November now, and I still think of how my 25th birthday was ruined because​ of that waiter. I will not be visiting Mckendrick's again.

At first glance the all you can eat menu didn't look too bad. For 10$ all you can eat my expectations aren't high to say the least. And obviously the servers are cranky but what else is new. So, we are getting ready to order and watching food arrive at other tables. This proved to be a seriously unappetizing experience. Exhibit A: Green sticky barf noodles in a stained glass bowl. Exhibit B: Oozing oyster boogers on dirty chipped plates. Me and my friend realized we need to skip this experience shortly after. Inspecting the menu outside and sitting down at a booth obviously shows a level of commitment that I felt uneasy not following through on. However, for my health I decided I better skip out on this one. The server didn't seem surprised in the least. Guess that happens a lot at this establishment. People sit down, realize this may be the demise of their bowl function and leave. Good luck to the people that decide to come here. :)

I use to go here for the prime rib and steaks.  Went last week on a Saturday  night and ordered the Cowboy Prime Rib.  Waites awhile for my salad and when I got it, it was wrong.  I waited again and finally  got my prime rib.  It did not look very good.  It was very thin and over cooked.  The bartender sent it back and i got another one.  Just as bad.  Not sure if it was really prime rib.  I am done and will never go back.  I did not even get to eat dinner.  So i went straight to Beavercreek Saloon and had a great meal.

During my 3 day stay here my privacy rights were violated, I was placed in an extremely traumatizing situation that should never have happened and several times they tried to give me medication that interacted dangerously with another of my medications. The staff were rude, condescending, unprofessional and dangerously incompetent. There is no counseling while you are in there. They just try to dope you up with medications and tried to make me have ECT without knowing much of my history. I am a Registered nurse and I was very scared and extremely disappointed with my experience there.

I would never come back here again. Completely disrespectful and the manager has the odasity to say to us  that the customers were complaining about my toddler. I asked him what would you like do me to do? Mind you, we were dining on a Thursday and their were five tables with patrons.... The manager had no skills and should never be a manager if he is unable to diffuse a customer complaint. I have dined here many times and never felt discriminated in this way. It's a family restaurant that has high chairs. We were so uncomfortable that we lost our appetite and didn't even order desert. Btw, our bill was over 200.00. This restaurant just lost two amazing customers.

I DON'T GET IT!

Since we were just a few miles away, we thought that we would visit the much talked about Krog market.  This was the perfect day to visit because the market was not crowded and there was plenty of available parking.  I guess you have to be from the area to really appreciate this market. 

After all of the talk about Krog market, I expected this huge structure with plenty of stores, (including produce markets) and great products.  This wasn't the case.  It turned out to be this very small over-priced  market with a couple of restaurants, a meat market,  a flower shop, bakery, gift shop, an open bar and some other businesses.  

People actually recommend this as a tourist stop and if someone duped me into coming here during a trip to Atlanta, I would be livid!  It was absolutely the biggest waste of our time today and we are just grateful that we did not have to pay for parking.

One and done!


***  The meat in the meat market window was brown and spoiled.
       
***   The bakery items my husband ordered were inedible, sausage pastry was heavy, salty and dry, that butter almond cake was more of a heavy, tasteless lard cake.

8/19/2016 Although this is the year of second chances for some of  those businesses awarded one star, this one is not on the list.  I am still paying for this mistake, (my Ishtar) because when my husband wants to win an argument, he only needs to remind me that I "dragged" him to Krog market and I automatically lose.  Thanks, Krog!

My husband and I visited American Cut last Friday night after work. I remember my first time as a very pleasant one because the food was just wonderful! - I ordered Wagyu steak and my friends and I ordered lobster to share for the table; it was prepared perfectly. Experience was great.

This time, it was just so BAD. :( I was so sad that it was my hubby's first time to AC. - He said NEVER again.. :(
We ordered 40oz. bone-in ribeye for 2ppl, something called chop. It was rare. - We wanted medium rare. Then our sides came out and one of them was incorrect.... We ordered potato purée and the sweet potato thing came out. Asparagus was just terrible.. 
We were there pretty close to a closing time, so we didn't want to be difficult. - We felt even guilty to correct things. (We should've. Honestly) 
I think they were short on staff as the bartender guy served us at the booth. - He was great btw..

I mean.... it was less than mediocre... We spent $220-ish, and we are about done with American Cut. This makes me very sad cause it has very cool ambience. I wonder why the quality went down just significantly..

When Dr. Browning as a PCP it was worthwhile, but now that he has moved into urget care, I would avoid it like the plague.  Today was the straw that broke the camel's back when I had a 3p appt and after being on time and waiting 1 hour, I was still not called up.  I went up to the front desk to let them know I couldn't wait any longer and right as I walked out I heard them call my name.  Absolutely terrible to have a 3p appt and make someone wait an hour, not to mention when they bring you back you have to wait another 30 mins before you actually see the doctor.

It's funny they will charge you a visit (and they almost were going to charge me when I had to leave) if you are late more than 15 mins, but they won't make your visit free if you have to wait over an hour past your appt to see the doctor.

I called last night to schedule a massage. I asked for an email confirmation, which they never provided. This morning a couple things came up so I called to reschedule it. The "Owner" answered and I said "I won't be able to make it, and I need to reschedule." He replied, "You will have to schedule future massages with a credit card," and HUNG UP THE PHONE! I called back immediately and no one answered. On the third attempt a girl answered and she said the owner was gone, I asked for his name and she said he was gone for the day and HUNG UP! So I call back several times and then another guy answers. He says he isn't the owner, he's not helping me, and says if I call back he is reporting me to Cobb county, then... you guessed it HE HUNG UP THE PHONE.

Please save yourself time and ,money and stay far away from this poor excuse for a business.

Came here with my little brother on a Friday for lunch, it was a 5-10 minute wait for a table of two.  We ordered the mini juicy pork dumplings, beef and string beans, and sauteed beef with okra (don't order beef and string beans if you are hoping to eat beef).

The Good: 
 My brother thought the dumplings were okay, not bad, but not great either. I thought the sauteed beef was decent but my brother said "the flavor was too strong".      

The Bad:
First, a table of two who put down their name after us got seated before us.  Second, they forgot to serve us our rice which came with our meals, not a deal breaker, but serving rice at a Chinese restaurant is pretty basic, and all the other tables got their rice. 

The Ugly:
The server spilled soy sauce all over my brothers pants when the server brought us our meal, he didn't say "sorry" or even a " 对不起 (Mandarin for sorry)" and left with out even trying to help clean up his mistake (they took off $5 from a $25 bill for the spill).

Final Thoughts:
I can't remember the last time I experienced service as bad as this, it was just one mistake after the other.  As a local Chinese American I know this place is over hyped, the only reason we came here was because my brother wanted to try the restaurant so he could write his own yelp review for it.  My brother was not happy that he smelled like soy sauce for the rest of the day.  If you know any better, you will avoid this place.

The worst experience ever when it comes to buying furniture from this place.  It was pleasant when I actually purchased the furniture, but their delivery service was a nightmare.  I had to call at least 15 times to get corrections for multiple things that kept happening and I ended up having to reinburse due to the frustration it caused.  Damaged furniture, not willing to work with you for redelivery even if it was their doing, told it would be delivered one day, but wouldn't show up or didn't have you scheduled after all..even after speaking with supervisors.  Now I have a child that will not enjoy furniture because of the constant inconsistencies their delivery people provide.  Not recommended at all, their delivery is the worst... it's fun to pick out the furniture, but getting it to your house is a horrific challenge.  Now I need to shop elsewhere all because of the terrible delivery service they have.  Your better off admiring what they have, but good luck with delivery to your home if you decide to shop here.

My dinner experience was bad. I ordered "Cut Mirchi" whose description in the menu was "Chilli bajji refried and sprinkled with onions, chat masala". When the dish was served, there were no onions. When I checked with the waiter, he said offered to get me onions and they were onion slices - not the finely diced cubes as they must be. The Mysore Masala that I ordered was not anywhere close to being real. It was yet another Masala Dosa. I enquired about Pesarattu and asked if they serve Ginger Chutney with it - again a basic requirement with this dish - and they didn't have any. 

I went with lot of hopes to get some good home food and came out disappointed. 

I hope that this is an issue with only this outlet. I shall try again elsewhere before I drop this off my list.

Came here last week for a pedicure and made an appointment to have gel mani at the same time. When I got there I told them and no one ever came to do it...so the girl who did my toes did my nails and by that time it was so late I only had time for a mani. When I checked out they tried to charge me $18!!!!! For a manicure and she didn't even give me a hand massage. She was the rudest nail lady I've ever seen. Rolled her eyes at me. Didn't say a word and was just so mean. They gave me $5 off since the manicure wasn't even fully done... won't be back. They also chipped in two days. Here's the photo.

I chose this company based on the good reviews. I left a message through yelp and got a response immediately. We scheduled an appointment for Saturday at 1. He called to say he was on his way. I came out on a Friday for a late lunch with 3 other co-workers around 1:30 pm. We intentionally went a little later to miss the lunch rush so we could get back to work in a decent amount of time. 

The hostess was pleasant and sat us promptly.

After that it was like being in the Twilight Zone. One of my co-workers ordered one of their featured wine spritzer drinks from the bar, the rest of us got fountain drinks. We sat there for at least 20 minutes between the time our drink orders were taken and we actually received the drinks. 
At this point I start getting nervous, because we'd already used 30 minutes including driving time of our 1 hour lunch, and we hadn't even ordered the food yet.

Another ten minutes went by, and I had to get up to ask a women,who I think was the assistant manager, if we could please put our orders in, because we were now on a time limit.

About a minute later our waitress finally came to take our order.
It was pretty simple, we all got wings, each a different style or sauce, and a side salad or fries, not rocket science. We also placed one additional order to go for another co-worker who was manning the fort in our absence.

In all seriousness, another 15-20 minutes went by with no food and no sign of our waitress. We flagged over another waitress to get an update. After checking with the kitchen window it turns out our waitress had never put in our order! My co-worker and I were quietly trying to calm each other down to prevent the other one from Hulking out at the table.

Finally the general manager came over to our table after we had literally been there for over an hour. He was clearly beside himself about the situation, apologizing profusely and telling us that our entire meal with the exception of alcohol would be comped.

Meanwhile we still had not received our food, and were praying that we all still had jobs (we called in late, of course).

When the food came, all I can say is it was not the saving grace I was hoping for. MY WINGS STILL HAD FEATHER HAIRS ON THEM. My co-workers were equally unimpressed with the food.  I ate 3 of my 10 wings and did not bother to get the rest to go, no way was I going to eat anymore now or later.

All in all we walked out of there with about $75 worth of comped food, and of course tipped nothing (this is probably the only time in my life I have ever not tipped). We never did see our waitress again after she  took our food order, and the bill was registered under her name. 

From the time we left work which is about 10 minutes away to the time we got back it had been about 2 and a half, almost 3 hours. Our bosses were flabbergasted, but luckily we live to work another day. I have definitely crossed this location off of my go-to lunch spots. NO WAY. 

I will say the manager did handle it as best he could once it was brought to his attention, but after the food was horrible to boot, so not worth it.
