Three dollars to add mushrooms to an omelette, are you kidding me? This place used to be our favorite brunch spot in Portland. The ingredients were fresh, the menu was creative and the staff were very friendly. Now, the entire staff has turned over, which is not a good sign of management. The menu is now hit and miss in terms of quality. We've began going other places, but received a gift card from a friend. The portions are now mediocre overpriced. They charge $4 for five slices of paper thin pear and call it a "plate". It goes on and on. To charge three dollars to add a couple of mushrooms to an omelette is the nail in the coffin. We'll never come back here.

Too bad the lowest rating is 1 star... have visited the Mall 205 location four times in the last 1.5 years. Three of those four times we entered the door, looked around, wait staff was usually in the back yaking it up, sign said to seat yourself so we did. These were always "off hours" when they weren't busy. Wait... wait... finally another customer would come in and immediately someone would jump into action giving them water and a menu, yet still ignoring us. Two of those three times we walked out. Will NEVER EVER visit this location again - why would someone want to be insulted? We are a senior couple, nicely dressed and groomed, very presentable and very friendly. The McMenamins staff & management at Highland Drive love us, as well as all our other regular restaurants. So instead of eating at a location practically within walking distance, we drive 7 miles to enjoy the food.

This is the worst Airline ever.  Flight Crew ride and obnoxious, as well as the check in crew.    They won't even serve water unless you pay for it.  Plane send to be built cheap, seats are then piece of plastic with a very tiny cushion, very uncomfortable.   I'm on the plane now, never again. Carry on bags to pit above $40.00 dollars.  By the time you check in a bag, get your peanuts or cookie and half a can of soda, you paid more money than a good first rate Airline.   Never again.

Portland style were you have to pay before you get your food while you have plenty of staff around. You have to tip before you experience the food (the option is not coming back I guess).

We ordered 4 tacos, which in average was $4 each. The chorizo and lamb were good (not $4 good) the two others extremely bland (one was El pastor, can't remember the last). You only get on taco shell, they get soggy and break... That's why you usually get two shells: the second hold everything together. Some of the shels were hard and dry.

$4 barely warm chips.

$6 Negro Modelo on tap? Seriously you can get half a case.

Overall: overpriced all around, 50/50 on the 4 tacos is not a good ratio. We were still hungry but we could not be bothered to go back to the waiting line to order more food, we went somewhere instead (and very likely not to come back).

I had better tacos at Don Pedro for $1.50 each.

Went to this location today for a late lunch. After a wait (there were only maybe 8 tables seated once we were taken back) we were walked to a dirty table, passing multiple tables covered with dirty plates, napkins and half eaten food. In the 45 minutes we were there a server attempted to "clean" by bringing a garbage bag to a table and tossing items inside while customers sat and watched, ultimately stopping half way through and walking away. At no point were plates or cups taken to the back nor were tables wiped down. Once getting our food (our orders wrong) we proceeded to wait an additional 20 minutes for our check. I've served and worked in the service industry for a long time and have never seen anything at this level (a manager openly chewing on food while serving food to a table of guests, multiple people walking past dirty tables, etc) . If I could give it zero stars I would.

Up until the delivery of my appliance, a fridge purchase on June 9th, I would have given them 5 stars. They were friendly helpful and offered a nice level of service coming from a small family business. I do my best to support small local businesses whenever possible. 

Unfortunately that is where the positives end. Upon delivery of my fridge, I instructed the drivers to go through my back door, since kitchen is adjacent. They decided to not follow my advice, so I quickly placed carpet runners down to protect the floors to the kitchen. They removed the carpet runners and consequently my home was damaged. The hand truck gouged the wood floor in my foyer, and also cut a v shape of about 4 inches long in my linoleum in the kitchen. Again, I wish I could give them stars for making the best out of a bad situation by quickly remedying it. As of today, Sept 14th, I still have these damages, and what has happened between then and today has been a whole lot of headache. 

I reported the damage and sent photos in that day, June 9th. By the end of the month I was instructed to pick out a new kitchen pattern since the only way to repair it is to replace the floor. I was given the contact information of the person they hired to install the new kitchen flooring (which hadn't been ordered at that time. 

This person they hired opened up a whole new type of headache: at the very best he was a flake. He made arrangements to come install the flooring on three separate occassions, and he no showed each time. At the worst, he was nightmarishly unprofessional. He sent long, hypercasual text messages asking me when he was going to get paid, (I wasn't paying him) sometimes at 9pm on Sunday. When I did hear from him, hours or days after the appointment he failed to show for,  instead of saying "sorry I need to reschedule I was injured" he actually sent me graphic pictures of his injuries. After several weeks of this and his third time not showing up to an appointment, I finally asked Appliance Ranchers to hire someone else and to give me a set date when the repairs would be made. I have decided to break my silence since I believe over 90 days is too long to wait for such a simple repair. They are now in the process of finding someone else, and while the owner has been in communication with me, I know that he could have gotten this done months ago if he actually wanted to.

When I took my Chevy HHR 2006 to this shop, it had one minor issue that didn't interfere with the car's driveability, but despite giving them, in total, nearly $3,000 for "preventative maintenance" and then a for number of new issues that came up almost immediately after they gave me back my car each time, I ended up having to get my car towed to a different shop within three weeks of getting it back from them, and paying that shop another $800.

The first time I took my car to this shop I think I told them the car shakes at high speeds and just doesn't run as smoothly as I'd like. Other than that, the car worked just fine, and there was no check engine light on. They told me to leave the car with them so they could make a determination as to what, if anything, was wrong with the car. I get a call around noon, from a mechanic who seemed very alarmed, telling me I needed $1800 in repairs. I was astonished, because as I said before, the car ran fine and I had no noticeable indication that it was about to break down at any second. The mechanic convinced me that all the things he suggested were really important and if I wanted to prevent breaking down in the middle of nowhere soon one day I should take care of the issues now. Maybe I was gullible, but I believed him and bitterly gave him almost $2000 to "fix" my car. Once I got my car back, I was expecting it to run like brand new and thought I wouldn't have to think about it again for a long while. That is not what happened.

Within a couple of days I noticed the car was shaking like before, and I called to let them know. They told me to bring it back to check on it, but I'm busy, and I was already bitter about the $2000 I spent before, so just decided to live with it. But then, something new happened. About three weeks after getting the car back the check engine light came on. I was pissed, because I JUST gave these people $2,000 to "fix" my working car that had never had a check engine light before, and now the check engine light was on. I continued to put off taking it back to them for awhile, until I had got a flat tire (with no spare). They put on new tires for me the last time, so i figured I'd take it back to them to fix the tire and figure out what was going with the check engine light.

I left the car with them, to get a call explaining I had a whole NEW SET of problems that was causing the check engine light to turn on. I'm confused because I gave them my car no more than a couple months before and when they did their check of everything that "needed" to be repaired, none of these new problems were brought up. I say this to the mechanic, and he accuses me of being aggressive and confrontational (maybe I was, but I was pissed). They again tell me these new problems need to be fixed right away, or my car would be at risk for breaking own. This time it costs like $200 to repair. I pay the money. They called me to get my car and warned me that the car wouldn't sound right for a bit because of the issue had been occurring for so long, i.e., the month and half since I got the car back originally. I don't know anything about cars, so I take their word for it.  I start the car to leave the lot and it sounded at bit funny, but since they warned me, I just left and assumed it would clear up as they said.

I kid you not, the NEXT DAY, I went to start my car, it would not start - not even a flicker. I call them and explain what was going on and they tell me I must have had an old battery. I'm livid. I said there was nothing wrong with my battery when I took it to them yesterday. They tell me batteries can go bad at any time. Later that day, I ask one of my neighbors to give me a jump, and he explains that it couldn't be the battery b/c the radio still worked and the headlights came on (of course!). The following morning I call them back an tell them it's not the battery.  They have someone tow it to them, at their expense. I get a call back later that morning telling me the starter had gone bad. They won't charge me for the labor but the part cost like $500, which I would have to pay for. I was like hell no! 

At this point, I'm angry as hell, and my husband who is in Tallahassee has to call to intervene. He says its not worth the fight and decides to pay for the starter (I disagreed vehemently). They replace the starter, my husband pays them, and I take the car back from them. 

Within three days, the check engine light was on again. I'm totally frustrated, and just ignore it, until three weeks later the car doesn't start again. This time it makes the noise as if it wants to start, but doesn't. At this point, I want to tow the car back to Orlando Import Auto Specialists, just so I can burn the car and the place down at the same time. 

Of course I didn't do that, nor did I call them again, b/c I'm not that much of an idiot. I found another shop who told me the computer had went bad, and charged me $800 to fix it.

Our reservation was for six at 6:30pm on Saturday night. We explained that we were having a Birthday celebration dinner. We were seated upstairs promptly. The place was packed. After a round of drinks we ordered three appetizers. Disappointment began with the appetizers. The Crab Cakes were dried out without flavor or any crabmeat of note. Our meatballs were better or at least adequate but once again very bland. The main courses were big misses. The fish medley dish served to my wife had but two non-descript shrimps. The lobster tail was mush and tasteless. The Calamari was everywhere but not tasty as  were the mussels. The serving dish was too small to deal with the contents.  All the plates were too small. The lighting was overly dim but I could still see a roach on the wall moving ever so slowly. My Filet Mignon was excellent cooked perfectly and quite substantial for its $46 price tag. The Gnocchetti Sorrentina was way below expectations totally flavorless. My Bernaisse Sauce never came out. My daughter-in-law's side vegetable likewise never was served but appeared on the check. The server was rude and pretentious and unattentive from the outset to the conclusion. This was my first and last meal at Bricco. Expansively expensive for what was placed before us. Only the Filet passed muster. No one at our table will ever return. Friends will be duly warned of what not to expect.

Spent $90 on 3 pizzas, a salad and apps. The salad was great my friend said so that's where the one star came from. The pizzas had so much greasy thick cheese on top on a hard crusty pizza that when you picked up a sliced it would crumble and becomes a greasy mess. It wasn't worth the money or the stomach ache I'm still dealing with this morning. If you want a quality pizza keep looking cause you won't find it here

This place does NOT have rapid COVID testing. I called to see how to get tested since I never have before. They told me to come at 7:45am and I would get my results while I sat there. I needed this for work. I waited an hour, spoke with Dr. Okpara only to be informed that not only do they not have rapid covid testing, but they don't even have the capability to do them in their lab (due to a shortage of tests...first I've heard of that) and had to ship them off to Baylor Scott and White for 48-72 hour turn around. So not rapid. Save yourself the hassle of waiting in a long line, getting misinformation and dealing with an incredibly rude director of operations.

I came here as a part of a group of 6 people. The first sign that we should have left was- we were there when they told us to be and watched as 3 employees took over 15 minutes to clean and push together 3 small tables. Everyone was irritated. 

We were finally seated and the menu items look pretty delicious. Our drink order is taken and filled pretty quickly but then we sat around waiting for someone to take our food order for a bit. We were told that they were out of potatoes - which are included in just about every dish- and offered NO substitute. Um ok? So I'm paying 18$ for an omelette and lemony greens. 

Our food finally comes and I'm already upset at the look at of it. I have the smallest omelette I've ever seen laying on a bed of lemony greens. I take a bite of said greens and holy crap- when they say lemony they MEAN lemony. It was AGGRESSIVE! Like, canker sore inducing sourness. My omelet was mediocre and also- 5$ for toast with jam? Really? 

I mean we all left angry and somehow hungry. That's what we get for trying a place like this. The ambiance and decor of this place was also bleh.

We visited Pizzeria Vetri when it opened about a year ago and one other time since. Initially, we were very impressed with the food and service. Not anymore. Food has definitely deteriorated and the service is horrible. The atmosphere in the restaurant has also taken a turn for the worse. One employee insisted on playing her music and cranked up the volume so loud we couldn't even carry on a conversation. We probably won't go back. If you're considering Pizzeria Vetri, don't waste your time and money.

We came here with my friend to help her get a car.  We asked the salesman if there was more space for negotiation.  Then the manager came.  My husband asked if he could tell us why they priced the car much higher than the KBB price.  Then the manager didn't answer the question and started talking to my friend , " we are good people.  And I can tell you in your face that this guy is a JERK.( pointing at my husband)  You are buying a car and he is ruining your deal. ". 

I don't understand what kind of salesman/ manager would call the customer 'JERK '.  Please don't go to this car dealer.  The manager is very rude.  Dealing with him will ruin your whole day!!!!

I was looking for 24/hour dry cleaning for a wedding. I had a perfectly clean dress that I needed pressed and One-Stop was just right down the street. Upon retrieving my dress and boyfriends tie I was horrified to see they both were ruined. The lady at the counter even acknowledged the fact that my dress had spots all over it. She still charged me and told me to bring it back and she would fix it but couldn't have it in time for the wedding. Long story short, I paid another dry clean service 20 to fix my garments. Wish I'd asked my friends in advance...seems this wasn't the first time! Look elsewhere for service.

I will never give them work again they broke trim on my truck and didnt replace it the paint job looked like crap they spent almost a week longer on the job then I had to bring it back for touch up said it would be only a day and it took three days so please dont go to this shop they will bend you over im stuck spending a extra 500 to have someone make there crappy paint job look good

We had a bad experience. I loved this place before. We ordered and they brought us the wrong meal after we had waited over 40 minutes for breakfast. So they went to re-do it. We waited over 30 more minutes. I totally get when people make mistakes and that's fine, but they didn't do anything to make it better. They could have brought more taster waffles or free coffee or given us a discount for the wait. Nothing. Our waitress Amber brought the bill for full price after that long wait. She said sorry. They include a 20% automatic gratuity. No discount or free juice. Customer service here is terrible. If they had done anything I would have given 5 stars, but nothing. Food was great, but no customer service. I guess we will stick to our favorite, Fat City In Multnomah Village. They have awesome service.

I honestly was hoping I didn't have to do this,...but I think you need to be warned!  I really do hate that I have to write this review because my initial impression when I walked into SK Northwest was really positive.  

Well in February I purchased a Can-Am Spyder from a private party with 3100 miles.  It was time for the 3000 mile oil change and inspection, so I researched the local dealers that could perform service.  Needless to say, all the dealers in the Portland/Vancouver area had really bad ratings so I just picked SK Northwest.  I really hoped my experience was going to be great because the folks there were nice and the facility was clean and organized.  However, when I received my Spyder back from service, a couple things were extremely wrong. When I got home I noticed that one of the body panels were cracked.  I called SK and naturally the service manager told me they didn't do it and I had the option to bring it back in so they could tell me to my face they didn't do it.  Ok, I have zero proof that they did it but it's a stress fracture and,...they did it (I'm a material science engineer,...28 years, beside the point) looks like I'll have to eat the $249 repair!  Secondly, the the left fog lamp didn't turn on.  Just tonight, after spending a couple hours researching this on YouTube, I took a panel off that exposed the wires to the headlamps on the left side of the Spyder.  Low and behold, they didn't reconnect wires when they took the panel off to change the oil and filter (if they even did that!).  

I'm a stickler about quality and safety and I take pride in my work to ensure quality and safety is a design fundamental.  If SK NW is going to be in the business of repairing state of the art motor vehicles, it's imperative that quality workmanship and safety consciousness be at the forefront of their service business model!  Based on my experience with SK NW, it makes me wonder what else they forgot to do.  I would hate to experience an SK NW catastrophic failure on my 3 wheeled vehicle at 60mph not to mention the countless 2 wheeled vehicles they've serviced in just the last 30 days.

This is for potential customers of SK Northwest.  I paid $325 for them to essentially cost me an additional $249 damage to my Spyder.  Hopefully I can reconnect the fog lamp wires but one would think that would have been included in the $325 oil and filter change? 

One more quick note.  My wife actually asked the Service Manager, "why are your Yelp ratings so low?".  He said, "There was a person at their shop that no longer works there.  And a couple customers were dissatisfied and tried to put the blame back on us".  SK, I think you terminated the wrong person or not enough people!  Well, at this point I'm not going to argue with the service manager about the damage to my Spyder nor my POOR CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE.  I'm going to have my Spyder re-serviced by a reputable dealer to ensure it's safe.  Additionally I'm going to help you SK NW by writing Can-Am Corporate to request they audit your ability to service their products!  

Check out the pics!

So last Sunday night we wanted to have some cherrystones and a few drinks.  Legals is in waking distance to where we live and has an outdoor bar, so it was our #1 choice in the neighborhood.  Usually the inside service for shellfish at this Legals location is good, and before heading down to the outdoor bar we confirmed with the indoor staff that raw bar was available outdoors.  They confirmed it was.  Great we thought.  Rawbar outside on a beautiful summer night.  Heaven!  So we head down to the outdoor bar, which bar is indeed a rare offering in Harvard Square.   We sat right down at the bar and ordered 18 cherrystones and 2 draft beers.  The service was initially attentive and our order was taken right away.  Off to a great start.... so we thought.   Our beers were served promptly and every thing was A OK. 20 minutes passed, we finished our beers with no sign or mention of the raw bar order.  Our waiter Ryan had disappeared, so we asked someone who looked like a manager to check on the status of our cherrystones.  All he could say was "I'll get your waiter."  Lazy and poor response we thought.   Ryan resurfaced, apologized and said "I'll call upstairs" which he did right away.  He came back to say they were backed up in the kitchen but they should not be much longer.  25 minutes after we had placed our order, the rawbar planner was delivered by a lady from upstairs.  She said "sorry for the long wait, these are on us."   A nice gesture, and the least they could do we thought, but what was on the platter were 18 littlenecks and not even the cherrystones we actually ordered.  If you know anything about shellfish, there is a world of difference!   Roger B. blows it again.  Not our first underwhelming and disappointing experience at Legals.  Not sure why we keep going back.  Something about the definition of insanity, doing the same thing over and over and expecting a different result...

Beside the view on the lake, Hula Hut has gone down hill over the past few years. We use to wait an hour for great service. The last few times the service has been horrible. We had to clean our own table to sit down, we had to call the waitress a number of times, we got our own chips, and had to wait for smaller drinks than before. The past 3 times we've gone there, we've waited on ourselves to be seated? How rediculous is that. There are too many nice places on the lake to eat than, having to put up with that. Plus their new billing system, who can read their 4 inch screens? I'll pass next time.

My wife and I went in to see if we liked the place before getting lunch there. We were greeted by a very unfriendly man who told us that "there are pictures online" and he didn't like people just looking around. We had never been there before and lunch prices were not cheap so we wanted to make sure we liked the place before sitting down.

I was hoping to like the place. It looked cute inside but I certainly can't eat where I don't feel welcomed.

First Time to this place to eat. Place was clean. The people that work there was nice. The food was terrible. My husband ask yo have fried rice instead of the white or brown rice that came with it. The waitress said we could not. We had to buy a dinner of the fried rice with chicken or another type of meat.  My husband ask her if he could pay the difference and get the fried rice. Again she said no we have to buy the meal. My husband got his meal with brown rice. He did not care for his meal. I got the crab fried rice which came with shrimp (no mention of that on menu) the fried rice was not good. The rice had no flavor and was gummy. The brown rice my husband got actually tasted better than the fried rice. I don't think we will be back. Sad because we were looking forward to a  Thai place close to home.

So disappointed!  Their food is pretty good - when they get it right.  I work near this cafe and sometimes order for pickup.  They don't seem to be able to consistently assemble The Caruso.  Can't be that hard right? tomato, mozarella, proscuitto, pesto - Voila!  Apparently it is.  First couple times they left off the tomato.  This time, they seem to have forgotten the proscuitto and decided turkey/ham was a good replacement.  

Talked to the Owner, Teri, about the inconsistency and she was fantastic. Addressed the issue.  A couple months later, back I go and this time received a tomato, mozarella, pesto, DELI HAM Caruso??? Don't bother reporting this problem if Owner Alex is there.  So the turkey/ham in my panini was just a "special proscuitto shipment".  Riiiight.  

Just accept the mistake and move along.  He'll shrug it off, make sure you know that he makes no mistakes, and try to get you to quickly pay and get outta there.

I'd give 0 stars if I could, SIMPLY for the rudeness.  But, Teri was amazingly sweet so it offset the 0.  The annoyances of worrying about a wrong order or bad service (from the owner) are just not worth dealing with.

Don't use their Groupon promotion. It is very deceptive, if not fraudulent.

I bought lipo-cavitation treatment thru Groupon. Spa's web site promises it may take a few hours or a day to get a treatment. In reality, no appointments on line are available for over a month. I talked with Sherrie on the phone and she found an appointment  in three weeks. 

So, I cancelled the Groupon purchase. It appears that they are not making any effort to honor their commitment to easy appointments. It makes me wonder if they are over committing about their services and the results they promise.

Went with 3 others for lunch. Decor was nice. Ordered beet salad..
 Small salad, with about 7 leaves of spinach, a small Spoon of goat chess, a few flat pecans, For $13? Added 4 shrimp $9. Wouldn't fill a kid, never mind adults. Decided to have a veg. Panini and split it 3 ways Came burnt and small.  Lucky to get a piece about an inch wide. They did give us a small piece of cake free because the panini was so bad. We all said we would never go back. Small portion. And expensive.sick of getting ripped off in restaurants.

When I reserved a cab several days in advance, my assumption was that it would arrive. After calling numerous times (for 40 minutes!!!) and getting the same response.."No cab has responded" which means " no cab is coming your way and we can't tell you if and when one will arrive"...I was upset. I live in Central Austin, and the ride was to the airport!  How many folks have missed flights because of a no-show taxi? I will never use them again.

Cannot believe the rude and arrogant salesperson Corey at this site.  We had purposely made an appointment to test drive a G-Wagon and were prepared to purchase that day.  Corey texted us asking if we would be on time - we texted back "yes".  When we got to the dealership on time, Corey was no where to be found. His assistant dropped us at his desk - 18 minutes later Corey was still a no show and no one had checked on us. We walked out and were not even contacted by the dealer until my husband sent a text. I guess business must be good.  It is sad bc I have done business at this Mercedes dealer in the past but my husband has written them off 100%.  Look elsewhere if you want to feel like you are a valued customer.

I was completely dissatisfied with Leather Menders and can not recommend them based on my experience.  First of all the shop is difficult to find even with Google maps and a GPS because they have no signage outside.  It took almost 3 weeks to do a simple couch cushion repair that they said would take one week.  The work is completely shoddy and looks like they spent 30 seconds on it.  The stitching was very crooked, the fabric was not cut evenly or straight, they used tan stitching on a dark brown cushion, which should have been matched brown, and they left messy glue on the fabric.  I paid way too much for something I could have done better myself without any experience in upholstery repair.

Had an appt and they did not work for 1 hr. Asked to start diag after 1 hr and they figured out they don't work because it did get  enough money with their time. Extremely disappointed in this place. As I was walking up to the building, the owner met me outside and would not allow me to even step foot in the building because I had a "pitbull." Ive never been turned away from a place because of my dog's assumed breed. He is a harmless Staffordshire Terrier - NOT A "PITBULL" - (which isn't even a breed). This is so wrong to discriminate against these animals! DO NOT SUPPORT THIS PREJUDICE BUSINESS AND THEIR UNLAWFUL PRACTICES!!!

DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY
during a recent move from boston to miami, with a month of storage in ft. lauderdale, many items of furniture were severely damaged. company refuses to accept the insurance claim. also had problems dealing with the florida branch of the company in regard to billing. nearly every piece of furniture had some damage ranging from nicks and scratches to extensive gouges and breakage. one box arrived soaking wet as if it had been sitting in water. although all of my stuff arrived an extra item belonging to someone else was also left. when i called to have them pick it up so it could be delivered to the rightful owner they told me not to bother! so whoever was moved before me is missing a piece of their furniture! After much research I was impressed by the 2 page ad in the yellow pages that proclaimed this company to be specialists in Boston-Florida moves....DO NOT BE FOOLED! I will never use this company again and hope that whoever is reading this takes care.

Wanted to sit outside, took forever to wait. Then, once we were outside, they promised they'd push two tables together. All the tables emptied but they never cleaned them off, to give us more room. I had to go in and ask for a cocktail menu, they didn't give us one.

Server took 20 mins to even show up, we asked if they would close the blinds, never did. They forgot my drink even though everyone else got theirs. 

Food took even longer, they are understaffed and every response to a request was, "yea, just give me a minute." Hence, nothing ever happened. 

Food took almost an hour to get, even though we ordered immediately. My burger was burnt to a crisp. Overall bad service, wasn't clean, food was subpar. Had to go inside to get check processed, because we got no service. DO NOT GO!

I now understand why you only have 2 stars ordered cookies on Saturday for same day delivery. After calling several times that day there was no response. 3 days later I got a phone call. My credit card wouldn't go thru. Damn right I canceled the card. So it wouldn't get processed that's how angry I was. I bought this bed because of extreme back pain from my old mattress. It took two weeks to arrive. It came broken. The Firmness wouldn't adjust and I was stuck on something worse than my old mattress. Yesterday I used a groupon that I had a very poor experience with and is now leading me to see a dentist to try and correct what happened. I'm just going to tell you the situation in full so hopefully this won't happen to anyone else. 

First off, the establishment listed, "Million Dollar Smile," is located inside of another place. The number listed rings and then leads to you an automated system... which then proceeds to hang up on you. I called it multiple times. After wandering around for ten minutes I entered the salon by chance to ask them if they knew where Million Dollar Smile was. The woman, doing someone's hair, told me to sit and wait because the person that was supposed to do my appointment went on break. I told her that I tried to call but the number listed and no one answered. She laughed and told me no one answered that phone. Okay... So she gave me the person's card that was supposed to be handling my appointment and told me to call her to let her know I was there. I called her and she let me know she would be there in five minutes. So I sat and waited. When she walked in she let me know that it would take her a couple minutes to get set up and I should wait where I am. When she came back out, she led me to her "office". The office was a small, dirty room. This is when I should have walked out. But she hurried me in to lay down on this chair. She then asked me if I had ever used whitening strips before and I told her I had been to the dentist where they whitened my teeth. She seemed confused by my answer and asked if I had ever used the whitening strips and I told her yes. She didn't probe any further. She squirted some gel into a mouth tray and told me that this wasn't going to be comfortable but to wait for a couple of minutes and it would go away. I trusted her and so I let her put the tray into my mouth. She let me know that she would let me sit for twenty minutes, then we would take a break, and do another twenty minutes of the treatment. It did sting pretty bad, but since she told me it would go away I didn't say anything. She set the timer on the light for ten minutes, put it over my mouth, and left. 

By the time the ten minutes was up, it was still stinging. She came in once to reset the timer for another ten minutes and left before I could say anything. 

The ten minutes is up again. This is when I was supposed to take a break- one that I really wanted because it was very uncomfortable. She came in, talking on the phone, reset the timer, and left again. 

Another eight minutes goes by. She comes into the room and by this time I'm trying to get her attention. I want this stuff out of my mouth, it's really starting to hurt. She takes the light off my my teeth and I take out the tray. She asks me if I want to rinse and gives me some water. I take it gratefully and as soon as that stuff is out of my mouth I feel a lot better. Then I take a look at my teeth in the mirror, and I'm floored. There are white spots all over them! My teeth were a little uneven before, but this is bad. It looks like it didn't whiten my teeth at all, except in those tiny white spots. 

At this point, I'm pretty upset and I tell her that if it's going to make those spots even worse, I don't want to do that last ten minute session. She lets me know that it wasn't her fault. If my teeth were uneven before, It was only going to make them worse. Which is confusing, because guess what? I've had my teeth whitened before, and i've never had them look like this. Either way, I wasn't letting her touch my mouth again. I let her know that I didn't want to do the last session and she asked me for my voucher from groupon. I gave it to her and she said thank you and have a nice day. I told her that the groupon came with a whitening pen as well so she went to get that. At this point I just wanted to get out of there so I took the pen and walked out. To top it off, this morning I brushed my teeth and half of my gums came off with my toothbrush. This is dangerous and now I'm in a lot of pain! I have no idea why I paid 78 dollars for this. 

As you can see, it's a long story. But long story short, this woman should not be able to do groupons anymore! She has no idea what she's doing and now I'm going to have to pay either a doctor or a dentist to look at my mouth to make sure I didn't do any serious damage. I do NOT want this to happen to anyone else!

I met these guys at Barton Creek Farmers Market. The sales guy, Dale, was very nice. They are a contractor & I need my house painted & gutters installed. He came out & gave me an estimate. The bid was fine, but I was running pretty busy & did not have the time in the summer to get the work done. 

In November, he approached me with a sweetener. They were slow & they "pay the crew even if they are not busy." This was enticing to me & they could start right after Thanksgiving. Great I said. He quickly came to my house to get me to sign a contract & took a 50% deposit on the agreed price. That was the last nice exchange I recall.

Maybe they are having growing pains. Maybe they hire people who should not be working with the public or are not qualified to do the job at hand. Maybe they hire a painter to do brain surgery. Whatever the case, from the paint swatches to the power washing to the repairs, there have been delays, lack of or mis-communication; & more time spent fixing mistakes.

The Nightmare: 

Paint sampling. I picked the colors, but their foreman could not be bothered to get the samples from the paint manufacturer. I had selected Sherman Williams & Kelly Moore Colors to sample. He first brings Home Depot paint, but the samples do not match the swatch. He goes to Sherman Williams for the Kelly Moore color, & again, not the same, but different from last. Then he finally goes to Kelly Moore for their colors & the swatch is closer to the sample. Not a big deal in theory, but it wasted 3 days of cycles just to pick colors & I need those to get HOA approval. 

Weather Delays. That & wasted time delayed the start date to December 18. In 30+ degree weather, they began to power wash my house. Unfortunately, they blasted my newly cleaned windows. 

No Shows & Excuses. People were sick, or they were short handed, so the painter & his worker started on the repairs & purchasing of the materials to do them. One day, I swear there were 5 people outside. There was an issue with wood rot near the back door, & some guy started running the saw with the door open & no sheeting to keep sawdust out of my home. I just had the place cleaned for my Mom's visit. They used the cheapest possible materials to do the repairs & not even siding on the trim, but fence pickets!?!? 

Fed up. On December 21, I kicked them out & said not to come back until after New Years. This circus of bad repairs was stressing me out. I had company & wanted to enjoy the holidays. The repairs would need to be fixed by a carpenter.

More delays. Weather is problematic most of January for painting, but they did not do any repairs either. Someone would randomly arrive to paint & I would send them away & ask them to send a carpenter or someone skilled to fix the repairs. This went on several times. Then they would schedule someone to do the repairs, & they would not show up or call. I got everything from illness, to sick kid in the hospital to no excuse at all. I guess their dog ate their calendar & chewed off the finger that dials the phone too. 

Glimmer of Hope. The repairs were FINALLY done correctly on March 25. In spite of my request to clean up after (nails & debris), I keep finding them & am worried my dogs will end up hurting their paws on them.

Flake Factor. I was told painters would come the next day. No show, no call. The next day, no show, no call. This has been going on over 4 months & I set an expectation early in March that I wanted it done by the end of March (as that would be 4.5 months since we contracted this) or I wanted a full refund. 

Are you kidding me? It is March 27, no show, no call. After a few tries, texts over 2 days, Dale called me back & assured me I am the priority the next 3-day weather window (20% chance of rain tomorrow?!?). I could have done it faster myself with a toothbrush & cotton ball. 

Just get it over with. I may write an update after/if the job is complete. But suffice it to say, I would not recommend these guys.

Only good thing. I like their gutter guy (they sub the work to him) & will likely review him under his own business, so as not to have his reputation mixed in with theirs. 

Do your homework. I have since looked them up. While I can find no reviews that are legit, the BBB gives them an F rating as of now. I should have gone there first. My bad. 

Sigh. So if you come to my house, & I have red swatches all over my front door, I am not waiting for the angel of death to pass over, just for the Lone Star Painters, a division of Saving America Energy to get their act together & finish the job. 

Bad Joke. How many SAE workers does it take to do a 3 day job? When all is said & done, probably 18 people & 6 months :(

Still waiting for The End! ...of job

And I've only driven a couple hundred miles.

I was told she couldnt give me an exact time but if we were there now, we could be sat. We were there in 5 mins. When we walked in, we were told an "all of a sudden hour and 45 min wait at least". I guess its their way of getting people in but in Texas we call that scaming people.

Sign says "truck repair" so when I called to ask if they could work on an rv they said "if it has an engine we can fix it." 3 months and $850 later and my airstream broke down not two miles after leaving their lot.  I don't know if they are just incompetent or intentionally misleading, but they have called me twice now to come pick it up (threatening storage fees the first time) and it hasn't worked either time. Jesse seems earnest but I am incredibly frustrated by their utter lack of concern and indifferent customer service and would not recommend them to anyone.

I just stopped by there for lunch. I did not see whether it was self seating or not so I asked a server passing by. She escorted me at an outside table where 3 other tables were eating. She dropped a menu on the table and walked away saying nothing. I then waited 10min while watching 2 different servers (one of which was the server that sat me) walk by my table 4 times not saying a word to me. During this time I had laid the menu down closed trying signal that I was ready to order. I know many would not allow servers to continually walk by but once it became obvious they were avoiding me, I wanted to see just how bad they would allow it to get. Having only a limited time for lunch, I was forced to leave after 15min. A couple of nice ladies were aware of the situation and apologized to me saying they had no idea what the servers were doing. I enjoy trying new places but unfortunately not all are winners.

This dealership has been one big disappointment.  Aside from NEVER having loaners available (try 2-3 weeks out), the whole experience is shoddy at best.  My favorite was scheduling a service appointment 2 weeks out specifically to get a loaner, only to show up and have Allen tell me I wasn't on the loaner list.  When I asked how long the service would take he said 2-3 hours.  Really?  After kicking around and with MUCH hesitation, he pulled out a key to a loaner.  There was one on the lot!  But it was SUCH an imposition that I wasn't "on the list" he made such a big deal out of it.  Then he mentioned that I wouldn't need to rotate and balance my tires because I will" need to buy new tires" by the end of summer (he did not even look at my tires).  I asked him to please do it as the car was pulling.  A few hours later he called to tell me the car was done.  He repeated that the car didn't appear to be pulling at all so they did not rotate the tires SINCE I would be replacing the tires at the end of summer.  IF I needed new tires, I had no intention of buying them from the dealership.  This on top of several issues I have had that they "could not find" since I've had the car has put a really bad taste in my mouth about Volvo.   I got much better service when I had an Infinity.

I just left the Kyle Target after an online order pick up. Came in with my toddler grandson and Marisol at the guest services grabbed my order for me. She didn't really seem to be speaking clearly or directly to me just sort of offhand mentioned that receipts are emailed. Got the baby and the bags into the car and drove off. Got about halfway there and noticed that it looked like a few things were missing. Drove all the way back, unloaded the baby and the bags and went back in. Marisol is still at the desk and was pretty flippant about the missing items...again saying they would email me anything that they couldn't fulfill. I showed her the clear text I'd received showing my full order was ready. Apparently they couldn't find the calligraphy pen my sister always buys at Target. It would have been soooo helpful if this girl had just mentioned that when she was rushing through my transaction the first time. Then I came to realize that I'd originally added a bunch of things to the order because if you spent $50 they gave you a free gift. Because of the loss of the pen set I was short by $5 which I had just spent in items from the dollar spot and a drink. They omitted the free gift.

Overall this was a super crappy experience but honestly really par for the course at most Kyle stores and restaurants. I'm not sure what's up out here but people lack courtesy, kindness, and consideration for others... and it's super disconcerting and disappointing.

Let me say the only reason i came here is because I just moved, and my previous dry cleaner is very out of the way. It is Monday, I need to pick up my dry cleaning for the week. currently it is 8:10 AM. They are STILL not open, your hours say 7am-7pm?
This is my first visit and will definitely be my last. I need a reliable cleaner, who has integrity to their business. A cleaner who will be open ON time. Very disappointed.

This used to be my go to sushi place, but unfortunately I only go to this one for convenience now. No complaints about the food as it's pretty good for conveyor belt sushi. However, I would go to this place about once a week and always order the same thing. One day I noticed my bill was higher. I let it go. The next couple of times my bill would change, it was always higher when the one lady would check me out. I finally asked the manager why my bill was changing. He stated oh it's because you got a to go order (mind you I always do) and you were charged for the box, he then points to a sign that says you will be charged for to go boxes (insane in my opinion, but it's posted to fine). However, my bill was higher than just a to go box so I asked further. He said oh, you asked for too many sauces (soy sauce, spicy mayo and ginger) so we charged you for them. I asked how that was decided and he said if you get more than 2-3 we charge you. When asked where I could find that information he said um, I guess we should put that somewhere... SERIOUSLY?!?! They were nickeling and dining me, knowing that I provided them a lot of business. Very very disappointed in this place and their management. Treating customers right goes a long way in my book and this was very shady.

Horrible.  Think twice before considering!  We currently rent here and are so dissatisfied with the service and are counting the days until the lease expires.  We have so many issues here that I don't know where to begin.  First, the charge you for "amenities" and then don't provide them.  This place is supposed to be "luxury" living, but it's far from luxury service.  Let's start with security.  The key fobs went weeks, if not months, without working.  So while carrying arms of groceries I had to fumble to find the correct key and struggle to unlock the door.  Meanwhile, resident's got so tired of dealing with this fiasco, so folks were just letting anyone in the building.  Not secure; not impressive!  Second, they have "plenty" of maintenance staff that works here, and they are pretty pleasant and hardworking guys.  However, if you need something done on the weekend.  Not gonna happen.  Example.  After two months of getting a really low (pennies) water bill, they came by (during a weekday, of course, since maintenance doesn't work weekends) and told me they had to perform some sort of maintenance to the meter.  Weeks went by and they left a notice on our door to let us know that they were coming by the next day to perform the work.  Who gives that kind of notice?  Making matters worse, my husband took off the day so he could be here (because who wants a third-party stranger here with their staff alone in your house?).  Unfortunately, not only did they not show up to work, they didn't even call or somehow notify us that they weren't coming.  So late in the day the hub's went to the management office to inquire and was told they ran out of time and would be here the next day.  Fortunately, I had the day off (holiday), so I was the chosen one who got to wait all day for no one to show up.  Again, no notification or call to let us know they were too busy.  Three emails later, on Monday, the management office offered nothing but empty apologies.  This after keeping us waiting and wondering if this was the day the staff would show up.  THESE PEOPLE ARE RUDE.  Parking.  When we first moved here, we paid for an assigned parking spot.  However, someone else continued to park in the spot.  And when we brought this to the attention of the management office, they just brushed it off.  Who does that?  Safety.  the complex next to this one is managed by another national company.  They have a security service that patrols the area.  Not Jefferson at Dedham Station.  I've seen and have taken pictures of a high-end SUV with all the tires removed; made me wonder if it was VANDALIZED. 

And finally.  Much like one of the other posts, I can attest to the fact that they trump up charges after you move out and they deduct those charges from the security deposit.  This was so blatant that I had to file a complaint with the MA Attorney General's Office.

If you plan to go to the o.h. Sports Bar in the Hollywood Casino to watch the game, eat and drink with your friends, you may want to reconsider. They do not allow food in the bar or sports entertainment area on Saturdays. The server said it is only on the weekends. The hostess said you could bring food in from "The Grill" (other side of Casino) but later bar server said she was not correct. No food at all allowed in that section. To be seated in the restaurant section so you can eat and drink, while watching the game, you must have half your party there before you are seated. Tables over four go quite quickly.  But watch carefully as their rules do not seem to apply to everyone. After we were finally seated and crammed into a table for four, it took 30 minutes before our table server waited on us. Do not believe the bar servers who say they will transfer your bar tab over to your table as they come looking for you to close out your bar tab. If their intent is for people to keep moving in the bar area, that was not happening. Later, we saw pizzas and the restaurant menus on bar tables which irritated us as we left a comfortable seating for five in the bar for the crammed table to be able to have food with our drinks, the safer approach. 

Also, the illuminated exit signs in the garage appeared to be for pedestrians and made leaving the garage confusing. 

The cheesecake was excellent, but not worth the overall poor experience. 

Zero out of Five stars! Not recommended as a "Sports Bar".

We have been getting food from Bacci's for a couple years now.  It has been our go-to place for pizza and calzones.  The food was always excellent, they were always very accurate with their delivery estimates, and the person who usually answers the phone was always very polite. Today however was a very different story.  It was the usual person who answered the phone when I called. He was polite as usual, and said the delivery would be in about a half hour. After 50 minutes went by and the driver had not showed up yet, I called to check and make sure there weren't any problems. The same person answered the phone, was polite and said the driver was running into a lot of traffic and would be here momentarily.  I was fine with this as they had always been on time previously. After another 10 minutes went by, I called back to see if they could call and ask the driver where he was and when he thought he would be here. The same person answered, was polite, and called the driver. The driver said it would be another 10 minutes.  Seeing as this would put the delivery at an hour and 10 minutes, plus my concern that the food might be cold, the person who answers the phone said to call him when it was delivered and he would give me a credit the next time we ordered.  After the food got here, I did just that. Only when I called it was not the same usual person who answered the phone.  I explained to the person who answered that the guy who usually answers the phone told me to call and he would give me a credit on our next order. The person who answered said it was not his problem, that he was the owner, and would not give us a credit. I said how that wasn't right, and he gave me a huge attitude and raised his voice and told me never to call again when I let him know how dissatisfied I was. Needless to say I will never be ordering food again from Bacci's. The owner does not deserve any business whatsoever given his extremely poor  customer service and lack of respect for his customers.

Took our dog in for grooming and paid when we left. She was groomed well, but we were called a week later and told that we never paid and just left the shop!  They just said that we owed them $55 and asked for a credit card over the phone. When I said that we wanted to check our credit card first they said this was okay, and then called me and my partner leaving voicemail messages about four additional times insinuating loosely that we were purposely stalling/ did this on purpose. We proved that we did in fact pay and the transaction went through, but they charged us only $16.  

What was the most irritating part of this whole experience was that they kept blaming this on a new hire, when the owner was the person who rang us up.   She kept talking to the new hire, kept forgetting our dog's name and what we were there for. It took her ten minutes to charge us with my partner waiting there, and then she insinuated that we just walked out on her?  A week later?  I keep thinking how lucky we were that we paid in credit!

We pointed this out to them and they didn't ask for the difference (which was nice), but honestly they did deserve the money for the service they provided.   When we went back and paid them the difference, telling them that we wouldn't be returning.   I realize that it is tough times but if you screw up you have to eat the cost.  

You don't have hair dressers calling you back telling you your color job was more than they thought and if you could come back and give them an extra twenty...

This "business" goes by several names and phone numbers throughout the region.  I will not go into much detail here because I am pursuing a legal resolution. Suffice to say I was overcharged for a simple A/C repair by 5 or 6 times the appropriate amount. Very shady practices.  Stay far away. As an FYI, this guy "Jack" also does business under "Beaverton Heating and Cooling".
I would also suggest if you are in Beaverton and had issues, contact City Consumer help dept, I have an active investigation starting.  Up next, KOIN News...

I am all about supporting local businesses but not at the expense of service or quality. Order took 45 minutes longer than promised time.  Pizza had been obviously reheated - crust was crispy to the point of breaking in your hand, cheese was overbaked and congealed.  Pepperoni was burnt black around the edges. Garlic bread was not toasted and cheese was scant at best. The girl at the counter offered no explanation or apologies - I had to ask to see a mgr - it wasn't offered.  After just getting back from being out of town and looking for a quick easy dinner this was an appalling disappointment.  Mgr offered discount off next order but can't imagine bothering.  Would not recommend!!!

This is my first Yelp review. My daughter convinced me to sign up for Yelp after my last experience at the Tavern in the Square located in Central Square. I was very disappointed with the service last Monday night when I went in for dinner. I sat at the bar on the left and was waited on by the young Hispanic bartender with curly hair. She was extremely rude and inattentive. It took almost 10 minutes for her to even take my drink order because she was busy talking to another employee. When I paid the check in cash and only left a dollar and change for the tip die to such bad service, she actually had the nerve to confront me about it. She asked if I meant to only tip her a dollar and then pointed out that I should tip at least 18%. I then asked to speak to a manager but was told the manager was on an important phone call and unavailable. So I asked her for a customer feedback card or comment card which I filled out with my phone number and email but still haven't heard back from the manager and it has been almost a week. I am very disappointed with my entire experience and have never had such awful service.

Trident used to be one of my go-to places for brunch because of the location and casual atmosphere, but not after my experience this morning!  We were first in line, and we were told there would be a 10 minute wait.  I pointed to an empty table, and I was told that the table was reserved for a party of 3, and I only had 2 people.  So we went upstairs and saw empty tables, and we were told by the staff upstairs that it was OK to sit at a table meant for 3.  So we sit down, and two minutes later, the same person from downstairs told us that we can't sit there because it's meant for 3 people.  So we were forced to move to a table for 2, and soon after, we see 2 people sat at a table meant for 3 and 2 people sat a table meant for 4.  Hello?!?  What kind of customer service is that?!?

Service in general was awful, and it was not overly busy. We had to flag down a manager to get a server to take our order because we waited 15 minutes, and then we had to bring the check up because our server disappeared.

The food is OK but nothing great, and the prices a tad high for the portion and quality of food.  Now, I'm not sure why it was ever one of my go to brunch places...

I used to go this restaurant several times a week. Food and previous waiters were very good. However last 2 visits they hired new waiter who is extremely rude and bad service. Even if all tables are empty he tell customers to wait unnecessarily and do not provide seat. I will never busy this place again and not recommend this to anyone. This kind of behavior from restaurant waiter is a disgrace to Indian community. God bless the owner who trains their waiter to behave like this!

Bought my first products at Sears in 1968. I have been satisfied ever since. A few glitches through the years, but not much. At times I even bought Craftsman tools of slightly less quality because of the lifetime guarantee. Today was my last day.  I brought some sockets and a line cutter the I use on my lobster boat-both are worn and rusty.  I replace the line cutter every year.  I spray it every day with wd-40 but it is cheap steel and rusts anyway. It has never been a problem under the guarantee. Today a young clerk named Brian refused the replacement. Said the tool was rusty and that constituted abuse. When I questioned him, he gave me an 800 number and said that was my only recourse. I called the 800 number and was told they only handled things like major appliances and that I should talk to the store manager to solve this. I asked Brian to see the store manager and he said that was him and he wouldn't do anything.  I do not believe he is the manager of the Braintree, Mass store, so I left rather than cause a scene.  I AM NOT SATISFIED. We are talking $40 worth of tools as opposed to a 40+ year relationship.

I made a appointment for 230pm Sunday  on 2/15
Wanted an 45 min in waiting room before I was
Called back. I stayed in the room for 40 min. When I asked how much longer. There were two patients ahead
If me. One of them a emergency. I left no intention of spending until 5pm. Before I was seen. I have no intention
Of going to this Apppka location ever again. To top
It off the receptionist did not offer to refund the money
I paid for the visit. Don't visit this location unless you
Have lots of time on your hands.

We shared 2 apps and ordered 2 cocktails and our bill was $70 before the tip - extreme rip off. Service was terrible, the restaurant was dirty, the food was bad, and the cocktails were horrific. 

We asked for a cocktail menu, before ordering and were told there wasn't one. So we ordered a Bloody Mary and a Margarita. They were both horrible, and we complained about them and didn't drink more than 2 sips, but were still charged. 

I would never come back here under any circumstances.

Huge shoutout to the cashier Angie. I was easily able to get in to the store with my moms card. Wanted to pick up ONE thing as a SURPRISE for my mom that she said she liked while she was there. Went up the the register and Angie said she wasn't able to charge the card to my mom since she wasn't there. Even though I have done this PLENTY of times over the years that we have been members. Offered to pay with cash since then I would be the one paying, not my mom. Knowing this item was supposed to be a surprise for my mom, she still said no, not without her. Thanks for the huge inconvenience, Angie

This was our first time here. We looked at other reviews on google and yelp and decided to give it try. For a Monday night the place was packed so we were even more sure of our decision to come here. We had thin crust margarita and thin crust with onion and mushroom. God, that was by far the worst pizza I have ever eaten in my life. The dough is not "dough" it's more like a big round saltine cracker with sauce and cheese on top served on cardboard. Felt like eating that cardboard. I regret eating those calories and I never regret pizza calories. Very very disappointed.

their description is new American and it spot on describes their food. It was good. It was american with a slight gourmet/pretentious twist.
I had the Lobster sandwich (it was low in mayo which is good, and high in lobster meat which was awesome) with a side of really good cole slaw and another side of potato salad (too much mayo and too bland for me, but my husband liked it). It was a $20 dish. YIKES! Over priced for what it was, but they have to pay for the nice cozy decor somehow! My husband got the burger, he liked it. it was cooked perfectly, which is hard to find these days. It was also overpriced.
I like my food with lots of spice and flavor so this was a little on the bland side for me, ok, really on the bland side, but that doesn't mean it's bad.
over-all i thought the food b-o-r-i-n-g.


oh, and a p.s.
I just found out that they don't let the servers take their tips on the night they make them, they have to wait a week or maybe even two before they get their rightfully earned and deserved tips. 

BULLSHIT! I refuse to support this place that treats their employees like that.

If I had the option to give zero stars I would. Placed a take-out order yesterday with a very rude lady named  Sierra. I should have stopped there since her attitude was very unwelcoming. I was in the mood for steak tacos and carnitas tacos only to be informed they no longer have those. You're promoting mexican food and the two most popular tacos you no longer have? Disappointing. I was told brisket and Barbacoa are the replacements so I settled for 1 Barbacoa and decided to try the nachos with beef. Barbacoa taco was horrible. It was dry, cold and the corn tortillas are the cheap sticky ones. Nachos were cold, soggy and drenched in Pico de Gallo which should have been called "Onion de Gallo" since all there seem to be was raw onion. Ground beef was dry and to make matters worse they add wax paper to the bottom of the containers so the cheese and sticky tortilla chips just stick to the paper so half way through you'll be eating wax paper. They don't serve salsa a common ingredient in any restaurant that is "Mexican". $14 dollars for a horrible, sad meal. I should have just cooked this myself since there's a Kroger across the street. This hipster vibe is wrong especially on the West End. If you're a foodie who likes to try cool new spots don't come here this place is far from it. Go to Live Edge or Spice House a mile down. You will get your money's worth and better food. Also this is the correct spelling of Chicharonnes since it's spelled incorrectly on the menu. I don't see this place lasting for long. I am honestly surprised this place even has positive reviews. Sad, sad, place. Please stop trying to be Mexican this is offensive to their culture.

I have given this place many chances, but each time they have failed me. I boarded my German Shorthaired Pointer here for two weeks in January, and when I picked him up they gave me half of the food I had carefully measured out for his extended stay. His collar that fit perfectly when we dropped him off was too loose when we picked him up.( we took the collar with us and did not modify it) The owner, Colleen said that some of her employees don't know how to read and they were giving my dog "House food" at nights. This is not ok for my puppy, switching his food like that can make him sick. I gave this place a second shot for boarding while we were at the beach and took our Frenchie and our GSP there for five days. When I picked the boys up this morning, my GSP had not been given a bath like I asked, he was just given a "wipe down" The receptionist said it looked like I had called to cancel the bath, why would I do that? When I brought the boys home they both had to go potty, but if the dogs had been walked that morning they would not have needed to go potty so bad. The dogs were also fighting over the water bowl which is also not normal for them. When I spoke to the owner she was very defensive and said "mistakes happen" Don't take your dog here unless you want them to be mistakenly mistreated.

I was there on Saturday, December 12th around 2 PM. The place is a petri-dish to infect every one of every virus there is. There were at least 100 people in this relatively small place. I entered and tried to make my way to one of the produce isles, but it was so crowded that I decided to leave. I was 5 meters away from the exit and the crowd of people was standing so close to each other to the point that there was no escape!
There was no employee at the entrance to make sure everyone was wearing a mask or if too many were getting inside. 
Forget COVID19! This place is also violating fire regulations as well.
Anyway, took me a good 2 minutes to inch my way to the entrance and get out of there.
This is not OK at all!!

I spent almost 45 minutes on the phone speaking to Daniel in Sales at this dealership, Mercedes Benz of Portland early afternoon Saturday, June 1, 2019.  I live in Denver, and was interested in a 2017 grey/black SL 550 that was listed in inventory on Cars.com.  I was told the car was in PERFECT CONDITION, one owner, and it just came into the dealership off lease 5-28-19.  Daniel said he would immediately go take pictures of the actual car and send them both to me and my boyfriend/car broker, Gerry, who found the car for me.  He was going to phone/send pics to him as well as me.  Well, it is 6pm MST Monday, June 3, and did not hear one word from Daniel Saturday nor today.  I bookmarked the car, looked it up today.....the price has risen over $3K from $80K as was listed on Saturday, June 1.  Livid, I called the sales manager, Dale, who said the car had not been inspected, and Daniel was not allowed to photograph the vehicle Saturday because it was FULL of ding/dents and was in repair mode as we were speaking today....thus the price was going to go up when repaired and be worth more money (?).  I didn't review the yelps on this dealership, but now I know why there are less than stellar remarks from customers....seems the sales staff doesn't know fact from fiction.  I would have appreciated a courtesy call from Daniel telling me of the facts he had just learned on Saturday or today, so I would know the facts and not be anticipating buying it and continue to search for other cars, which I will resume immediately.  I wouldn't buy a coke from a vending machine at this dealership, let alone an $80K car that fit my criteria and would need to be shipped to me.  This is amateur behavior for even 10-year-old children....even worse of the sales manager selling high-end vehicles to be speaking over me on the phone and telling me there are other people interested in the car....I only care about what I was told, which were untruths.  I will NEVER offer up my last name, phone number or email to any dealership ever again....I've been well-educated at this point.

Had my brakes done here about 9 months ago. I should have known to run when they called me and told me my truck needs synthetic oil per the manufacturer.  I told them no it doesn't but they told me I was wrong. 


Anyways paid more than I probably should have for my brake job and my brakes stopped vibrating. Then 4-5 months later it returned. 9 months later it's worse than before. Moral of the story. Don't use brake check unless you have to.

Car smelled like smoke! Like someone smoked 5 packs inside of the car with the windows rolled up and no circulating air! Just smoked out! No joke. The smell seeped through my luggage and my clothes smelled like smoke. I don't smoke and I don't want to smell other peoples smoke or smell like their smoke. I would have really appreciated a car and company that didn't expose me to such crap! Yuck! The attendant says to me "I tried putting air freshener in it but it still smells." Well here's an idea....take it off the damn line!!!! Clean it or let it air out...do something instead of nothing. 

There were other issues but this is what got me. I did attempt to get another car and of course I got the run around on that. Never again. Just so we're clear, I'm not the complaining type. I've been on Yelp for years and have experienced shitty service but this really pissed me off.

Absolutely the worst experience at Krispy Kreme & I would not recommend anyone spend their money here. The staff was rude, unwelcoming, and made us feel like we were better off taking our money elsewhere. It was about 10p & I was there to get a 6 piece original glazed for my boyfriend and I. I inquired if they were hot before purchasing & the cashier told me yes. After the transaction had been made I asked again just to be sure and she told me they were in fact cold but still should be fine. Had I known that, I would not have purchased them in the first place so I politely asked if they could be warmed up because this was a concern of mine before purchasing. She nonchalantly told me no & that there was nothing she could do. I reminded her that she told me otherwise initially & she had the audacity to shrug. I didn't persit, I just asked to speak to the manager. He then walks over to our party and instead of introducing himself just stares at us. I explained the situation & he told me that there was nothing he can do, we weren't even supposed to be let in because they were about to close. (By this time, they weren't closed for another 10 minutes & I already spent my money). In the midst, my partner asks to use the bathroom & he denied access saying he already closed the bathrooms for the night. At that point, I was fuming. Not only did the cashier sell us cold donuts she said were hot, but the manager was unwilling to rectify the situation & would not even let us use the bathroom after we had already spent our money there. From the line level to management, the staff is very lazy, nonchalant, and unqualified on the simplest form of customer service. I will definitely not be returning to that location until they revamp their staff to reflect their brand.

Ameer's was excellent one month ago, but has since gone downhill.  Why?  Let's talk about their dinner buffet on Friday and Saturday nights.  Before it had baba ganoush, main reason I would pay $15.99.  Now not only does it not have it, the main hot dishes include rice, dry beef stew (prob leftover from lunch),two kinds of fried fish (thin and breaded)...  The only thing good was the falafel (which they have at lunch too).  
Though their lunch buffet use to have fruit, and now they don't even give you fruit.

This is a classic thing that happens to relatively new buffets... They start out strong to lure in customers, but after they figured out that their profits are low or nonexistent, they cut back.  Now old royal customers see a change in quality but no change in price, and thus won't be back.  Maybe they should just stick with their menu.

I drove 72 miles to get my truck. I called ahead and made sure they had all the paperwork ready as my two small kids were with me and it was going to be late. After test drive and all that we found that they literally did nothing to speed up the process. I was already pre approved so I didn't get their financing.. after leaving the lot I noticed the tire sensor warning was on so I called the sales guy but the office was closed. So I let them know that I I had gotten 10 miles away and had this issue but I would check the air and make sure it wasn't that. it wasn't. I spent two weeks trying to get them to answer or give me guidance. After I finally got ahold of the sales guy he essentially told me to go take it somewhere and then added "we sell our cars as is." Now, I'm finding out I have to take it in for service because when I put it in 4 wheel for the first time ever it just drug the back tires like it had the e brake on.. I wouldn't send my mortal enemy to this place...

I have a toy yorkie, she's barely 3 pounds so you can imagine how protective I am about her. I've been here before and I was satisfied with how they cut her hair and did her nails. BUT I was so disappointed and devastated from my last visit. 
 I made an appointment for my yorkie at 8:30 in the morning I dropped her off and they said they would call me when they were done(I ONLY wanted them to cut her hair and nails). Such a disappointing bummer. I want to write to AirTran to describe my experience flying on August 20th, 2013, Flight 32 from Atlanta, GA to LaGuardia, NY.  I was flying with my mother, father, two little girls, and wife.  When we boarded the plane my daughter Maisie's seat (23B) would not sit straight up (it only reclined).  Her tray was angled downward.  My daughter Marlowe's tray literally came off.  Neither of these things bother me but I am setting the stage.  During the flight I had to be careful not to allow Maisie (age 5 y/o) to put her beverage down on her tray as it would slide off.  When Marlowe (age 3 y/o) spilled her drink and I went to help her, Maisie put her drink down and spilled as well.  I had a double spill in aisle 23 and still neither of these things really bothered me.  You see, I work for a public hospital in NYC, I take care of the poorest people in the city and I love my job.  I see the worst things in the world and so a double spill doesn't really get to me.  It is annoying but it is also somewhat laughable.  Next, a stewardess walked over and asked if the seats were wet.  I said, "No, I've dried them off."  She then asked again, "Did they soak through the seats?" and I said, perhaps with a slight edge but nothing more, "No, I dried them both off."  Now, she did not ask if I needed help, if there was a problem, nothing like this.  She then said, "Well, I will need to change the seats if they have been soaked through, you don't have to yell at me."  

Let's be totally clear here, I did not yell.  It takes a lot to get me to yell.  I have people threaten me at my job, my physical safety, and I don't yell.  What I find so terrible about the service that was given to me and my family is that there was no interest in whether we were uncomfortable.  There was no interest in me as a consumer.  She was reprimanding me in front of my children and my family even though I had not raised my voice at all.  I wanted to respond that I did not yell but I did not want to escalate the conversation which she had already done.  I stopped and went back to my kids who were of course quite uncomfortable.  Later in the flight my wife asked another attendant for the other woman's name and she said that my wife would have to ask the woman directly.  Is that the correct response?  I think their jobs are very difficult, so is mine.  All of this occurred in some way because to begin with our seats were malfunctioning.  The plane was shoddy and the service was very poor.

Ummm, so 36 hours after barely eating here, we're still sick ....... we got here for a late birthday lunch.....so excited, sat outside, great weather,  good server. ....but the food  . Ordered mussels...., almost threw up after the first taste. The mussels had gone bad, and once we returned it, they had to take it off the menu for the rest of the day and sited "mussels are in mating season" as the reason for me feeling sick. 

Then I ordered the scallops entree......finally it came out, but guess what, the scallops tasted just as bad as the mussels. At this point,  I had to take the plate in to the manager myself. No lunch for my birthday I guess. Tuna steak was grossy undercooked and shrimp pasta was not cooked well. We eventually had to send back almost everything on a day that was not busy. Another manager tried to give me some flounder, but after 2 dishes that made me sick, why would i even eat anything else? We decided to stick to finishing up our self-made mimosas. 

Yeah, maybe 0 stars after this experience,  but our waiter was apologetic and it wasnt his fault.

For a $$$ restaurant that specializes in seafood, at least the temperature of the fridges/chilllers should be checked often..... how could have the mussels and scallops been prepared and no one smelled that it had gone bad? 

So in the end,  what was done?  Nothing really.  I still ended up paying full price for all my drinks,  and got a measly 20% of the 3 items that we were able to eat, and some free desserts I was offered after we left but I had to come get my parking validated.... basically an "after the fact fix"..... would I come back,  HELL NO.....
