Thanks Legal

So, I gave this place a pretty good review a few months ago.  I'm disappointed to retract it now.  A couple of days ago (August 8, 2012 if I recall correctly), I was here with my family for the nth time.  We frequent(ed) this place and pretty much walk in and out of here without remark... until now.

As usual, I order a half-portion of their Texas Cheese Fries for an appetizer.  Something unusual came with it this time, though.  As I was chewing a mouthful of gooey, cheesy fries topped with a jalapeno and some bacon bits, I noticed something was hesitant be shredded to bits by my teeth.  And believe me, I was trying.  For a moment, I considered giving up and just swallowing.  I didn't think much of it.  Until I kept chewing...

I put my fingers in my mouth and reach for this un-chewable, hard thing.  To my extreme disgust, I pulled out a GIANT fingernail.  This thing could have been a toenail.  Anyway, how do I know it wasn't mine?  Because I don't grow my fingernails out half an inch.  It was also coated in cheese.  I had to wipe off the cheese to make sure it was what I thought it was.  I took a picture of this fingernail, right next to the mouthful of Texas Cheese Fries I spit out with it.  I wish I could share it here to validate my story.

By the time the waiter came back with our food, I politely told him to take the food back and let us pay for the drinks we ordered so that we can leave.  He fetched the manager; an Asian lady I've seen many times before (although she does not know/recognize me).  Even she was shocked.  She was profusely polite (and not just then - she always has been quite courteous).  She asked if there was anything she could do.  Nope.  I just wanted to walk out of there.  She declined my offer to pay for drinks (not even the margarita was a good-enough chaser) and gave us her sincere apology.

Now, I've been here countless times before without incident.  I really liked this place.  However, after this, in good conscience I cannot recommend that anyone eat here until whatever sanitation issue in the kitchen is resolved.  A fingernail, folks.  Not a little clipping either.  And I THOUGHT TO SWALLOW IT.  I was under the assumption that those in food service had to keep their nails clipped...  I just gagged again.

She kept trying to encourage me not to get the implant removed and suggested that I just add a pill on top of it to stop the bleeding. After telling her repeatedly that I wanted the implant out and didn't want to go back to the pill bc I'm bad at taking them everyday (which she would've known if she had taken the time to look at my chart) she kept trying to push me into getting a different pill and saying that I was older now so I'm responsible enough to take it everyday. Then when I was trying to ask about my other options she gave me one word answers not pertinent at all to the symptoms I was trying to alleviate.  Also she never asked me if I was sexually active, but instead asked if I had a boyfriend and if I wanted an std screening which I found kind of strange. I eventually settled on the Nuva ring. Then when she left she made a rather inconsiderate comment about my mental health issues. When I tried to go to the pharmacy to pick it up I was told that I needed to contact my doctor because I wouldn't be able to pick it up for seven days because of the way the prescription was filled out and how my insurance worked. The reason I still wasn't able to pick up my prescription was because my insurance wouldn't pay for me to get enough so that I wouldn't have to have my period. When I was talking over the phone a nurse actually overheard the conversation and said I could keep it in for 28 days which, while helpful, kind of felt like an invasion of my privacy. I was finally able to work it out with my insurance and the doctors office but I hated this experience. I understand that I'm not their only patient and my issues are pretty unimportant, but I'm just a young girl looking for some help and this was quite the opposite. This place seems incompetent and doesn't really care about patients with everyday problems.

I can not be more disappointed in the way I was treated. Buying a motorcycle should be a fun and exciting experience, this place drop the ball. I went in to look at a bike this past Saturday and give it a test ride. I was ready to put a down payment on the bike after the test ride if I liked the bike. Once again I told him that's not what I want to do. He quickly went down through all the numbers on the bike as fast as he could trying to get me just to sign. The tag on the bike was 8999.00. Good place to live until you try to move out... During the end of my 2 years of living here, Austin experienced extremely heavy storms. My entire kitchen flooded due to the pool overflowing and the fact that the building is not built to code. When I moved out, I discovered that my window had been leaking the previous month while I was in Europe. Under my bed was a massive black spot of mold. The carpet was ruined and some parts of the wall were still damp. I filed a maintenance request and was told it was taken care of.

When I finally received the email describing my move out charges, I was not pleased. Even though I moved out a few weeks sooner than my roommates, I know there's no way they would've left the common areas THAT messy. Regardless, I had to pay the following charges: 
- Heavy Clean Microwave - $3.75 (3 other roommates charged same amount)
- Heavy Clean Stove Top - $11.25 (3 other roommates charged same amount)
- Re-caulk Tub - $7.50 (1 other roommates charged same amount)
- Replace Bedroom Carpet - $81.69

How does it cost $16 to clean a microwave? How does it cost $45 to clean a stove? Why does it cost $15 to replace the cheap caulk put in the shower at least two years ago? Why am I being charged $80 to replace the carpet ruined by the window leaking?

Axis also didn't find time to send me this final bill until August 25 and stated that all payments had to be mailed in my September 1, otherwise you would have to deal with their asset management division or the collections department.

This meant nothing and I was hung up on. I called back at least 7-9 times to speak to a manager, which mysteriously wasn't there and kept getting put into the manager's voice mail or HUNG UP ON! WHO DOES THIS??? I MISSED MY FLIGHT because of these morons!

This company is HORRIBLE and beyond UNPROFESSIONAL! I will NEVER use this company again and will walk home from the airport before giving them any business!

I have never had a worse experience with a business of any kind. When I saw them listed for ATL Burger Week, I was excited to support them as a local small business (and as a business owner myself). I called ahead to see if I could get the burger to-go (for timing issues), but I understood when I was told this was not possible. To-go has never been allowed in the past for ATL Burger Week, but thought it might be different during a pandemic. I went to dine in and there were two other patrons in the restaurant, one with a mask hanging off his ear, one with no visible mask. The bartender/server also was not wearing a mask at any time I was in the restaurant. 

When I went to the restroom to wash my hands, I also noticed that the tables were not marked for social distancing. Not a big issue when the restaurant is empty, but there was nothing to keep another group from sitting at the table next to me. 

Again, it wasn't crowded, so this wasn't a major issue. What happened next blows me away. I knew that me and the owner (who I have met before) have a mutual friend, so I asked her for his number so I could give him a heads up about the Governor's Executive Orders regarding restaurants and they could be fixed before someone else noticed and reported them. I texted him with the information to help him owner-to-owner instead of reporting this to the Governor's office or writing a review. He proceeded to call me and yelled at me for 7 minutes about using his personal cell phone number. There are businesses on the brink of bankruptcy and some that have gone under because they are following the laws and trying to keep their patrons safe. Instead, he would rather focus on HOW I contacted him instead of WHY I contacted him. Timmy, I'm sorry I used your personal phone number, but I will not apologize for caring about my community. It is not too much to ask that your staff wear a mask while working handling food (gloves should be a given, regardless of a global pandemic). According to the owner, he was trying to do his best for his employees that have to feed their families. We all get that. Masks are not going to break the bank. Working together as a community helps us get past this, not yelling at the people who spend money and reach out to you personally to help.

I purchased a '18 Tundra from this location about 2 weeks ago. I've waited a week to post this review to see if Carr would do anything to remedy the fact that they lied about the truck I bought online, and was supposed to get a call back last Friday. All their online marketing for the truck stated it was Platinum trim. We agreed upon a price and I purchased it, easy enough as I had been looking for 2 months and knew exactly what I wanted. On my drive home I realized it was not what they said it was. It was the Limited trim. There is a $7K MSRP difference between the trims new, I understand this is not a new truck, but I bring this up because the difference was downplayed multiple times while trying to get Carr to fix their deceptiveness. 

So they lied about the level of the vehicle, and when I brought this up, the only option Cody gave me was to unwind the deal. Since there was no dialogue, no real solution, and no option given, I threw out oil changes as something to at least start up the communication to find a happy medium. On the phone I was told they couldn't refund any money since the deal was done, Cody then informs me they can give me 4 free oil changes, of course I would have to drive from Beaverton to Vancouver to get them. OR they could cut me a juicy check for $200. What a deal!! I told Cody I wanted to sleep on it. 

I text him the following day telling him I would keep the truck and we'd go our separate ways, me obviously being unhappy and I'll let everyone I can know that this dealership lacks integrity and I'd never do business with a Carr dealership again, they bait and switched me. He wanted to talk. So we talked the next day, pointless conversation of course. I knew they wouldn't do what needed to be done to make me happy, which was $2,000 reimbursement. I would not pay over $40k for a platinum, and $38k for a Limited, these were my guidelines. I didn't even ask for it because I knew I was wasting my time and we were miles away from a win win solution. I accepted what happened and can't do anything about a business with trash customer service that lacks honesty and accountability. He continued making excuses about how the "accident" happened, darn VIN was at fault of course, apparently it was the 1 in 10,000 (or whatever number) vehicles that the computer screwed up and auto populated all the wrong info. Stupid computers am I right? Well I don't care who's fault it was, the company screwed up and bait and switched me, and then simply waits for me forget about it, not doing a damn thing. 

Deb and Cody were nice enough to deal with, I have a problem with the company and their policies when it comes to them screwing up and lying to customers.

I could have unwound the deal, I should have looked at things in more detail, but I trusted the company to not mis represent their products and it wasn't even in my head to think they were lying. At the end of the day, instead of me feeling like I got a good deal, I feel like I walked in a paid sticker price at a dealership like an idiot would. Yes, they had the truck booked out as a Limited (per Cody), but wtf do I care about that. Also, the truck had been sitting for over a month and they took my offer immediately, wonder why?! Then Cody tries to tell me the dumbest and most common load of crap a salesman says, THEY BOUGHT THE TRUCK FOR $39,900, yet were selling it to me for $40K. Sure, I've heard that identical story from 4 different used car salesman the past 2 months. Weird how these poor car companies are always the ones getting the raw deal. Poor things. 

I will never do business with Carr again, and will forever tell anyone I know about this experience to make sure to stop as many people as I can from doing business with them. I've been in my own business for close to 20yrs myself and have made many mistakes, my employees have made many mistakes, but you know what? I always rectify them and make them right, not sit there and point fingers and have an attitude of "oh well, crap happens move along".  I'll be waiting to hear how I'm the bad guy from Carr.

Worst service ever getting a prescription filled here. Called yesterday and was told they had to get a technician to process it and would call me back. No call. Today I speak with someone who says they got it to go through and it will be ready in an hour. I show up to pick it up and am told they were out of stock so they transferred it to a store in Round Rock! One that isn't open late or on holidays. So can't get it until Tuesday now and have to drive to RR to get it, ugh. Not to mention, no one bothered to call and let me know this minor detail. The pharmacist just shrugged at me and the manager on duty, Angelina, did the same, saying she didn't know anything about the pharmacy. No offer of any help or a fix or to say she'd even check on why it happened. Had pretty below average experiences here before, but this one takes the cake!

Our company was looking to get a small counter top installed in our office. Granted, it was a very small project in which we wanted to use a "remnant" piece of granite, but I've given up on Toluca. I've gotten in contact with them 4 different times over the past 2-3 months, and each time I have to reintroduce myself, the company I work for, and the project we want. Each time it seems like they write down my information and request, and every time I have to reiterate it to them.

I also went down there in person a couple of times to look at what remnants they had. When they didn't have anything in particular that day, I asked them to email or call me when they next received a good piece of black granite. I've asked them to notify me about this a couple of times, actually.

After a month, I haven't heard a peep from them. I get the impression that since it's such a small job, they don't care. Regardless, they're not getting our service anymore.

If no stars could be used, I would have used it, but to play the game you have to give them one star !
I guess one star means they exist !
Walked in this evening, had not been there in a long time.
I asked the cashier what time they closed.  She didn't know, had to ask someone.
I'm looking at the specialty pizzas.  I asked her what was on the 'Deluxe' pizza.  She didn't know, so I ordered a small Deluxe for myself.  Cost $10.95.  Then I ordered a large 
'Meatza' for my son for $16.95.  Paid for them.
There was a 10 min. wait time.  
So I'm waiting for my order, looking around and then I saw small chalk board with "Manager's Special".  I asked the cashier about the special (large 5 topping pizza for $9.95).  I asked her why she didn't tell me about the special.  She shrugged. 
I am tired of posting now.
The thing that really made me see red was when I had to go back 6 blocks and get the 4 garlic butter dipping sauces she forgot to give me.  They were 60 cents each!

Never again at this place !

I went to this park everyday before it closed last year. It was great. However alot of the people that went dont clean up after there dogs so it closed for renovations. Now that it reopened its a leash only park. How can your dogs socialize and play on a 6ft leash. This is rediculous. They now pay an employee to make sure that dogs are on leashes. Wouldnt it make more sense to pay someone to fine the idiots who cant clean up there dogs crap. It would also bring in more money to pay for the guys salary. But I guess Im the only one that thinks this way. The City of Austin does NOT know what they are doing! Im pissed.

I've been here a few times   I actually love the location, view, and vibe of this place, however, the wait staff is either not well trained or not well managed. In my most recent visit from Houston to reward the employees associated with my medical company, I asked the Austin staff to meet me at the Oasis. All was well, we had a great time on the patio, except our waitress, Theresa, seemed unhappy to serve us. She was a bit older than my mid thirties team, maybe early to mid forties. Since this was a company reward, I decided to treat the team to whatever they wanted, and just hang out since we are so far apart most of the time with our headquarters being located in Houston, where I currently reside. 
Theresa seemed to be much more engaged with her other tables than she was with ours, our drinks were left empty for long periods of time and our table left with dirty dishes while we had our post lunch meeting. 
When I received the check from her I noticed a gratuity was added. On the actual receipt it mentioned gratuities for parties of 7 or more...  our party was a party of 5 for all of the time we were there, with 1 additional employee showing up after we ate, and only ordering 1 glass of water. 
While I do understand that we did sit there for a few hours enjoying each other and the scenery, we were buying drinks, and continuing to be kind throughout the entire visit. 
When I received the bill, I intended on tipping her for the time we were occupying her table, but as I read the receipt I saw that she had placed the gratuity on our table of 5 eaters and 1 water only drinker. Keep in mind that I also own a restaurant in Houston in addition to the Medical company whose team I was meeting with in Austin. I feel as if Theresa saw my table of mid thirties masters and bachelor degree professionals, who all make 6 figures a year, as one that would not accommodate her time. I went ahead and left her only her requested gratuity, even though normally I would have tipped way more for this type of event. 
Employees like Theresa, give this place a lower review that it should receive. 
My suggestion would be to not assume anything. And to let Theresa go..

Do not use this company under any circumstances.

What you need to know is that Seaport doesn't actually move your stuff.  They outsource to people who will pick up your things, then a driver who drives your it, and hire people at an abysmal hourly rate at the far end who unload.

None of these people have ANY INCENTIVE to be careful with your property.  The ones who picked up our things did not bother to label ANY of the boxes. They did not even keep hardware with the furniture they disassembled.  They just threw everything into boxes as fast as they could, probably because they were paid a flat rate.

Furniture was damaged.  Our bikes were compressed at the bottom of the pile and will never be the same again. I know where our TV is, but have no idea where to find the cords, the remote, the VCR.  There was no rhyme or reason, no order, to how they moved us.  They don't care if you can actually use your things again.

At the other end of our move (from Portland to Tucson), the people who were hired to unload the truck were stiffed by the driver, which understandably made them very angry.  The result is that our furniture was never reassembled.  Does Seaport care? Here's how you know the answer:  they demand a cashiers check at the end, so you can't challenge the charge if you're not happy with the service.

Don't let your property and your life be treated shabbily by this company.

I wish that I could give them a 0 rating. 

EXTREMELY pushy and desperate sales associates. I was just in there not too long ago looking for rooibos teas with rosehips. I was shown a few but then I was offered "higher quality" teas(how she put it). These higher quality teas were white teas, which according to the person I was buying it for, are horrible tasting. 

The salesperson shows me the white teas after I say I'm interested in the red teas only. Then after saying that I'd take a half pound of red tea, she continues to push the white teas on me after telling her I haven't liked it in the past. In the end she was so adamant about me purchasing white teas that I agreed to sample them.

I asked for a cup to go. What did she say? "The line is so long though, you should just get it you and your friends will totally love it." I agree to get 2 ounces of a white tea to sample at home. She begins to push for me to purchase an entire pound of it. I respond with "Why would I get an entire pound when I don't know if I like it yet?" 

I begin to get impatient. At this point I just want the sample of the tea she wanted to push on me. BUT SHE ISN'T DONE YET. I need to get an additional sample, a sample of another type of white tea. So I ask for another 2 ounce sample. She AGAIN tries to convince me to get an entire pound. 

I just stand there and look at her in complete silence, clearly frustrated. So she finally decides to ring me up. 30 BUCKS!!! 30 Dollars for a couple of 2 ounce sample baggies. I take her word for it though, I assume that my friends and I will love this tea. 

After the transaction she then lets me in on a little known secret regarding white tea. They're very easy to screw up and make bitter. She tells me to put an ice cube in with the tea before adding hot water. She tells me that I need to steep it at  vey specific temperature. I love tea, but I'll be damned if I sit there with a thermometer monitoring the tea as I steep it. 

I go home and make using her ice cube trick though. It taste HORRIBLE. I bring it back. They are not happy with me. Tough titty I say. They had to throw the tea that I returned away. Again their own fault. 

Word of advice? If you have a good product, let it sell itself ok?

We bought $3000 worth of bedroom furniture and another $300 worth of glass to cover our table and dressers. The glass was cut out of thin window pane glass instead of thick tabletop glass and tgen was cut with sharp pointed edges instead of round so you cut yourself every time you walk by. I tried to get them to take it back and replace it but they refused. I then used a wood cleaner and the paint bubled up off of the side table leaving a 12" x 4" hole down to the bare wood. Bought the warranty but they wouldnt honor it. The mattress arrived so that when you lay down you roll off the side of the bed it's been like this for six years. Finally I slid the dresser a few inches and the leg popped off taking the molding with it. I tried to call tonight to get a rep in The chestnut store to give me the name of someone who could replace the leg but the automated message said they were no reps available and told me to call back later. Terrible product. Terrible service.

Can I give a zero star review for this place? I mean I've lived in Austin almost 8 years now and I had better apartment management when I lived in student housing! Smh, I was one of the first residents to move in and I absolutely loved management, it was the reason I chose to live at ALTA. Then early November they were bought out by Roscoe Properties and it's just been downhill since then. The outdoor gates are broken for weeks at a time, office staff are unfriendly, I'm almost positive their emails are written by 4th graders, and service orders take weeks just to be completed. For the price, you're better off moving across the street into a house. Cannot wait to move out of this place.

Since Winthrop has a million and one nail salon selections, please choose anywhere but here. I was drawn to this place because it's a large new salon (next to Bell Isle) but I felt that although they could seat a lot of people, I did not feel attended to. They would buff one nail, go finish up a pedicure, come back buff another one of my nails, then go do a wax. Meanwhile I watched them do all of these things without washing hands! When she was cutting my cuticles, she was so rushed she made 5 of my 10 digits bleed (something that never happens at Tokyo Hair & Nail). Days after my shellac manicure, 2 of my nails were red and inflamed. Also, the fumes in there could kill an unborn fetus, but at least the manicurists had masks on to protect themselves. To end on a high I did appreciate the complimentary parafin wax and the bootleg pitch perfect 2 playing

I got wings to go here and the wings were extremely small to the point that I lost my appetite when I saw them!  It was a weird feeling to say the least. When I called back to complain, they told me to bring the wings back for a refund but I did not feel like driving out to the location a second time to get my refund. The manager said she could not give a refund over the phone because of "security" purposes although I don't quite understand the concept of that since I am not trying to make an outstanding purchase with a card number but simply trying to get a refund.  Long story short .. I posted a photo of one of the MANY (if not more than 1/2) wings that were disproportionate so beware!!!

TERRIBLE customer service.  

I was so excited to order from this company since they are local and carry such awesome, sustainable stuff.

Unfortunately, when I received my order it was the wrong item!  And fine, things happen, but I have emailed, and emailed, and called, and emailed with no response!  I'm not really sure what to do at this point but I am very frustrated that I paid for an item I never received!  Hopefully they'll get back to me at some point.  I wish they still had a storefront so I could at least find someone to talk to.

They get one lonely star just because they're available after hours, and when your fridge goes out, you don't have much of a choice.

Otherwise, they stink. HORRIBLE! This is my first review on yelp just to say how horrible they are. It's the 5th time the technician has been out to fix an ice maker. If I had known it was just the ice maker and it would cost me upwards of $400 and over a month of failed repairs, i would have said "forget it, i'll just make ice in the freezer like anyone else" but now, i've put so much money into it i can't let it go.

they give you a 3-5 hour time frame of when they will arrive, have ALWAYS been late, and don't schedule until the morning of. so if you have a life, give it up to get your refrigerator not fixed.

This company is the worst. I want my money back.

We expected that a doctor specializing in pediatrics would be good with children, but we were absolutely wrong! Dr. Rainey is not good with human beings. One year ago, we took our 2 year old for an exam with Dr. Rainey and we will never schedule another appontment with her. Our son greeted her cheerfully when she walked into the examination room, but she never looked down at him or acknowledged him whatsoever. Her bedside manner is absolutely rude and caustic. As part of the exam, I was told to assist, but was not given any instructions or directions about what I should do. Dr. Rainey proceeded to chastise and scold me for not assisting her correctly and then called in one of her assistants to help finish her exam. Dr. Rainey seems to be mad at the world and should do everyone a favor and retire and become a hermit. Do yourself a favor and find a different doctor, unless you prefer an abusive, angry physician. I would not recommend Dr. Rainey to treat animals, much less people or children.

Worst dinning experience I have ever had was here. I was with a group of about 10 people we order drinks and food. When the food arrived, the server told me mine would be out in a few minutes. 5 minutes go by, nothing. 10 minutes go by, still nothing. At a certain point my entire party had eaten their entire meal and had drinks severed to them, but I never received my meal. I called over the server and ask them to cancel my order since my party was getting ready to leave. I was pretty disappointed. I was told I didnt have to pay, whoohoo nice!I I didnt have to pay for a meal that never came, awesome. They did pay for my drink, but still had to pay for my girlfriends meal. Unfortunately this experience put a sour taste in my mouth and would never recommend this place to anyone, EVER.

To start, it wasn't the worst dining experience I have had, but because my expectations were originally very high, along with the price, I gave it one star. I have dined at Uchi before and the food was amazing. I booked my reservation two months out to celebrate an anniversary. We had a great table and decided to get the Che'fs 10 course tasting for a total of $200 plus a $100 bottle of wine. Each course came out 25-30 min apart which seems like a very long time in between with how small the portions are and how very hungry we were. The dishes were sub-par, it seemed like they were an afterthought because the kitchen was busy.  Our server offered an excuse for the delay by telling us every time she rang something up, the kitchen was out of it. This was a concern since we ordered a Chef's tasting which I thought would be more inspired by the chef and not the server. Maybe I misunderstood. Wish this would have lived up to all the hype and the prices.

I gotta say I was disappointed. I gave Hill's Cafe two chances. I'll start by saying I wanted to like this place because I really enjoy the building and atmosphere. Its an older building with wood floors and walls, nice homey/country vibe with great outdoor patio. The staff is also very friendly.

The first time I went I ordered the chicken fried chicken with yellow gravy and I enjoyed it, but my sides were served really cold. I gave them the benefit of the doubt and thought I would give them another shot. 

This time I started by ordering a bottled beer. It took awhile to get to me (not a big deal) but it was served warm. It felt like they heard I ordered it so they stuck it in the cooler for 10 minutes to give it a chill, even thought it didn't work. Before the meal overly greased corn muffins with overly salted imitation butter were brought to the table. Those were so awful they were almost good in a junk food/desperation kind of way. In comparison to the rest of my order they were sadly the most enjoyable part of the meal. 

I ordered the two meat plate. I chose two servings of fatty brisket, with mac&cheese and grilled zucchini. This by far was the worst brisket ever "cooked". It had the consistency of being zapped in a microwave for a few minutes. It was just huge chunks of uncooked fat and was nearly impossible trying to cut through it with the butter knife that was provided. The noodles in the mac&cheese weren't cooked enough and were drenched in a watered down liquid cheese sauce. I did enjoy the grilled zucchini, this was shocking because by this point I was expecting a wilted, frozen vegetable. Their BBQ sauce is some generic/basic/overly sweet type ketchup nonsense. The icing on the cake was the stale slice of bread.

This hotel has an "incidental" policy that requires the front desk clerk to make a photo copy of your ID and credit card.  The copy is kept on file in a box on the front desk and the box is not secure.  Anyone can steal the photo copy of your ID and credit card.  If you are concerned about identity theft, stay away.  That's what I did, I left this hotel and booked a room at another hotel that was much nicer and cleaner - one that did not make a copy of my ID and credit card number.

I know you're hungry, that it's late and you're just trying to get some cheap chicken and fries, but DO NOT make the same mistake I did. The chicken and fries were soggy, rubbery and cold in some spots; in fact, the entire order was microwaved. Also, when they say seven pieces of chicken, some of them might be about as large as your pinky finger (or even smaller than that). 
In a city full of amazing places to eat, Awesome Burger PDX falls flat on its face, as hard as it can. One cannot help but wonder how this place stays open and keeps people employed.

Stay AWAY from a&m!!!!  They promise you a quality vehicle only to pawn off problem vehicles.  We bought a honda odyssey and have had NOTHING but problems literally from the moment we got it home.  We are now in the process of hiring an attorney.  I have never had such a horrific experience with a dealer
UPDATE; the owner finally agreed, after serveral threats, to fix the vehicle.  However it's been at his shop for 2 weeks with no end in sight.  He won't answer his phone.  He won't give us any idea of when we will get our van back.  We've had to borrow a car from family and have been so incredibly stressed out over this horrible experience.  Hopefully he'll be out if business soon.  Contacting the BBB today

I had planned, what I was hoping, was a great weekend in Austin for my boyfriends birthday. Originally my friend booked the reservation but unfortunately would not be able to make it due to a family illness. Both her, and myself About two and a half weeks in advance to notify the hotel of the situation, and to see what would be the procedure that we needed to do to have the reservation switched to my name. We were told that it would not be an issue and all we would need to fill out was a form and email it back. I informed them that my friend still wanted to pay for the hotel as a gift and I was told it would not be a problem as long as she filled out form and returned it in a timely matter. Which of course we did. We made sure to do everything that was asked in order to avoid any issues when we arrived. My friend even called the day off the reservation to make sure everything was in order before we arrived. She was told the name had been changed to mine, vanessa Munoz, as well as it would be charged to her card (she noted card was on file). When we arrived we were quickly told that I was to provide a cc for payment. I explained to him the situation and the gentleman at front desk told me there was no card on file and I was to pay. I then explained again the situation and informed him of form we had previously filled out. He did not seem in any way reluctant to help me with this confusion. He quickly grabbed his manager, which of course I was told the same thing, there was no form to be found. I felt as though they were being very defensive as though they didn't believe me. I was quite embarrassed to have this discussion in front of other customers. As I mentioned before, my friend was the one who originally booked the hotel, but due to a family illness was not able To make it. Well because the front desk as well as the manager made me doubt myself I then called my friend to confirm that she actually made the changes and calls. She was enraged to get a call not only when she was in the hospital but to have to confirm what she had called earlier to avoid this from happening. She made it a point to call ahead of time to avoid this from happening. She brought up a valid point, if there was no form then how did the reservation name get switched but no card on file??? She emailed me the forma she filled out, and I then showed it to end manger and like magic he found it. 
situation solved!! They did not seem to happy to have found out that there was in fact a paper. But they proceeded to give my hotel key and we went about our way, a 30 min mishap that should have been avoided. We told them we needed valet for parking, we were told it would be charged to the card. I asked if we could get it complementy for the troubles, of course that was a no. later that night we received a complained of being too loud so we quickly decided to call it a night not until no more than 2 min later got a knock and was told we needed to hush or we would be evicted from our room. We were not even giving 2 sec to get ourselves together. 
The hotel itself was pleasant rooms clean and stocked. Nothing to complain on that.
My issue was lack of customer service. I have stayed in the same hotel every time I visit Austin and decided to explore other hotels. Def the wrong choice in choosing this one. I felt embarrassed, belittled, and overall disappointed. The situation should have been handled in a better manner. Maybe it was a bad night for the staff and manger (Jonathan and lucus) maybe there were overwhelmed that night, I don't know. But what I do know is no matter what the circumstance is customer service should be superb 24/7. A customer might not always remember the little things, neatly folded towel, stocked toilet paper, chocolate on the pillow, but they will always remember how they were treated, and that is what makes a customer a returning one. I did not have the fortune to feel that way during my stay, but hey you can't satisfy everyone right. Oh I forgot to note 2 other parties had also booked there because of my recommendation to stay here. Them and myself will definitely not be likely to stay here again when we come back to visit. I will not be wasting my money where it is not appreciated.

Went to Chiara for the first time summer '19. Service was great and the food tasted wonderful that day as we sat outside in a packed restaurant.

Fast forward to 8/23/19 and I will no longer be giving this restaurant my business. Upon arriving, we were denied from sitting outside at an open table that remained open for the entire night while we were eating. The meal kicked off with our waiter being bumped by the female owner and spilling a drink all over a member of my party. While the waiter was very apologetic, the owner quickly walked away like nothing happened. Neither her or the other owner/manager would ever come to our table to make sure everything was ok. Now, my friend has a ruined shirt that we hope the stain will come out of.

Oh, It gets better. When another waitress asked my significant other how her burger was, she told her the truth and that she felt it was bland and not very good (and she hadn't eaten any of it). To which the waitress' response was "no one has ever said that before," said with a healthy dose of attitude. She then very VERY clearly went to complain about us to the other male owner.

I'm devastated to give this place a 1 star review, but never have I so keenly felt like the neglected "problem table" because someone else gave us bad service.

I'm usually someone who thinks yelp gives businesses a bad rap, but honestly I feel like this one is deserving. There hasn't been one time where I left this Taco Bell with my complete order. Literally every single time, and I'm counting at least 8 visits this year so far. They're never even nice (and I'm writing this with no expectation of nice service at a Taco Bell). I've worked in the food business, and I know it gets stressful, but most of the time there's barely anybody even in the store or in line, so there's honestly no excuse for the service. I can also say this is the only Taco Bell in the area (mostly meaning interstate and west burnside locations) where this even happens. Somethings gotta change, man.

Usually a cute little spot with decent service and killer happy hour, but Valentine's Day here was absolutely terrible. I got there early for happy hour and was able to get a table, but was greeted with a "we aren't doing happy hour drinks today, just food." 

I'm sorry, but your main hook is your happy hour. There were no signs, nothing on their website about not doing happy hour on Valentine's Day. They certainly lost out on a lot of business with this move as tons of people kept coming in and just walked out when they heard happy hour drinks weren't being offered. $8 bottom-shelf liquor drinks are NOT why people show up to Bartini. 

So, alright, my partner and I decide to just have a drink and go somewhere else. Already seated, it took 20 minutes from the time we ordered until we got our drinks. Bartini is small and on top of their little "bait and switch" happy hour thing, you'd think they would be more on top of getting what business they did receive. 

I realize a lot of places intentionally try and shaft you on Valentine's Day with inflated prices, but to not have that information anywhere at all and leave it to be found out AFTER people have all made their journey to your establishment is just rude and pathetic.

My husband and I were staying in a nearby hotel and had come in late from hanging out. I pulled up Yelp and saw this place was still open and delivering. I called around 12:41 am and ordered 1 pizza and an order of wings. I was told delivery would be about an hour, which I was okay with. Well, 2 am rolled around and still no food, so I called them to inquire about my order, was rudely advised that "there were other orders ahead of yours and I don't know when we'll be delivering to you". At that time, I asked the person to CANCEL my order. When I woke up the next morning there were 3-4 missed calls from the restaurant 25 minutes after my last call to them cancelling the order. 

I noticed charges pending for the food on Monday, no big deal b/c it was a Holiday, surely they would reverse that since they never delivered right??? I called them and explained the situation and got "A manager will call you when she gets in" reply. The call never happened and here I am almost a week later calling my bank to dispute the charge. It is ridiculous that I would have to go to that extreme, I will never deal with this company again.

This company is a small family owned business that doesn't honor the rates or contracts you sign. They think a verbal conversation is how to conduct business in terms of rates and length of term. They agreed to rent me a storage area for 223 a month (Normally goes for 350)  (more than I needed, but they had someone for the smaller unit and I agreed based on the deal, it would be easier for me and willing to pay more). We never discussed the length of the term, but when I actually showed up, the manager who was nice to sell it and rude upon my arrival...... basically said "Yea, it's for one month". I questioned him and he walked away....Not only that, but they have some long term people who store merchandise in and out of there who are the rudest people I have ever met. They wouldn't give me space for my truck, dirty looks, rude to my movers....This went on for the whole 2 hours. Management never said a things and walked away. My term became longer than expected (3-4months) and when I called to pay for the next month, they jacked my rate up and were extremely rude and not willing to work with me. Quite frankly, if I thought this would happen I never would have agreed in the first place. All over a 100 bucks a month and when I did them a favor and they keep telling me they did me a favor??? I could have taken the smaller unit. I was living in back bay in 500 square feet apt. BTW I'm a contract lawyer and any larger company would never be able to do this. There would be legal ramifications.  Conversations V. legal contract don't hold up on court. I signed a actual contract that states all the terms and my rate. If it was only for a specific time, it should have been written into the agreement. Nevertheless, if they acted nicer and gave me a break for the month I owed, I would have been more sympathetic. They now have a renter for the space and want me out or pay for it.  I WOULD NOT RECOMMED USING THIS FACTILITY AS THERE ARE MANY OTHERS IN THE AREA THAT ARE CHEAPER. WISH ME LUCK, I'M SHOWING UP ON FRIDAY TO GIVE THEM THEIR MONEY AND HOPE THAT I DON'T NEED THE POLICE TO FACILITATE GETTING INTO MY UNIT.

Me and 2 friends came here after brewfest since it was right next to the Hawaiian shaved ice place we wanted to try afterwards, BIG MISTAKE. Our server was so rude and awkward that we just wanted to get the hell out of there.

We placed our order for 2 spicy red miso ramen, my friend wanted it extra spicy and I went with the basic ramen. When she brought out my friends ramen and she brought him a thing of sriracha to make it spicy on his preference. 15 mins went by and the table next to us who ordered after us, got all of their food. My ramen still hadn't came yet!!! I patiently waited thinking it was still on its way no big deal. Our server walks pass us to go outside, on the way out she looked at me and ROLLED HER EYES, seriously WTF?!  I asked the other server if my order got put in or what happened? she told me that she'll get it out to me asap.

I finally got my ramen after both my friend finished there. My ramen noodles weren't even cooked all the way. If that wasn't bad enough that same server who rolled her eyes at me and forgot to put in my order walked over to us without saying a word, NOT EVEN APOLOGIZING that she forgot my order or even ask if we need anything else. NOPE, she just walks over and drops us the check on the table and walks away. After 15 mins of not even coming over to collect our cards to pay for our bill we had to walk up and hand her our cards so she can run them. After she ran our cards she just walked away, without saying a single word. Didn't even say thank you or even apologized about not putting in my ramen order. 

ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! I never been so livid after leaving a restaurant. If that server mission was to make sure we would never come back, mission accomplishment!

I hope my review can save someone else from going through the same bullshit I had to go through. 

Take your money somewhere else, there are plenty of other ramen places who won't treat you like dog shit.

I brought one of my best-friends here for her graduation dinner because I saw how many great reviews this place had.
It was around 9-10pm and it wasn't super busy. 
But we had such horrible service.
We, each ordered fish & chips and I ordered a strawberry lemonade. 

We got water around the same time we received our meals which took a bit. 
After receiving our meals is when I finally got my strawberry lemonade and we barely ever saw our waiter. 
She did not check on us or ask if we needed anything more. 
The food was bland and the service was less than mediocre.
I don't know if it was just an off night but it left a bad taste in my mouth. 
I won't be back!

$40 spent on what?

Stopped in for breakfast and no one was at the door or register, I asked the guy behind the counter if I seated myself and he pointed to the dining room.  I sat there for 5 minutes then wondered if I was supposed to order at the counter.  Approached the woman behind the register and asked if I was supposed to order at the counter or if there was table service.  (I had seen no menus at this point) she asked "for food or coffee". I said food, she pointed to the dining room/counter and I asked again do I order at the counter? She didn't seem to understand me.  I left and went the th me bakery cafe across the street.  Someone should be greeting customers and it should be someone that can easily communicate without just pointing.

I got a groupon and went there for laser hair removal.  I have had laser hair removal done before, with not a ton of success.  After 1 visit, I wasn't comfortable with the experience level of the staff to give me this procedure.  I'd heard about burn marks, scarring ect, that can happen, especially if someone isn't using the laser correctly.  The girl who was doing the procedure was barely out of high school and didn't seem to know anything.  So I transferred the remainder of my groupons to facials.  This service was much better.  But I would never pay their full prices which are insane for this place.  I'd rather go to a glamorous day spa that has amenities like a steam room and special assorted teas and cucumber sandwiches at those rates.

Unfortunately, my last facial was not relaxing at all.  The girl had a cold and was sniffling the whole time and sucking on cough drops.  Please call in sick next time, no one wants someone who is sick pawing at their face and breathing on them for an hour.  Lastly, if you accept Credit Cards and request for tips- then we should be able to give a tip on a credit card.  I pay taxes, so should you.

I won't go back to Reid's. I took in 3 silk shirts and one pair of pants. The bill came out to $29. I've never had a bill that high for these items, which I get dry cleaned regularly.

My silk blouses came back with wrinkles still in them and everything smelled chemically. I know it is difficult to get rid of that smell, but a lot of places do a good job of it. I would rather drive across town to another place which I already know I like and save the money. The staff was forgettable, which is neither good nor bad.

I am a professional decorative painter. Two years ago, I went into City Paint to purchase Venetian plaster. A few months later, I was texted inappropriately by a City Paint employee. When I did not respond in the manner they expected, the text messages became increasingly vulgar and offensive. Because I live in another state, I didn't need to purchase products from this vendor, therefore I decided I wouldn't return and blocked the employee's number. However, I recently acquired a job in Boston and needed to purchase additional materials. City Paint was the only vendor with the product I needed. Regrettably, I ended up having to deal with the same salesperson.  Although I called hours in advance to have the plaster ready when I arrived, my order wasn't even started when I was told to pick it up. On top of it all, it cost me additional expenses for the wasted time I had to pay the contractor that was working for me.  Since the owner was in the store when I arrived, I had the opportunity to speak with him privately about what had occurred concerning the text messages. I was disappointed that the issue with the text messages was brushed off as unfortunate and he did not put much value on the time it took for me to wait for the Venetian plaster to be mixed. 
As a woman in a male dominated field, I feel disrespected by the manner in which I was treated by the owner and employee of City paints.  I sincerely hope the employee has been dealt with and this situation never happens to any woman that does business with this company in the future.

The one reason I'd hesitate to give Ken's only 1-star is for the fact that our experience is now a funny story to tell. We went shopping at 5 Austin area bakeries with high online ratings  and brought back samples of cookies, muffins, and other goodies.  Our #1 criteria was overall taste was the main criteria. There were six of us who taste tested back at home. 

Going to Ken's was unique. I'll keep the story out of it, but suffice it to say that the service was jarring (not in a good way), and the food was no different than going to a doughnut house in its final years (you know the type - they were great at one point, but you can tell by looking around that their day in the sun is about over). Not to say that this is true of Ken's - it's just the vibe we got. Getting out of Ken's parking lot is extremely difficult as well. So, food, bad; ambience, bad; food, kids loved it - adults hated it; price, great. That is really the positive take-away - it's cheap food is perfect for hungry college kids.

Never again, that's for sure.  This place is more interested in being a "scene" than serving quality food.  We had an 8:30 reservation but were bumped because a walk in group knew the owner who looks like Jo-Jo the Whale in Bronx Tale.  The doorman/host was apologetic, but we weren't seated until 9:30.  

I'd read about the place online and much was made of the fun atmospere and the meatballs.  It was not fun, I definitely did not get it.  Maybe I suck, maybe you love tacky disco and overdone wish-they -were cougars at the bar.  The food was average at best.  Shared the caprese salad and meatballs as an app.  Ummm, the caprese salad was good, meatballs were mushy and bland.  My main course was the veal chop which was awful.  Bad cut and fatty.  

Good news is the place is small enough that they probably can get by suckering in the tourists and catering to their buddies.  There are 200 choices within walking distance, and I'll visit them all before I go back.  All except Strega which apparently is owned by the same guy.

Note I did not get a massage, so he may be the most amazing massage therapist ever but I didn't get that far so can't review that.
Came highly recommended by a friend of a friend. I went online and amazingly there was an appointment available that same evening. Maybe that should have been my clue. I booked my appt online. At the appropriate time headed out for the visit, but encountered sad difficulty with my GPS. So yes, my bad. I called to let him know I was running a bit late and then came a long and super frustrating conversation in which he repeated several things over and over as if I hadn't heard or understood him, and yet also seemed not to hear or understand what I was saying (for example, kept trying to give me some thoughts on directions even after I had multiple times said I didn't need his help finding the place, and when his directions also showed that he had no idea where I was or how it made sense to get from there to his office). Five minutes of talking to this guy made me 100% clear I wouldn't want to meet him or get massaged by him so I declined his offer to reschedule later in the evening (it took 2-3 times for me to say this for him to actually hear me, he kept talking about how much time it took to clean up after a visit and how much time a proper intake would take). So sad, he had been so highly recommended, and I really wanted a massage, but I'll be looking elsewhere.

This is a horrible Avis location and I would not recommend anyone to rent a car here. They actually lied to me by telling me they called me to tell me my rental would not be there. 
I went to the Windy Hill location and the owner there was great. AND he informed me that my phone number was correct in the system. No way anyone called me from Cumberland. 

I will always use the location at Windy Hill from now on. 

I can't imagine why AVIS would allow this manager to operate at this location

First I want to say super friendly staff 
But not to professional I have an appointment with Becky and I was late 20 minutes but my appointment upped to be for an hour and half and I made another appointment for conditioning 25 min 
Sad part is that they did horrible in blow drying my hair and I pay 130 plus tip to be really unhappy about my hair I have ombré and my blonde is totally different and have black dots terrible 
The guy the did my hair super nice but not good st drying my type of hair

DO NOT GO HERE! My girlfriend and I went to the Bicycle Sport Shop located on Lamar the other day. She was coming in from San Francisco to visit me and we decided to rent a road bike to ride around town and just enjoy our time together for a few days. That idea was completely ruined thanks to the jerkoff at the counter named Mike or Kyle or whatever the hell his name was. Some asshole with short hair and a speech impediment. We needed help in finding the right size bike for her and he was of no help. Some other guy working back there with Adidas Samba shoes and glasses was kind enough to stop what he was doing and help us out. He tried asking the jerkoff if they had any extra seats to install on the bike she was interested in renting out because the seat on the bike at the time was too high. He replied with some with some incoherent mumbling that not even his coworker could understand and then rudely waved us off and asked the other people who were waiting if they needed help instead. This is the complete opposite of the treatment we received at the Research location. We'll make sure that whenever we're in need of a rental, the Bicycle Sport Shop on Lamar is the absolute worst place to go to. Then again, that's $500 bucks I saved from crappy service, so it all works out in my favor anyways. Thanks for nothing.

Decent service, horrible business! 

I would recommend going to absolutely any other physical therapy office before you go to this one.

If you must go to Waldron Peak, Only pay cash out of pocket... Do not go torough insurance... They end up charging YOU the interest, and will not wait for your claim to settle.

It is obvious that they do not have enough business to keep afloat in order to wait until your claim settles. So if you are waiting on a settlement for more than a year, they will send you to collections, and charge you an astronomical amount of interest.

The actual therapist are decent, but I wouldn't risk it with the horrible business practices they follow.

If you're looking for a 30 minute to-go wait, then being served up a shrimp *not* to go, sending it back, taking another 10 minutes to wrap it to go, then getting in your car and finding *this thang cold*- then TT is just for you. 

I apologize to you out-of-towners or discerning Austinites; you deserve better. I've bailed from the Austin food scene but my 91 yr old momma needs weekly visits, and today I was hungry.  Graceland, I'm coming home to eat, where friendliness and customer service is cooler than a body covered in ink. Thank you, thank you very much. E

We had a reservation and were on time. We waited 15 minutes before I had to get up and go to the hostess stand to ask for a server. The server promptly came over and apologized that she was in the back because the table next to us had their appetizer order screwed up (probably shouldn't have told us that). We ordered appetizers which consisted of grilled artichokes (excellent), table made cocktail shrimp (never told us it was the normal cocktail shrimp) which was ok and my daughter ordered 2 orders of oysters.  The artichokes came timely. It was kind of a bit of a wait for the tableside shrimp cocktail. The oysters were still not there. The server finally came over and asked about the Oysters (the set up came about 20 minutes before) and we said she never got them. She came back to inform us that they were on their way and the first order was stolen. Another excuse. She ate a few and they didn't taste right. At this point we were there for an hour and 15 minutes with only appetizers served so we asked for our check for what we ate and drank. The manager came over and we just simply wanted our check and wanted to get out.  He offered a to fix the wrong and explained they were only there for a week (yet another excuse hmm) and offered us a gift card.  I declined as we were there to celebrate our daughter's birthday and wanted to pay for what we ate and drank.  We waited another 5-10 minutes for what I believe was the GM And he again offered us a gift card and to comp our tab so far.  I refused as we are not there to get something for free and just wanted a nice night. They again gave us the gift card which my husband accepted and directly gave it to our daughter whos birthday dinner it was (she will use at Moonfish).  He then agreed to have them charge us for a soda so we could tip the server who apologized and cried which tells us this is a normalcy for them.  Thanks for trying to right a wrong but this has happened in the past and never again.

I almost hate to do this but it is what it is. I want to start by saying my previous review of this restaurant prior to their renovations was 4 stars and we were regularly returning customers. ALL of that has changed, and we will not be returning and will advise others to steer clear.

I'm not sure what happened, but the new management has all but ruined this place. Allow me to start from the beginning:

We returned to Rock Bottom because we were again in the area to see a comedy show, and it's our routine to go here prior to the show. I was glad to see it had reopened since it was down for renovations.

The night started off alright as we were seated outside which is nice. When I went to order Chili, the waiter informed me they had ran out. Okay, no big deal. I ordered the Bourbonzola Burger, the waiter asked how I would like it cooked, medium was my answer. My girlfriend ordered the Lobster-Shrimp-Pasta dish. 

Well, when we received our meals it was quite surprising to see that the $20 Lobster-Shrimp-Pasta dish was basically a bunch of pasta with a few shrimps and a sad tiny piece of a lobster... Now, we certainly didn't expect a ton but for the price this seemed a bit ridiculous. Not to mention my burger was well-done, not medium. So, we contacted out waiter and he seemed willing to help and understanding so he took the dish back, asked what she would like to do she asked if she could just have them add some lobster. 

Soon after the manage came over, and honestly this is where things got bad. Instead of offering a fair solution he decided to talk down to us about how all of their restaurants have the same measurements and that he can't add anything without charging us... Wait, so you can't even provide a meal worth the $20 and you want to charge us MORE to make it right... Yeah, some how I don't think so. He continued his poor customer service act, until I had enough. My girlfriend refused the food (even after he comped the meal) and didn't want anything else as substitute. At this point because of the way he was treating us, I decided to voice my opinion on my own meal. Honestly, I hadn't planned to say anything at all but his demeanor ruined the good mood of both us. I told him and even showed him my burger's cook was well-done not medium, and what is his response? That they actually cook their burgers as sliders and they are not cooked to order. Okay... then why was I asked how I would like that cooked?? He said he will have to re-train the waiter because I wasn't supposed to have been asked... Wow. The fair, simple and proper solution would've been to add a bit of lobster, send the same plate back and off go two loyal customers in a good mood, feeling that the restaurant made right out of the bad situation... instead this.

He did comp both of our meals, but only the burger was eaten anyway. So, in closing I would just advise people to stay away. Check out the other restaurants in the area first. This experience will be our last at Rock Bottom. Their management's customer service is non-existent.

We went there on a Saturday during lunch and the restaurant was dead. We sat outside and then ordered our drinks (3 adults and 1 infant). The waitress came out with our drinks on a large platter and then proceeded to spill the drinks 1 by 1 from the platter onto our table, me, the baby stroller, my iPhone (6S Plus) and my wallet. She somehow did all of this with absolutely NO reaction whatsoever?!?!  For me it would be an automatic and jerk reaction, so it was off putting to say the least. She simply turned around and walked back inside while she said under her breath "that's why people don't like to use that one"... Don't know if she was talking about our table or the large serving tray. 

She was inside for about 10 minutes, while we struggled to clean my phone, the stroller (which she spilled a beer on), and my clothes and wallet.  When she returned she brought with her, not napkins to help us clean, but NEW DRINKS. Seriously?!?!?!  Our stuff is soaking wet, I can hang tight on my drink, how about some napkins. At that point we said we would go somewhere else and she just turned around and went back inside without saying a thing. 

RUDE!  If I could give zero stars, I would. It's amazing how one person can ruin what looked to be a nice place forever.

Kudos for cheeseless pizzas, but not my style. The crust is far too floppy, not crispy enough. Although I do enjoy their non-traditional flavors, variety and fun names. I sampled a spiral tap, and wished it had more tomato sauce, and less sweet onion sauce. I forget the other one I tried, but it was too drippy. Warning: should eat these pizzas fast lest you create a mess while it melts. I may try the other flavors one day on a visit to Powell's across the street, but wouldn't if I could avoid it.

Okay. As much as I adore the NPs at this clinic, I cannot say the same for RediClinic's operations. It turns out the extra $50 price hike back in September was a result of the front desk ordering a lab test that was neither asked for, medically necessary, or communicated to me, the patient. Additionally, this extra lab test was only $25 -- so why on earth was I charged an extra $50?

Trying to get this money back has been an absolute ORDEAL. The clinic itself was unable to refund this to me directly, and I was told to contact corporate, who have not responded to repeated inquiries. By this point, I have been refunded the $25 for the lab test (without any communication whatsoever from corporate -- not even a short, "Hey, we're sorry we performed this 100% unnecessary lab test, here's your money back") but I never received the additional $25 extra charge. I have had to open a dispute with my credit card company, complete with invoices, to recover that $25 -- and if RediClinic resists, I am going to raise absolute hell. $25 doesn't seem like a lot, but it's the principle of the thing.

I myself work in a medical clinic and understand that I might be judging the front desk staff a little unfairly. However, BECAUSE I work in a medical clinic and have often had to settle billing disputes, I know this was handled in exactly the wrong way. Medical visits must always come with itemized invoices. Fees must be explained upfront. I should not have had to find out from an NP a month later, after I expressed confusion at being charged my usual amount for a follow-up visit, that the front desk had ordered a test on my lab specimen that literally could not have returned a positive. 

I initially started going to the RediClinic because I was uninsured and needed frequent last-minute appointments, but now that I once again have insurance, I will likely be transferring back to ARC, which has never given me any kind of billing hassle in the last few years.

If you visit any RediClinic, make sure you know up front EXACTLY what services you are receiving here. Do NOT let the front desk staff give you vague excuses about price hikes -- I doubt this is a result of maliciousness, but incompetence is equally as damning. Whichever staffer was running the front desk at Tech Ridge on September 15 at 4:30, thank you so much! You are singlehandedly responsible for this one-star review.

Really bad place to try and work or just enjoy yourself for a minute. Downstairs has no laptop policy which I can completely respect but Staff completely ignored the fact that they had no space to sit upstairs. Staff was also rude and unresponsive when i tipped them and said thank you. Very bad service- giving them one star cause pastries are nice but really cant compensate for a rude and unresponsive staff so overall would not recommend this business and will be reconsidering spending my money here in the future

I have been to this restaurant several times before this evening when I decided to order the Godfather sub. What an enormous disappointment! This sub is not deserving of its name. There wasn!t even 1 ounce of meat on it....for $8.99!! You can find bigger and better subs at Grinders or Penn Station for less. I called the manager shortly after arriving home and seeing the sandwich and was told by some millennial that he was helping in the kitchen. I stressed that I wanted a call back ASAP. I never even got a call back from the manager. This is terrible terrible terrible customer service. If they don't care, then I don't care to spend my money there. I can find better options in the future where people care about my business. I won't go back there because of this terrible customer service.

Their website is hard to use. Their payments are hard to set up. The claims portal is almost nonexistent. They denied even the most generic birth control. I have "cancelled" my subscription more than once and I keep getting charged. Overall a total skam and I hope every state sues them even if I don't get money back. Whoever "runs" this company should live with a lifetime of shame because if you were such good caring Christians to set this up then so many people wouldn't be finically and physically harmed. I hope you truly are religious so when you make there God's judgement day will be a harsh reality that you are bad people.

Churros are small but tasty. It's a bit pricey for what you get and considering it's not a great environment for sitting and relaxing. I would choose the Pie Spot or Blue Star over this joint. What's worse is the seating area is facing the kitchen and we got a birds eye view of how unclean this place is. The worker with the Beard was touching his face and beard and continued to knead his dough without washing hands. The gals went from cashier to filling in churros without washing hands. This is disgusting and ruined my appetite. What's worse? My churro "stand/plate" came with two ants running around the bottom of it. When I returned and pointed out the ants- the response, "oh sorry." I think they are due for a public health inspection before someone gets sick. And a reality check regarding pricing. One of their small desserts is $6- I can go to Papa Haydns and get a good dining experience and full cake slice for couple bucks more. Skip this place if you care about cleanliness.

Last year we went to Bistro Niko and it was amazing. I was so excited to come back. It was easily one of the best restaurants Atlanta had to offer at the time. We went back tonight and it was easily the worst meal I've ever had in my life. The baked oysters were just weird. Not terrible but not good either. I had the bouillabaisse, which was bland and actually made my dry heave toward the end as I tried to continue eating it. It looked like a thick tomato soup and it had little to no flavor. There was also a piece of fish in there that tasted like chemicals. My husband had veal tenderloins. Again, bland-- no flavor. It tasted like they took it out of the packaging from the grocery store, put it in a pan without butter or oil, and served.

The service was good, however.

I would give ZEERRO stars if I could. They are just flat out right liars. They know and they don't care. They know they will sell their car to an unknowing victim. Their cars are all thoroughly inspected?! Sure they are..
Wont budge on their price on used cars even though I was told to come down to make an offer-that they WERE taking offers-and they would work on the numbers. Oh, they came down few hundred. But what a huge waste of time and gas for my family and myself.
They could have had made a deal, but upper management is just plain rude.

Why bother scheduling service if they're not even going to look at it that day?

I called early midday on a Monday to ask if they had time that week to look at my car (any time--I mentioned that I'd happily bring it in later in the week).  I described what issues it had, and the guy on the other line (I'll withhold his name) cheerfully said he had time tomorrow.  Perfect. 

Fast forward to tomorrow.  I drop the car off at 8 AM, and the guy behind the desk says they'll call me with an update later in the day.  Well, 4 PM rolls around and I haven't heard a thing.  I call back and guess what?  They haven't even started looking at my car yet.  Remind me why I bothered calling ahead?  The whole point was so that I could drop the car off in the morning and pick it up in the afternoon.  If they had run into unexpected problems, I would understand.  But to delay simply because they can't plan is unacceptable.

good luck going if your a woman of color!! I went in for my passport and didn't have my picture with me when I first walked in and the lady was nice enough to inform me and told me to go get my picture taken at CVS and come back to finish  what needed to be done.
