He borderline kicked me out and told me there was nothing he could do even though I booked this appointment weeks in advance. I am African American woman and I didn't see him talking to anyone else in this manner ahead of me.. I am not the one who says this so beware.

I was in a hurry and needed something quick and being mostly vegan I dont eat meat hence the reason i come here to taco cabana instead of other fast food places because they have things I can actually eat. well i ordered two black bean tacos and waiting for my food i seemed to catch a funny vibe like i was the center attraction for some kind of joke... well I got my food and pulled away i was wondering before i even opened the tacos if i should even eat them because i felt that someone did something to my food the way they were acting and looking at me. Well as i pulled away I checked my tacos and at that point i knew what was up the tacos we're both steak tacos with meat only. I felt horrible that they would think someone being hungry and needing some food is an opportunity to play a joke on someone. i never called back in and from now on I go inside to get my food. Ill just say that taco cabana is lucky i still eat there sometimes but I know I will never come to this location on N Lamar ever again

I used to take my fur babies to this facility and Management is the absolute worst. The girls need a lot more training from answering the phones to when you come in through the door, extremely unprofessional. I currently took my babies to another vet that just opened in Hunters Creek and I feel Crystal Creek Animal Hospital can learn a lot from them. The girls were very compassionate from the time I scheduled my appointment, to the moment I walked in through the door. The Dr. was exceptional and answered every question I had and did not rush me out the door. I will no longer be going to Crystal Creek and I will not suggest it to anyone until they get better management and customer service skills.

I hate the fact that this is the closest BK to me. The past few experiences have been horrible, but that's what I've had to endure for a flame-broiled Whooper when I didn't feel like grilling my own burger at home. 

My most recent experience was the evening of Monday, May 1. My brother-in-law and I pulled up around 9:35pm and tried to go into the dining room. A rather rude employee that was just hanging out in front of the restaurant brusquely yelled that the dining room was closed(much to my consternation, because usually this location's drive-thru always gets it wrong). We pull over to the drive-thru window to place our orders, but the speaker system is horrible.  The person taking the order is unintelligible, so we pull up to the window to complete placing our order and pay.  The manager working the window seemed a little frustrated. He asked us to pull around because he had to drop fresh onion rings.  5 minutes later, another employee brought our bags to us and we headed homeward.

7 minutes later, we arrived home. I looked at my bag and the entire bottom was soggy with grease. Apparently, the bagger just dumped my rings into the bag, totally missing the container that they normally come in, which was barren save for a couple of errant fries.  I hustled up the steps to my apartment afraid that the entire bag would give way due to the seep-through. No big deal as long as the food was still in the bag. It was...that was the good news.   The bad news is that the onion rings were so hard and tough that eating them was damn near impossible-I ended up trashing them.  The chicken fries were rubber but I soldiered through. 

Quality like this is why Sandy Springs needs a Cook-Out in the worst way.

Terrible customer service. Living here was a nightmare 
I was charged an entire month's rent for not verbally stating my end date (even though it was listed on my lease agreement!!!!) I'm a student with crippling student loan debt, and a fee that huge seemed like overkill. 
I tried calling the corporate office MULTIPLE times, and the director hung up in my face! I could not believe how unprofessionally this was handled. 
I honestly feel SCAMMED by this leasing company. I suggest avoiding all the hidden fees and loopholes so that you do not get scammed like I did, but if you do choose to rent with them, read the lease agreement VERY carefully.

My frustration lies not with MGH in general but with the PICC team. They are either understaffed or poorly organized. I'm currently going through 6 rounds of chemo and EVERY time it's the PICC team that holds everything up. Cannot start the chemo without the PICC line. 
Today my PICC was a scheduled appointment:
Arrive at 11:45am for a 12:15pm procedure
Its 2:45 and I'm still waiting... that's 3 hours... no communication from the staff. This causes unnecessary stress on patients already stressing over health struggles. Poorly organized and sad display of customer service.

We had the breads with sausage and meat Patty.  The bread could have been cooked more to have a browner complexion, and the meat was not layered on thick enough to make a textural difference.  It was like dog food texture on bread.  

I ordered the Adana kebab, a spicier version of the traditional kebab, which was average.  I was amazed by the portion size of the hummus on my plate.  It was an embarrassment in portion and uninspiring in flavor.

The rice was not prepared well.  It was overcooked and oily.  I've had better at Persian places.

Also, the restaurant didn't give us water from tap.  They only sold bottled water or topo chico if you wanted a glass of water.  Our party of 8 asked repeatedly in disbelief thinking there was a misinterpretation.

I strongly do not recommend this example of middle eastern cuisine.

Won't be going here again.  When I walked in with a few friends of mine the staff behind the counter were chatting we were looking at what to get and when we were ready they acted as though we were not even there and when we finally said something the rolling of the eyes would have knocked you on your ass, it was as if we had asked them to move the world and help us.  The food was ok, the drinks were so, so and the service was donright AWFUL.  No, no, no!

The service was terrible.I had a birthday party for a group of 9 , and the 15% gratuity was including in the bill ;which is acceptable .However ,because the tip was already included, they didn't even care about the customers. we got a table at 7pm , waited 25mins for drinks and another 40mins to have food In the table .For desert, I brought a birthday cake over and take her 20 mins just to bring the cake out .Ours waitress was a tall blonde lady ,she tried to service other table and forgot about us. She shouldn't deserve that much tips .My Greek used to be one of my favourite restaurant but not anymore. Iam really disappointed and wouldn't come back anytime soon.

Visiting from the SF Bay Area, I've had my share of poor service, old buidings, and generic Chinese food. This place was the worst. My family and I chose to have dim sum. The cart came around once and we were offered 6 selections. 2 of them were chicken feet, and the brownest soysauce covered fried rice I've seen. The shu mai had a hair in it! We received nothing to drink until we were done. We should have left, but instead decided to order 3 entrees from the menu, since we were starving. It took them close to 25 minutes to get the first dish! The bathroom sign had a sign for employees to wash their hands. There was no soap in the dispensers. This was the first time that I didn't leave a tip.

I love Mod Pizza, particularly their caesar salad. However, its very disappointing when you order online and you receive the wrong order. My mom was kind enough to pick up what I ordered online (caesar salad, no tomatoes) since I was home sick. To my disappointment, my salad arrived with tomatoes on it despite me ordering it clearly online with no tomatoes. I am allergic, deeming the whole salad not edible. I also don't live nearby and being sick, I was not about to get up and drive it back for THEIR mistake. Very disappointed.

I will be moving out of these apartments in the next month or so.  I have lived here about a year and a half and the only benefit I can see is the location to GT. The buildings are built poorly...i mean everything. You will hear your neighbors conversations both above and next door. You will be driven nuts by the upstairs neighbors walking. The floors have absolutely NO sound deadening. I had to use thermal curtains because the windows are some of the worst I have dealt with. Your air conditioning will run all the time in the summer and the heat will run all winter.
Most recently I have had to call the police on the weekends because 30-40 individuals will empty into the parking lot from an apartment around 1 a.m. I spoke with the officer and was informed that I should move because he gets these calls frequently. There is no security and the gates are pointless. 
I could go on and on but I haven't got the time. I will say one good thing about the complex. They recently changed managers and I have received more front office communication since. So that's nice.

I don't even know where to begin with this place. Every single thing about my experience here was awful. I'm no stranger to hole-in-the-wall Buford Highway tacos, and have had enough tacos from Del Rey and Taco Veloz to feed half of Mexico, so my expectations were pretty high that this might be yet another diamond in the rough. No.

First of all, Yelp says they deliver. A taco place that delivers?! I couldn't contain my excitement, so I called, ordered, and then was told to come pick it up. Fine, whatever. I should have expected that anyways. I arrive at the place 20 minutes after placing my order (they told me it would take 15) and proceeded to wait another 20 minutes at the hot, stuffy restaurant for my food. During that time, they inform me that they are out of carnitas. At that point I had been there for 10 minutes already, but whatever. It's Friday night, I get it, people run out of stuff. I'm still not pissed at this point. Of course I hit every light on Chamblee Tucker trying to get home and am starving and so excited to eat until.....I open the boxes. Not only did they not give me what I ordered, everything was almost gray and inedible. It was all worse looking and tasting than freezer burritos. Oh, and did I mention their health score was 77? So not only was the food disgusting to look at, it was probably riddled with salmonella. I tried a bite of most of the items anyways because I hate wasting food, but most of it went in the garbage and then I drank a gin and cried into my pillow thinking of all the children in the world who would gladly eat my salmonella infested garbage. 

Just...don't go here. Just don't.  Everything about it was a disappointment. Except their orange salsa. That was alight, but the chips with it were so ridiculously stale I couldn't enjoy it.

yuck yuck no.

Like many of the other posters on here I do agree that this is the best Chinese place to open at this site (simply by not having a dead rat in the restroom they achieved this).  Located half a block from my apartment Wisteria still falls way way low on my list when I have a craving for Chinese.  Super-expensive for the portion adn the neighbor-hood, especially considering the previously noted lack of ANY flavor.  The fire chicken, sounded tasty enough, but all that came was greasy fried chicken with a few warm-ish peppers.  After the first few bits the grease made the dish inedible.

If you feel like droping 25$ a head for crappy food, eat up.

Back in the early 80s when I first found Sam"s, I raved about it and went pretty often and at all hours. Over the years "Sam" passed operations to his children and the original building burned down, and I found less and less to love. On my last visit I literally couldn't bring myself to eat the cold, globby, limp mess of fat and bone that they gave me in place of the delicious mutton I had enjoyed so many times back in the day. I gagged my first mouthful down, but I actually had to spit my second and third mouthfuls out before sadly throwing the rest away. Sorry to see such a great institution in such hard times.

Been here probably 30 times in the last few years. 
Always been kinda good, sometimes crappy, mostly good. 
Food is what it is. 
But yesterday, it was abysmal, truly horrible in every way.
We walked in and a girl, who literally only said four words to us,
look at us as if "hello....." and said what's the name? she wrote down
my wife's name, then said nothing, looked away, then walked away.
No indication that there'd be a wait, or how long or anything, at all.
Same thing for the next 12 people who walked in.
20 mins went by, the restaurant was half empty, I went up and said
what's the deal? she said, oh, we only have one barperson on, sorry,
and I said "we here to eat", she just walked away. 
We eventually got seated, 30 mins later. 
I counted about 10 or so people leave for every two she seated. 
When we sat down we ordered two drinks. One took 3 mins, the other,
the easiest drink in the world, took 15 mins. 
They forgot our starter, our salad, and the main course came 30 mins after 
ordering.
How we didn't leave I'll never know. Actually, we were starving and just off a flight home. 
But seriously, this place was a freaking shambles, and the 'manager' type person
drifted by at some point and mumbled 'sorry for the wait' as he looked at a chair somewhere
in the distance. 
This place is falling apart. 
Won't be coming back for a looong time. 
Embarrassing carry on.

"Leave and never come back!" Those are words I never heard before and did not expect to hear in America's Vancouver. As a regular customer of Madhouse Coffee on Mill Plain, I spend 2-3 hours most weekdays working on my laptop while enjoying a coffee and occasional snack. I practice social distancing and wear a mask.

Last week I was asked to move to another table by the owner because I was "taking up too much space." As I looked around the empty store, containing several other large tables, I responded politely that I would be glad to move if a large group came in. This week, the same man aggressively demanded of me, "Didn't I tell you to move last time?" I again responded that I was happy to move if space was needed. The store was empty except for me.

I was then unexpectedly told to "leave and never come back!"

I am shocked at this treatment, especially during a time of reduced business on account of COVID-19. I encourage customers of Madhouse Coffee and anyone looking for a drink, snack, or dessert to find another place to go. Clearly, this business is aptly named.

Went to the Tides restaurant today for a nice lunch with my dad. Got there at 12:20, and was told there would be a 25 minute wait for the bar side. We chose to wait. We were seated at 12:45, our order was taken at 12:55. We both chose the lunch special, baked haddock with two sides.
Time went by, people who were seated after us were getting their food, we watched three tables , seated after us get their food before we did.
Waitress went by, we grabbed her and asked about our food. She told us something happened in the kitchen, that was the explanation, nothing else. I can understand if there was a problem in the kitchen, but if that was the case , why were other people getting their food?
Finally , at 2:00, our food came.  The baked haddock was cold and dry, I had to sip my drink to get a bite down. The onion rings were lukewarm , and the grilled vegetables were raw, with a char on them, also cold . I ate some onion rings .  I flagged the waitress down for our check, she never asked how our meal was, she offered another explanation about a party of twenty showing up in the dining room, and there being only two cooks in the kitchen. Still doesn't explain why other people were getting their food, and ours took so long. 
I grew up going to the Tides, when it was owned by the former owners, and NEVER had a bad meal or bad service. This was a $40 disappointment that I I will neither forget or repeat again. The beautiful view can only make up for so much.
I will never recommend the Tides to anyone. If the service was this bad on a Thursday noon time, I can't imagine what it's like on a weekend!

They deleted my review and several of my frienfs reviews. That should tell you something about how shady of a business this is right off the bat. We went with a group of 20 people after a wedding. Then a regular at the bar joined in on the racism. Who was so drunk he could barely stand. This guy punched someone in the face the cops came. I was a patient of Urology Team PA for over 4 years.   They were unable to solve my problem no matter how many meds had been prescribed.  The last straw was when I went in one last time and the physician prescribed another medication.  Of course, I explained I was pregnant at the time.  When I called my OB/GYN to review the meds she had prescribed, he was furious stating if I even TOUCHED the medication it could cause harm to the fetus, maybe even miscarriage!  

That would have been horrible since my husband and I had been trying for 3 years to get pregnant.

None-the-less, that was it.  Never took the medicine, the baby is perfect and I'm never going back.  

I'm surprised the other 4 reviews of 1 stars are no longer on this site (which had similar bad experiences).  Yelp has removed my review twice now, so I'm hoping it stays on this time to inform others.

Stay Away! Beware of highly overpriced food and built in tip!

This type of food is Chinese fast food! It should not be expensive or fancy. The 3 of us decided to grab a lunch bite while on our way to the airport to pick someone up. Ordered 2 wonton noodle soup and a roast pork noodle soup, the waitress was a tad rude but not unusual for an Asian restaurant. The food was not stellar but run of the mill, does the job. Small portions for the noodles compared to other places. 

The bill was $75.00!! We had to double check the bill a few times and noticed that the tip was already added at 12%. She literally took our order, brought the food and never came back again. We had to go up to the till to pay. An automatic 12% grat is completely ridiculous and misses the point of why you would tip someone.

Poor service and mediocre bbq. There are so many Korean/Japanese bbq joints in the city to choose from. Please save your money and take your business elsewhere as the portions here are small and food quality is just ok. The real nail in the coffin and 'Never Return' stamp of disapproval is the snotty and incoherent waitress who clearly hates her job and hides in the back after throwing our food down on the table. We even had a hard time flagging her down to get our bill. Really poor service and manners.

I really dislike giving negative reviews, but I'm pretty disappointed with this place.  I initially called in to confirm hours of operation and the women who answered the phone was not too friendly whatsoever.  However, I decided to give them a chance regardless.  I came in and there were about 6 people in here on a Sunday evening and the 2 woman behind the counter who seemed extremely overwhelmed and inconvenienced by the business.   I Just ordered a couple slices of cheese pizza, which were nothing special, and tasted very chemically. I asked to use a restroom and was told that they have no public restroom.  I'm completely appalled!! How can you have a restaurant with a dining area that can seat over 50 people, and no public restroom?? ARE YOU KIDDING ME! And she didn't say it was out of service she, clearly said that they have "No public restrooms"  Do not come here. It's not worth the irritation.

we had been going there since the shop opened, and we know the family that owns it.  Unfortunately, the attitude towards the customer has changed dramatically!  We ordered a platter from them, to be picked up on Sun. at 11:30, for a lunch at 1:00p.m.  When I got there, I was presented with a small platter, costing $50.00, and not the right platter!  We had ordered a platter with corned beef, which they had done for us in the past, and which the owner had said he would do again.  I also went in on Thursday to verify this platter, and the young lady at the counter read me the slip, with the corned beef on it, and pick up at 11:30.  When I arrived, I was told by the employees that they don't do corned beef, and after a little back and forth and a couple of phone calls, Bill, the owner, happened to walk in/  First he told me they don't use corned beef, and when I told him that he authorized it while I was on the phone with his employee, he then suggested that he would go out and buy some, but it wasn't on the paper.  Well, then I guess they use invisible ink, since on Thursday, the corned beef was on the slip when I went in.  After a couple more minutes, I decided they could keep the platter they had made, since it wasn't up to par for what they had given us in the past, and they were "all" pretty rude about the way this was handled.  My family will never order anything from them again.
Marc R.

I have given this place a fair try but they just either don't know what they're doing or they just like taking your money.  First I got tires from there last october. I spun out last february & my wheel weights fell off the rim.  Had to go get my tires re-balanced only to have my hubcap fall off the next day.  After my hub cap fell off I saw that they put the wrong wheel weights on my rim. 

So I was really mad that my hubcap was gone & that there were aluminum wheel weights on my iron rim .  So I called sullivan tire in marshfield & Firestone in quincy(they seem alright) & asked them "What kind of weights should be on my iron rim?" They both said iron weights immediately. I call hingham what do they say ? "oh Well, it depends..." I cut him off immediately & tell him no & to rebalance my tires correctly & I'm not paying.  So they re-balance my car again for the third time. The manager apologized & told me my car was perfectly balanced now.  

A month later I get my brakes done(else where), and the place asked me why I had aluminum weights on my car.  They replaced the aluminum weights on the rim that the hubcap fell off but not the rest ! Again ! Now to boot the guy at the brakes place tells me that they sold me the wrong tires for my car & that's why they rumble so loud.  

So in short, this place doesn't know what they're doing. They replaced bad work with bad work.They don't care, don't trust them. Yes, that skinny guy at the desk is as sleazy as he looks. Never again.

I've done business with Bharat before and was very satisfied with his work to the point I was a returning customer. Which is why it's hard for me to write this review. Long story short I asked him to print shirts for me using a process that prints into the fabric. He said he could do it if I gave him the design by a certain date. I did as he asked. I didn't hear back for a few days, but when I finally did he said he was switching over to a process using vinyl. Although it's not what I wanted he convinced me I'd like his way of doing it and it looks great. They didn't. The shirts look like cheap iron ons you can hear crinkle like plastic when you pick them up.

Basically Bharat ran out of time and used a cheaper process hoping to get my money. I lost money on the shirt sales because they look so cheap. I had an email exchange with him which I've posted below where he said he'd take care of me but he never got back, even after an email and a couple of calls. I don't think this is his normal way of doing business, so that's why it's so surprising to have had it happen to me. Sadly, I can't trust to use them again.

Great location, but truly the WORST customer service. When checking in, we were not greeted at all, and the woman barely spoke to me and gave me zero information, acted out out when I asked about the very complicated parking situation and didn't confirm a total or make any sort of welcoming gesture. When we called the front desk for sheets for the couch bed, the attendant said "sending some" and then hung up the phone. When checking out, same experience as check in-rude, uninterested and unfriendly clerk who was doing the bare minimum. For as much money as this room was for the weekend, and based on other location experiences, we were expecting ABOVE AND BEYOND what we received. Truly have received better service at most other places we've stayed. 

The parking is asinine.  If you don't valet, which we were not given an option for or instructions, you have to park in a garage that is not attached to the hotel and make a ridiculous trek with all of your stuff. And on top of it, you're paying $33 a night to do so! 

The air conditioner did not work properly. It was either very hot or very cold, and the cold didn't last long. It wasn't responsive to our requests, and it just made for an uncomfortable nights sleep, both nights. 

The TV offerings were by and large the worst of any hotel stay we've ever had. The TVs themselves are old, bulky and out dated. They have blocked it to where you cannot use your own prime stick or Roku, which some hotels do so that's whatever. But to not have any channels that are worthwhile, a guide that is from the early 90s, and movies to rent that are $20, the whole thing was atrocious. 

We have paid hundreds of dollars less a night and had much better of an experience, from the service to the TV to the parking to the outdated and not terribly clean rooms. I would not recommend this hotel, not for any price but especially the $600 it cost us for 2 nights. 

Stay somewhere else! Trust me!

I'm sitting outside the dealership in 35° weather writing this review because I refuse to be in this garbage place any longer. Who would have thought that returning a car lease could be made so needlessly complicated? My wife and I have wasted hours dealing with this issue, only to be told that it will take another trip here, even though BMW customer service assured us it would be all set. Thank you for creating needless issues. I'm just happy to know that after today, I'll never have to be in this place in my lifetime again.

My wife and I stopped by the Boulder store 2weeks ago and found a lovely white rope pillow on close out. We inquired to see if they had a second one and were told they didn't have one but the Cherry Creek store did. The sales person called but got no response but their inventory said they had one. The sales person promised to follow up with the store the next day and get it shipped to Boulder. After 2 or 3 phone calls to the store and 2 fricking weeks of waiting for an answer, I finally get an email saying NO they didn't have one. Come on now - 2 weeks to get a simple answer on wether another store had something in stock????? Crazy. Extremely poor customer service. Will shop elsewhere next time.

As a lover of Ribs, it truly hurts to give Redbones 1 Star.  I went yesterday and had the worst meal imaginable.

I ordered the Memphis Ribs (the last 3 times I went, they were out of them) and wanted BBQ wings.  They didn't have BBQ wings only grilled with BBQ sauce on the side, so I said OK.  The staff was really great and helpful with my order.   

I received my food and took it home.  I was shocked.  The great smell of smoked BBQ permeated throughout Davis Sq. did not make it into my ribs & wings.  The ribs were not dry rubbed. The wings were just burnt and the smoke was very light on the food. I used so much sauce on everything.

The sides: the dirty rice was not dirty at all-but expensive for the amount.  The Beans to my surprise was not BBQ Beans they were hospital bland, in fact, you could serve this whole meal in the hospital meeting the blandness requirements. 

The coleslaw was just OK, but for the container, it looked like they literally took a pinch of slaw and stuck it in the middle.   (I really dig the plastic containers)  

The literal definition of Barbecue involves cooking meat on an open fire.  Unfortunately, Redbones went no further than throwing the meat on the fire.

 Now, my taste for Ribs are 1. The Barbecue Pit (Dorchester) 2. Smoken Joes (Brighton Circle)  and down to Wing it (Allston) and Ryles-wet rubbed (Cambridge)

I've been to Redbones  a few times before yesterday and I don't remember it being soo bad on everything

But I got some really cool plastic containers for my lunch, I guess the $32.00 was worth it.

Came here with colleagues for lunch last Thursday.

Pros: not crowded, relatively good service
Cons: Very dimly lit--a bit of a depressing vibe!  I thought the lunch menu was overpriced.  I got the chicken finger app as my main course and it was over $10!  The soda was flat, and the food I had was terrible.  Chicken fingers are usually a safe bet at restaurants, which was why I ordered them.  They were bland and had a distinct freezer burn taste.  I actually spent the rest of the day in bed with what I suspect was food poisoning!  

Do not recommend this place for food at all. Maybe for sports and beer on the weekend.

First of all, I have wanted to go to Salty's for years and finally convinced my husband to try it out since my parents were in town.  I made our reservation online using Open Table.  This went well and someone from Salty's called to leave a confirmation message.  Our reservation was for 7:15.  I called to let the hostess know that we were running about 10 minutes behind and was assured that our table would be ready for us.  
When we arrived at 7:20, we waited 20 minutes to be seated.  The hostess informed me that there had been a mix up and someone else had taken our original table when the name of our party had been called.  I'm not sure how this happened since I was standing right beside the hostess stand from the second we checked in, but I was willing to give her the benefit of the doubt.  I was not thrilled that the table we ended up with after the mix up and the wait was back in a corner of the restaurant with almost no river view - the primary reason that I had wanted to visit Salty's in the first place.
It was a Friday night, and the place was hopping, so I wasn't completely surprised that our initial service was slow.  However, as the evening wore on and the restaurant emptied out, the service did not improve.  There were extended periods of time between visits from our server and delivery of drinks and food.  By 9:05, my father (who never complains) was ready to get the bill for what we had eaten so far and leave.  He made eye contact with our waitress, who turned around and walked the other direction!  At three different times, someone from our table had to be sent to track our waitress down for requests.  She finally let us know that the kitchen was "plating our food" and a full 10 minutes later it was finally delivered to our table.  This was an hour and a half after we sat down, and two hours after our original reservation!  I have not waited this long for food since I was in the Peace Corps and the restaurants would go buy, slaughter and clean a chicken in that amount of time!  At this point, the restaurant was practically empty.  
The waitress apologized and told us that things were slow because 400 people had come through that night - however I find it very hard to believe that this should be a problem for a place the size of Salty's that is used to large crowds.  

On top of all of this, the food was average and the bill was large.  Neither the waitress nor the hostess made any attempt to offer any sort of compensation for the glaringly poor service.  The 18% gratuity was added to the bill because our party was 6 people.  I suppose this was lucky for our server since she would probably have gotten significantly less after her stunningly bad performance - although it is difficult to say how much of the evening was actually her fault - other than ignoring our table for extended periods of time.

Interestingly, when I got up this morning and checked my email, there was something from Open Table (time stamped at 9:00 pm) saying that Salty's had canceled our reservation - which leaves me wondering if there was yet another screw up.

7/22/2020 DON'T GO HERE!!

Went to this place for Botox on 7/8/2020. I have had Botox done before and Dr. Mark Goldsmith didn't seem to  know how to correctly administer the medication. The bridge between my eyebrows still has a wrinkle and somehow made a new wrinkle after the treatment! Maybe it's because he's a psychiatrist with a record! When the procedure was done, he told me to come back in 10 days for a follow. I received 6 text messages from their office with 2 different dates and 3 different times then what I was scheduled at. So I went to the latest text message that had the date and time that I confirmed. Of course when I arrived at my scheduled time, the office was closed. There was no notification of it being closed nor did I receive any calls to reschedule. It's now been 4 days later and still nothing from the office! Don't waste your money here!!

I've been to this place plenty of times for a wedding.  Food has always been just okay.  However the experience I had a few days ago was so disappointing.  It was literally impossible to get water.  Guest can get alcohol because the wedding party brought it in.  The waitress pretty mean ch themes the food at us.  She didn't listen to anything we said.  There was no AC in the place.  We end up leaving early from the wedding due to the service.  I would never come back here for just a meal.

We are from NYC and had 2 special nights to go out in Austin. We chose Fixe for our Sat night dinner. We were seated immediately upon our reservation - great! We had extremely disappointing service but the food was amazing. I think they are severely understaffed and we are pretty laid back about things - but this was over the top negligent. First of all it took a very long time for our waitress to take our order. We had to keep asking for our water to be refilled throughout dinner and had to keep asking for new dinner drinks. They served my husband his dinner and forgot mine and didn't even "blink" or ask if something was wrong! I couldn't find our waitress so I found another one after my husband was half through his dinner. The manager came over and noticed the problem - put my order in and we ended up eating separately because by the time my dinner came my husband was finished with his. It was just a comedy of errors as when we received the check and it was a different price than what was on the credit card bill and it took another 5 mins to find our waitress. The manager comped my meal. I would have rather had a lovely experience with my husband than to have had $28 comped on my bill. We are more than willing to pay for incredible food and service. The night before we went to Lonesome Dove and had a phenomenal experience with food and service!!! Very attentive to every detail.

The staff here was very nice, but it was the quickest, skimpiest, most rushed pedicure I've EVER gotten in my life - I was in and out of that chair within 25 minutes. There was no massage, just a very quick rub of my calves - she didn't even do my feet. She only trimmed/filed my first 2 nails and not all of them. As I type this I can feel the nails on my smallest toes scratching against my socks. 

At the end of this rushed treatment (the salon was not even busy, by the way) I asked why she skipped the massage? She replied that she did do a "short massage" and that to get more than that I'd have to pay for a spa/deluxe massage.  I have never gotten a pedicure somewhere and had them skip the massage. I had actually really looked forward to that part of the pedicure because my feet were hurting. On top of their already steep prices, they want to charge extra for the massage part.
Unreal. 
I won't be back.  North End Nails down the street is cheaper and they include a massage in their pedicures like all the other places I've been aside from this one. 
I left with my feet still sore, and long toenails with sharp corners. Thanks, Amy Nails.

Please do not go here. This place is overrated and overpriced! Took them 45 mins to bring out our food. The bulgogi was cool and bland, our fish soup tasted like they made it with soup powder from cup noodles, and our Nakji Bokum tasted rubber. What made it even worst was our server. Tall korean dude with glasses sat us and was very rude. Took our order and never came back to check on us.  What a Douchebag!Guess you got to be Korean to get good service here. Thanks for ruin my fathers day meal A$$ hole! Place looks fancy but the people working there made it trashy. 

I will take my money to Korea House! Folks there are so sweet and wonderful. They make sure you will get great service dont matter if you black, white, etc.

I'm surprised that this location hasn't been shut down by the Health inspectors. It's funny how they spend so much time spraying down the cart and basket handles but manage to overlook the actual cart and basket interior (Spoiler alert: they are all FILTHY). Even the staff there were appalled by the lack of cleanliness of the baskets. Last visit there was a day ago wherein I witnessed yet another cockroach scurrying around, which is understandable but it's time this locations gets its act together. Also, be mindful of any conversations you have while waiting in their incredibly slow moving check out lines as the checkers there are quick to judge and discriminate. My husband and another patron started a conversation of world event which clearly the young checker did not agree with and managed to find fault with my husband's mask (which is a perfectly functioning mask) and literally refused service to him. Mind you, his mask has obviously never been an issue during any of our other visits to this store. Their corporate office will be hearing about this discriminatory experience.

Not worth it, honestly. Brought my dog in for a dental procedure, and a litany of issues resulted from their care and the antibiotics they had him on. They told me repeatedly to call them if issues occur, but when I called them, they said they couldn't see him and that I should visit another hospital. Why tell me to trust you and then at the first sign of an issue, refer me elsewhere and not even bother trying to fit him in? I don't trust them, and I would advise you to not as well. Take your pet to BluePearl and call it a day. 

I won't be visiting them again, and am glad to not have to deal with their incompetent desk staff anymore. If you're the face of the company, don't spend your time gossiping with each other and ignoring me. It's rude and disheartening.

9:20 pm--Placed phone order for 14" MoPac. The call center told me the cost and that it would be ready in 15 minutes. 
9:32-- arrived at the location on 35th. After about 5 minutes a guy came to the p/u window, took my first name, confirmed my last name and my order. After going to the back of the place, he came back with the news that my pie was in the oven and asked for payment. I handed over my card and signed when the charge slip was presented. After about 5 minutes that guy left with a delivery. 20 minutes later the 4 people who ordered after I paid for mine, got theirs and left. A young woman asked if she could take my order and I informed her of my name, showed her my credit card with my name on it & told her what the delivery guy had said. Then she told me that he was unqualified to tell me anything. "He's just a delivery driver." 
Well, I have to say that the delivery driver knew who I was after hearing only my first name. He also charged my card. From this point it was all downhill. At this point i was not prepared to throw good time after bad. i asked for a refund---a simple task. And all I got was a string of excuses. Did she not know how to perform the simple functions that a mere delivery driver had mastered? I am sure I will never know because after I contacted the call center. I was assured that my card would ultimately not be charged for the pie that never materialized--we'll see. How can this sort of mistake give rise to accusations of drunkenness on my part, I'd like to know. One can only surmise that it is I and the poor unqualified delivery driver who ultimately will bear the blame for this piteous ineptitude. If there is such a thing as a moron hazard curve in the pizza business then I am sure that I have run up against it at 35th & Kerbey. And at...
10:35--I left with no intention of ever returning.

I couldn't poke my fork into the paneer. They took super duper frozen crap and deep-fried the hell out of it.

Indian food is Indian food every where; it pretty much has the similar blend of spices and you kind of know what to expect with some change in the amount of spices and oil. My bad experiences with Indian food has only been because the food was too oily. 

However, today at Kabab and Tandoor, the food just tasted BAD. It was wrongly cooked with the wrong ingredients I think. I ordered a Paneer Tikka Masala. The masala was wrong and the curry just tasted a lot like plain yogurt, which might be an ingredient for the dish but not the dish itself!  The naan pieces were square shaped and just tasted like fluffy pita bread. The worst thing was the fact that I couldn't even poke my fork into the panner. It was that hard. I'm thinking it was super duper frozen stuff and they just deep fried the hell out of it. 

The cherry on top was the bad service. The food took such a long time even though it was a Sunday evening and there were only two other tables eating while we were there. The waiter couldn't care less about how the food was or how we were doing. 

I am not going back and I am annoyed have to payed for it.

The reason I stopped going before was because I had a coupon for 20 items, and brought in 40 (2 sets of 20 at the discounted price). On pickup, I was delivered 39 items and told I had to pay the difference in price between 39 and 40 since the discount no longer applied (and I couldn't have ANY of my prepaid dry cleaning until I paid the extra). 

When I argued that Rick's staff had counted the clothes and the number was 40 at drop off, why would Rick's staff now blame me for the missing item/miscount and demand extra payment? This went on for at least 30 minutes while every staff member in the store stood their ground (and this includes calling on the phone to an outside manager) to confirm that I could not have my prepaid dry cleaning until I paid this fee. After paying the fee, I returned home to find that a garment was missing (thus the change in the garment count) - your staff lost it. I went back to track it down, it was never found. 

So that's a novel strategy - lost my stuff AND charge me extra for the privelege! Nice!

And by the way this is the story of why I stopped going to Rick's the first time - the lost favorite sweaters is the most recent time. 

So no, Ian, you can't fix this. This is not a one time event. This is how you do business!

Just not with me.

I came inside expecting authentic fried chicken. When I got inside it was pretty run-down looking but I know places that look kinda old but have the best food so I stuck around and ordered popcorn chicken. I watched a man grab a bag of frozen popcorn chicken, open it, and grab chicken out with HIS BARE HANDS and dump them into a fryer. Used those hands to make phone calls, touch money, etc. I ran out before the chicken was done and had to pay. So disgusting.

This review is based on our personal experience and the good people whom we knew personally living in Dublin Park so called Luxury Apartments. Don't be fooled by the word luxury because outside is like a lipstick on a pig but inside is everything like from 1980's. 

We encourage everyone before renting from this place do the online research and read about "The Conor Group (TCG)", where you will see that there are thousands of tenants reviews and complains. Also when reading reviews start from the lowest rating because remaining ones are payed for by the TCG. If people spend their time and made a huge effort to write a negative review, it means there is something not right about the place. 

In addition, check the Facebook and Twitter groups called "Tenants Against Connor Group". Based on their experiences which we also faced, TCG with Dublin Park management is the most unprofessional, unethical, rude and shady company that we came across. Please also see the attached photos for the feedback's by the TCG employees which you can read on Glassdoor. 

As a family we lived in this apartments for a couple of years before moving out. Initially apartments were run by the name "Lakeview Square Apartments" and the administration was not that responsible but prices, location and school district was covering that. Then in Feburary 2019 the premises has been bought by TCG and new administration came, we have not noticed any difference initially but once we start receiving lease renewals the nightmare begun. Their sales persons came they promised a lot of things, that there will be renewals they would change everything inside the apartments and many more promises. For everything in their new lease term they increased the rent by 20% where in my case around $160. At that time our kids at the middle of the school year so we decided if everything is as they say than we lets renew even thought it is over our rent budget. They make you sign utilities amendment where they charge you for trash ($45), sewer ($40), common electric, common gas, admin fee which comes in total between $110 and $120 additional to your rent which they never tell you before on top you will be paying for gas and electric. In addition for other premises they own they also charge for internet for around $100. You will learn about the bills from Resident Billing System which is a company owned by TCG. When you start question the leasing office you will never get a clear solid reply, always lie or deception. Their property manager is also unethical, and very rude lady. 

The move out process was also painful, when you request a move-out inspection together they would never accept that. For example before move-out we cleaned our apartment, repaired the stuff which their maintenance ignored, didn't repair and still got cuts from our security deposit, planning to apply for small claims court and get our hardly earned money back. For our family this year was really difficult, I am hearing from my friends that during this pandemic time the TCG hugely increase the rent, they don't care about people who cannot pay on time by applying exorbitant penalty fees. They don't have a lease breakage (when signing the lease they would just tell you it is as usual 60 days notice) even if the person looses a job or gets sick or have a work change in other location. For the same apartment there are different renting prices, for example my neighbor was renting $100 less than us for the completely same apartment. For the same price even lower you can find better places and new apartments around with less hassle, more clear and transparent renting process      

Everyone who wants to rent from here, we are asking you to do your own research read about The Connor Group company. From our side we can say, stay away from this place, believe you will thank later by preserve your sanity and peace of mind. They practice shady business practices and you will be sorry that you rented from them.

I am occasionally able to afford a manicure. Nothing fancy just the basic. The gal that did mine at spoil me left most of my ratty cuticle on my nail. Didn't push them back or cut them evenly at all.  I didn't notice until I was sitting under the drying table, but then I didn't want to say anything (just get out of there). The gal that had just done my mani was refunding her, her money and handing her a tube of cortisone cream telling her that it will be fine in a couple of weeks. It was an accident and I'm sorry you will be fine....honestly I couldn't have gotten out of that place fast enough. They charge you a dollar to use your debt card, and honestly I think the basic mani is over priced.

El servicio mas cafre y unprofessional de mi vida!!!! Esta mujer en el front desk se encojono por k no entendia k yo queria ondas, no curls, no body. Waves!!! Le digo hasle un wash and set entonces. Go to domican salon en cascade road!

Horrible for groups!! Thet try to get you to sign up for family meals at $30 a person where you share a dish amongst all of your party. We had several people with dietary restrictions that where in our party and well they were not accomidateing at all to our needs. Half of our party wound up leaving the restaurant!!!!!!  I paid $30 for what amounts to a bit of salad some pasta and 1/2 a piece of chicken. I was so hungry 2 hours later that I had to eat fast food as it was the only option. I would not reccomend any large groups go here!!! We would have been fine if allowed to order off the regular menu but even after a conversation with the manager we were unable to accomidate all our guests. The place is way overpriced for mediocre service and food. Better off elsware!!!

So I used to think this was a great, fairly high-end brand. Then I bought a suit and had it dry cleaned as per the instructions, only to have it returned ruined. All the elastic in the fabric had buckled through the surface of the garment...making it look almost like it was covered in dandruff! I took it back to the dry cleaner to complain and she said it was an issue with the fabric - a second dry clearner substantiated this. 

Long story short, I took it to the Robson location with my complaint to the store manager. She was less than helpful and pawned me with some customer service line to call. Where I got the run around. 

With so much choice out there, I really wonder why I would continue to buy at BCBG. It's not cheap, but the quality and the service seems to be deeply flawed! 

I had a problem once with a swim suit bleeding colour from Quiksilver, which I bought in the States. I took it into the Van location, they changed it no problem  and were apologetic for the quality issue. Now that's service and I will buy there again!!

I used to be a fan but over the years Pok Pok has really gone downhill.  I always found them to be slightly overpriced, but considered it worth the extra money for the deliciousness and uniqueness.  But now?  $14.00 for some cold, undercooked wings?  Served by an extremely rude, douchebag hipster?  I'm good, thanks.  I still enjoy going to Whiskey Soda lounge.  The prices are still a bit high, but they quality and service are about a zillion times better than Pok Pok.  It seems like both places should be the same, but they are certainly not.  Yay, Whiskey Soda, for your delicious wings, yummy drinks and super friendly service!  Boo, Pok Pok, for your crap food, weak drinks and horrible service.

Let me just start by saying; if you want the weirdest and worst service ever then this is the place for you. I've always loved I hop for the quick and decent breakfast but this particular I hop takes service to a new level and not in a good way. I won't go on about every time I've been here but the last time just left me speechless. The waitress was so high and was talking to herself and insulting customers and when I got my food she was like omg you ate it?! Then when we finally left, after waiting 30 minutes just to leave we went outside and there was several people passed out in the parking lot with their car doors open. Weirdest experience ever and I just gave you the jist of it. So no I would not recommend this place and if I could have given negative stars I would of.

Somehow I picked this place of all the food carts. They had very good reviews. They have pictures of the meals they serve attached to the truck. They were out of mostly everything so I went with shrimp fried rice. The picture looked good -- 10 plumbp shrimp on a bed of fried rice. I paid and got the dish... There were 4 measly shrimp included. I opened it and poked around looking for more shrimp, but it wasn't happening. I asked the guy "how many shrimp?" He said "four." I replied "your picture has 10 friggin shrimp; what's up with that?" He said"the price of shrimp has gone up, so less shrimp"... Maybew they need to change the picture. The guy was clearly dishonest. He wasn't into providing a good meal, something which you want more of... He wanted to seperate me from my money. Screw him. Stay away.

I went here for the first time over my lunch break in hopes that I had found my new nail salon without going very far.  The reviews were really good and it is walking distance from both my office and house!  I was however a little disappointed when it was all said and done.

Everything started out great, I walked in and was one of two in the salon so I was able to sit right down, always a plus!  They were very nice and offered me a complimentary bottle of cold water which was much needed after the walk from the office.  Sue did my nails and she was nice.  She didn't talk much, but that was okay, I just let her do her work.  A lot of the reviews raved about how fast the service was, so I thought I would get both a balance and pedi while on my lunch break.  I don't know if she was having a bad day, but I was there almost 2 hours and had to cancel my pedi because I had to get back to the office.  I thought my balance service was okay, at best.  At first glance, they looked fine but after I left and got back to the office, I started noticing a lot of flaws in my nails.  There are air bubbles under the gel, and my nails are pretty un-even.  It is something I can easily fix with a nail file at home, but when I just paid them to do it, I shouldn't have to.

I want to go back and try a pedicure, because I want to support local businesses downtown.  It was very clean, and again, it is easy access to my everyday life but I think they may be a better place for just getting a mani/pedi, maybe fills and full sets are not their forte.  All and all, it was okay at best for what I got.  I didn't feel it was as low as 2 stars but 4 stars seemed a little high for just having nice people.

UPDATE:
I originally gave this business 3 stars, but after a week with the job they did on my acrylics, they are FALLING OFF!!!  So I am changing my review to a 1 star.  This should NEVER happen to acrylics after a week.  The nail gel was on my cuticles and it is lifting so water is getting underneath the gel and the glue is not holding.  I called the salon earlier today and they said it was not thier fault, and if I wanted to come in a fix it, I could but they would charge me for a fill.  I THINK NOT!!  I will be going to another nail salon and see what they can do, and will NEVER return here.

My husband loves Chinese food, so we order from here almost every week. Tonight we got our usual order it came to $26. We got home and found that they forgot our 2 dollar crab Rangoon. We called to have it replaced and they treated my husband as if he was trying to pull something over on them. He went up and picked up the missing Rangoon and was questioned again about it.  They have lost a loyal customer because of this.

I've been going to the Tavern for 10 years. It had been one of my favorite a places to grab a beer and watch a game. Today I went ordered a beer and a burger. 20 mins go by and no food. Server shift changes and new server tells me the previous server forgot to enter my order. No apologies. What's amazing is the previous server is still serving other tables and doesn't acknowledge the error. We have some testy words and I left. Very disappointing, I'd recommend folks steer clear until there is some basic hospitality training with the staff.

Scheduled for install between 8-10 on Monday. Receive a call at 7:55 saying install would be between 1-2. Annoying, but okay.

Get on 12:15 call at work. Wife starts repeat calling my cell at 12:40. End call at work. Wife tells me they arrived 15 minutes ahead of schedule and despite her asking them to wait til I get home, they started pulling the old windows. Also, they are talking back to her and telling her they need to get started so they can move on. I Leave work to head home.

Arrive at home. During my drive, the WW crew has shattered one window sending glass into the house and has also told my wife to get out of the room where they are working. Long story short, call the supervisor. He apologizes but that's about it.

They leave. Caulk shkinks and it's clear they have gouged the hell out of my trim work around the install areas.

I brought my 2004 Toyota Prius into the service department after buying it used. It needed a 600 dollar sensor replaced and at the time I stated to the nice man that I wanted to get all of my scheduled maintenance up to date. He said there was no scheduled maintenance that needed to be done, but to come in at 80,000 miles to get my plugs and wires changed. A few months go by, I drive the car quite a bit. I take it to a jiffy lube for an oil change and they inform me that I'm 23,000 miles overdue for a transmission system flush. Basically, I'm pissed that I wasn't informed of this at the dealership, which is supposed to be more knowledgeable. I'm trying to resolve the issue with the dealership and keep getting put on hold and switched from one person to the next. An apology would be nice, instead I was told that "we assume you had service elsewhere". How could you assume that when I spoke in length with the technician about how I had just bought the vehicle used and wanted to get all of my scheduled maintenance up to date, and was willing to pay the going rate. Long story short, don't trust the "professionals", make sure you learn as much as you can about when your scheduled maintenance is so you don't have to rely on their crappy assumptions and terrible advice.

I received terrible service here. My boyfriend and I went for a quick dinner, but he started feeling a bit sick. I wave to a server for some more napkins and suddenly,  a woman who was behind the counter starts rudely lecturing me. 

Me: "Hi!  Sorry, can we have some more napkins please? "

Her: "Don't say HI to the servers,  you're supposed to say 'excuse me' or 'do you have a moment,  please'. Do you understand me?"

Me: (... I'm sorry,  what?)

I sat there speechless for a few seconds before I told my boyfriend we are done here. We get up to leave,  because there is no way we we're staying after that kind of rudeness. 

Me: "You should get some f*cking manners, holy crap."

Her: "No thank you!  Bye! "

Me: (wow, are you being serious right now?)

It was the worst service I've ever received at a restaurant,  and before that I actually quite liked the place. I was disappointed,  insulted, and angry. If my boyfriend didn't want to throw up I probably would have given her a piece of my mind. 

Will never be back. Ever. Absolutely ridiculous.

I GOT SCAMMED.
It has been several years since I have used K&M and I have been meaning to write a review for a long time.
I used K&M several times to clean my carpets and mostly to clean my vents and loved their service...until the last time.
I had them come by to clean my air vents. The guy said he found excessive mold in my air ducts and then went up in my attic to look around. He said there were several holes in my vents and to keep the mold down we would have to seal everything up.
This included taping the AC unit, utilizing spray foam sealant, RTV and killz moisture sensing paint. 
The price kept climbing and the time needed as well.
From a a simple $99-149 duct cleaning, it turned into $3000.00 AC system sealing.
During the process the technician kept coming up with what I thought were legitimate concerns that would cost more $$ to fix. The whole time, in the back of my mind, I had a nagging feeling I was getting scammed. I should have listened and acted. I didn't.
The process took 3-4 days. 
About 3 months later my AC guy came by to service my AC unit and asked me what all of this tape and RTV was doing on the unit. I told him the long story and he told me never have someone than an HVAC person do anything to to the AC system.

The owner of this company is pushy and sleazy and apparently hires scam artists.

I take full responsibility for getting scammed out of $2800.00 but I am writing this review to warn others.

Maybe things have changed with K$M but I will never use them again.

Beware of any of their techs suggesting anything more than you have requested and ALWAYS listen to your gut feelings when dealing with these kinds of services.

I attempted to cancel my membership, was told it was cancelled, was charged for three more months and then when i called explaining the situation they said they had no proof of cancellation and wont refund me. I cancelled my membership because I went back to school and my parents moved so i didnt even live in that town or ever go back but they still will not refund me. Besides that there is no parking (the parking there is there you have to pay for) the gym is not open that late and the machines are awful. STRONGLY suggest that you do not go to this gym!!

Unprofessional as can be. I emailed them online to make an appointment and a month later they called me back. When I picked up the phone they didn't even know who they were talking to. On the morning of my appointment they called me to cancel and weren't remorseful and didn't even try to get me in to reschedule. 

If someone is handling my eyes, a very important part of my body. I'd hope they'd know what they're doing. Here - they do not.

Terrible experience here for my girlfriend, who shopped around tirelessly for a good spot for a haircut in Austin. Unfortunately for her, she landed on Birds Barbershop.

The "stylist" was rude, telling my girlfriend, who had been carefully considering bangs for a while, that she'd "look bad with bangs" and "your hair is thick and oily," closing with "there's just nothing i can do with it." What a thoughtful way to treat a customer, eh?

Then, after a bob cut (which, according to the stylist, requires more skill), she was charged $40 for a ladybird cut after assuming her short hair would count as a midcut. She was not consulted about what type of cut she'd be charged for before the cut was completed. 

It's bad enough to pay $40 for a haircut you don't feel really changed your hair at all, but even worse to be insulted in the process. Bird's not only loses our business but all our respect.

What is all this 5 star talk about. Yall are nuts, are you related to the owner? The philly was probably the worst cheesesteak I have ever had. So I went back and decided to give the place another try with another sandwich. So I ordered just a plane ham and cheese. Well yet again It was terrible. If this is how the sandwiches are up north then I will not be ordering sandwiches when I head north.  Not only that it was half the size of the subs anywhere else in austin. Very little meat. The veggies didn't taste fresh. Thumbs down all the way for me.

This business is the epitome of profit over people. I was subject to a disgusting scene of a slice of cake being dropped on the counter and then scraped up and put in my box and charged full price. I didn't want or plan to leave a review about that until my most recent visit. 
There hours on yelp said they opened at 7am, I arrived at 8:45am and the door said 9am, no biggie! I went in just after 9am and politely mentioned yelp had the incorrect hours and that I had suggested the update on here. The young immature teen said the hours had changed a year prior (but yet no one had updated them anywhere online.) I smiled and said I was just coming in for a coffee and some slices of cake. The case was empty so I asked what was available.. her reply was a smug and irritating, nothing is available, yet cakes were stacked high all around the bakery. I imagine they make a fortune from custom cakes and think the cafe is secondary or not significant to their business. Or maybe they grew the business too fast and cant support it all. Cakes are good by Beaverton standards, but easier to get at New Seasons then bother to visit the bakery or even find parking. I won't start about the parking lol!

Stanley Chaban, 617-467-5599

I experienced an overall lack of quality with this dining experience.  

First off,  the actual meal I had intended to eat ended up costing me five dollars over the twenty dollar Groupon value.  It doesn't do me much good to buy a Groupon when it won't cover a meal to begin with.  

Their website did not list the sizes of their sirloin steaks by ounces.  I had to talk to the manager (Geoffrey) in order to get him to update his site.  I would think any customer-oriented business would want their potential clientele to know what they are ordering to avoid any issues down the line. 

The largest sirloin they offer is 10 ounces, which is fine for most people but rather small for those of us who are used to eating 12-16 ounce sirloins regularly.  Most steakhouses offer large steaks.  I was rather disappointed  to find out that Texas Steak Out did not.  

I had to negotiate over the phone with the owner to get what I wanted and even with that, I still paid $5 more than the value of the Groupon!

I ordered a sixteen ounce sirloin steak meal.  They allowed me to sub out the salad/baked potato/roll for grilled asparagus and onion rings.  

Sirloins are lean cuts of meat and that has been my experience whether dining out or buying meat at a deli.  Naturally, when this steak came out, I was shocked to see a slab of fat on the side which probably weighed about four to six ounces itself.  When I finished cutting away the fat, there might have been eight to ten ounces of actual meat there.  I gave my feedback to the manager on duty (Marlon) and he refused to serve a new steak nor refund the purchase price.

To summarize:  The taste of the steak was fine and the sides were adequate; it was the value for the cost of the meal that was lacking, as well as the quality of the cut of meat that is in question.  This steak was roadhouse dive quality.  You would not see this type of cut at a butcher or grocery store.  

The worst part of this experience was the ineptitude of management and ultimately, the owner (Geoffrey).  They knew I was using a Groupon, knew I was trying their product for the first time, and STILL could not deliver on the promise of a good impression.

The meal I had would have cost $25 without the Groupon, and quite frankly, it was wasn't even worth half of that (value-wise).

Lower your expectations if you are going to try this place, or better yet...grill your own steak at home for about one fourth of the cost.

If you have a trust fund and can't think how to spend it, then Whole Foods Market is the place for you. But then again, I think you probably already know that because you're already filling the place up.

Whole Foods Market is one of the most financially successful retail chains in North America, and just one look at your grocery bill can tell you why. Yes, you can get all sorts of fancy nonsense you won't find under one roof anywhere else in Vancouver, but by golly you'll pay for it. The genius of the WFM business model is that you won't mind paying for it because you can pretend it's important to you that it's all organic and green, but deep down it only matters because all your chums are shopping here too.

Don't get me wrong, there was a time when I used to love shopping here. But then I had three children and found something useful to do with my money.

If you want real fish tacos and burritos, hit up the cart at SE 34th and Division. That cart cannot be beat. The people working here are nice, but this is not authentic Mexican food, not by a long shot.

That was okay because I needed to review the menu.  When he asked for my order, I explained what the hostess had said and asked that our food be plated rather than in to-go containers.  He abrasively said, "she doesn't know what she is talking about.  That's against health code regulations."  I asked him to clarify and he said "you have to take the food in to-go containers."  I asked if we could have plates to transfer the food onto.  He said, "no."  He didn't try to be accommodating in his tone, demeanor or words.  He was a jerk.  I ordered a small coffee and then we went to Starbucks for breakfast.  What a disappointment.  It's a beautiful hotel and charming café but Michael was an ass.

This experience could not have been more horrific!! I wouldn't touch this gong show in a million years and consider it a public service to warn people off this terrible company. They finally arrived late at 4:20 and spent the next 15 mins and several phone calls later kevetching that there was no parking and their stuff was heavy, poor babies. Hubby saw the cleaners out and frankly the cleaning job was about as basic as you get. What 3 girls did for 3 hours I don't know. The sinks weren't sparkling, the floor tiles still had marks, they must have just breezed over. But I didn't see this until the next night when we waited at the condo for the carpet cleaner that never came. Diane never called, I called her at 5:30pm and she said she hadn't heard from him all day. We heard nothing more. Meanwhile the landlord came and did the inspection and we've made other arrangements to clean the carpets (more cash out the door). 

This morning I called to get a refund. She decided to go off on a rant whereby she blamed me for everything. My condo was horrific, she tried to accommodate my difficult schedule (I work during the day, that's it) etc etc. Yelling at the top off her lungs she went full psycho and wouldn't let me say one word. I hung up. THEN the crazy cat phoned me back to say the call was being recorded for quality assurance whereby I started to laugh!! Seriously?? And she started her rant up again!! OMG!! Needless to say we figure she stole about $150 from us as the carpets were never done and her package deal is a scam. 

My hubby tried later on this morning to reason with her and she was in her own dimension, out and out lying to him about what I had agreed to (and he knows because he was there). A refund will never come.

I made my second trip here the other day to give this place another chance but unfortunately it will be my last. They have very cute items and the store is set-up very well. There is a super-cute chair and a pair of shoes that I would die for but I just cannot do it. I thought they had new stuff but it turned out everything was just moved around. Someone must have a degree in merchandising because they do a great job but they need to go take Customer Service 101. The attitude on the girl in there was absolutely appalling. Cambridge is a very diverse community with a mix of people but this store seems to think they are in the middle of Beacon Hill. How about a hello? Or maybe it was because I was wearing sweats and my $1.00 flip flops from the nail salon down the street. Maybe if I had pulled out my DVF sandals from my bag they would have acknowledged me? 

I love vintage items and when I go to a store that markets itself as vintage I expect vintage. I do not expect Bebe shirts and knock-off Louie bags. To give them the benefit of the doubt it's vintage with a modern twist - but to me that's deceptive and it's like buying something for $50.00 and getting the bill for $200 because you didn't read the small print or it's like going into the dollar store and nothing is a dollar. They know how to get people in there but they sure don't know how to keep them.

I met the cutest little old lady outside who wanted to sell her shoes from the 60's - she said she was treated awful and that the girl said "Those aren't vintage!" and turned her back and walked away. Come on Lady Luxe - you are in a family neighborhood - at least be somewhat considerate to the people who make up the neighborhood. You've got to be welcoming of all people or you are not going to make it.
I won't go back there ever again. I will continue to frequent the Cambridge Antique Market and Vintage Revenge - the owner there is friendly and very welcoming!  At least there I know I am getting authentic vintage merchandise and I don't have to weed out the items from the mall. 
The good things about my experience there is they caused me to need a drink and I went down the street to Guidos for a drink and met some interesting people. 
You can see the attitude yourself without visiting the store by reading their snide comment to a Yelper who wasn't that satisfied. Instead of being sarcastic why not contact that person and see what you can do to change their feeling about your establishment?  Offer them a coupon or a personal shopping experience to help them find what they need. Maybe the "dynamic sister" duo should stop concentrating on the over-done reviews by their friends and start concentrating on how to be personable and welcoming.

I can get around the prices because this is Carlos' right?!? Forget about it! From the tiny eclairs that claim to have custard (whipped tasteless cream) with barely any chocolate, to the "close your eyes and you don't know what your eating" cupcakes with supposed buttercream (again whipped dumbed down flavor), to the actually disgusting dry cookies, the nasty rugela, stale donuts, etc... I do not frequent Jimmy Johns on a regular basis. When I went into this location I said to the young lady at the cash register, "I need to look at the menu for a moment, I don't come here very often."  She acknowledged me, she was very polite. When the young man put the sandwich on the counter, I collected my chips, sandwich, napkins, again, wait!....no bag, maybe I should have brought my own. I will not return to this location.

I have been at many TGIFs and by far this was the most disappointing.  Would've been different if they were slammed...which obviously would have been understandable. 7:20 pm - Still no Technician

1. If a customer is a victim of overbooking then they should be pushed to the top of the list for next day...not four days.

It is not safe to eat here if you have food allergies!

What can I say, the fastest way to a one star review from me is to poison my wife.  The first thing I ask the server at any restaurant is whether or not they can safely accommodate my wife's food allergy. The second thing I do is make it ABUNDANTLY clear that her reaction is severe and life threatening (I use the scene in pulp fiction, when Uma Thurman O.D.s, and they then have to stab her in the heart--substituting an Epipen--to illustrate the severity).

With that information, there is absolutely no excuse for then topping the food with that very ingredient.  That's what happened tonight at Nuestra Cocina. When the food runner pointed out that her ticket said not to use the ingredient in question, they simply scraped it off my wife's meat, and tried to serve it to her.

Luckily I could see this entire interaction from where I was sitting in the restaurant, and I insisted the food be remade. What they SHOULD have done then is remake her dish from scratch, making damn sure it wasn't contaminated by the allergen. Unfortunately,what they did instead was simply give her the next one that they had already been cooking. By the time we got home this evening, my wife's throat had begun swelling shut. I had to stab her with her epipen, she can barely talk, and it will be days before she is fully recovers.

Yep, you really EARNED this one star review, Nuestra Cocina.

It is heartbreakingly difficult to get my wife to try a new restaurant. It is terrifying for her, and it shouldn't be, because--as a veteran of over a decade in food service--I can tell you that it takes just three things to avoid what happened to my wife tonight.  Empathy; good communication between the servers and kitchen; and an intelligent approach to food prep.   

Unfortunately it is sometimes infuriatingly difficult to get servers in Portland to take food allergies seriously. Every...single...time my wife has been poisoned, it is because the server did not--despite my effusive examples of how serious her allergy is--simply write "food allergy" on the ticket to the kitchen. There is an ENORMOUS difference to a cook between receiving a ticket intimating that a customer wants "no peanuts", for example, and and one that lets him/her know that the a customer is "allergic to peanuts", because in one case cross contamination won't really matter, and in the other it can kill them.

So again, if you have any sort of food allergy, Nuestra Cocina is not for you.

My partner who I was with only got two of his three slices of french toast ordered, and the waiter made an excuse about some other waiter taking our food to a different table (poor form, I'm sorry, you don't talk crap about other coworkers to the public like that). 

My partner also wanted to order more food at that time, and when told they didn't have what he wanted (a bagel...basic breakfast food) he rambled yet again about east coast/west coast bagel politics and didn't even suggest something else...just walked away (FINALLY) without my partner having a chance to order something! 

I honestly can't remember if he returned to refill our drinks himself because they have a friendly young lady doing that for the whole floor...which makes me wonder if the house splits up the tips or what. She deserves some percentage for sure!

So, when it came time to tip, I had to get change (which I did from the front register myself because I honestly wasn't confident we'd get change in a quick and smooth way without some mumbled crap from the waiter. Then, my partner and I agreed to honestly just leave exact change because he was pretty upset about never getting a chance to order more food. You know, the basic thing you do at restaurants?

THEN, what do you know, the waiter FOLLOWED US OUT OF THE RESTAURANT to ask why we didn't tip! 

Not only does that leave his other tables totally unattended, it made me feel REALLY UNCOMFORTABLE. If you don't get a tip, quietly assume we're assholes or quietly consider what you did or didn't do well. DO NOT CHASE US DOWN THE STREET.

It wasn't like he was super overwhelmed and busy, like he was trying his hardest to do the basic. We didn't get the basic service, we got this guy waxing poetic about bagels and philosophy while our stomachs growled. Then we got followed by him out of the business. That's wildly inappropriate and I will not be returning to, nor recommending, Genie's in the future.
