When I spoke with Trey on the phone, I asked is there a reason that the lymphatic massage does not show on the menu and is it the same price? So today when I completed my services. Trey told me the price was $80 for 90 minutes. So I asked, I could have gotten 2 hours for $90. I had not paid yet, so I asked Tara could I get my other 30 min. Because Trey could have advised me it would be a better deal it I received the other 30 min for $10. She told me I would have to pay $20 more. Beware!!! As a entrepreneur myself, it was a simple fix. But, I will never return!!!

It's a shame that such a good line has rude people working there. We had to interrupt the employees conversation to ask about an item with a SALE. But the one we wanted was not on sale. "Only the one on top, that's why the sign is there", our unfriendly employee said. So we asked for the price on the one supposedly on sale, it turns out it was NOT on sale either. The misleading sign was just left there by the laborious personnel.  Items at the store are not cheap even on sale. Try harder with your customer service training.

We got there yesterday to have a late lunch. The food was okay but the service was really bad. At first place, he treated us as tourists even though we live in Fenway. Our bill was $32 when we checked, but the server gave a final bill (once we gave him a credit card to pay) as $47...luckily we found the error and ask to fix it. Our server never apologized to us for his mistake. I don't know whether he intentionally changed the final bill or not, but recommend watch out when you dine there.

Please be careful as last night my wife and I we came away with a case of food poisoning. I wish I had seen Luj W. review to be beware of unsafe raw meat handling practices.

We were in the area and came here for Korean BBQ based on good yelp reviews. We ordered short ribs and marinated chicken with a pork dumpling appetizer. We sat next to a Korean couple with two children and struck up a good conversation about Korean restaurants. We left thinking the food was just okay and a little overpriced.

In the middle of the night my wife became very sick and knew it was food poisoning.  She was up often during the night and when I got up in the morning I too had food poisoning symptoms. We have spent the entire day trying to recover and my wife had to cancel the flight she was too take this afternoon.

I called the restaurant at 11:00 am. And after three tries found someone I could leave message for the owner or manager to call. I asked when their last food health inspection was and she told me last Tuesday. I also asked their score which she said was a 91. As of this review I have received no call back.

We bought a bed set that did not include the main, middle support beam, although the beam is pictured in the assembly manual. When we called the 1-800 number to inquire about the part, we were told there were 10 beams available at the Atlanta store. My wife drove for 40 minutes back to the store to purchase the $10 missing part. A customer service representative tells her they were sold out of the part and "the guy she spoke to at the 1-800 number is in Maryland and they don't know what they have in the Atlanta store." Then he told my wife that she can only order the part from Ikea but they're back ordered. He was rude, unapologetic, and offered no good recourse. She found the part on eBay for $62. Clearly, the Atlanta store did not update their inventory to reflect what they actually have in stock. Clearly, the Atlanta store thinks that good prices for items means they can mistreat paying customers. I learned that I got what I paid for and I'll be sharing my experience with others, particularly other military families and I won't be returning to Ikea. Pay more for quality service!

ZERO PRIVACY! The Albert Corporation has sent in over 75 brokers to try to sell our overpriced unit in the last 3 months. Had to contact the State Attorney General's office as the property manager Dan V failed to respond to the last two emails we sent. The brokers have shown up with no notice, walked in on me in the bathroom, when I'm asleep in my bedroom, one even had the audacity to give zero notice and then try to undo the chain lock from the outside to give a showing. I would never recommend anyone live in a building managed by the Albert Corp. I only moved here for parking and found out they also lied about parking availability and who gets a pass.

Never ordering from here again. I ordered for a delivery and the person tells me 30-40 min, ok. So over an hour goes by and I still don't have my food. I call to see what's up and the lady on the phone tries telling me I called them back saying I was going to pick it up??? Not once did I call and she was extremely rude about it. Told them I didn't want the food and still haven't gotten a refund from them!!! Awful customer service to a loyal customer.

Have to agree with most of the others, the "employees" simply do not care about the business, now that is to be expected in a fast food joint but you would figure there would be a manager or someone on duty who does care.  I have seen the ads on TV for Taco Bell's new breakfast, they finally got me interested enough to give it a try, or so I thought.  I didn't know the menu so I went inside, only person in there, no cars at the drive thru either.  I waited 10 minutes; 5 minutes AFTER the second of two "employees" saw me and then did their best to avoid eye contact so they didn't have to get off their lazy butts to help a customer.  I left without anyone acknowledging I was even there.  Obviously ongoing issue, if the employees care so little about a customer who can see them imagine what they do to the food when the customer cannot see them.  I would be very afraid to eat the food from this Taco Bell given the attitude of their staff.

To update my review: My BF and I decided to both try Sprouts out again since we came right after the opening the first time. 

I feel even worse about Sprouts than before! The customer service is abysmal, and the products are low quality.

We were not greeted when we walked in, no one offered us any help as we walked around, and items are very difficult to find since the store is very poorly organized. 

Once we got the decent looking items that we could find and headed to the register, The girl at the checkout did not say anything to us at all, she only asked us what our cilantro was and typed the number in, $200 later, we did not get so much as a thank you or " have a nice day" before leaving. 

I previously stated that Sprouts was slightly better than Publix, I take that back, publix may not have the best products or ethics with food sourcing, but they have FAnTAsTIc customer service. I feel as if we would have been better off shopping at publix and spent a lot less money. 

We will never waste our money here again.

Pretty bad service. Made a few hours in advance reservations, but when we arrived, we had to wait about 15 mins before being seated. 

After 30 mins since ordering, we noticed the tables around us whom arrived later than us had already gotten most of their dishes while we had yet to get one. Turns out the waitress didn't even send in the order slip to the chef. 

When the food arrived after another 15 mins of waiting, the clams with black bean dish was very disappointing. A quarter to one third of the plate were dead clams or empty shells. 

The waitress gave a simple apology, but the owner did not seem to be sorry at all regarding both mistakes of food and service.

Go somewhere else. Not worth the stress. 
I took my laptop in to sell and they needed to go over it, said they would give me a call on when to come back for the quote. 6 hours later, near closing time,  I called to check in and they said they are still working on it. They finally called me after closing hours and i couldn't call back because the phone automatically said the store was closed. I had to leave it there over night and went in the next day for terrible customer service only for them to offer me $10 on my 2015 touch screen laptop that just needed a hinge replaced. It was like an unfunny joke

My daughter ate a kids chicken quesadilla and cookie from here soon after she finish eating her meal she had diarrhea twice. When we were getting our fountain drinks after we ordered our food this is when I realized how filthy this restaurant is. The fountain drink area had sticky, dried up liquid everywhere look like it haven't been clean in awhile. We reach for a lid for our soft drink the lid we grabbed was stuck to at least 4 other lids with MOLD growing on all the lids. We threw the lids away in the garbage so other customers didn't grab them but I did notice other lids had stuff on them too. I don't want her eating from this location again I rather go to Taco Veloz on South Cobb or Taco T's for a quesadilla.

My husband and I came here for the first time 7/15/18 to see Corey Holcomb. We purchased tickets in advance online. Previous yelp reviews said parking was $10. Well we arrived and it was $30 for VIP or a few steps over $20. This is all self park by the way. Whatever. We enter and are seated. We're at a table right in the middle two tables from stage. Good seats. 

We had THE WORST experience with getting a freaking waitress...like wth?? I asked a waitress and my husband spoke to 3...yes 3 different people including the "manager" before somebody finaaaaalllllyyyy came. The show was almost over at that point, yet we had been trying to order or find someone since before it started!! My husband also mentioned that all the waitresses who came by were musty. You may say why bring this up...well hygiene is important and you're  interacting with people in a small space...but I guess if they don't respect themselves enough to bathe properly why should we expect proper customer service. 

I just wanted fries and my husband wanted the fried shrimp and fries. The shrimp dinner comes in a 7 piece, 14 piece and a larger size. He ordered the 14 piece. It was around $22. All sides including my fries are $5. I ordered a glass of Merlot and he a margarita. When the food finally came I had a tiny portion of fries and they were almost cold. She also brought a beer. Neither one of us drink beer. She tried to argue with him about it. He just said ok so we could enjoy the show. They automatically charge 15% gratuity to your bill so I'm sure that also plays a role in them not giving the best service. After we were done eating my husband explained that he wasn't going to pay for the beer. After some back and forth it was taken off. 

They charged $15 or $16 for a margarita. This place is ridiculous. Now I see why people in the reviews kept saying this place will nickel and dime you. Money isn't our issue...it's the horrendous customer service. His shrimp were ok. Nothing to rave about. We didn't get VIP tickets because reviews stated it wasn't worth it and customer service was lacking there too. The set up is mostly tables for 4. I saw a few round tables that probably sat 6-8 people. 

I don't know. If I go back I guess I'd get there early enough to establish service with a waiter/waitress. 

The comedians were awesome. The host Lav Luv and the other guy who's name I didn't catch were great! Of course Corey had us literally screaming! Love that crazy man.

Called there and put in an order for two large calzones.  Sent my 20 year old son to pick up our order who was approached very rudely as he walked in with credit card in hand, before he had a chance to say he was picking up an order, and he was told cash only. He said I just called in an order, he said oh my credit card machine broke 10 minutes ago?  really?  I choose not to do business with arrogant unprofessional individuals. If you order from here be prepared to walk in with cash.  Very unprofessional poor customer service and rude. (I did call to complain but the person on the phone was difficult to understand.) Food here is average, nothing special just on the way home.  Won't be back.  Not sure how they stay in business, must be location.

Zero stars. Went in for a cleaning and left with a $5000 dental plan that they wanted me to sign up for without even explaining what it was for. I'm in sales and it's definitely worst than a used car dealership!! Very unethical approach! 

They referred me to have my root canal done but it was inoperable. That is something a dentist should be able to tell and not have me waste my time going  to have an expensive procedure done. Even the dentist at Quincy center endosontist was upset.

1)  The place is very cold in the winter with many people like me in full winter gear including head-covering
2) The noise level is extremely high since like many large places they don't have a proper ceiling.  Ridiculous brewpub chic.
3) The help plays loud, angry heavy-metal music frequently which just adds to the cacophony.  How anyone can listen to such garbage is beyond me.
4) The men's room reeks of the smell of pis.  I mean it's bad.  Never been in a men's room that smelled like that.  
5) The beer is very mediocre.

Bulwark was fine until I had a recurring problem which they are suppose to get under control when you're on their contract, as I was.
As someone else mentioned the call center never made the grade. They would never make the follow-up appts. and the techs would show up to just do the usual contracted outside treatment, until i was home one day when one of them showed up. The techs were usually great. One techs even tried to call to make my follow-up appt. for me before he left, without luck. He finally told her to call me back when she figured it out and she never did. One of the managers even told me he would personally treat my house for my next follow-up appt. at a specific time and credit my acct. He did neither. i don't even remember now how many times i raced home to meet them and they wouldn't show up. When i would check-in with the call center they would have me scheduled for some off time that i never agreed to, like up to 7:00 in the evening.
So i finally gave up.

FALSE ADVERTISER.  On multiple occasions I responded to offers by Vacation Express for package deals at a certain price.  When I go on to the Vacation Express site and find the very same offer, and then try to book it, it is not available in the booking process.  An example is a Punta Cana package I just tried that is on their site for $799 each.  When I attempted to book it, the lowest price was $1012 each.  So I noticed that they have a number to call to book, so I called their number and was simply given the runaround, and the booker would not honor the ad posting that was on their web site at that very moment, claiming that the price was valid at the time it was posted, and is subject to change.  Well, guess what:  the price is still posted and has not changed.
She also said that maybe, if I keep trying different dates, that I might find a set of dates over the 100 day period it is supposed to be available, where there is a package left.  Of course, she was not going to do that for me.
That is a very dishonest and shoddy way of doing business.

I called the parts department for parts for my Nissan Pathfinder
Needed Rear Window Shocks for the window...
Ready for the Price...$250 per side=$500 for simple air shocks
Went to Auto Zone....$25.00 per side=$50 for simple air shocks
Had my window repaired and window holding up in less than 30 minutes!

Today thought I'd give them another try-Oil Truck hit me and I wasnt paying so I Called again for a rear lens/light...the doof that answered the phone says he cant' look it up without the VIN #..."Are you Serious?" 
I called 3 local junk yards and they had my vehicle lens price to me within seconds...

Lesson Learned...Never calling them ever again-Try to do yourself! 
I've owned 2 Nissan's and I will never buy another-plastic junk!

This Is quite possibly the worst restaurant you could choose on the universal studios side of the park.  It's outdated decor and blank walls show it's age as being original to the park.  Two slices of pizza and a dinky pile of lettuce is 13$ and that does not even include a drink.  The pizza is probably the worst pizza I've ever had.  It's obviously made on a conniver belt style pizza oven.  It's a shame that this is the sad excuse for a pizza shop that is placed in the New York street of the park.  Red oven pizza which is located on city walk is a million times better and you can get a whole pie for 12$.  Save your time and money and eat your park meal here instead.  If universal management had any sense they would put a red oven franchise in this location.

Can I give this place negative stars?  This is the only place in MA that I fight the urge to sneer at every time I pass by.  Yucky, runny, soggy eggs and toast.  The coffee is terrible with a capital "ick."  Seriously - the first taste made me shudder.  If you make it through a whole cup, don't worry, they'll charge you full price for a refill.  And they are really unfriendly to outside coffee cups: they have a whole trashcan full of cups from peet's, starbuck's, au bon pain, tealuxe, etc.  The service was awful and they charge extra for everything!  Has Bush rationed syrup for the troops?  Free syrup for everyone!

I am an 88 year old recovering from back surgery. I thought a new mattress might help my back. I bought a mattress and intersprings. I paid extra to have my old ones taken out. The mattress was delivered on time and things were fine until I asked them about taking my old ones and they said they didn't do that. They said they would call the dispatcher to get them removed. I called twice later with no luck. Later I got a call saying they couldn't pick them up because the mattress was soiled. They said they would refund my pickup money. I told them what they could do with it. It will cost me more to get someone to remove. A friend told me the same thing happened with her. We will never spend a dime with vcf again. We will pass the word around. Wish I could rate lower than one star!

I really don't get the hype over this place. If you're looking for dim sum with carts, this is not the place.

Pros: cheap
Cons: mediocre service, mediocre dim sum at best

I wanted to look for a new place to eat some dim sum. This place was reviewed decently well. So we went to check it out. We went in and it wasn't very full. I did joke "we may have come to the wrong place, no one Asian is eating here" as I scanned the facility.

The service is what you'd expect at some of these restaurants in China town. They don't mean to be rude, but it comes off as very sub par service. It's the typical slam your dishes down on the table, not bother with you as you wait to be seated...

The food was not good. The taste and texture was that of something that was frozen. The dumplings didn't tear, but rather turned to mush as you picked them up.

All in all, a very disappointing experience.

Awful.  If negative stars and a punch in the face was possible, that would be my rating.

I was recently in an accident and USAA sent them to look at the car.  They were too lazy to go to where the car had been towed in Southborough so waited for the car to get to Herb Chambers Collision in Braintree.  Between being lazy as hell and the snow, we lost 2 wks of moving ahead on the car, until finally we got the first estimate.  It was what we thought: minimal damage to the engine and mostly cosmetic to the front of the car.  A week for the work to be done.

A week goes by and we get a call from Enterprise car rental, where we have a loaner car.  No work has been started and the car rental is set to expire in a week.  They just thought we should know. 

So call to USAA to find out that the appraiser from Viking is now changing his tune and there is "hidden" damage.  So it's going to be double the cost and triple the wait time.  HERE'S THE KICKER: NOONE TOLD US THIS!!!!!!  Noone from Viking bothered to contact us, noone from USAA bothered to contact us,

So now, it's a month since I was in the accident, I'm no closer to having my car fixed and two days from now, my rental loaner has to go back to Enterprise because they're working on the original estimate.  

Don't use these people if at all possible.  They are completely non communicative, unresponsive and lazy.

After my cat was found to have a heart murmur I called them and was quoted for an echocardiogram and since their prices were fair and they were close to home, I took my cat in.  Once there, they took it upon themselves to run a large amount of blood tests, acting as though this was part of the appointment. No one asked if I was okay with it so I assumed it was standard. As I was checking out, the receptionist told me "not to freak out" because the bill was slightly more than I was quoted for. $500 more! I was so flustered I just paid the bill and left, without so much as a diagnosis for the heart murmur. I will say this, everyone in the office was very kind and when they called me a few weeks later to tell me that they had figured out the cause of the murmur, I took the risk and bought the medicine that they recommended for another $275. During the treatment I called many times to ask if something my cat was going was a side effect of the medicine and very few times was my call actually returned by a doctor. I was supposed to take my cat back for a follow up echocardiogram after the medicine was done but I've since chosen not to at this point.  I guess they got enough money out of me thus far because I haven't heard a peep from them. Disappointed because I initially felt as though I had finally found a vet that wasn't in it for the money.

Another Southpark Meadows Failure!

We decided to give this place another shot. Even average Asian food will make my wife happy. Unfortunately, I don't think this place can handle more than 6 tables on a Sunday evening. 

We arrived and the smiling hostess delivered us to a table. handed us menus without a single word. Waters were delivered. Menus perused and placed down. And then nothing for the next 10 minutes. The hostess seemed to be one of two people working there and she was busying herself in another area of the restaurant with some little task like folding napkins up. We saw one person cooking, but no servers. 

My wife has a low tolerance for stuff like this. We walked out and I don't believe we'll be returning.

Called today to get a quote on what a prescription for contacts would cost with my insurance, the guy who answered the phone did not sound professional and was unwilling to help me get a quote. He stated that is was something that they were not able to look up. So I called the vision place right next door, and received a quote by a very professional person, and I made my appointment there. If you are looking for assistance in pricing regarding your insurance this is not the place to go!

I had high hopes after reading previous reviews, however, this location was another LabCorp disappointment. I can't speak for all the staff at this Winter Park location, but the employee behind the desk Sophia was the most passive aggressive labcorp employee I have ever encountered. Her lack of empathy and general "I hate my job" attitude is what prompted to write this review.

I came in on time for an appt, after providing my information and specifying which Dr provided the order (as I have been seen by a few Dr's that have ordered lab work recently and sent in the order electronically ) I was told to have a seat. A few minutes went by and I was given the patient responsibility form to sign with my estimated costs. I signed it sat back down to finish reviewing it and realized that the wrong order was processed from a physician I haven't seen in months. 

I realize that this is an honest mistake, however, had I not reviewed the entire form I would have paid to have unnecessary lab work performed from a months old order that I would have never seen the results to as I am no longer a patient of said doctor. Not to mention I would have shown up and paid for a follow up visit to my actual Dr only to find out that my lab work was never performed. 

Honest mistake, however, I not once received an apology in fact  the total opposite she became frustrated with me because of the extra work her mistake had now caused. At that point I didn't dare to mention that I had confirmed with her from the very beginning the Dr who had actually ordered the lab work in the first place. 

I work in the customer service field and I understand the challenges that working with the public creates, however, when I am in the wrong an apology goes a long way. But with a company that overworks and underpay's its employees and in an industry where the insurance companies only gives us 2 major lab companies to choose from I can see how hiring and retaining good quality employees is not a priority.

Definitely would not use them again.  Very high pressure upsells once they got here -spots and odors reappeared quickly after cleaning.   They seemed very,very rushed and this carpet cleaning company rep was angry that I had not  vacummed my carpet prior to their arrival.  I've had carpets cleaned many times and never vacummed right before they came.  If that's what they expect, they need to relay that on the phone when making the appointment.   To be clear, there was no visible dirt, trash, etc...on my carpet, just some random dog hair from my shorthaired dog.   I do blame myself for succumbing to the sales tactics.

The service was slow and unfriendly. The food took a long time to arrive and when it came, I could not eat it because the French toast was burned on the bottom and mushy and tasteless on the top. The hash browns were burned on the outside and raw in the inside.

A couple of business-suited men behind us carried on a speaker enhanced conference call the entire time we were there. Finally another customer asked them to at least turn the volume down.

Worst customer service. I went in and had a few questions about their meats. The women working there could barley speak English and couldn't understand and or answer any question I asked!! her reaction to me was to yell/scream at me " WHAT DO YOU WANT". If you can't speak English or understand a simple question then maybe you shouldn't be working there. Attitude like hers is the reason why Indians are constantly judged and criticized. I or anyone I know will never go there again.

Wouldnt even give one star if possible. Way overpriced. Waited over an hour to get my cable box and it didnt even work. Was told someone would be out the next day to fix it. No one came. When I contacted them, there wasnt even a work order put in. They then informed me I would be charged 29.99 for a technician to come out, even thought no one told me that before, and it was their equipment that wasnt working. When I said I wanted to cancel, they told me to return my equipment, and then never responded back to me. AWFUL customer service. Also, while I was chatting with someone, I was disconnected multiple times because my internet through them kept going out. terrible services as well as customer service. will not recommend nor ever be a customer with them again.

I had been using Roof Life for years.
Something has changed.  They have lost interest in Customer Service and it is sad to see.
In April 2016, we paid Roof Life over $2200 to clean our roof and replace 83 shakes.
Just 4 months later, after finding a few shakes in our yard, we called Patrick (the owner) back to check the integrity of the roof, and see why shakes were blowing off.  Patrick told us we needed 80 more shakes replaced at an additional cost of $771.  IN JUST 4 MONTHS!!!!  Patrick has zero interest in even replacing the shakes that blew off, or explaining how he could have miscounted SO many shakes needing replacement.  We had him replace shakes and treat our roof just 2 years ago, and 5 years prior to that, so it isn't that we have neglected the roof.  There is no good explanation for miscounting so many shakes.  I feel so disappointed and let down by someone who use to care about his customers.  I won't use Roof Life again.

Once again, Yelp needs to consider allowing a "Zero" star for a company.  They are hard to get a hold of.  When you finally get to a "claim rep" he acts like everyone is out to get his company.  Sounds paranoid maybe because they su(k at their job.  They did not take seriously their job as an arbitrator.  Either that, or they have a secret agenda that does not bode well for the unsuspecting general public that may have to rely on Agero.  All I can say is, "good luck to you if you must deal with them".  They either knowingly lie or they are incompetent. They can still make it right with me, but it's been a month and I'm losing faith in their integrity.

I have been going to this carwash for over 15 years for my oil changes and I have never had  such a bad customer service  experience. I had a dispute regarding what type of oil I wanted in my car vs. What was actually used . It's how the situation was handled that i have issue with. The Assistant Manager Bruce was called over and instead of introducing himself and asking what the issue was he approached me pointing his finger and saying" Are you the guy?" After disagreeing on what type of oil I wanted in my vehical he rambled on about why would he lie...he dosen't produce or sell oil and that he didnt care if I put "dirt" in my car for that matter.  I asked him if the $20 or so difference in  the price was worth losing 2 loyal customers ( my wife and I ) and he just stared at me. A complete and utter lack of professionalism.  I will not be returning.

Only because its required to rate i have to give it 1 star. I would give it a flat ZERO!!!
Walked in, (having never been there before) we weren't sure if we sat ourselves or had to wait to be seated. F i n a l l y someone came & seated us.
Took there time getting our drinks.....20 mins later nobody had came to take our food order. I saw our waitress serve herself a soda pop(mt. Dew)& walk into the kitchen. Thats when we decided to leave!! TERRIBLE, HORRIBLE SERVICE!!!

Ebenezer's Journey:  oh what a disappointment. $48...promised 7 pm reservations. 8:30 pm still nothing. I had written emails with responses saying this was approriate for a six year old, and that we would be here 1 and 1/2 hours.   I almost didn't write this, since afterall they are a nonprofit, but people ... enough ... this was inexecusble!   It was cold...we had expected an hour an a half performance starting at 7... we got there at 6:30... 8:30 ...we still were waiting...of course we had to leave...six year old was getting cranky ... not to mention grammy and mom and dad... what gives Pioneer Farms?  At least you should let folks know what to expect!!

The moment I pull in to this place even before I could get out of the car the owner or manager approached me asking me what I was doing there and if I was coming in to buy something, treating me as if I were a criminal...after I was done with my phone call it went inside to see what this place had to offer...I don't live on that side of town so I never been there, needless to say I wasn't impressed by this ghetto place, the guy then says he's sorry but his place has been robed before...(l guess every black man that goes there is there to rob them)  anyway I just ordered shrimp...how hard would it be to mess that up? Well they did...the shrimp tasted like catfish!!! Yuk! I gave the whole order to my cat. I will never ever visit this place ever again!

Complete nightmare.  Shop had covered a huge hole in the floor with a flimsy piece of plywod which was not obvious before pulling in and splintered when we drove into the garage.  The car bottomed out in the hole causing at least $900 of damage to the car. Am now having to sort the whole thing out with my insurance and hoping that the owner will pay for the damage.  But right now out $500 for the deductible plus an insane amount of time and inconvenience.  

Avoid at all costs.

Horrible owners Amanda and Butch! Ordered A/C unit and Air Handler. Saved on shipping because I was able to pick up units at the Las Vegas warehouse.
The man who loaded the air handler in my pick up truck was an idiot and did not know what he was doing! I am a senior citizen and EXPECT the loader, Manny to have a CLUE about how he put yup the units in the truck. Manny put the air handler in an upright position in the back of my small pick up truck. Upright, like a refrigerator. Manny loaded the air handler with a fork lift. 
Manny was the only one to touch the unit and to be in the back of the pick up truck.
I thought the product was very heavy... I thought Manny was the professional and KNEW what he was doing.

He NEVER suggested laying the unit down or perhaps tying the unit down... Nor did he suggest that perhaps I should make two trips with my little pick up truck so the products could SAFELY BE LAID DOWN.
Bottom line, Manny loaded the truck improperly. He knew the Air Handler was a very light, tippy unit. I had no idea.

Needless to say, a few blocks down the road the Air Handler fell off of the side of the truck and rolled across 3 lanes of a very busy street.
LUCKILY NO VEHICLE WAS next to my truck for someone could easily have BEEN KILLED!

I recorded Amanda and Butch...  It was beyond frightful!!

Don't come here! It's a tourist trap. So disappointed in Pok Pok :( Dishes here are all range for about $15 and the portions aren't very generous. The service was lackluster and was just overall clearly a tourist trap.

FOOD: 5/10
SERVICE: 3/10
AMBIANCE: 4/10

FOOD - 
+ Kaeng Hang Leh ($15.50): Pork belly & pork shoulder curry. This was too salty and only filled half of the pot it came in. There were maybe 4 or 5 pieces of tiny, miniscule green beans and 4 or 5 pieces of pork. One of the pieces was just a piece of fat as well... The flavor was strong but there was definitely too much salt.

+ Neeua Nam Tok ($15.50): Spicy flank steak salad. This was just pieces of beef and cilantro. It was very flavorful and tangy! But although its description is that it's a salad, IT'S NOT. For $15.50, you'd expect a lot bigger of a portion as well.

+ Coconut Ice Cream Sandwich ($7): This was interesting! It came in a piece of bread and truly was a sandwich. The sticky rice was yummy! The ice cream texture was a bit odd though.

SERVICE - 
We were the first ones at the restaurant when it opened on a Sunday for lunch at 11:30am, and our server was the furthest thing from friendly. She was constantly looking at herself in the mirror and would ignore when we would politely say thank you. Not impressed at all.

AMBIANCE - 
They definitely try to stick with an authentic Thai atmosphere. That was pretty cool! I felt as though I was truly in Thailand at a restaurant. 

Overall, I don't suggest going to Pok Pok for the hype. Not worth it IMO :(

This place is in concourse C at Hartsfield near gate C46. The service is frequently slow, the staff can be argumentative. The staff is all Airport HMS employees and there is a systemic problem in the airport with the horrible staff they employ. Last visit I ordered the shrimp and grits. The shrimp smelled fishy, and not in a good way. In the way old shrimp that sat out in the sun for a bit smell. My wife could smell them from across the table. She and I both decided it was best not to chance eating them and sent them back. No visit from the manager after this and no apology.

This should be your LAST resort. Like, choose any other rental company before this one. First of all it's not convenient if you're coming from the airport because it's not on the airport grounds there's a shuttle you have to take. The shuttle itself is a little wonky because it has multiple stops and the confirmation email from the place doesn't really explain where to catch it. Then when you find it and get to the actual location you'll be greeted by lots of unprofessional people who have no sense of urgency whatsoever to get you processed. They also won't know what they're doing and have to stop several times to ask other people questions. When you finally do get your car you'll see that it's disgusting and probably hasn't been cleaned in forever. Stained seats, dented doors, dirty floors, etc. Oh and if it rains your windshield wipers may not work. Basically, the experience won't be pleasant.

This place will be out of business in 6 months. I can promise you, any positive review is by an employee or an owner of the establishment. I don't live in the area, but was staying overnight because my flight was the next day. It was Saturday and found it on yelp because I wanted to catch up on some college football.  I had my family with me which includes my twin 7 year old daughters so I looked at the website to see if it was appropriate for children. The website says it's a family friendly establishment so perfect, let's go. We arrived at 6pm.  Ambiance is nice with lots of tvs. There were only about 7 other people in the restaurant which worries me a little but still committed to give this place a try. When we were seated, the waiter told us that we had only an hour to eat because you had to be 21 after 7. He wasn't particularly nice about it, just said we had to be gone in an hour. What's worse, is that he sat us, we sat there for 15 minutes with no attention whatsoever.  No drinks, no "I'll be with you in a minute", no menus. Totally pathetic!!!!  They clearly didn't want us there so we left. So if you're looking for terrible service and to be treated rudely, this is the place for you. If not, I'd suggest going somewhere that they actually appreciate your patronage.

This restaurant is so awful that the first thing I thought about upon waking up on Saturday morning was writing a condemning Yelp review about it.

It's a familiar story at this point; we arrived around 8 p.m. with intentions of eating at Sunset and were diverted to Patron's.  It wasn't until around 9:40 that we were actually served our food.  I had to ask, as other unfortunate Patron's patrons have had to, for the shockingly meager serving of chips and salsa we were given to tide us over about an hour after we ordered.  Finally, four of six dishes came out at the same time (one of which was not what my friend had ordered), and we all picked off of our plates and waited until the remaining two dishes were served- one of them, the fajitas, incomplete and served in installments.

We were finished eating and very ready to leave, but as you probably suspected, it took forever for us to get the check and another seemingly eternal stretch of time before our server actually picked it up.  If you want to go to Patron's for dinner, I'd suggest going while you're still eating lunch.  And don't get too excited about your post-dinner plans, because you'll miss them.

The manager came over as we were getting ready to leave and asked how everything was.  When I told him that, "Honestly, it took forever," he apologized, made some excuses, and told me that "next time, we'll do something for ya."

Ha!  Next time.  At least he had a sense of humor.

Here's what my boyfriend had to say about this experience:

"I was at this table as well, and agree that this was the worst service I have ever received at a restaurant, with little to no apologies to top it off.  It was almost as if it were our fault for deciding to get dinner on a Friday night...
What enraged me the most was when a table of 6 sitting right next to us arrived at least 30-45 minutes after we sat down, was served their food BEFORE us, got their check BEFORE us, and paid and left while we were still waiting for our plates to be cleared.  
They never offered to wrap our leftovers, never apologized for the almost 2 hour wait, and included the tip into our check, which added insult to injury.  The food was okay-at-best, and cannot compete with their sister restaurant Sunset.  As others have mentioned, the servers were not rude, but extremely inattentive.  Toward the end of the night (since we didn't get to leave until almost 11:30pm!) I noticed more staff members running around than during the dinner rush.  I wondered if someone had gone downstairs, told the Sunset crew to throw on Patron's shirts, and help clean up the disaster upstairs.  Perhaps these issues are "growing pains" but they should cut into the owner's bottom line for the first year, not ruin the customer's night.

Food: 2.5/5
Decor: 3/5
Service: 0/5"

Terrible service and unsanitary conditions. I watched the cook blow his nose in his armpit and then reach into the oven to grab my meal..More over, our bartender singled out a young woman who had been over served (by her) for a questionable decision, which was disheartening and literally heart breaking to watch. I expected more and got less. This is the last time I support this business and I encourage you to think twice about spending hour hard earned money here.

As a long term customer of this location I'm sad to have to leave.  My dog, who does not like the vet got along great with an exceptional vet at this location, who was amazing with him.  However after my most recent interaction with their "Chief Of Staff" Dr. Thompson, I'll be taking my business elsewhere.  She not only belittled myself and my wife on the phone, but continued to call back and leave an extremely sarcastic and snarky message after the fact.   Very unprofessional and am having my pets files transferred out immediately.  If this is the caliber of person running this location it makes me question every procedure that has ever been performed on my pets, its really a shame someone like this is in charge of the facility.

Edit 10/5 - User  "L.D. " who created an account and has posted one review to all of Yelp  combatting my review clearly is an inside job, as they seem to be more familiar with the situation at hand than was disclosed in my previous post.  This reflects directly on the lack of professionalism I experienced at this  location.

I can't tell if this is a front for something else or if I have the worst luck in the world, but I've been trying to stop by this shop since December 2019 and it has been closed each and every time I've visited. Today was the last straw - I visited at 12 pm when their website said they were open 10 to 3 and Yelp said they were open 11 to 3, and they were once again closed. The good reviews made me want to visit but it's time for me to seek out a business that is open when it says it is.

Worst experience ever. New customer. My old dentist retired and didn't notify me. Had emergency. Tooth severely cracked. Can't eat. Called them. They cheerfully told me they could get me in and take care of it today. So I stopped calling other places. (It's Friday). I sit in waiting room for 1 hour. Then they come do X-rays. 5 minute exam with dentists. Tells me what my options are and she will drill out cavity and do crown. I'm very phobic so I've been sweating bullets. She tells me how she will numb it and walks out. Her asst comes back to go over the root canal (what!) charges. I say root canal here; now?  No she says. When you come back. I say what do you mean come back?  She says well were much to busy to treat you today so we can see you Tuesday. We can't treat everybody that comes in with emergency. (Did I say I can't eat?). And that was that. Very misrepresented just to get you in the door and enrolled. Not one person introduced themselves. Not even the doctor. They were sorry for the misunderstanding. I did not misunderstand ANYTHING. Terrible.

I typically Love Pluckers but had an awful experience at thus location right off the bat. Given we had a new waitress that played the biggest role in our horrible experience. In short, our orders were incorrect, which caused our food to come out late. The whole dining experience was a little over an hour. Then on top of that our $150 tab didn't even get put onto my rewards card! This was awhile back and I do hope this location has a well run staff now.

Food was okay, but the restaurant is filthy, I was there 2 days, first day the service was a bit slow but the food came out, and there wasn't much of a crowd in the house. we were a party of 6 and chose what we wanted went upto the cashier and placed the order and paid upfront got a number and came back to sit on our table, than slowly after 10-15 mins food started to come out.  It's casual dining, tables are sticky not cleaned or wiped down, floors were sticky, I could see the boot prints on the floor.  But mind you I didn't care because we were hungry, as long as the food was edible, that's all we cared about.  

Second day we go in again, try new things but in the same price range my bill came out $15 more.  My bill was $100 a day before and $114, $15 is nothing but the fact they added that because we were a party of 6.  They didn't add that a day before but second day all of a sudden rules had changed.  "we charge gratitude for 4+ people" are they for real? for what? you don't give anything to your workers, because the day before, before we were leaving my husband gave the wait staff tip, which they were surprised and happy about.  You don't seat us properly, tables are in set of 4 seats, 6 of us sat at 2 different tables both days, you don't come to us and take our order, you don't welcome us when we enter the restaurant. the food isn't great, the service is mediocre, but you want gratitude?!?  when we said we are not happy and don't want to pay gratitude, he goes than leave, I want to see you go to another restaurant and see if how they wont charge you gratitude for 6 people.

Hey wake up!!! we eat 80% of the time out side during the summer.  all the big chains, seafood, italian, even indian/desi food with your type of restaurant ambiance don't charge up front for the food!  and charge gratitude on top of that!

Really is a disgusting place and sad to see people like that.

Unprofessional and frustrating! I went for a blow dry and asked for volume and movement that framed my face....an hour later, my hair came out stick straight! My stylist paid no attention to anything I wanted. When I asked her to fix it, she charged me for the half hour she spent FIXING what I asked her to do in the first place! She also charged double what was promised when I called in before making an appointment, as they did not mention their prices are "starting," and then did not take responsibility for this mistake. In the end, I paid $80 to have my shoulder-length hair straightened - and not even in the way I had desired. This place went against all common courtesy and ethical business practice. Ridiculous. I will never return here again, and have made sure to tell my friends the same!!

I always come to this place every two weeks. I like the service, however this place needs to be on one accord when it comes to pricing. 4 weeks ago, while one of the nail techs were doing my nails she tried to upcharge me for a fill in saying it's $3 to change the color. I felt like she was trying to haggle more money out of me thinking I am stupid. So I basically informed her that it is included in a fill in. She basically caught on that I wasn't the one to mess with. Two weeks ago on September 6, 2018 I had ONE broken nail and needed a gel fill in. I decided to go out my comfort zone and do a nice pretty ombre. With a gell fill in and ombre I paid $45. There are alot of price discrepancies in this nail shop. I paid $40 today for ONE color gel fill in. Now a gell fill in is $20 according to the GORGEOUS NAILS pricing in the shop, so what I am trying to figure out where the extra $20 came from. The nail tech's English was supbar and I felt stolen from. My nails are average length, and it only looks long because of its almond shape but a gell fill in should include shape up, etc. So where is the extra $20 coming from?? $40 gell fill in is more than a full gel set for ONE COLOR. I tried giving you guys the benefit of the doubt but this consumer will consume somewhere else. If you're going to run a nail shop let all the prices be on one accord and stop letting nail techs upcharge just because.

I have gone to this place twice now. The first time went I had bought a groupon. While they were a little late taking my car in, and it took about 25 minutes longer than they said it would, I would have still rated it 4/5. The lady at the front desk was super sweet, bringing me home cooked curry to eat while I waited. So I went back. They honoured the groupon price without me having to purchase another groupon- great. Same lady, same food- great. Late taking my car in and more than 45 minutes longer than they said it would be- not so great. But the reason for the 1/5 rating is because I realized after this last oil change that the sticker they put on my windshield to tell me when I needed another oil change was for 5,000km. For a synthetic oil change, this should have been at least 8,000. So I called to tell them, and to ask if they could see if the same thing had happened with my last sticker, and sure enough, they had written 5,000 after the first one. This means that I bought another oil change at least 3,000km early, and only 3.5 months after my last oil change. I explained my frustration to the guy, and non-chalantly he suggest he could "throw in a tire rotation or something next time to make it up". I think you can say that the first time was a mistake (forgot it was synthetic), but doing it twice certainly makes me think they are being dishonest, assuming most people wouldn't notice (I didn't- it was my husband who did). Anyways...I don't usually review places, but I feel like this was pretty disappointing, and maybe others who have had their oils changed by these guys should also double check the math so that you don't waste your money too! Rant over.

This Institute is a joke and the staff rude, the "so-called" dr is completely incompetent, and him or his staff left a sticky note on my Dads records when we tried to go elsewhere that stated "Do Not Accept This Patient". Unprofessional and absolutely uncalled for.

To all the low star reviewers out there, he has another Yelp page you can review. I suggest we copy our review or add anything new we've found to it and help me contact Yelp about his other page so they can leave this con artist nowhere to hide.

This man and his staff need to go far from here or get out of practice. Nothing but trouble getting meds or trying to get out of their care. HORRIBLE!

This location is a bit of a paint in the ass no real bus access and the walking distance is a bit much, just try not to get hit by cars crossing. Think of it as a live action version of frogger.....but with more risk. The store is organized, however, what annoyed me what the lack of customer service and the condescending attitude that I received from one of the clerks. I am not a home improvement guru which is why I asked for help. Attitude was totally not appreciated and walked out of there for nothing and had a sandwich instead at the subway.

I used to use this Target when I lived downtown in 2014 and 2015, and I never had a bad experience back then. Fast forward to 2019, and my experience yesterday was that the place was crawling with transients and homeless, you could barely get in the door due to the groups of people gathered there, and the entire store smelled like urine and feces. I was happy that I'd at least called ahead and put my stuff on hold before I'd come in - I just needed soap and was thrilled to not have to spend time walking around the place. Of course, after I checked out, I realized that I'd been charged $2 more per bar of soap than had been advertised on the Target website (that's 50% more than had been advertised on the website - for an item that wasn't on sale). What?! I'll be taking advantage of Target's price matching policy to get my money refunded, but I'll be doing so at a different location. Unless I'm supremely desperate, I don't see myself stepping foot into this Target again. I felt unsafe and was totally grossed out by the smell, which permeated everything.... I didn't want to touch anything while I was there, either. Positively disgusting. I would give this location zero stars if I could. Target management and oversight, where are you, and do you even care about the experience of your paying customers? Appalling.

Horrible customer service in the service department.  I waited over 2.5 hours for what I was told would be a 45 minute oil change.  Mind you, I made an appointment to avoid any issues.  I didn't get so much as an apology and only a pathetic explanation that they were "backed up"  and wouldn't even have time to do a recall on my truck.  Common courtesy should have given me a choice to reschedule or wait.  Sadly, NOBODY thought it was necessary to provide apology or explanation ahead of time.  I will not be back.

We are repeat guests at the resort, but haven't been in a couple of years. We reserved a 1 bedroom villa, and checked in to the resort. Front desk agent was average on a friendliness scale, allowed us to check in at 3pm, which was appreciated. Then he gave us our keys and said we had to go to a desk behind him for a parking pass. PLEASE be warned, this is a high pressure timeshare presentation desk. We were harassed for 5 minutes and after repeatedly saying no that we weren't interested we eventually were given the parking pass and left to go to our room. 

When we got to our room, the room was in the same building as the reception. And the room was really dark, and the bed was right next the the front door to the room. The room was extremely noisy and you heard everything going on in the hallway (this was with hotel staff attempting to be quiet). And there was a loud banging noise coming from the room's utility closet. We would expect this from a $40 a night hotel down the street, but not from this type of hotel.

So, we brought these items to the front desk's attention and asked to move rooms and to have a different room layout where the bed wasn't directly next to the door. The front desk agent said she didn't have a different room layout to offer but could offer a 2 bedroom villa, but it would be at an extra cost and could not waive the upcharge fee. She was very nice about it and explained she didn't have the authority to waive the fee. We then asked for a manager, and out came Danny, a completely useless management team member. We explained to both employees we have been here several times and have been in different building and it had been fine, and we've never had any issues. Danny's solution provided was to downgrade our room to a studio (a cheaper room, with no refund given) and the room had two beds when we reserved a room with a king bed. He said he could put us in a 2 bedroom but couldn't waive the fee. We explained that we're only two people and we don't even need the 2nd bedroom, we just want a comfortable place to sleep. He just didn't seem, to care, and that's a disgrace for an employee in the hospitality industry. We eventually had to pay the upgrade to the 2 bedroom because he didn't care and we were so tired from driving all day, and couldn't go to another hotel at the last minute. Once we got to the room, the room was very nice, but it wasn't worth it. There's too much competition in the area. Pick somewhere else, we're not coming back. This hotel lost loyal customers over this issue.

My husband and I went here prepared to buy a new car. The salesman was very nice until he realized we were going to buy a base model car. His initial offer was a good bit higher than those of other Subaru dealerships in the area and as soon as we tried to request a lower price based on other offers we had, he turned rude. He was pushy to get us to buy at that moment and when it became clear we were not going to buy he walked away from us without a word.

First time ever visiting this hotel. And we were so excited to have been able to come and stay here after they renovated it, our car got broken into while sleeping including over 30-40 other cars. No security as they say they have wondering the lot to ensure this doesn't happen, when asked to speak to a manager of course the only thing she told me was she was sorry this happened and didn't really care. When asked to at least compensate for the night for this happening she flat out said no I asked to find a place where we can get this fixed not even that. Parking fee wasn't much we are from Miami this was a birthday vacation for my 6 yr old daughter who both my kids were so upset they cried!!! Out of the many times I've been to Orlando we have stayed in all sorts of different hotels including Disney resorts which I will definitely stay in next time. I will never spend a dime at this place again. NOT WORTH THE HASSEL. room maid Maria Carmen was the only positive thing that came out of this place she was helpful and amazing!!!!

This place has been here for several years now, and even though I live in the same town, I've never really eaten there. There were a few times when I did if I was in the plaza though. However, I do remember those few times being good: the food was delicious, nothing wrong! Until last year.

They must have gotten new management because when I went here for the first time in a long time, they had some new items, like the fried bananas (plantains) and "bbq" chicken wings (which is basically the wings covered in that red sauce that's paired with krab ragoon). While their sesame and general tso chicken were lacking, their "bbq" chicken was delicious. My brother and I, for a while, got that; we went there 4 or 5 times. Meanwhile my mom would get the original fried wings with fried bananas. Then suddenly the quality got worse and worse.

We noticed they weren't really frying their wings all that well. They constantly switched between sweet fried bananas and the salty ones without telling customers. They started putting less of the red sause on the chicken so then you'd end up with oddly textured fried wings with a dried coat of sauce.

Then one day, they got our order wrong. We ordered 2 "bbq" chicken wings with french fries and 1 order of the original fried ones with salty fried bananas. SOMEHOW we ended up with 3 orders of normal wings and sweet bananas. We drove all the way back just for the guy to hand us a cup of red sauce and to tell us they had no more of the salty fried bananas. Oh, the chicken looked weird. 

Never went back.

Awful on my 3rd experience. I took my work suv twice before for quick clean up wacky Wednesday special, no big deal I just need it the dust off, but when I took my 2015 vehicle for a similar quick clean up so I can hand wax it at home while vacuuming the car found grease like at the door so I point out to manager he quickly responded what would I expected for a $5.00 wash, I was only getting cheap soap and water...

The customer service at this store is awful-at the management level. Management has a negative attitude. I went to return a shirt with a spot on it from the hanger that still had tags on it and they refused to take the shirt back. They have a very strict return policy because their clothes are so cheap. I highly discourage anyone from shopping here.
They also told me they couldn't return my shirt because they didn't have enough cash in their drawer. Some of the worst customer service I have ever experienced,

Probably the most overrated seafood place I've ever been to. It used to be worth the ride, talk about going downhill. The clams which they used to be famous for were fried in burnt oil, the French fries were probably fried in the same manner.  The line was long and service was slow . You would think there would be more complaints but with most of the people in the area are stoned on weed how would you know any better. This place sucks.

I have UHC community plan and was told they accepted my insurance. I called and made an appointment and was turned away saying they didn't take it. I called UHC and they reassured me that they did. It took 9 months later for me to finally get in to see them because in NOV 2020 all the sudden they accepted it. I found it odd that in NOV right before Thanksgiving dinner and Christmas dinner they want to finally pull my teeth and give me dentures.....A better class of people must not want work done in those months,? maybe???? 
I'll pass----you cant save us welfare insurance folks for the last 2 months of the year! I would NOT recommend and SHAME ON THEM!  
NO STARS WASN'T an option!

Maybe we just had a bad waitress, but the experience turned me completely off to this place. We ate on a Friday morning,  and it was fairly busy.  We ordered one country omelet to split, an english muffin and a side of bacon.  We waited and waited, seeing others order and receive their food that had arrived after us.  After seeing our plate reach the window, it sat there for 10 minutes, as the waitress kept passing it, lazily filling coffee and chatting with other tables. She finally approached the plate, touched the gravy with her dirty fake fingernail, told the line cook it was cold, so he added another scoop of gravy. So the plate arrives, with a crusty gravy layer covered with a hot gravy layer. You couldn't even see the plate. Needless to say, I was majorly grossed out.

The moral of the story is; yes portions are huge but if you care about food safety, or receiving good customer service, venture elsewhere!  Or avoid the tired waitress with the 1980s bleach blonde hair and disgusting food handling habits.

I went into this "spa" for the second time to get a mani and Pedi. The tech was quite rough with me, and was trying to cut my cuticle on my feet VERY deep. At one point I felt a shooting pain up my foot and asked her to be more gentile, which she really didnt listen. Ive had MANY pedicures in my life and never had someone digging around like that! I went home later and my big toes were red and hurt. I woke up the next morning and they were even angrier than the night before, after working my shift I had to visit the emergency department since I couldnt event touch my toe without crying. Needless to say I had to have my toe abcess cut open, take antibiotics for a week, and then culture came back as a STAPH INFECTION. Id suggest not visiting this place unless you want to visit the hospital too.

OMG how many times do they -icky up an order..... for delivery.? Well I'll tell you almost 50 percent of the time. Either missing food I paid for or going to the wrong location. Also can I at least ask for someone to speaks English...... always a hard time with me not understanding them or visa Versa.....
So frustrating!!!  Now stuck waiting another 45 minutes to come back and deliver missing food.  They are terrible after all these years ... fire the person and replace with someone who can do the job.

It was freezing cold...

Half of the restaurant is located outside.  Normally, that would be plus, except we ate there in January.  They basically covered the outdoor seating area with a tarp (it had holes in it) and had heating lamps.  The inside of the restaurant was full, and even though we had reservations, they sat us outside.  The heating lamps did absolutely nothing and we wore our jackets the entire meal.  

The food was also very mediocre.  As you walked by the kitchen, you could see vats of each pasta and sauce type which they used to make the meals.  We have been to five restaurants in the North End and they have all been amazing...this was awful.

My boyfriend and I ordered from Great Chow about a week or two ago because our usual Chinese place is closed in the pandemic. It was fantastic and arrived quickly. So tonight we ordered from them again, and waited. And waited, and waited...and waited. We tried calling them almost 10 times and no one answered. The phone just kept ringing. No food and a pending charge on my credit card I now have to wait to be finalized so I can dispute it. A really great way to end a nearly 10 hour work from home day. Never ordering from here again.

Employees seem friendly to talk to, but they rip you off. A $20 oil change turned into $93. Brought my car in for a simple oil change and tire rotation, called me 30 minutes later. I thought my car was ready, then they told me air filter needs to be changed, battery needs to be cleaned, otherwise battery will die. I mean on a two year old car? Does that make sense? I just went with it, $70 extra for a peace of mind. What else can a person do when shop tells them their car will break!? I only hope they have the basic ethics to not purposely break my car. I will not be coming back here.

Had gone here once with no issues but on my returning trip is when it all started. I picked a polish that seemed to almost be down to the end and I'm assuming older than the rest. Had an issue with the gel bubbling up 3 times on my thumb which I don't believe was the nail artists fault at all. It was nearing closing time and we decided that it was less noticeable with a shiny topcoat even though the rest were matte. We left it at that because it was around 15 minutes after closing time but I was never told that I could come back if it still bothered me. I called and they got me in the same day which was nice. 

Once I arrive, I am asked what number the color was... as I am not a nail artist I didn't have the nail color memorized so I let them know it was the forest green of which there was only one on the swatch so I figured that would be helpful. I was told "there are a bunch of forest greens, I will go find it" in a negative tone. This is from a different nail artist as my previous one wasn't in. I am sat down and she fixes the nail with not a lot of issues. All is good or so it seems lol. 

The next day, a whole separate nail has chipped for no reason as I have an office job and not one with much manual labor. I call again to schedule another repair for the new nail. This is all within 3 days. A gel mani should last a minimum of 2 weeks... so they get me in right away (nice) and I come in to find they are out of the color I had on this new nail. We pick a color close to the last. She fixes this nail super quickly and I leave. 

Within a few hours of this repair, I g the same chip. I don't even bother calling or going back because of the way I was treated the past two times as if they were annoyed I was back for them to fix their errors. I had to pay 3 times for parking in the short north (which is not easy to find btw) with not one apology or discount offered for my next service. 

If this had been a $30 gel mani elsewhere I would expect this but not at a seemingly upscale nail salon such as W nail bar.

I am saddened by the end results today.  The sales department was very professional and very helpful in getting us a loaner car as we were told that it would be 4 or more hours before our Jeep was done with service.  But THAT is an entirely different story.  


Mike Orcutt - what the heck?  You and I shared emails. You personally spoke to my husband - yet the Jeep is still NOT fixed the way we wanted it and the way you promised it would be.  

We do appreciate that the parking brake was fixed.  We do appreciate the transmission fluid being added.  We do appreciate the thought of rotating the tires.  But I have a few questions:

Why after being there for 2 hours were we told it would be another 3-1/2 to 4 hours before Jeep would be ready as they had to disassemble part of it to look at transmission (we asked that it be looked at since it was difficult to put in reverse).  Do you remember that conversation?  We were offered a loaner car since told it would be 3-4 more hours for repairs to be done.  We got loaner car and within 45 minutes we were called by Wes saying the Jeep was ready for pickup?  Huh?  When Wes called me back after I had to call you he stated that they could not look at the transmission today as they do not have a transmission repair person on the weekends?  Then why the heck were we told it would take another 3-4 hours to have it looked at and fixed?   We would not have asked for a loaner if it were only another 45 minutes to wait.  And why were we NOT told this when we asked them to look at the transmission when we brought it in?  

Here is where it gets serious...  

After they rotate tires, do they balance the tires?  Do they check the tires?  The answer is no.    Please tell me why on the way home today I had to pull off the highway and check the tires as every time I apply the brakes the Jeep pulls harshly to the right?  And why does the front end shake when I hit 50 MPH?  It has never done this before.  

It took me an hour to get home as I had to exit the highway and use side streets to get home in fear of losing a tire or not being able to control the Jeep over 50 MPH due to the horrific shake and shimmy?  Would you want your family to drive something like this?  Would you drive a vehicle like that?  NO?  Then why should I?  I thought about turning around and bringing Jeep back to y'all to fix but figured your would only mess it up more and I do not trust your staff at all to do anything right.  

We had plans on going out to meet friends Saturday night.  DId we go?  NO!  WHY?  We were afraid to drive the Jeep.  

We will be taking the Jeep somewhere else for the 5 tires we need.  We will be taking the Jeep somewhere else for the transmission that we EXPLICITLY told them to look at --- and all we got was fluid.  Well, I guess that is better than nothing. 

I am truly disappointed in our return trip today especially since you and I had emailed each other and even more so since you spoke personally to my husband.   Yes, I believe in maintenance on vehicles and have a passion for keeping our only vehicle in good running condition - we kind of need it to get to work.  

One recommendation - get your staff either hearing aides or teach them to LISTEN to the customer when we come in with concerns.  Not just hear us, but LISTEN to us. 

So, yes, another whole Saturday, Saturday night and now Sunday shot to hell!  Due to your staff NOT doing their job the right way yet a second time.  

What can you tell me you will be doing to fix this?

Remember, I work for an international company and deal daily with customer care all day long.  I can read and smell customer care poop an ocean away.  LITERALLY.  Right now, I am smelling cow poop from Landmark Service Department.  Maybe take a lesson from Sales Department on professionalism and listening skills? 

Hope you have a wonderful rest of the day and hoping that you serve other customers a whole lot better than you did us.  

Nuf said.

I haven't written a one star hotel review in my life. I consider myself a positive reviewer in general. But I swear to you my stay at the Disney Swan was more a prison sentence than a holiday.

Check in: They did not have the room I had reserved. I was put in an overflow room on a floor that stunk of mildew and no daylight. They eventually moved me the next day to the room I reserved facing the boardwalk.

Room: My room was covered in mold, and anything with metal fittings was rusting. Gross would be describing it kindly. When I called and asked to be moved to a different room the front desk acted like I should have been grateful to even have a room because they were overbooked. I asked about being moved to a different hotel and they said that it was not an option. When I escalated the manager (whom I spoke to more often than I've ever spoken to any hotel manager in my life) offered me a $75 credit which I could not care less about because I'm staying here for work and my company is picking up the tab. I explained that it was worth more to my company for me to be well rested and healthy than to save that money on my room. She said that she would look into it and never got back to me.

Starting on my second day they started doing construction with power tools on the room directly above me because, as I learned later, their balcony had broken. Once again, a call to the front desk yielded nothing and the manager came back with her $75 credit offer, but she said they couldn't stop the maintenance people and if I would like to leave my room for a few hours they should be done when I got back. This is where I started to feel like a prisoner. They won't swap my room, they won't move me to a different hotel, and I can't leave because I have a presentation due in a couple of hours.


Staff: I don't know if this is where Disney puts its rejected greeters or what but nobody here is nice.I see a lot of reviews referring to nice staff, I find that to be the exception rather than the rule. Every time I talk to anyone they act like I'm bothering them.

Awful. If you got a great deal and you're here for Disney parks then it's probably fine because you won't be spending much time in your room, though I worry about your kids' health with all this mold and mildew. Make sure your kids are up to date on their tetanus shots.

I recently had a very disturbing experience at this particular Walgreen's. My intention was to leave my car safely in the parking lot for a couple of hours until I could travel to Worcester, deliver the eulogy and return. By the time my ride arrived, it was beginning to get a little on the late side, but I felt getting the manager's permission to park in a corner of his lot would be the right thing to do, so I went in, asked for a manager, was directed to a young lady to whom I told my story and the urgency which I was now beginning to feel to get on the road. She told me she would have to speak to a store manager and left to do just that. I first signed my lease when Alta At the Estate was in charge of the property in 2014. They were an amazing company that put the comfort and safety of their residents first. Ultimately, since Bell Watertown has taken over there have been continuous short comings. This should be abundantly clear by the number of staff that has gone in and out of the leasing office over the course of their time here-not to mention the maintenance man that was physically removed on the property by the other maintenance man in front of residents. 

Maintenance requests are consistently not addressed, even after one month, and a variety of calls to the office. This includes requests to fix the washer and dryer that is included in the rent. I initially called on December 23rd and have yet to hear (January 26th) back from a member of the maintenance staff. In addition, the other requests made includes safety orders like changing a filter and checking the stove after 7 years. Furthermore, there is mold. 

The biggest issue, however, is not the appearance or upkeep of the property, but the management team both locally and globally. The lack of response, and clear lack of respectful and kind communication does not match the price tag to live here. Further, I was threatened by another resident in the gym, and asked the management staff to address this. Rather than addressing it, apologizing for not coming down the hall into the gym when contacted about it, or even showing any semblance of empathy or compassion, I was answered with a letter from a lawyer. The letter stated that I made an accusation that is completely false, and there is no basis to back this up. In addition, instead of taking this as an opportunity to reassure a resident of their safety, it was used to twist my words, accused me of things I did not do, and tell me to incur unnecessary legal costs as a result of poor management.

Ultimately, as I have over the past 7 years, I will likely stay solely because of the convenience factor and that this is my home and has been since 2014. However, I know that by deciding to re-sign with Bell Watertown, I will ultimately be charged hundreds of dollars more than newer residents and continue to receive zero updates or maintenance checks in my apartment as new residents do. If you think loyalty is appreciated here, I urge you to note that it is punished instead. If you are looking for an apartment complex that treats you with respect and dignity, please do yourself a favor and continue looking.

We never had lost packages on any of our previous shipping providers.  When we are shipping 500 orders a month with NG, 5% is too high.

I purchased a Groupon for a dolphin/manatee tour in July 2014. My Groupon ended up being about $40.00 for 2 people. I was a little thrown off by the additional charge of $3.00 to park on their grassy patch upon arrival, but at that point I didn't have a choice. The tour was 2 hours long, but in reality, it took about 20 minutes to get to the island and back, so you had just over an hour on the island. As well, they throw in an additional surcharge of $7.20 for gas. Nice. And no water is provided on the boat for guests, so be prepared to bring your own.
The web-site indicates that the island is 'remote'; however, the island sits right next to highway 528, so for the more adventurous, you could park your own car on the side of the road and paddle over with a canoe or kayak. The island is also situated next to a bridge, so boats are frequent passerbys. 
We were fortunate however, to see a couple of manatees in the distance and 1 dolphin. The island itself is small and nice, but it dismisses the rural field as you are near boat and street traffic. In fact, in the distance you see all of the Disney cruise ships, which may be nice for some folks to see. 
What bothered me most though, is that it was expected that you tip the captains. I used to be a tour guide, so I understand and respect the idea of tipping and always do that. On the confirmation email by the company, they expect you to tip on the 'full' amount of the tour, not the groupon amount. For me, I was expected to tip $18.00. I almost choked. It was expected that I pay a captain $18.00 for driving me 20 minutes to the 'island', leaving me there with a tour guide on the island, and then they pick us up later and drive us back. Granted, the captains provide us with a bit of information, but they certainly did not earn an additional $18.00, on top of the costs snuck in by the company. In fact, if anyone deserved a tip it was the tour guide on the island who actually spent time with us and gave us information on the manatees and their habitat. 
Overall, I felt that I was mid-led and the company demanded more money from their custumers than they were upfront about.
I would not recommend this company to anyone.
